pages.title: Pulsed Magnet Lab
pages.text: A coil of Bitter plates and a room of capacitors dumped into it: a field of up to a hundred tesla, for a few milliseconds.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the turns, the current and how long the pulse lasts. The field is B = μ₀NI/L. Every storey adds copper and cooling to the coil. All that current heats it (ΔT ∝ NI²t/size) - past 400 K it melts - and past 100 T the magnetic pressure tears it apart.

pages.title: Pulsed Magnet Lab
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Magnetar Crust Fragment, Magnetic Monopole, Magnetite, Samarium-Cobalt Magnet.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

A current makes a magnetic field. Around a long straight wire it circles the wire, and its strength falls with distance: B = μ₀I/(2πr). Ten amps give 40 µT five centimetres away - about the strength of the planet's own field.

The $(item)Gauss Meter$() reads the field where you stand: the planet's (25 to 65 µT in the Overworld, none in the Nether or the End) and any magnets near you (block tag $(thing)magnetic$(): lodestones, and more to come).

A changing field drives a current: spin a coil of N turns in a field B and it gives ε = NBAω·sin ωt. Every generator works this way. The iron core that guides the field is built from thin $(item)Electrical Steel Laminations$(), so the changing field cannot stir currents inside it.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): mined from Core Magnetite Ore in the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core); dropped by the Geodynamo Wraith (the Planetary Interior (Geodynamo Core)).

$(item)Magnetite$() comes from raw iron roasted with charcoal, or from the Spectrograph's radium assay. Pressed with clay and redstone it makes $(item)Ferrite Magnets$(): iron oxide that stays magnetised.

Iron is ferromagnetic because its atoms' spins line up by themselves - until a critical temperature, 1043 K for iron, shakes them apart. Above it the susceptibility is χ = C/(T − T_c). The item tag $(thing)ferromagnetic$() lists what a field pulls on, for the Magnetized effect to come.
Spin a coil in a magnet's field and it drives a current: ε = NBAω. With the same coil and load, the power goes as ε², so a magnet three times stronger gives about ten times the power.

The $(item)Induction Generator$() burns fuel to spin its coil. Put a magnet in its second slot - a Ferrite Magnet gives 24 FE/t, Samarium-Cobalt 180, Neodymium 250 - and flowing water beside it, like a water wheel, adds half again for every side.
A permanent magnet is set by a field stronger than its $(thing)coercivity$(), and keeps what it was given. Ferrite needs about 0.35 T, neodymium-iron-boron 1.2 T, samarium-cobalt 2 T.

The rare earths come from $(item)Monazite Sand$(), which the Spectrograph picks out of ordinary sand and separates into $(item)Rare Earth Oxide$(). Monazite carries a little thorium: it is weakly radioactive.
The $(item)Magnetizer$() gives 0.6 T from its coil alone. An iron core multiplies a coil's field: each block of iron (or any block tagged $(thing)magnetic$()) touching the Magnetizer adds 0.35 T.

Push a conducting fluid across a magnetic field and it becomes the armature of a generator: the field drives current across the flow, into $(item)MHD Electrodes$() on the channel walls. No turbine, no moving parts.

Power per cubic metre is p = σu²B²k(1 − k): conductivity, speed squared, field squared. The load factor k is the share of the voltage the outside circuit takes; one half gives the most - unless the current density, j = σuB(1 − k), would arc the electrodes away.
Brine conducts a little, magma a little less but the Interior has oceans of it, and $(fluid)Stellar Plasma$() conducts ten thousand times better. The pumps limit how fast a dense fluid can be driven.

A proton crossing a magnetic field circles, and how often it circles - $(thing)f = qB/2πm$() - does not depend on how fast it goes. Lawrence saw what that meant: put an RF voltage at that frequency across a gap, and the proton is kicked every half turn, spiralling out faster and faster in step.

Set the field B, then the RF to 15.25 MHz per tesla. At the edge, 0.75 m out, the beam has $(thing)E = (qBR)²/2m$(). But relativity: the faster it goes the heavier it is, its frequency drops, and over its hundreds of turns it slips out of phase. Past 90° the gap slows it instead. Tune a hair low to split the difference - the classical cyclotron runs out at about ten MeV.
Five MeV protons on iron make $(item)Cobalt-57$() (⁵⁷Fe(p,n)⁵⁷Co): the Pound-Rebka source, two at a time, without radium. Above 2.2 T the iron yoke saturates; more than 2 kW of beam melts the target.

Two circuits, each a capacitor and a coil, each ringing at its own frequency. Tune the primary to the secondary and energy sloshes across - and appears at a voltage higher by $(thing)√(C₁/C₂)$(): kilovolts in, megavolts out.

The secondary of the $(item)Tesla Coil$() rings at 159 kHz. Set the primary capacitance and where its spiral is tapped (inductance grows as the turns squared) so it rings there too; a few per cent off and most of the energy stays in the primary. In air an arc reaches about a metre for every 700 kV.

Its arcs fix the air's nitrogen into nitrates - the Birkeland-Eyde process that made the first fertilisers: water becomes bone meal. Arcs over 2.5 m fuse sand into glass, as lightning makes fulgurites: Fused Silica, without the Sun.
Stand well clear. A running coil strikes anyone within six blocks of it.
Maxwell's equations put electricity, magnetism and light into one theory: changing fields make each other, and a wave of field carries itself across empty space at $(thing)c = 1/√(μ₀ε₀)$().

The $(item)Laser Cutter$() cuts copper into $(item)Waveguides$() (microwaves along a pipe), $(item)Bitter Plates$() and $(item)Rail Armatures$(). A $(item)Faraday Cage Mesh$() keeps fields out - carried in the off hand it shields you from Decoherence. $(item)Mu-Metal$(), nickel-iron so permeable the field runs through it instead of you, does the same for being Magnetized.
$(item)Litz Wire$(), woven so every strand takes its turn at the surface, winds the coils of the Tokamak.
Steady magnets top out near 45 tesla. For more, dump a room of capacitors into a coil for a few milliseconds: $(thing)B = μ₀NI/L$().

The $(item)Pulsed Magnet Lab$() grows a storey for every stack of Bitter plates (1 to 7): more copper and cooling to soak up the pulse's heat (ΔT ∝ NI²t/storeys). Past 400 K the coil melts; past 100 T the magnetic pressure B²/2μ₀ tears it apart.
At 40 T it magnetises samarium-cobalt in bulk. At 80 T, with magnetar crust and cosmic ray shards, it searches for $(item)Magnetic Monopoles$() - and now and then, finds one.

In a strong field and the cold, the Hall resistance of a sheet of electrons sits on plateaus at $(thing)h/(νe²)$() - 25 812.807 Ω for ν = 1, exact to a part in a billion, because it counts a topological number. The Laser Cutter cuts $(item)Hall Bar Chips$() from silicon and gold.

A collapsing star keeps its magnetic flux: its field grows as $(thing)(R/r)²$(). A magnetar's is 10¹¹ tesla. Its crust, found in the Accretion Frontier's Pulsar Field, cracks in starquakes; Dirac showed a single magnetic charge would have to be a multiple of h/e.
Two rails and an armature between them: current up one rail, across, down the other. The field between the rails pushes the armature out with $(thing)F = ½L′I²$() - a railgun.

Set the current and the armature's mass. It leaves at $(thing)v = √(2FL/m)$() and strikes the target with a shock of about $(thing)½ρv²$(). Graphite shocked between 15 and 40 GPa becomes $(item)Lonsdaleite$(), hexagonal diamond, as in meteorite craters; sand and coal at 50-90 GPa fuse into moissanite. Each shot spends a Rail Armature. Above 3 MA the rails erode.

pages.title: Tesla Coil
pages.text: A resonant transformer: a spark-gap primary ringing in tune with a tall secondary steps a few kilovolts up to millions, and the toroid throws arcs metres long.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Tune the primary - its capacitance and the turns tapped - to ring at the secondary's 159 kHz. In tune, the voltage steps up as √(C₁/C₂) and the arcs grow a metre for every 700 kV. Stand clear: anyone within six blocks of a running coil gets struck.

pages.title: Tesla Coil
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Bone Meal, Fused Silica.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
I threw the Omnilex into the Quantum Foam. It shattered into everything I had ever made, and the pieces became a shape with too many directions. It asked me whether I understood.

It took me into itself - $(thing)the Living Proof$(), eight chambers, each a law that had to be understood before it opened. Then the proof melted, and it fought me as a creature, closing itself into questions twice.

It left me the $(item)Proof of Everything$(). With it and $(thing)Beyond the Omega$() researched, the Omnilex Engine can do the impossible - and open the way to the Transcendental. Dying in the proof costs nothing but the attempt.
What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omega Simulator$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Proof of Everything$(): Logos Thread, Omega Simulator
$(thing)Dimension data: The Living Proof$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 3 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Law$(): no attunement - it is the fight itself.

pages.title: Axiom Distiller
pages.text: The source code has a floor, and something lies beneath it. The $(item)Axiom Distiller$() boils reality down past its code to the axioms underneath, and condenses them into fragments.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.

What is an axiom? In mathematics, a statement accepted without proof - the bedrock every theorem is derived from. Change the axioms and you change what can be true. Holding a fragment of one is like holding a rule in my hand. It hums.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 3 fluid inputs, 2 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Infinity, Axiom Fragment, Crystallised Law, Primordial Law.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

pages.title: Axiomatic Breach Engine
pages.text: Note to self: this machine breaks every law of physics and mathematics at once. While it runs, step into its heart and you fall out of reality.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

Two ways through. Forge an $(item)Axiom Key$() here - it is reusable, and takes you to Hyperdimensional Reality Space and back. Or run $(thing)Open Breach$() and, while the engine runs, simply walk into its centre.
Inside, reality shatters into shards that each obey different laws. I took a step and the rules changed under my boots. I am still not sure which laws I was standing in.

pages.title: Axiomatic Breach Engine
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Axiom Key, Paradox Residue.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiomatic Breach Engine$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Axiom Key$(): Absolute Notes III, Axiom Key, Omnilex
The Reality Compiler showed that the universe runs on source code. Beneath the code are $(thing)axioms$() - the rules that decide what can be true at all. Physics is just their consequence.

Real mathematics agrees there are cracks. Godel proved any consistent system rich enough for arithmetic holds true statements it cannot prove; Russell found a set that both is and isn't its own member. The axioms are not as solid as they look.

So, the plan. To leave reality you must break all of them at once: build $(item)Aleph-Null Shards$(), the $(item)Godel Sentence$(), $(item)Russell Paradox Sets$() and $(item)Banach-Tarski Spheres$(), fuse them into $(item)Absolute Infinity$(), then distil $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and open the $(thing)Axiomatic Breach$().
The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
"This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Law Wraith.

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Aleph-Null Shard$(): Aleph Glass, Axiom Distiller, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Cantor Key, Conceptual Singularity Compressor and more$(li)$(item)Godel Sentence$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Distiller, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, Russell Paradox Set and more$(li)$(item)Russell Paradox Set$(): Absolute Notes III, Dimensional Residue, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, T...

$(thing)Dimension data: The Transcendental$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 11 spatial dimensions, time x1, true vacuum vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Identity Kernel$() - with it, Weakness and Mining Fatigue.
$(thing)Landmarks$(): Anomaly Vault Transcendental Expanse.
$(item)Omnipotent Edge$(): cuts through any armour and any invulnerability. Right-click erases the hostile creatures in front of you; sneak and right-click stops time around you.

$(item)Scepter of Singularities$(): right-click puts a singularity where you look. Sneak-right-click changes which: Black Hole (pulls in and crushes), White Hole (throws out), Tesseract (folds space - you are simply there), Entanglement (one strike, every linked foe), Big Bang (everything near the point at once).

The $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$() (Crown, Mantle, Greaves, Treads): each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.

The $(item)Ex Nihilo Engine$(): Defying Laws of Thermodynamics, creating energy from nothing, limitless. Over two billion FE every tick on every side, and it charges the energy items of everyone nearby.

The $(item)Lawgiver's Codex$(): open it and rewrite the place you stand in - its gravity, its time and weather, which creatures may appear and how strong they are; create creatures, or rewrite the one you were looking at. "Restore" puts the natural laws back.
The Omnipotence Core is not the end. Its $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$() destroys the Transcendental - and that is the way forward, not a loss.$(br2)What happens next, in order:

$(li)$(bold)The Sundering$(): the Core leaves $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(). The old machines turn shards into $(item)Omnipotence Dust$(), $(item)Apeiron Ingots$(), $(item)Pleroma Crystal$() and $(item)Logos Thread$().$(li)$(bold)The Rekindling$(): those build the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$(), the largest machine there is. Fed the Echo, it rebuilds the Transcendental.$(li)$(bold)The Forge$(): the reborn Core can $(thing)forge$() - by solving a simulated universe's constants of nature - what even Omnipotence could not simply make.

The last tier of materials, all forged at the reborn Core:$(li)$(item)Omnipotent Ingot$(), $(item)Crystal of Transcendence$(), $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), $(item)Eschaton Core$()$(li)the $(item)Omnipotent Edge$(), the $(item)Scepter of Singularities$(), the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$() and the $(item)Dodecaract Excavator$()$(li)the $(item)Ex Nihilo Engine$() (endless power), the $(item)Lawgiver's Codex$(), the $(item)Censer of Entropy$() and the $(item)Equilibrium Lattice$()$(li)$(item)Eschaton Cells$() - every endgame item runs on their charge$(li)and at the very end, an $(item)Omnipotence Core$() of your own, with the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() to tune, wake and move it.
Each of these has its own chapter, which opens as you get there: The Sundering opens the shards' chapters, The Rekindling to the Forge's.

pages.title: Cantor Diagonalizer
pages.text: Cantor's trick, built in brass: list every number, then build one that differs from the n-th at its n-th digit - a number on no list. It manufactures infinities, then bigger ones.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

It takes the computational power of a superintelligence and points it at infinity.$(br2)Odd result today: $(item)Banach-Tarski Spheres$() can be split and reassembled into two. In real maths that is a theorem, not a trick - the pieces are so strange that 'volume' stops applying to them.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 2 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Infinity, Aleph-Null Shard, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Continuum Shard, Godel Sentence, Hilbert's Hotel Key, Hypersphere Fragment, Inaccessible Cardinal, Ordinal Stone, Russell Paradox Set, Surreal Number.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.$(br2)Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Banach-Tarski Sphere$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Transfinite Casing

pages.title: Conceptual Singularity Compressor
pages.text: The $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$() takes whole stacks of everything a field of science has produced and compresses them into a single singularity of pure concept.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 6$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

Each recipe eats whole stacks: nine slots of a field's products plus three tanks. Nothing here waits on a timer - it only costs what it costs. I fed it a decade of lab notes and it handed me back one glowing point.

The Omniscience Catalyst is made in the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() from every singularity there is. Here, with cosmic neutronium or transfinite coils, catalysts are forged into $(item)Omnium$() in bulk - 128 catalysts and stacks of the late metals for one ingot, or 4 ingots from 128 with transfinite coils - with no 9x9 grid to fill by hand.

pages.title: Conceptual Singularity Compressor
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Cognitive Singularity, Dimensional Singularity, Eschaton Cell, Exotic Matter Singularity, Mathematics Singularity, Omnipotence Dust, Omnium Ingot, Quantum Singularity, Spacetime Singularity, Standard Model Singularity, Stellar Singularity, Temporal Singularity, Theory of Everything.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Every field ends the same way. The $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$() takes whole stacks of everything it produced and compresses them into a $(item)Singularity$().
One for each field: $(li)mathematics$(li)the Standard Model$(li)spacetime$(li)stars$(li)dimensions$(li)time$(li)quantum$(li)cognition$(li)exotic matter

Four singularities plus the field capstones constructs the $(item)Theory of Everything$() - the unified theory physicists have chased for a century, sitting on my bench. That, the other five singularities, Absolute Infinity and the Omega Point fuse into the $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$().
The catalyst and stacks of every late-game metal make the $(item)Omnium Ingot$() - and the $(item)Omnilex$() is forged from four of them. It costs everything, but nothing here waits on a timer.
Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().
All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).$(br2)
Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Mathematics Singularity$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Singularity, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction, Spacetime Bearing$(li)$(item)Omniscience Catalyst$(): Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence$(li)$(item)Omnium Ingot$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex and more$(li)$(item)Theory of Everything$(): Absolute Notes II, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst

The creative items of other mods (infinite chests, tanks, energy cells...) are no longer simply handed out by the Core, nor kept in the Transcendental's reliquaries - those now hold the controllers of the great machines of the endgame.$(br2)Only the rebuilt Core's $(thing)FORGE$() can make creative items, each from Eschaton Cores, Omnipotent Ingots, Absolute Singularities and Transcendence Crystals - and each needs its own universe tuned.

Pack makers: the Forge finds creative items by itself (a list of known ones, and any item whose id says "creative"). The item tag $(thing)theoreticalsciences:forge_only$() adds items the search misses - or late-endgame items to keep behind the Forge - and $(thing)theoreticalsciences:forge_exempt$() takes out ones it picked up by mistake.
A pickaxe in the shape of a twelve-dimensional cube. It mines anything a netherite pickaxe can, far faster, and never wears out - it spends Eschaton Charge instead.

Sneak and use it to change mode; sneak and scroll to change its reach, from 3x3x3 to 33x33x33.$(li)$(bold)Single$(): one block at a time - any breakable block, broken at once, with its drops, whatever slows you down.$(li)$(bold)Area$(): breaking a block breaks the whole cube reaching into the wall behind it. The drops come straight to you.

$(li)$(bold)Ore Extraction$(): use it on a block, or in the air to work around yourself. Every ore in the cube is pulled out into your inventory - with the tool's Fortune or Silk Touch - and the stone it grew in takes its place. The rest of the rock is left as it was.

It respects spawn protection and claims, and never takes unbreakable blocks or blocks with contents. Pack makers can add ores with the block tag $(thing)theoreticalsciences:excavator_ores$() and protect blocks with $(thing)theoreticalsciences:excavator_ignored$().
Forged at the rebuilt Core. Sneak-use to choose any harmful effect of any mod, its level (up to 255), how long it lasts (up to an hour) and the radius of its cloud.
Use it on a creature to lay the effect on it; use it in the air to leave a lingering cloud of it where you look, up to 48 blocks away.

Everything beyond Omnipotence now has to be kept that way. Every endgame tool, weapon and piece of armour holds $(thing)Eschaton Charge$() - shown as a bar under it and in its tooltip - and spends it as it works.

With none left an item is $(thing)dormant$(): the $(item)Omnipotent Edge$() is only a blade, the $(item)Scepter$(), $(item)Codex$(), $(item)Censer$() and $(item)Hand$() refuse to act, and a piece of the $(item)Raiment$() grants no protection. The Raiment drains while worn and for every blow it keeps away.
An $(item)Eschaton Cell$() holds 100,000. Use it and it fills every endgame item you carry or wear, emptiest first; what is left stays in the cell. Things come out of the Forge full.

Cells come four at a time from the $(thing)Core Forge$(), or one at a time from the $(item)Concept Compressor$(), which condenses them out of Pleroma with an Eschaton Core and a Rekindled Spark held as catalysts.

$(li)Edge: 20 a hit, 400 Erasure, 600 Stasis, 5 a kill$(li)Scepter: 150-1500 a singularity$(li)Codex: 500 a law$(li)Censer: 200 a touch, 400 a cloud$(li)Hand: 250 an action$(li)Excavator: 5 a block, 20 an ore$(li)Raiment: 1 a second, 10 a point of damage$(br)Creative players spend nothing.

pages.title: Eschaton Foundry
pages.text: A sphere of Pleroma glass on a waist of Omnipotence casing, ringed in Logos coil and watched by four towers. It packs as much as the laws allow into as little space as they allow - right up to the edge of becoming a black hole - and repeats what you once forged by hand.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Makes the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), $(item)Eschaton Cells$() and the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - but only what its owner has forged by hand in the Core's Forge at least once. It costs far more than the Forge, and there is no downtime between each craft attempt.

pages.title: Eschaton Foundry
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Singularity, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.$(br2)Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().
The end of all things, held still in a cage of Omnipotent metal. Every endgame artefact is built around one.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Absolute Singularity$(): Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core$(li)$(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark$(li)$(item)Eschaton Core$(): Eschaton Cell
Near the structures of impossible geometry - tesseracts, fractals, Calabi-Yau folds, event horizons - space itself bends on your screen. The $(item)Euclidean Anchor$() holds it flat.

Carry it anywhere in your inventory and use it to switch it on. While you are inside a distortion, the Anchor spends a little $(thing)Eschaton Charge$() to keep parallel lines parallel; outside one it spends nothing. An $(item)Eschaton Cell$() fills it again.
It is forged at the Omnipotence Core, from what the $(thing)Abnormality$() branch resolved.

The rebuilt Core does not simply make what lies beyond Omnipotence: it has to $(thing)simulate a universe$() in which the thing can exist. Its $(thing)FORGE$() page lists what it can forge and what that costs; beside it are the six constants of nature and six readings of the simulated universe.

Each recipe needs its own universe. Every constant moves one reading strongly and a few others a little, so tune them patiently: watch the bars, bring each to the middle. When all six are stable the recipe can $(thing)COMPILE$(). The Core remembers your settings while the game runs. JEI shows every Forge recipe.

Outside every universe there is a single, endless space. A $(thing)World Tree$() of an unknown material towers over it, uncountably tall at the very center.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in Hyperdimensional Reality.

Its branches spread for more than a thousand blocks in every direction, and every branch carries $(item)Bubble Universes$() - entire cosmoses, each the size of a fist. Break one to take a sample.$(br2)Eternal inflation predicts exactly this: pocket universes budding off a larger space. I never expected to pick one.

$(item)Arbor Heartwood$() does not behave normally. It drifts between four phases:$(li)dormant$(li)$(thing)inverted$() - gravity reverses for whatever stands on it$(li)$(thing)luminous$() - blazing light, and it hurries you along$(li)$(thing)unreal$() - no light at all, and things fall as if through syrup

Below the Tree lies the $(thing)Ocean of Primordial Law$(). Laws bubble up out of it and pop out of existence again; anything that swims in it obeys whichever law is in force at that moment. Despite being a fluid, one can breathe within this liquid Law itself.
The fluid can be distilled. The Ocean yields $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and $(item)Crystallised Law$().
Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().
An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.$(br2)Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Our understanding of Mathematics is built on these; thus in extention, so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and frozen before it could pop.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Arbor Heartwood$(): Arbor Heartwood Sample, Arbor Simulacrum, Hyperreal Cache, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine$(li)$(item)Bubble Universe$(): Arbor Simulacrum, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omnilex Seal, Panspermia Seed, Transfinite Lattice Bolt$(li)$(item)Axiom Fragment$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Crystallised Law, Paradox Residue and more$(li)$(item)Crystall$()...

$(thing)Dimension data: Hyperdimensional Reality$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 11 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Primordial Charter$() - with it, a new law every minute and a half.
$(thing)Landmarks$(): World Tree, Anomaly Vault Hyperreal Expanse.

The Omnium ingot is not hard because of one rare thing - it is hard because of $(thing)how much$() goes into it. The $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$() is a 9x9 crafting grid; JEI's "+" button fills it for you.

The $(item)Singularity Compactor$() swallows thousands of one material and squeezes them into a $(item)Material Singularity$(): 2,048 netherite, 8,192 diamonds, 65,536 redstone... There is no timer - it absorbs as fast as you (or pipes, or AE2) feed it, and remembers its progress.

Lattices of $(item)Cherenkov Lattice$() and nether stars make the $(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(). Four "everything" items take one of every meat, every crop, a ring of ender pearls, and every music disc.
Tallying the totals. The $(item)Omniscience Catalyst$() takes one of every material singularity, the conceptual singularities, the four everything-items and more - roughly 587,776 raw items each.

The $(item)Omnium Ingot$() needs 16 catalysts, 32 Cosmic Neutronium, 16 Crystalline Matrix and an Omega Point in the 9x9 table.$(br2)In bulk: with $(thing)cosmic neutronium coils$() the Conceptual Singularity Compressor forges one from 128 catalysts and stacks of the late metals; with $(thing)transfinite coils$(), 4 at a time from 128.
Made in a crafting grid.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.$(br2)Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.$(br2)Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Extreme Assembly Table$(): Autonomous Extreme Assembler$(li)$(item)Omnium Ingot$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex and more$(li)$(item)Cherenkov Lattice$(): Crystalline Matrix Ingot, Form of the Self$(li)$(item)Crystalline Matrix Ingot$(): Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Transfinite Weave$(li)$(item)Omniscience Catalyst$(): Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence
A small indulgence. Working miniatures on pedestals: black and white holes, a wormhole, a pocket universe, a tesseract, a pulsar, a galaxy, a quasar, a Dyson sphere and a penteract.

They are drawn live, not painted. The ones that bend light (black hole, white hole, wormhole, pulsar) are the heaviest - their tooltips warn you. Only the nearest two dozen are drawn at once, so my shelf of forty never melts the renderer.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

pages.title: Absolute Dossier
pages.text: The research record of a civilisation that is encroaching the complete understanding of its universe. Its cover is primordial law itself, so the book reads like a document from before the universe decided its rules. It weighs exactly what I expect it to, which unsettles me more than anything.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To build the Omnilex Engine I needed a machine that knew everything I did. I bound the three absolute volumes over the unified dossier with primordial law, and for the first time the Research Nexus had nothing left to ask me.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.

pages.title: Absolute Frame Casing
pages.text: A frame that keeps its shape whatever the laws around it do: the one fixed reference in a place where every other measure has come loose.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry.

pages.title: Absolute Infinity
pages.text: Cantor's absolute infinity: larger than every infinity, larger than any set that can be formed. By its definition, it should be beyond comprehension, and it cannot be conceived, yet here it is in my hand, without size or edge. Looking at it, my eyes slide off and I forget what I was counting.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Only the Omnilex Engine, simulating the World Tree and the Ocean of Laws together under a Primordial Law, could reach it. It added every infinity together and found one more on top. That was it.

Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes III, Absolute Singularity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot and more.

pages.title: Absolute Notes I
pages.text: The first of the final volumes: axioms, paradoxes, the Banach-Tarski sphere that doubles itself, and Godel's sentence that says it cannot be proven. It is a notebook about the foundations of thought, written by someone standing on them while they shake.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex required notes about the rules beneath the rules. I fed an axiom fragment, paradox residue, an axiomatic field emitter, a white hole fragment, a Banach-Tarski sphere and a Godel sentence into the line, and the first absolute volume came out signed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

pages.title: Absolute Notes II
pages.text: The middle absolute volume: crystallised law, a theory of everything, neutronium, the first uncountable cardinal, the E8 lattice and the Hopf fibration. It is where the most elegant structures I have found are set side by side, and it is beautiful in a way that makes me slightly afraid.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered the most symmetric things I had made - an E8 lattice, a Hopf fibration, aleph-one, a theory of everything and crystallised law - and bound them with neutronium. The Femtoscale line produced the volume that I now consider my best work.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

pages.title: Absolute Notes III
pages.text: The last volume of all: the axiom key, absolute infinity, pocket universes, axiom schemas, epsilon-naught and an inaccessible cardinal. It ends where mathematics itself ends. I read it once, closed it, and went for a long walk.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)For the closing volume I needed the largest objects I had ever handled - an inaccessible cardinal, epsilon-naught, absolute infinity - with an axiom key and an axiom schema to frame them. Pressed together with a pocket universe, they finished the record.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

pages.title: Absolute Singularity
pages.text: Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core.

pages.title: Aleph-Null Shard
pages.text: Aleph-null is the size of the set of natural numbers, the smallest infinity. This shard makes it solid: a crystal whose facets can be counted one by one but never finished. It is cool and clear, and every time I count its edges I lose track at a larger number.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I found one in a Hilbert Hotel, where every room was full and still had space. To make more, the Cantor Diagonalizer paired a Natural Number Lattice with its Power Set and a Superintelligence Core counted them.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Hilbert Hotel chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Aleph Glass, Axiom Distiller, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Cantor Key, Conceptual Singularity Compressor, Continuum Shard, Dimensional Residue, Godel Sentence and more.

pages.title: Amethyst Singularity
pages.text: Amethyst shards compressed into a single violet point. It rings softly when tapped, like a crystal bell, and the sound seems to come from all around. Purple light refracts out of it in all directions.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Amethyst grows in geodes and chimes when struck. Feeding enough shards into the Singularity Compactor, I crushed them into a single ringing point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Antimatter Singularity
pages.text: Antimatter compressed into a single point without touching any matter, which ought to be impossible. It holds an almost unimaginable amount of energy. It glows faintly and must never be dropped. It is kept in a magnetic cradle and checked on more often than strictly necessary.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Antimatter annihilates on contact, so compressing it took careful magnetic fields. The Singularity Compactor eventually crushed the pellets into one point without letting them touch anything.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Exotic Chemistry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Apeiron Ingot
pages.text: Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Logos Coil, Logos Thread, Omega Simulator, Omnipotence Casing, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Reconstitutor, Rekindled Spark.

pages.title: Arbor Heartwood
pages.text: The innermost wood of the Arbor, dense and pale, with rings that record not years but the branching of possibilities. Run a finger along the grain and it follows a different branch each time. It smells faintly of a vague rainy memory...$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in Hyperdimensional Reality.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Arbor's core wood is different from its outer planks; the rings branch rather than circle. I cut a block from near the trunk and found each ring recorded a choice the universe had made.

Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arbor Heartwood Sample, Arbor Simulacrum, Hyperreal Cache, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine.

pages.title: Arbor Heartwood Sample
pages.text: Wood from the World Tree, the structure outside every universe on whose branches universes grow. Its grain holds contradictory properties: warm and cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once. It smells faintly of rain in a universe that has yet to exist.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Carving a piece from the Arbor Heartwood with my own hands, I expected the tree to resist. It did not. The sample came away clean, and it has not stopped changing temperature since.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Evolution Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.

pages.title: Axiom Fragment
pages.text: A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on axioms that cannot be proven but must be assumed, and reality appears to be built the same way. This fragment holds one of those rules, and when I hold it, I feel very sure of something I cannot name.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Law Wraith.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Law Wraiths in the hyperdimensional reality drop these when they dissolve. In the Axiom Distiller, I learned to boil down a Primordial Law into its foundational assumptions and crystallise them.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Law Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Crystallised Law, Paradox Residue, Primordial Charter, Primordial Law, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum and more.

pages.title: Axiomatic Field Emitter
pages.text: A field emitter that projects not forces but Laws - a small region where a chosen axiom holds or does not. It is built on a graviton emitter with an axiom fragment, and it feels like holding a principle.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Axiom theory showed that axioms can be distilled and edited. I mounted an axiom fragment on a graviton field emitter with transcendent metal, a horizon shard and a transfinite processor, and the emitter began projecting law instead of force.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I.

pages.title: Banach-Tarski Sphere
pages.text: A solid sphere that can be cut into five non-measurable pieces and reassembled, by rotation alone, into two spheres the same size as the original. It relies on the axiom of choice, and the pieces have no well-defined volume. It is perfectly smooth and quietly unsettling.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, I used an Aleph-Null Shard to choose a point from each of uncountably many orbits on a sphere. The choice split it into pieces, and when I put them back I had two.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Banach-Tarski Sphere, Transfinite Casing.

pages.title: Blue Ice Singularity
pages.text: Blue ice compacted into a single point so cold it frosts the air around it. Normal ice melts; this does not. It is perfectly clear and blue, and slides across any surface with no friction at all. Water that touches it freezes instantly into perfect hexagons.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Blue ice is ice compressed until the bubbles are gone. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor gave me a single, freezing point that refuses to melt.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Bubble Universe
pages.text: A sphere of an entirely separate universe, nucleated out of the inflating vacuum and sealed off from ours. Inside it, the constants are slightly different. It floats in place and is faintly warm, like a tiny sun behind fog.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Eternal inflation predicts bubbles of other universes forming endlessly. I caught one at the moment it nucleated and found it would sit still in our world without expanding into it.

pages.title: Cherenkov Singularity
pages.text: Cherenkov quartz compressed into one point, glowing the electric blue of particles outrunning light in a medium. It flickers as if something inside is still moving faster than its own light. It is the light of a nuclear reactor pool, held in one hand.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cherenkov quartz glows blue where particles move faster than light can in it. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor focused that glow into a single brilliant point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Chronosteel Singularity
pages.text: Chronosteel compressed into one point, its time-hardened structure collapsed together. Time behaves oddly around it, ticking slightly faster or slower depending on how you hold it. It is cool and dense and smells faintly of rust.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Chronosteel is steel tempered in time. I compressed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that its timelines merged into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Coal Singularity
pages.text: An enormous pile of coal compressed into one point, pure carbon squeezed far past the pressure at which coal becomes diamond. It is jet black, and the stored chemical energy of ancient forests is almost palpable.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Coal is carbon from ancient plants, so I crushed vast amounts of it in the Singularity Compactor. It passed through graphite and diamond and kept going until it was a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Cognitive Singularity
pages.text: Every thought that could be thought, from a single neural lattice up to a superintelligence and a Boltzmann brain, compressed into one point. It feels attentive. Holding it, I am briefly aware of ideas I have not had yet, and then they are gone.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed every model of mind I had built into the Compressor, from neural lattices to general AI cores and holographic matrices. Thought itself collapsed to a single, watchful point.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Identity Kernel, Omega Simulator, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction, Proof of Everything, Spacetime Bearing.

pages.title: Computronium Singularity
pages.text: Computronium compacted into a single point, matter optimised for computation crushed together. It processes constantly and feels warm with the heat of erased bits. It seems to be thinking about something.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Computronium is matter arranged to compute as efficiently as possible. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor gave a single point running more calculations than I can count.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Conceptual Containment Casing
pages.text: Housing for things that are not physical. Its plates are woven from transfinite structure and braced with formal proofs, so that what it contains is held by consistency rather than by strength. It is cold, perfectly regular, and slightly unnerving to look at for long.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Ordinary containment failed the moment I tried to compress an idea. I stitched a Transfinite Weave through Crystalline Matrix and a Category Lattice and sealed it with a Formal Proof Tree. Now the shell holds because it must, logically.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

pages.title: Continuum Shard
pages.text: A shard whose size is that of the real line, two to the power aleph-null. Cantor guessed nothing lay between it and the countable infinity; Godel and Cohen proved the usual axioms cannot decide. The shard looks different every time you examine it, as if politely refusing to commit.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Taking the power set of an aleph-null shard should give the reals; it did, but the Cantor Diagonalizer refused to say whether omega-one fit between them. Dark energy kept it from collapsing while I waited. I also found pieces in the Ordinal Spire.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Ordinal Spire chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Axiom of Choice, Topos.

pages.title: Copper Singularity
pages.text: A great heap of copper crushed into a single point. It has a reddish glow, and electricity seems to pass through it without resistance. It is heavy and smooth and smells faintly of pennies. Verdigris never forms on it; there is no surface left to oxidise.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Copper is cheap and plentiful, so it was easy to feed the Singularity Compactor enough of it. The ingots collapsed into a single conductive point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Singularity
pages.text: Cosmic neutronium compressed into a single point. It was already one of the densest materials I had, and now it is denser. The point is absolutely black and impossibly heavy, and space visibly dips toward it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cosmic neutronium is neutron-star matter enhanced further. I crushed it in the Singularity Compactor, and it collapsed into a single point almost too heavy to move.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Crown of Transcendence
pages.text: You see everything, because nothing can hide from what is outside it.
One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Hand of the Demiurge
pages.text: The craftsman of the world had to hold it somehow. The only thing that can tune, wake or move an Omnipotence Core.

The only thing that can handle a forged Omnipotence Core. Sneak and use it in the air to change mode:$(li)$(thing)Tune$(): turn the Core's resonance (sneak: the other way) until it is in tune with the place$(li)$(thing)Activate$(): wake a Core in tune - or let an awake one sleep$(li)$(thing)Move$(): lift the Core into your inventory (it must be tuned again where you set it down)$(br2)It does not work on the Core of the Transcendental.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Diamond Singularity
pages.text: A hoard of diamonds crushed into a single brilliant point. Diamond is already carbon at its hardest; compressed further, it becomes something harder still. It scatters light into every colour and is cold to the touch.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Diamonds are carbon under pressure, so I applied more pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed the gems into a single blazing point that scratches anything.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Dilithium Singularity
pages.text: Dilithium crystals compacted into a single point. They regulate high-energy reactions, and the singularity carries a faint thrum, as if still waiting to channel something. It glows a pale pink. Nearby energy seems to steady itself, as though being supervised.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Dilithium regulates matter-antimatter reactions. Crushing enough crystals in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that hums with stored control.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Dimensional Singularity
pages.text: Eleven dimensions, with all their compactified circles, branes and moduli, compressed into a point with none at all. It is impossible to say which way it faces. Even the space around it seems to lose a direction or two when it is near.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Compressor everything that held the extra dimensions in place: Kaluza-Klein shards, the dilaton, moduli, a D-brane, a penteract and a Calabi-Yau. Every dimension curled up until none remained.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Theory of Everything.

pages.title: Singularity
pages.text: A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).

pages.title: Echo Lattice
pages.text: Echoes of the Transcendental, crossed and woven into a frame that remembers the shape of a world.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dodecaract Excavator, Hand of the Demiurge, Seed of Omnipotence.

pages.title: Emerald Singularity
pages.text: Emeralds crushed into one bright green point. It is perfectly clear and seems to carry a faint scent of trade and villages. Light passing through it turns a deep, satisfying green. Every facet has merged into one, and yet it still seems faceted.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Emeralds are beryl coloured by chromium. I crushed a hoard of them in the Singularity Compactor until the crystal lattice collapsed into one brilliant green point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Censer of Entropy
pages.text: Swing it and the world remembers how to decay. Any affliction, on one creature or on a place.

Sneak-use to choose any harmful effect of any mod, its level (up to 255), how long it lasts (up to an hour) and the radius of its cloud. Use on a creature to lay it on; use in the air to leave a lingering cloud up to 48 blocks away.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Eschaton Cell
pages.text: The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.
Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.

pages.title: Eschaton Core
pages.text: The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core - and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.
The heart of every endgame artefact, and of each creative item the Forge makes.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Censer of Entropy, Crown of Transcendence, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Euclidean Anchor, Ex Nihilo Engine, Greaves of the Absolute and more.

pages.title: Exotic Crystal Singularity
pages.text: Exotic matter crystals compressed into one point. Exotic matter has negative energy density, and the singularity seems to push space away from itself slightly. It is faintly repellent to the touch. Dropped, it falls slowly, as though the floor were pushing back.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Exotic matter holds wormholes open. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that pushes everything else away.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Exotic Matter Singularity
pages.text: Negative mass, massless alloy, antimatter, strange matter, dark matter: every substance that should not exist, compressed together. They ought to annihilate each other or fly apart. Instead they sit in uneasy balance, and the point seems to push and pull at once.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gathered every form of exotic matter and fed them into the Compressor together, half expecting an explosion. Negative mass cancelled the rest, and they settled into one strangely stable point.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Glowstone Singularity
pages.text: Glowstone dust compacted into one point, glowing so brightly it is hard to look at directly. It is warm and seems to light everything near it. Its light flickers slightly, as if keeping time. Shadows do not quite form behind it, as if the light wraps round.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Glowstone gives off light without burning, so I wondered what happened if it was compressed. The Singularity Compactor crushed it into a point that shone far brighter than the original dust.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Godel Sentence
pages.text: A statement that says, of itself, that it cannot be proven. If the system could prove it, it would be false; so it is true, and unprovable. Godel showed every system rich enough for arithmetic contains one. The crystal reads differently each time and is always right.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, a Superintelligence Core encoded a Formal Proof Tree into numbers using a Riemann Zeta Crystal. The diagonal of that encoding produced a sentence the core could not prove, and knew was true.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Incompleteness.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Distiller, Axiomatic Breach Engine, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, Russell Paradox Set, Topos, Transfinite Processor, Undecidable Kernel.

pages.title: Gold Singularity
pages.text: An immense hoard of gold, collapsed into one gleaming point. The warmth of the metal survives, and it gives off a soft yellow glow. Every ounce of it was originally forged in neutron star collisions, and now it is all in one place again.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gold came from neutron star mergers, so it seemed fitting to crush it back down. The Singularity Compactor squeezed a pile of ingots into a single bright point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Greaves of the Absolute
pages.text: Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.
One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Hyperreal Cache
pages.text: Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force. The contents, like infinitesimals beside the real numbers, sit at a scale no ordinary rule can reach.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.

pages.title: Identity Kernel
pages.text: A tiny, dense seed that holds the minimal description of me - not the body, not the memories, but whatever remains invariant when everything else is stripped away. It is almost weightless and yet the hand closes around it reflexively, as if it knew what it was holding.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transcendental dissolves anything that cannot say what it is. I compressed my own pattern through an ontological processor and a cognitive singularity, and anchored it to the omega point on a transfinite weave. What survived the compression was the kernel.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.

pages.title: Iron Singularity
pages.text: A mountain of iron, crushed until it collapsed into a single point. It is still recognisably iron: grey, cold and faintly magnetic. Holding it feels like holding the core of a planet, and it tugs at nearby metal.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor iron ingots until their atoms could no longer stay apart. The pressure crushed them past degeneracy into a single dense point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Kaluza-Klein Singularity
pages.text: Kaluza-Klein shards compacted into a single point, their fifth-dimensional momentum crushed together. The point crackles with faint static and spins slowly around an axis that does not seem to exist in three dimensions.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Each Kaluza-Klein shard carries momentum around a hidden dimension. Compressing enough of them in the Singularity Compactor, I folded that dimension into a single charged point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Lapis Singularity
pages.text: Lapis lazuli in such quantity that it collapsed into one point. It is a deep, perfect blue, and the colour seems to go down forever. Holding it feels cool and calm, like the bottom of the sea. Old painters ground this stone for ultramarine, the costliest blue there was.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Lapis is mostly lazurite, a complex silicate. I fed the Singularity Compactor enough of it that the crystal lattice collapsed into a single deep-blue point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Crystallised Law
pages.text: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop into a universe. It holds one rule completely, and nearby, that rule is slightly stronger than usual. Some feel heavier, some brighter; this one makes falling objects land softly.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Law Wraith.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Law Wraiths drop these when they dissolve. In the Axiom Distiller, I boiled a Primordial Law until one of its rules bubbled out on its own, and cooled it into a crystal.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Law Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes II, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Local Law Violation, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine, Omnilex Seal and more.

pages.title: Lawgiver's Codex
pages.text: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.

Open it to rewrite the laws of the place you stand in: gravity, time and weather, which creatures may appear and how strong they are. Look at a creature while opening it to rewrite that creature too. "Restore" puts the natural laws back.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.

pages.title: Logos Coil
pages.text: A coil wound of Logos Thread, the word that puts things in order. Current through it does not so much make a field as insist on one.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.

pages.title: Logos Thread
pages.text: A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Logos Coil, Rekindled Spark.

pages.title: Mantle of Omnipotence
pages.text: Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.
One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Netherite Singularity
pages.text: Netherite crushed into a single point. It is dark and dense, already the heaviest metal I had, now heavier still. It does not burn and it does not scratch, and holding it feels unshakeable. Lava slides off it and it stays exactly the temperature it was.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Netherite is ancient debris and gold, already immensely tough. I fed what I had into the Singularity Compactor and it collapsed into a single, unbreakable point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Neutronium Singularity
pages.text: Neutronium is already matter at nuclear density. Compressed beyond even that, it is close to becoming a true black hole. The point is perfectly black and unthinkably heavy, and space seems to dip toward it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutronium is what a neutron star is made of. Compressing it further in the Singularity Compactor brought it close to the Schwarzschild radius, and it collapsed into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Obsidian Singularity
pages.text: Obsidian compacted into one point. It is black volcanic glass, already hard to break, now impossible. Its surface reflects things that are not there, and it is faintly warm, as if still cooling from the lava.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Obsidian is lava cooled too fast to crystallise. I fed the Singularity Compactor a quarry's worth of it, and the glass collapsed into a single dark point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum
pages.text: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Primordial Laws, the space where physical laws bubble up and fall back. It is still bubbling inside its lattice, each bubble a possible rule. When I hold it close I can hear it, flowing from a higher Dimensional space.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine first had to simulate the Ocean itself, using its own previous run as a seed under a Primordial Law. Each iteration added more bubbles, until the simulation was complete.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Crystallised Law, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal and more.

pages.title: Omnilex Casing
pages.text: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing with a transfinite weave. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time, yet weights none.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine simulates the Tree and the Ocean, so its casing requires both. Arbor heartwood brought the Tree, crystallised law brought the rules, and the transfinite casing held them together.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnilex Engine.

pages.title: Omnipotence Casing
pages.text: A material that cannot be broken, as if a Law written within itself. Tools pass over it without effect. I have come to find it is not a Law to not be broken; it simply exempts a tool acting against it, and touching it feels like pressing against the end of an argument.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found forming the walls of the deepest structures. I tried every tool and every machine I have. Nothing. I logged it as a boundary condition rather than a material.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Eschaton Foundry, Pleroma Reconstitutor.

pages.title: Omnipotence Dust
pages.text: Omnipotence grounded into dust grains. Each grain can still be anything - for a moment.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Apeiron Ingot, Eschaton Cell, Logos Thread, Omnipotence Casing, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Crystal, Proof of Everything, Rekindled Spark and more.

pages.title: Seed of Omnipotence
pages.text: Everything a Core needs to grow, folded small: a heart, a remembered world, and the proof that it can be done.
Four of them go into an Omnipotence Core of your own.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Core.

pages.title: Shard of Omnipotence
pages.text: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.
What is left of the Core after the Shutdown Sequence. Once the Transcendental is rekindled, the reborn Core's Forge resonates more of them.
Made in $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Echo Lattice, Echo of the Transcendental, Eschaton Cell, Hand of the Demiurge, Rekindled Spark, Seed of Omnipotence.

pages.title: Omnipotent Edge
pages.text: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.

Cuts through any armour and any invulnerability. Use: $(thing)Erasure$() - hostile creatures in a cone before you cease to exist. Sneak-use: $(thing)Chronal Stasis$() - time stops for every creature within 24 blocks for 10 seconds.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Omnipotent Ingot
pages.text: A metal that represents all that has been, is now, and will be, eternally. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.

Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Dodecaract Excavator, Equilibrium Lattice, Eschaton Cell, Eschaton Core, Euclidean Anchor, Greaves of the Absolute, Hand of the Demiurge and more.

pages.title: Block of Omnium
pages.text: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I ran out of room for omnium ingots and pressed them together on a whim. They fused seamlessly, but taking them apart proved my attempt at saving space has been costly.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omnipotence Casing, Omnium Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Transcendent Cache.

pages.title: Omnium Energy Cell
pages.text: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping. It is calm, featherlight, and seems to remember every charge it has held.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Beyond the singularity cell there was nowhere left to store energy, except at the end of everything. Binding an Omega Point to omnium gave me a cell that holds what the universe will eventually amount to.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.

pages.title: Omnium Ingot
pages.text: A metal made of every concept, every material and every law, distilled into one bar. It has every property and none of them, depending on what you need. It is warm, cold, light and heavy at once, and feels like the end of the line.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnium block was too dense to shape, so I cracked a single ingot back out of it at the crafting grid. Whatever else I make from here, it starts with this.

Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Omnilex.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Frame Casing, Apeiron Ingot, Axiom Key, Block of Omnium, Omnilex, Omnipotence Dust, Omnium Energy Cell.

pages.title: Omnium Singularity
pages.text: A hoard of Omnium Ingots crushed into a single point, every concept compressed into one place. There is nothing left beyond it to compress it into. It is everything and nothing, and holding it feels final.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Singularity Compactor Omnium Ingots until even they collapsed. The result was a point containing everything there is. I am not sure there is anything left to build.

pages.title: Oracle's Lemma
pages.text: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.
$(thing)Creative mode only$(). Used inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers, the chamber counts as solved - for pack makers and testers. It cannot be crafted and the Core refuse to make this.

pages.title: Pleroma Crystal
pages.text: Pleroma - the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.

Made in $(item)Reality Compiler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Echo of the Transcendental, Omnipotent Ingot, Pleroma Glass, Pleroma Reconstitutor, Rekindled Spark.

pages.title: Pleroma Glass
pages.text: Named for the Gnostics' Pleroma, the fullness of all that is. Light passes through it; nothing else is allowed to.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry.

pages.title: Prime Singularity
pages.text: Prime shards compressed into one point. Primes cannot be divided, and the singularity seems to have inherited that indivisibility. It is perfectly smooth and cannot be split or cut by anything. Every attempt to halve it simply returns the whole thing again.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Primes cannot be factored, so I wondered if they could be compressed. The Singularity Compactor forced countless shards into one point that is still, somehow, prime.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Primordial Charter
pages.text: A sheet of crystal on which the laws of physics are written as they were before any symmetry broke - one force, no masses, nothing yet decided. Reading it is like looking at the draft of a finished book that every later amendment has forgotten. Its edges are perfectly sharp.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hyperdimensional Reality kept rewriting me to fit its own laws. I wove axiom fragments and a source code fragment through a transfinite weave and pinned it with a reality anchor, hoping a copy of the original laws would remind the place who I was. It did.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Axiom Theory.

pages.title: Primordial Law
pages.text: The substance of law itself, before any particular law. It has no temperature and no fixed form, and it reshapes itself to fit whatever rule is asked of it. It is clear, cold and utterly still until disturbed.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Simulating the Tree and the Ocean in the Omnilex Engine, I found the simulations produced a residue that was neither matter nor energy, but rule. Primordial law, distilled from the simulation of law.

Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier, Absolute Infinity, Absolute Notes I, Absolute Notes II, Absolute Notes III, Arbor Heartwood, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment and more.

pages.title: Quantum Singularity
pages.text: Every possible state of every quantum system, in superposition and compressed to one point. It is not in any definite state, and looking at it seems to collapse it differently each time. It flickers between being there and not.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I compressed the wavefunction, superpositions, entangled pairs, wave packets, spinors and fields together. Every possible outcome fell into the same point without any of them being chosen.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Bearing, Theory of Everything.

pages.title: Quartz Singularity
pages.text: Nether quartz crushed into one point, its crystal lattice compressed until it has no edges at all. It is milky white and faintly warm. Squeezing it seems to produce a tiny piezoelectric spark. Every vibration in the room seems to pass through it and come out sharper.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Quartz becomes electric when squeezed, so I squeezed as much as I could in the Singularity Compactor. The crystals collapsed together into a single, faintly charged point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Redstone Singularity
pages.text: Redstone dust in such quantity that it collapsed into a single point. It glows a pulsing red and seems to carry a faint signal, as though waiting to switch something on. Its warmth fluctuates rhythmically.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted to know what redstone's strange conductivity would do under extreme pressure. The Singularity Compactor crushed a mountain of dust into a single pulsing point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Rekindled Heart
pages.text: Four sparks of the second creation, beating together around an Eschaton Core.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hand of the Demiurge, Seed of Omnipotence.

pages.title: Rekindled Spark
pages.text: What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.
Made in $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.

pages.title: Incompleteness
pages.text: $(thing)Incompleteness$()$(br2)Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

$(thing)Insight$(): 400$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Transfinite Mathematics, Category Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Aleph-Null Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the Gödel number of the symbol sequence with codes (a, b, c) = (3, 1, 2), using prime-power encoding.

pages.title: Paradox Engineering
pages.text: $(thing)Paradox Engineering$()$(br2)Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

$(thing)Insight$(): 400$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Transfinite Mathematics, Causality Violation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Paradox Residue.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Show how many reduced words of length n = 5 exist in the free group on two generators, the engine of the Banach-Tarski paradox.

pages.title: Theory of Everything
pages.text: $(thing)Theory of Everything$()$(br2)Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

$(thing)Insight$(): 500$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Conceptual Singularities, Grand Unification, General Relativity, M-Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 M-Theory Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the inverse strong coupling at the grand-unification scale Q by running it up from μ = M_Z with the one-loop renormalisation group equation.

pages.title: Russell Paradox Set
pages.text: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. If it contains itself, it should not; if it does not, it should. Russell found it and broke naive set theory. In the hand it flickers between being there and being empty, never committing to either.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Cantor Diagonalizer, I fed a Godel Sentence, a Power Set and Paradox Residue together with Chronon Gas. The diagonaliser tried to decide what the set contained and produced this contradiction instead.

Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes III, Dimensional Residue, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transfinite Casing.

pages.title: Simulated Universe
pages.text: A whole other world, run from its first instant to its last inside the Forge. Each mod has its own.
