Each mod with creative items has its own, forged at the reborn Core from universe seeds, pocket universes, Omnipotent Ingots and that mod's own most advanced things. The Forge page shows exactly which.

pages.title: Scepter of Singularities
pages.text: It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.
Use to put a singularity where you look, up to 64 blocks away; sneak-use to change which: Black Hole, White Hole, Tesseract, Entanglement, Big Bang. It never harms players.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Spacetime Alloy Singularity
pages.text: Spacetime alloy crushed into a single point, its woven space and time folded inward. Distances near it seem shorter than they should, and time seems to skip. It feels slightly warped. A ruler laid beside it reads a slightly different length every time.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Spacetime alloy is metal woven with spacetime. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I folded its spacetime inward into a single point.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Spacetime Singularity
pages.text: All of relativity, from Lorentz transformations to the field equations and the stress-energy that sources them, squeezed into the one place where relativity itself predicts its own breakdown. Clocks near it disagree with each other, and straight lines bend toward it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Relativity predicts singularities but cannot describe them. Feeding the Compressor every tensor and transformation I had derived, I let the theory collapse onto the exact point where it fails, and kept that point.

Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Ontological Junction, Theory of Everything.

pages.title: Standard Model Singularity
pages.text: Every quark flavour, every lepton, every force carrier and the Higgs, compressed past the point where they are separate particles. It hums with all the interactions at once. Small enough to vanish in the hand, it nevertheless feels as if it holds the entire periodic table in reserve.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I gave the Conceptual Singularity Compressor each generation of quarks, the leptons, the gauge bosons and the Higgs, and asked it to compress the zoo. The particles collapsed into a single point carrying the whole Standard Model.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Spacetime Bearing, Theory of Everything.

pages.title: Stellar Iron Singularity
pages.text: Star-forged iron compacted into one point. It is the end of fusion, now crushed even further. It is dense and dull grey, and carries a faint warmth from the stellar core where it formed. A compass needle swings toward it from across the room.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar iron is where fusion stops. I crushed enough of it in the Singularity Compactor that it collapsed into a single point, the ultimate end of a star's life.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Stellar Singularity
pages.text: Birth, life and death of a star, from protostar to remnant, in one point of light that never dims. Holding it is like holding a star's whole history: the warmth of fusion, the swelling of a giant and the cold heaviness of collapse, all at once and all faint.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I loaded the Compressor with every stage of stellar evolution I had produced, from protostar core to supernova remnant. The stages merged into one luminous point that remembered all of them.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst, Ontological Junction.

pages.title: Strange Matter Singularity
pages.text: Strange matter pellets crushed into a single point. Strange matter may be the true ground state of matter, converting anything it touches. This point seems eager, and I keep it well away from anything else.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Strange matter could convert ordinary matter on contact. Compressing enough of it in the Singularity Compactor, I made a single point that is, so far, content to stay put.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Surreal Number
pages.text: Conway built every number from two sets, a left and a right, and found that the reals, the infinite ordinals and the infinitesimals all fit into one ordered field. This gem contains all of them. It is impossibly dense, endlessly fine, and every attempt to find its edge reveals another number there.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Cantor Diagonalizer was the only machine with room for this. I fed it octonions, the reals, an aleph-null shard and an infinitesimal, and let dark energy keep expanding the space between them until every gap was a number.
Made in $(item)Cantor Diagonalizer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Unified Notes III, Well-Ordering Charm.

pages.title: Tachyon Singularity
pages.text: Tachyon crystals crushed into a single point that seems to arrive before it is placed. Tachyons move faster than light, and this point moves faster still. It is cold, faintly blue, and seems to be leaving.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Tachyons can never slow below light speed. Crushing tachyon crystals in the Singularity Compactor gave me a point that seems to be everywhere it will be, slightly early.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Temporal Singularity
pages.text: Every moment collapsed into a single instant, with no before or after. Clocks stop being meaningful near it, and holding it gives a strange impression of remembering things that have not happened yet. It is perfectly still, and that stillness feels like waiting.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding the Compressor every time artefact I had built, from a backward arrow to a closed timelike curve, I compressed history itself. All the instants fell into one and stayed there.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronal Accelerator, Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Theory of Everything
pages.text: The Standard Model, quantum mechanics, relativity, string theory, grand unification and M-theory written as one equation. It is short, symmetric and almost embarrassingly simple, and it describes every interaction there is. Holding it, nothing feels mysterious, briefly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Compressor the singularities of the Standard Model, spacetime, quantum mechanics and the extra dimensions, plus the unified cores. All that I have come to known, all the theories ever conceived managed to merge. What remained fit on a single line, an equation that described all possible states of our universe.
Made in $(item)Conceptual Singularity Compressor$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Theory of Everything.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes II, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Crystal of Transcendence
pages.text: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Transcendent Glass
pages.text: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible. It is smooth, slightly warm, and has no detectable thickness.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Turned up beside transcendent stone at the edge of reality. It frames a view nicely, so I use it for windows where I want to remember what I am standing inside.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Pleroma Glass.

pages.title: Transcendent Stone
pages.text: This rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood. Building with it feels less like stacking blocks and more like stating facts.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in the Transcendental.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Found lining the regions beyond the last physical layer. It cuts cleanly and holds a shape, so I started using it for walls. Practical, if philosophically suspicious.
Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Sundering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Transcendent Cache.

pages.title: Echo of the Transcendental
pages.text: The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, though with the origin gone.
Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Rekindling.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark.

pages.title: Transfinite Casing
pages.text: A casing built to hold infinities: a transfinite weave over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams. It looks smaller from the inside than the outside, and larger from the side.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Axiomatic Breach Engine leaked infinities into everything near it. I used a Banach-Tarski sphere, which can be doubled, and a Russell set, which contains itself awkwardly, as a frame that would accept anything, including Infinities itself.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Paradox Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiomatic Breach Engine, Conceptual Containment Casing, Omnilex Casing.

pages.title: Transfinite Processor
pages.text: The seventh tier of processor. It completes infinitely many operations in finite time, a supertask like Zeno's runner who halves each step. An aleph-null shard keeps count and a Godel sentence marks the limits it cannot pass. It is perfectly silent.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the Femtoscale Assembly Line, I paired an Ontological Processor with an Aleph-Null Shard and a Godel Sentence. It ran an infinite loop, finished, and reported the answer before I had asked.

Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Incompleteness.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Omnilex Engine, Omnilex Seal, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.

pages.title: Transfinite Weave
pages.text: A cloth woven with more threads than there are natural numbers to count them - an uncountable weave in the honest Cantorian sense. It drapes like silk, and every thread is visible no matter how close I look. The endgame assemblies are stitched on it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cantor showed some infinities are larger than others. I used an aleph-null shard as the warp and let a cosmic processor diagonalise across it to produce the weft. The result was a cloth that cannot be listed.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.

pages.title: Treads of Infinity
pages.text: Every step lands. None of them fall.
One of the four pieces of the $(item)Raiment of Transcendence$(). Each piece has its own gift; the whole set grants invulnerability, creative flight, and erases all dimension's laws effects on you.
Forged at the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$().

pages.title: Arbor Simulacrum
pages.text: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe, running inside a lattice small enough to carry. Every possible universe grows on it, and every one is real enough to compute. Looking into it is like looking down from a great height.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine needed to understand the Tree to control it. It simulated the Primordial Ocean under a Primordial Law, and from that the Tree grew in simulation, one branch at a time.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal, Pocket Universe and more.

pages.title: Unified Dossier
pages.text: Everything I know up to the brink of pure mathematics, pressed into one volume until the separate fields are no longer separable. The pages are slightly damp with synaptic fluid, as if the book had been thinking. Opening it anywhere lands on something connected to everything else.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Learning to compress a whole field into one point taught me to compress my notes the same way. I stacked the three unified volumes on the theoretical dossier, soaked them in synaptic fluid, and the result read less like a book and more like a single idea.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.

pages.title: Unified Notes I
pages.text: The first unified volume, where infinity, hypernova metallurgy, reality anchors, geodesics and quantum superposition sit in the same paragraph without apology. Nothing here belongs to a single discipline any more. The paper itself seems to bend slightly along the lines of text.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Compressing a field into a point taught me to compress my notes too. Absolute infinity, a hypernova alloy ingot, a reality anchor, a geodesic thread, a superposition crystal and an eigenstate lattice went in; one volume of unified theory came out.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

pages.title: Unified Notes II
pages.text: The middle unified volume: countable infinity, catalysts of eternity, the Christoffel symbols of curved space, pocket universes, white holes, gravitons. Every page cross-references three others. It is a delight to read and almost impossible to summarise.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I bound an aleph-null shard to a Christoffel symbol and a pocket universe to a white hole fragment, with an eternity catalyst and a graviton crystal to hold the threads. The Femtoscale line found the common thread I had been sensing for months.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

pages.title: Unified Notes III
pages.text: The last unified volume: surreal numbers, the omega point, degenerate matter, the stress-energy tensor, causal loops with no origin, magnetic monopoles. It is where my notes stop distinguishing between what is true of matter and what is true of number.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To close the unified record I needed the strangest proofs I owned: a surreal number, the omega point, a bootstrap artifact that has no beginning, a stress-energy tensor, degenerate matter and a monopole. Woven together, they read as a single theory.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Unified Dossier.

pages.title: Void Lattice Singularity
pages.text: Void lattice crushed into one point. It is made of crystallised emptiness, and compressing nothing turns out to yield something very strange. The point is hard to look at, because there is nothing there to focus on.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Void lattice is a crystal of the vacuum. Compressing it in the Singularity Compactor, I expected nothing; I got a point that seemed to absorb its surroundings.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.

pages.title: Well-Ordering Charm
pages.text: A pendant of nested rings, each smaller than the one before, with no ring missing yet has an end. It embodies the well-ordering principle: every non-empty set of ordinals has a least element, so every descending chain must stop. In a place full of infinities, it is comforting to wear a guarantee of a bottom.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Transfinite Hierarchy kept dropping me into staircases that went down forever. I set a surreal number inside rings cut from a power set and an aleph-null shard, and the charm forced every descent to end. I have not fallen forever since.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Transfinite Mathematics.

pages.title: Omega Simulator
pages.text: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 7$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Makes more $(item)Proofs of Everything$() without fighting Alpha Omega again: keep one Proof in it as the template (never used up) and feed it Omnipotence Dust and the stuff of the argument.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (6 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Proof of Everything.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().

pages.title: Omnilex Engine
pages.text: It simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 8$() machine.
Too complex for any crafting grid. I built this controller on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts; I needed every one of them.

This engine will only run in $(thing)Hyperdimensional Reality Space$(), and is built partly from the World Tree itself. It simulates the $(thing)Tree$() and the $(thing)Ocean$() - first separately as $(item)Simulacra$(), then together.
A perfect model of a thing is, in the end, a handle on it. Whoever holds the resulting $(item)Omnilex$() is no longer bound by gravity.

pages.title: Omnilex Engine
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Crystallised Law, Omega Point, Omnilex, Pocket Universe, Primordial Law, Primordial Ocean Simulacrum.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
The final goal: build the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() in Hyperdimensional Reality Space. Simulate the Tree as an $(item)Arbor Simulacrum$() and the Ocean as a $(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$().

Then join them with an $(item)Omega Point$(). Tipler's Omega Point is the end-state where computation embraces everything - a fitting seal.$(br2)Hold the $(item)Omnilex$() and you gain permanent flight.

With the two simulacra the engine can grow new bubble universes, rewrite laws into crystals, or simulate everything that will ever be, down to the Omega Point.$(br2)Last entry for now, that should be the end of all that I can discover and know. However, the history of sciences shows otherwise, that I am confidently certain I am wrong.
Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Arbor Simulacrum$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Omega Point and more$(li)$(item)Primordial Ocean Simulacrum$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Fragment, Axiom Key, Crystallised Law and more$(li)$(item)Omega Point$(): Identity Kernel, Omega Simulator, Omnilex Engine, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Energy Cell and more

A note scrawled in the margin, in a hand that might be mine: $(thing)the Omnilex remembers where it began - in the foam beneath everything$(). I do not know what that means. I do not want to find out.

Pour every fluid of this mod - and water and lava - into the $(item)Pleroma Confluence$(): $(thing)1,000,000 mB$() of each. Every other mod installed counts too, through its $(fluid)Essence$() (distilled in the $(item)Essence Distillery$()): $(thing)64,000 mB$() of each mod's Essence. The Confluence keeps a running total; when every one is full, 1,000 mB of $(fluid)Pleroma$() appears.

The old word means 'fullness': the totality of everything. Fitting. It accepts fluids from any pipe or AE2 on any side, and Pleroma can be drained from any side. Its screen (and JEI) shows what is still missing.$(br2)Mine is fed by every tank I own.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
Pleroma carried in a $(item)Containment Cell$(), like every fluid of the mod: fill it at a tank, empty it into one.

pages.title: Pleroma Reconstitutor
pages.text: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.
Runs once: fed the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), it rebuilds the Transcendental. Only works while the Transcendental is destroyed.

pages.title: Pleroma Reconstitutor
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Crystal of Transcendence, Omnipotent Ingot, Rekindled Spark, Shard of Omnipotence.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.$(br2)Made in $(item)Eschaton Foundry$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(): Eschaton Foundry, Rekindled Spark

The reborn Core's Forge makes the last materials by hand, and after every forging it must re-seed its universe: three minutes before it compiles anything again. The $(item)Eschaton Foundry$() makes four of them in bulk - the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), $(item)Eschaton Cells$() and the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - with a Rekindled Spark resting in it.

It costs far more than the Forge, and it only repeats: each thing it makes, its owner must have forged by hand at least once. Until then it reports $(thing)Forge it once by hand first$(). (The Pleroma Reconstitutor still makes Omnipotent Ingots, Crystals of Transcendence and Omnipotence Shards.)

Its physics is $(thing)Bekenstein's bound$(): a volume of radius R holding energy E can store at most S = 2πRE/(ħc ln 2) bits. Each forging needs a certain amount of information packed in - more energy, or more room. But the radius must stay outside the Schwarzschild radius 2GE/c⁴, or the energy is a black hole. The best forgings sit just outside that edge.
Once explained, an anomaly is not gone: it is a $(item)Resolved Anomaly$() - a law that was broken and now holds. The last things of all are built on them.

$(li)Eschaton Core: 4$(li)Echo Lattice: 6$(li)Equilibrium Lattice: 8$(li)Hand of the Demiurge: 8$(li)Seed of Omnipotence: 12$(li)Lawgiver's Codex: 16$(li)Euclidean Anchor: 24$(li)a forged Omnipotence Core: 32
So the Abnormality branch is not a side road: every Eschaton Core - and everything made from one - goes through it.

endgame/second_core.title: An Omnipotence Core of Your Own

pages.text: Once the Transcendental is rekindled, nothing the Sundering left is a one-off anymore. At the reborn Core's Forge, $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() resonate into more shards, Shards replay the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(), and Echoes strike a second $(item)Rekindled Spark$().

They make the last things there are: the $(item)Rekindled Heart$(), the $(item)Echo Lattice$(), the $(item)Seed of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() - and, last of all, an $(item)Omnipotence Core$() of your own.
Nothing can break the Core: not a pickaxe, not an explosion, not a piston, not the Wither. Only the $(item)Hand of the Demiurge$() can handle it. Sneak and use the Hand in the air to switch its mode.

$(li)$(bold)Tune$(): opens the Core's attunement.$(li)$(bold)Activate$(): wakes a Core that is in tune, or lets an awake one sleep.$(li)$(bold)Move$(): lifts the Core into your inventory. Set down somewhere else, it must be attuned again.

Attunement is the hardest tuning there is. Every branch you studied has three parameters - 21 in all - and every place (world, dimension, spot) wants its own values. The screen only says how in tune each $(thing)branch$() is, never which parameter is off. All seven must reach 97% (Mathematics: all four lamps) before the Core can be woken. Hover over a branch's name for its rule.

Each branch behaves differently. $(thing)Chemistry$()'s reagents always make a whole. $(thing)Biology$() measures what its parameters settle into together. $(thing)Mathematics$() is exact: congruences and a prime. $(thing)Origin$()'s phases wrap round, each counting from the one before. $(thing)Finality$()'s entropy creeps up while you work.

Contain $(thing)Abnormality$() first: while it is loose it spreads into the other branches, nudging them, and clouds every other reading. And the branches lean on each other in a ring - Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Origin, Finality, Abnormality - so settling one moves where the next one wants to be. Go round more than once.

Asleep, the Core is dim and seven faint motes drift slowly round it, one for each branch it must be attuned in. Woken, it flares: the motes race, golden rings turn about it and light rises and falls from it.
An awake Core works like the one in the Transcendental, wherever it stands: Materialize and the Forge. It has no Shutdown Sequence. Changing its attunement out of tune puts it back to sleep.

The rebuilt Core does not grant Creative power without proving yourself. To forge one of such item, it must first simulate the universe that item belongs to - the whole of that mod, from its first instant to its last.

Each mod with creative items has a $(item)Simulated Universe$() of its own, forged from universe seeds, pocket universes and Omnipotent Ingots - and from that mod's own most advanced things (the Forge shows which). Then each creative item asks for its universe, an Eschaton Core, the best ordinary version of itself, and the material that fits what it does: pocket universes for storage, false-vacuum membranes for tanks, negentropy for energy...
No two Forge recipes are the same. Simulated universes are beyond Omnipotence: the Core's "make anything" cannot make them.
The reborn Core's screen has a $(thing)Forge$() page. Its recipes take materials from your inventory; it shows what each needs and what you have.

It makes the last materials - the $(item)Omnipotent Ingot$(), the $(item)Crystal of Transcendence$(), the $(item)Absolute Singularity$(), the $(item)Eschaton Core$() - and from them everything beyond Omnipotence. None of these can be given freely from the Core as these exist as an authority beyond the Core.

After every forge, the Core needs three minutes to re-seed its universe before it compiles again. The same materials can be produced by machines - Omnipotent Ingots, Crystals of Transcendence and Shards (the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$()), Absolute Singularities, the Echo, Eschaton Cells and Eschaton Cores (the $(item)Eschaton Foundry$(), once you have forged each by hand) - are cheaper here, but a universe tuned for one of them is $(thing)spent$() by forging it: its laws drifts once more. For better quantity, build the machines.

The $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$() is the largest machine there is: seventeen blocks in every direction. Fed the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$() and the rest of the Sundering's materials, it plays the echo back.
When it finishes, the Transcendental exists again, rebuilt as it was, and everyone learns $(thing)The Rekindling$(). The reborn Core keeps its Omnipotence - and gains a $(thing)Forge$().

The Rekindling happens once in a world: the Reconstitutor only plays the Echo back while there is no Transcendental. Its screen says why it waits - the Transcendental still stands, is still coming apart, or was already rekindled.

Afterwards the machine is far from idle. Keep the $(item)Rekindled Spark$() in it (it is never used up) and it plays back the Echo's $(thing)harmonics$() - the Forge's last materials, made by a machine instead of by hand, and some in greater yield:$(li)$(item)Omnipotent Ingot$() x3$(li)$(item)Crystal of Transcendence$()$(li)$(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() x3$(li)$(item)Absolute Singularity$()$(li)another $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$()$(li)$(item)Eschaton Cells$() x4
Each harmonic rings at its own frequency: set the drive onto the $(thing)Echo frequency$() the recipe names (JEI shows it), and give it the playback power its window asks for.

The Omnipotence Core can make anything - except what lies beyond Omnipotence. To go further you must force its reconstruction.$(br2)Its screen has a $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$(). Once initiated, it cannot be stopped: in sixty seconds the Core releases every law it holds, and the Transcendental disintegrates from the rim inwards.

Anyone still there is carried out at the end. Afterwards nobody can enter the Transcendental at all.$(br2)Whoever began the sequence receives what is left: $(item)Shards of Omnipotence$() and the $(item)Echo of the Transcendental$(). Everyone learns $(thing)The Sundering$().
This is not the end of the road: see $(l:endgame/beyond_the_shutdown)Beyond the Shutdown$() for where it leads - the Rekindling, the Forge and the last things.

The old machines can work with the shards:$(li)$(item)Omnipotence Dust$() - Concept Compressor$(li)$(item)Apeiron Ingot$() - Transcendent Plasma Forge$(li)$(item)Pleroma Crystal$() - Reality Compiler$(li)$(item)Logos Thread$() - Universe Forge

Omnipotence does not run out: with one Shard kept in the Concept Compressor as a seed (it is never used up), $(item)Omnipotence Dust$() condenses out of Pleroma onto omnium - as much as you can feed it.$(br2)More $(item)Proofs of Everything$() come from the $(item)Omega Simulator$(), which replays the fight with Alpha Omega using one Proof as its template.$(br2)From them: $(item)Absolute Frame Casing$(), $(item)Logos Coil$() and $(item)Pleroma Glass$() - the parts of the $(item)Pleroma Reconstitutor$().

Beyond every universe, beyond even Hyperdimensional Reality, lies the $(thing)Transcendental$(). The way in is made, not found: with the $(item)Proof of Everything$() and $(thing)Beyond the Omega$() researched, the $(item)Omnilex Engine$() does the impossible and collapses into a five-dimensional $(thing)hyperobject$(). It consumes its own structure, then drags in everything nearby; whoever reaches its heart is carried across.

The hyperobject stays where the engine stood, a doorway that pulls only those who come close.$(br2)The first arrival builds the place: a disc of transcendent stone a hundred and twelve blocks across, a Hall of Matter on its pedestals, eight reliquaries holding the controllers of the great machines of the endgame, and a rift back to the Overworld. Carry an $(item)Identity Kernel before entry$().

At its centre, on a dais within eight omnium pillars, stands the $(item)Omnipotence Core$(). Its screen lists every item of every mod installed: $(thing)Materialize$() any of them, as many as a stack, as often as you like.

$(thing)Access denied$(): the Core lists everything of $(thing)this$() mod too, but will not make any of it - ask, and it refuses. Nor does it make what lies beyond Omnipotence, nor the creative items of other mods (only the reborn Core's $(item)Forge$() makes those).$(br2)The Core cannot be broken, and nothing of Omnipotency can be built elsewhere. What comes next is the $(thing)Shutdown Sequence$().

pages.title: Antimatter Penning Trap
pages.text: Pair-produces antimatter from gamma photons and holds it in a magnetic bottle.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Some basic physics: a gamma photon with enough energy can become a particle and its antiparticle at once - $(thing)pair production$(), E = mc² run backwards. Antimatter annihilates on touching anything, so a $(thing)Penning trap$() holds it in vacuum with electric and magnetic fields alone. Frequently check the seals as this must be precisely handled.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Annihilation Core, Antimatter Pellet.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Penning Harness

pages.title: Chronon Field Inverter
pages.text: Inverts the local arrow of time to harvest chronons.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Note to self: a $(thing)chronon$() is a hypothetical quantum of time, proposed in the 1920s and never adopted by physics. The arrow of time, though, is real: Entropy follows the rule of Thermodynamics, always increases and rises, and that is why the past differs from the future. This machine flips it locally and catches what falls out.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Solder, Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Gas, Chronosteel Ingot, Fractured Essence, Hawking Emitter.
Made in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Dark Matter Halo Collector
pages.text: Gravitationally focuses the invisible halo surrounding every galaxy.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.

Galaxies spin too fast for the matter we can see to hold them together. Something unseen supplies the missing gravity: $(thing)dark matter$(), about five times as much as ordinary matter, spread in a halo far beyond the visible disc. This collector gathers it - and the Nebular Gas my first stars are made from.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

pages.title: Dark Matter Halo Collector
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().
$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Dark Matter, Exotic Matter Crystal, Nebular Gas, Void Essence.
Made in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Antimatter Pellet
pages.text: A small cloud of antimatter levitated in the middle of a Penning trap, held by electric and magnetic fields so that it touches nothing. If it did touch anything, both would vanish into gamma rays. Through the window it is a speck of light hanging very still, which is the reassuring part.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Firing entangled photon pairs into a heavy nucleus produced electron-positron pairs. With a superconducting coil and superfluid helium, the Antimatter Penning Trap caught the positrons before they met anything.

Made in $(item)Antimatter Penning Trap$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Antimatter Containment.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Annihilation Core, Anticarbon Crystal, Antihelium Nucleus, Antihydrogen, Antihydrogen Crystal, Antiproton Bundle, Antiquark Shard, Antisilicon Shard and more.

pages.title: Black Swan Feather
pages.text: Proof that the improbable happens. For centuries every swan was white - until one was not.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Black Swan.
$(thing)Dropped by$(): Black Swan.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Boltzmann Brain, Magnetic Monopole.

pages.title: Bottom & Top Quarks
pages.text: The third and final generation. The bottom is heavy; the top is as massive as a gold atom and decays before it can form a hadron. They are rarer than anything else in the Standard Model, and holding them feels like holding a pair of collapsing weights.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The second generation was not enough; colliding strange and charm quarks with pentaquarks in the Hyperion Synchrotron pushed collision energy high enough. Quark-gluon plasma caught the heaviest quarks before they could decay.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes III, Higgs Boson Crystal, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Calorimeter Detector Array
pages.text: An array of scintillator crystals and pixel trackers that records where a particle went and how much energy it carried. A quantum processor reads the flashes. The crystals glow faintly when hit. Tiny flashes ripple across it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To know what a collision produced I needed to measure both position and energy. I combined scintillators for energy, pixel trackers for paths and a quantum processor to read them.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Nuclide Forge, Particle Spectrometer.

pages.title: Causal Shield Lattice
pages.text: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that strike it are deflected into somebody else's timeline instead of mine. It is cool, faintly ticking, and slightly out of sync with the world around it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Chronon Field Inverter, I threaded Chronon Capacitors through Chronosteel with Chronon Gas. When a paradox hit the lattice, it slid off into another history and left mine alone.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Chronal Accelerator, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Entangled Bus Bar, Quarantine Field Matrix.

pages.title: Chronon Capacitor
pages.text: A container for chronons, the speculative quanta of time. If time comes in discrete ticks, those ticks can be stored and released, and this is the vessel. It pulses irregularly, slightly out of step with my own heartbeat, and it is wise to handle it before you use it, never after.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Paradox Echo.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Chronon Field Inverter let Tachyon Flux soak into a Tachyon Crystal, with a Qubit to count the ticks. Paradox Echoes drop charged ones; I took that as a sign the idea was sound before I proved it.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Paradox Echo.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arrow of Time Shard, Bioreactor, Brane Tether, Casimir Energy Cell, Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Solder, Chronal Accelerator, Chronal Anchor and more.

pages.title: Chronon Gas
pages.text: A gas of time quanta, if time comes in quanta. It drifts against the direction of other gases, and clocks immersed in it tick unevenly. Breathing near it leaves me unsure how long I have been standing there.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Distilling dimensional residue, one fraction made my clocks drift whenever it leaked. Chronons are only hypothetical, but whatever settled in that tier of the spire carried time with it.

Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arrow of Time Shard, Bootstrap Artifact, Causal Shield Lattice, Chronal Accelerator, Chronon Gas, Chronosteel Ingot, Closed Timelike Curve, Contained Anomaly Specimen and more.

pages.title: Chronoplastic Casing
pages.text: A casing laced with tachyon crystal and a chronon capacitor, so that time inside flows at a rate I can adjust. It feels slightly out of sync with the rest of the world, as though the hand touching it is one heartbeat late.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Time-manipulating machines bled their effects onto their own housings. I built a casing whose clock could be set independently, using tachyons to reach ahead and a chronon capacitor to store the difference.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Anomaly Containment Ward, Causal Shielding Plate, Causality Loop Engine, Chronal Accelerator, Chrono Loom, Evolution Engine.

pages.title: Dark Matter
pages.text: Matter that feels gravity but ignores light. Bottled, it looks like nothing at all; the flask is merely heavier than it should be. Galaxies are wrapped in halos of this, holding them together like an invisible net.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Vera Rubin saw galaxies spinning too fast for what they showed. Sweeping the halo with the Dark Matter Halo Collector, I gathered something that registered only on my scales.

Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmic Processor, Dark Matter, Dark Matter Lens, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Matter Singularity and more.

pages.title: Dark Matter Lens
pages.text: A lens that focuses gravity, not light. Dark matter does not interact with photons, but its mass curves spacetime, and this lens shapes that curvature into a focal point. It looks almost empty, a faint ripple in the air, yet anything placed behind it seems drawn toward the middle.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wanted a way to concentrate the dark matter I had gathered. Wrapping it in Metamaterial Sheet around a Void Lattice Shard in the Metamaterial Weaver gave a lens that bent gravity itself into focus.

Made in $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Axiom Distiller, Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmological Constant, Dark Energy, Dark Energy Siphon, Dark Matter, De Sitter Horizon Shard, Dimensional Residue and more.

pages.title: Dipole Bending Magnet
pages.text: A superconducting dipole magnet on a neutronium frame that bends a charged particle beam into a circle. Its field is perfectly uniform across the gap. Metal tools drift toward it. Its field lines would draw a perfect rectangle in iron filings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A synchrotron needs magnets to curve the beam back on itself. I wound a dipole around a superconducting coil block on a neutronium plate and the beam turned exactly as calculated.
Made on the $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Particle Spectrometer.

pages.title: Dipole Winding
pages.text: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle-shaped coil. Its magnetic field runs straight across the beam pipe and bends charged particles into a circle, as in every synchrotron. It is cold, heavy and slightly springy, frosted along its windings.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To steer particles around a ring I needed a uniform bending field. In the Metamaterial Weaver I wound a Superconducting Coil over Neutronium Plate and metamaterial into a saddle, cooled in helium. A derelict station had one too.
Made in $(item)Metamaterial Weaver$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dipole Bending Magnet.

pages.title: Entangled Relay
pages.text: Two halves of a quantum pair, each locked inside a small housing. Whatever happens to one is correlated with the other, however far apart they sit. It is cold, quiet and faintly luminous at the junctions.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entanglement cannot send messages faster than light on its own, but it does make two places share a state. Binding Entangled Photon Pairs with a quantum dot and a chronon capacitor gave me linked relays.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Entangled Transceiver.

pages.title: Entanglement Node
pages.text: A junction that keeps entangled pairs until they are wanted. Their correlations are perfect, yet no message can ride on them: no-signalling sees to that.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.

pages.title: Exotic Matter Crystal
pages.text: Matter with negative energy density, the ingredient general relativity keeps asking for whenever someone wants a wormhole or a warp bubble. The crystal tries to fall upward and slowly drifts toward the ceiling if I let go. Its facets bend light outward, as though the space around it were gently repelled.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Void Wraith.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Pocket Universe whose vacuum decayed unevenly left pockets of negative energy behind, and the Universe Forge froze them into these crystals. Before that I had only seen them shed by Void Wraiths, or sitting in anomaly vaults, quietly pushing the lid up.

Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Alcubierre Coil, Dimensional Residue, ER Bridge Thread, Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, Entanglement Node, Exotic Matter Singularity, Exotic Solder, Negative Energy Lattice and more.

pages.title: Feynman Diagram
pages.text: A picture standing for a term in the calculation of how particles interact: lines are particles, vertices are interactions. Sum all diagrams and you get the full answer. The diagram moves slightly, lines bending and joining as if acting out a process.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Integrating over all the ways gauge bosons could interact with a quantum field lattice and a wavefunction, the Formal Proof Assistant returned a sum of diagrams, each a possible history of the process.
Made in $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quantum Singularity.

pages.title: Fractured Essence
pages.text: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once, flickering between them, and it is never quite where I expect it. It feels like a shard of glass whose edges keep moving.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Destabilised Husk.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I first picked these up after a Destabilised Husk came apart in front of me. The splinters kept flickering in and out of my pocket until I put them in a jar.

Made in $(item)Chronon Field Inverter$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Destabilised Husk.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Integer Ring, Strange Matter Pellet, Warm Helium, Xenogenome Sample.

pages.title: Gauge Boson Cluster
pages.text: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the particles that carry electromagnetism and the strong and weak forces. Each is the ripple of a symmetry in its field. The cluster is lively and restless in the hand, pushing and pulling in ways that do not quite add up to any single force.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Entangled photons gave me the photon; a glueball core gave me gluons; quark-gluon plasma at high energy supplied the W and Z. The Particle Spectrometer collected all four force carriers into a single cluster.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Feynman Diagram, Higgs Boson Crystal, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Glueball Core
pages.text: Gluons carry the very colour charge they mediate, so in principle they can bind to one another with no quarks at all. This is that bound state: a knot of pure strong force, heavy and warm, with nothing inside it but the glue. Lattice QCD predicted it for decades; I am holding one.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I stripped the quarks out of a quark-gluon plasma beam using strange matter as a sink and a qubit to tag what remained. Most runs left nothing. One left a dense, colourless sphere of self-interacting gluons that refused to decay.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Gauge Boson Cluster, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Plasma Forge.

pages.title: Higgs Boson Crystal
pages.text: An excitation of the Higgs field, which fills all of space and gives particles their mass by dragging on them. Normally it decays in less than a zeptosecond. This crystal caught one before it could, and it is heavy in a way that seems to come from the field around it rather than the crystal.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Higgs couples most strongly to the heaviest particles, so I fed top quarks, gauge bosons and a Higgs field capacitor into the Hyperion Synchrotron. In the debris, a resonance I had been looking for froze solid.
Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Higgs Catalyst, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Higgs Field Capacitor
pages.text: A device that holds a local excitation of the Higgs field, the field that gives fundamental particles their mass. Inside, the field sits slightly away from its usual value, so objects nearby feel faintly heavier or lighter. It is dense, cool, and handles mass the way an ordinary capacitor handles charge.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A magnetic monopole wrapped in a superconducting coil in the Topological Phase Transmuter created a tiny defect in the vacuum. The Higgs field pooled around it, and with a qubit and a condensate I learned to store that excitation.

Made in $(item)Topological Phase Transmuter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Capacitor, Dyson Shell Segment, Higgs Boson Crystal, Higgs Catalyst, Higgs Field Modulator, Metastable Vacuum Lattice, Stellar Frame Casing.

pages.title: Hyperon Crystal
pages.text: Baryons in which at least one ordinary quark has been swapped for a strange one: lambdas, sigmas, xis, packed into a lattice. Strangeness adds mass and a slow, stubborn weak decay that these crystals simply postpone. The faces are cold, the inside feels heavier than the outside, and it is never quite still.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Feeding strange matter and a sterile neutrino through the synchrotron, I tried to coax strange quarks into ordinary baryons. Tachyon crystal stretched the decay clock long enough for the hyperons to settle into a lattice instead of decaying.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Empirical Notes I, Graviton Field Emitter, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Transcendent Plasma Forge, Transfinite Coil Block.

pages.title: Lepton Triplet
pages.text: Electron, muon and tau, three charged leptons differing only in mass, each paired with its own neutrino. None of them feel the strong force. The triplet hangs together loosely, and the neutrinos seem to drift straight through my hand without noticing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Neutrino flux passes through almost everything, so I used a sterile neutrino as a bait and antimatter to tag charged partners. The Particle Spectrometer separated three charged leptons, each shadowed by its neutrino flavour.
Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Magnetic Monopole
pages.text: A magnet with only one pole. Maxwell's equations would be beautifully symmetric if these existed, and Dirac showed a single one anywhere would explain why electric charge comes in fixed units. A compass near it points straight at it, no matter where I stand.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Smashing Quark-Gluon Plasma in the Quark-Gluon Collider, I aimed a superconducting coil at the debris. One particle threaded the coil and left a permanent jump in the current: the signature of a monopole, just as Cabrera once looked for.

Made in $(item)Pulsed Magnet Lab$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Attoscale Inductor, Dimensional Residue, Empirical Notes I, Exotic Matter Singularity, Grand Unified Core, Graviton Condenser, Higgs Field Capacitor, Higgs Field Modulator and more.

pages.title: Negative Energy Lattice
pages.text: Casimir cavities stacked by the million: in each, the vacuum between the plates holds less energy than the vacuum outside.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Warp Bubble Core, Warp Coil Ring.

pages.title: Octonion Crystal
pages.text: Eight-dimensional numbers, built by doubling quaternions once more. Multiplication stops even associating, so the order you group products in matters. Yet every non-zero octonion still has an inverse; they are the last and largest normed division algebra. The crystal is beautiful and slightly unsettling to look at for long.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Doubling the quaternions by the Cayley-Dickson trick needed room for eight dimensions, which a Calabi-Yau manifold and some exotic matter provided. A prime shard stabilised the multiplication table. Hurwitz says there is nothing beyond this that still divides.

Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Abstract Algebra.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, E8 Lattice, Functor Bridge, G₂ Manifold, Mathematics Singularity, Surreal Number.

pages.title: Penning Harness
pages.text: Coils across the shoulders, electrodes at wrist and ankle, a faint blue hum. It holds a bubble of field a hair thick around the wearer, and nothing gets through it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first step into the Antiverse lit me up like a flare. A Penning trap holds a cloud of positrons forever without walls - I scaled one up and wore it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Chronodynamics.

pages.title: Penrose Spindle
pages.text: A spindle built to couple with the ergosphere of a rotating black hole, the region where spacetime itself is dragged around so fast nothing can stand still. Penrose showed that energy can be extracted there by splitting objects. It spins freely and never seems to slow down.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A Kerr black hole wants to give away its spin. I built a neutronium spindle with a superconducting coil and a magnetic monopole at its core, so the frame-dragging could grip it and turn it directly.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Kerr Metric Shard, Penrose Ergosphere Generator.

pages.title: Pentaquark Shard
pages.text: Four quarks and an antiquark, bound into one hadron that real accelerators only glimpse as a bump in a decay spectrum. Here the bump has been frozen into a glittering shard. It hums faintly against the palm, as if the five constituents are still arguing over who holds whom, and the colour charge never quite settles.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Smashing strange matter into antimatter inside the Hyperion Synchrotron, I saw a resonance in the debris that matched no ordinary baryon. Pouring quark-gluon plasma over the collision point, then cooling it with entangled photons, let the five-quark state crystallise before it fell apart.

Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Accelerator Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Cosmic Neutronium Coil Block, Dimensional Residue, Hypernova Plasma, Residual Starlight.

pages.title: Pixel Tracker Module
pages.text: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it. Each pixel is a qubit that flips when a particle passes, and the trail of flipped pixels traces a track. It is flat, cold and delicate.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I needed to see particle tracks, not just flashes. In the Femto Fabricator I laid Qubits and Quantum Dots on a Cherenkov Wafer with Superconducting Solder. Every passing particle flipped a line of pixels.
Made in $(item)Femto Fabricator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Calorimeter Detector Array.

pages.title: Quadrupole Pole Tip
pages.text: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres of its ideal shape. Four of them together form a quadrupole magnet, which squeezes a beam in one direction while letting it spread in the other. Alternating them focuses the beam like a lens.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A beam spreads apart if nothing focuses it. In the Casimir Vacuum Press, I shaped Neutronium Plate against a Topological Insulator, using the vacuum pressure to grind the hyperbola exactly.
Made in $(item)Casimir Vacuum Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quadrupole Focusing Magnet.

pages.title: Quantum Field Lattice
pages.text: A field spread throughout spacetime, with particles appearing as quantised excitations of it. Every electron in the universe is a ripple in a single electron field. The lattice glows faintly and seems to ripple when breathed on.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Placing wave packets and spinors onto a differential manifold and cooling them in a condensate, I found the Analytic Continuator could describe them all as excitations of one field.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Coherence Stabiliser, Feynman Diagram, Quantum Singularity.

pages.title: Quark-Gluon Plasma
pages.text: The state of matter that filled the universe for its first few microseconds. Protons and neutrons have melted, and quarks and gluons flow freely as an almost perfect liquid with barely any viscosity. It is the hottest thing I have ever bottled, and it pours like light.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding neutronium nuclei in the Quark-Gluon Collider, cooled with superfluid helium between runs, I saw jets quench as if passing through a thick liquid. The protons had melted. Heavy-ion physics in a flask.

Made in $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Solder, Flerovium Ingot, Gauge Boson Cluster, Glueball Core, Grand Unified Core, Hawking Radiation and more.

pages.title: Quaternion Crystal
pages.text: Hamilton's numbers: one real part and three imaginary units i, j and k, which multiply in a fixed cycle and do not commute. Swap the order and the sign flips. Rotations in three dimensions are just quaternion multiplication, so the crystal turns in the hand with an uncanny smoothness and never gimbal-locks.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Trying to extend the complex plane into three dimensions failed, as it did for Hamilton, until I added a fourth. A magnetic monopole supplied the twist that lets ij differ from ji, and the condensate held it steady.

Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Abstract Algebra.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes II, Hopf Fibration, Minkowski Lattice, Octonion Crystal, Spinor Lattice.

pages.title: Grand Unification
pages.text: $(thing)Grand Unification$()$(br2)At high enough energy, three forces become one.

$(thing)Insight$(): 150$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Supersymmetry, String Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the inverse U(1) coupling at Q = 1e16 GeV, given 1/α = 59 at μ = 91.2 GeV and one-loop coefficient b = 4.1.

pages.title: Supersymmetry
pages.text: $(thing)Supersymmetry$()$(br2)Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Standard Model, The Dark Sector, Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Standard Model Matrix.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the relic density of the lightest supersymmetric particle (a WIMP) from its annihilation cross-section.

pages.title: RF Accelerating Cavity
pages.text: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Particles in a ring need repeated kicks to gain energy. I built an RF resonator cell into spacetime casing and drove it with a tachyon klystron, so every kick arrived on time.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiproton Decelerator, Hyperion Synchrotron, Nuclide Forge.

pages.title: RF Resonator Cell
pages.text: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. A standing radio-frequency wave rings inside, and each bunch of particles that crosses it at the right moment gets a kick forward. It is small, smooth and cold, and hums faintly when powered.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To accelerate a beam I needed a resonator with no losses. In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew a cavity of Topological Insulator and Cherenkov Quartz in superfluid helium. The wave inside would not decay.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): RF Accelerating Cavity.

pages.title: Scintillator Crystal
pages.text: A crystal that flashes when a particle passes through it. Each flash is proportional to the energy deposited, so counting them tells me what was made in a collision. It is clear and slightly blue, and twinkles constantly from cosmic rays.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew Cherenkov Quartz with Quantum Dots in superfluid helium. Every passing particle lit a dot, and the flashes gave me a clear count of each collision.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Calorimeter Detector Array.

pages.title: Spinor Lattice
pages.text: Spinors describe electrons and other spin-half particles. Rotate one a full 360 degrees and it comes back with its sign flipped; a second full turn restores it. The lattice feels oddly twisted and never quite seems to have come back to where it started.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Representing rotations with quaternions in the Peano Arithmetic Engine, I noticed each rotation had two quaternions, plus and minus. A qubit stored the sign, and the result behaved like a spinor.
Made in $(item)Peano Arithmetic Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Field Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Eigenstate Lattice, Quantum Field Lattice, Quantum Singularity.

pages.title: Strange & Charm Quarks
pages.text: The second generation: copies of the up and down with more mass and new quantum numbers, strangeness and charm. Outside strange matter they decay in a fraction of an instant through the weak force. These are held together, faintly fizzing, as if impatient to become something lighter.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Sorting virtual quarks by mass, I noticed a heavier pair in the Spectrometer's readout. The charm quark took experimentalists by surprise in 1974; it took me by surprise too, until the helium cooled them enough to keep.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bottom & Top Quarks, Empirical Notes II, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Strange Matter
pages.text: Quark matter laced with strange quarks, possibly more stable than ordinary nuclei. A drop of it converts any normal matter it touches into more of itself, given the chance. It is dense, dull and should be kept very far from everything.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Witten's strange matter hypothesis haunted me as I ran Strange Matter Pellets through the Particle Spectrometer with quark-gluon plasma. The spectrum showed a third quark flavour dissolving into the mix and staying.
Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Hyperon Crystal, Pentaquark Shard, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Superpartner Shard
pages.text: Supersymmetry pairs every boson with a fermion and every fermion with a boson. The lightest such partner, the neutralino, would be stable, invisible and heavy: an ideal candidate for dark matter. The shard is almost weightless in light but seems far heavier when you try to move it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Colliding the Standard Model matrix with dark matter through a dark matter lens, I searched for something that interacted only weakly. A heavy neutral partner appeared, and it matched dark matter perfectly.
Made in $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Supersymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Grand Unified Core, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Tachyon Crystal
pages.text: A crystal grown from hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Tachyons would have imaginary mass, slowing down as they gain energy and never dropping below light speed, and in some frames they would arrive before they left. Holding it, I occasionally feel its weight a moment before I pick it up.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Tachyon Resonator, Cherenkov light passed through a Void Lattice Shard and came out early. Cooling the output in superfluid helium, I caught crystals that existed before I flipped the switch. Bulk monoliths hold a few, inexplicably.

Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Tachyonics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Causal Solder, Causality Loop Engine, Chrono Loom, Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Field Inverter, Chronon Gas, Chronoplastic Casing, Hyperon Crystal and more.

pages.title: Tachyon Flux
pages.text: A thin stream of faster-than-light particles. Because their mass is imaginary, they speed up as they lose energy, so the coldest flux is also the fastest. It arrives in the pipe a fraction of a moment before I open the valve.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pumping tachyon crystal with superfluid helium in the Tachyon Resonator, I drained energy from the cavity and the readings jumped ahead of the clock. Faster-than-light particles, slowing by speeding up.
Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Tachyonics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronon Capacitor, Chronon Gas, Imaginary Unit, Lorentz Transform Crystal, Temporal Singularity.

pages.title: Tachyon Klystron
pages.text: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future, so the wave is already there when each bunch arrives. It hums with a pitch that starts before it is switched on.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)My cavities lagged behind the beam. In the Tachyon Resonator I wound a superconducting coil around a quantum dot in helium, sending tachyons through. The drive signal now arrives a little early.
Made in $(item)Tachyon Resonator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Chronal Accelerator, Empirical Notes II, RF Accelerating Cavity.

pages.title: Up & Down Quarks
pages.text: The two lightest quark flavours, carrying charges of plus two-thirds and minus one-third. Two ups and a down make a proton; two downs and an up make a neutron; so nearly every atom ever touched is built from these. Confinement means they never appear alone, and the pair sits in the palm with a stubborn, sticky pull.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Virtual quarks from the Quantum Foam vanish almost as soon as they appear. Running them through the Particle Spectrometer under superfluid helium, I could sort them by mass, and the two lightest flavours came out first and most often.

Made in $(item)Particle Spectrometer$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Antiquark Shard, Empirical Notes III, Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity.

pages.title: Void Essence
pages.text: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled. Light falls into it and does not come out; air slides around it. It feels like a cold hole in my hand, and it is lighter than nothing.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Void Wraith.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The first Void Wraith I defeated left this behind, a small region of emptiness the air would not enter. I scooped it into a jar and it stayed there, quietly refusing everything.

Made in $(item)Dark Matter Halo Collector$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Void Wraith.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Contained Anomaly Specimen, Dark Matter Lens, Empty Set.

pages.title: Warp Forge Casing
pages.text: Hull plating for a warp field forge. An Alcubierre bubble would need negative energy density in its walls, which is what makes this casing exotic.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Dark Sector.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Warp Field Forge.

pages.title: Wave Packet
pages.text: A localised bump made by adding waves of slightly different frequencies so they reinforce in one place and cancel elsewhere. Quantum particles are wave packets, which is why their position and momentum cannot both be sharp. The packet seems to spread slowly the longer you watch it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Adding up a Fourier series of entangled photon modes in the Analytic Continuator, I built a pulse of light localised in space. Its spread in frequency and position balanced exactly as Heisenberg said.
Made in $(item)Analytic Continuator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Quantum Field Lattice, Quantum Singularity.

pages.title: Particle Spectrometer
pages.text: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Real spectrometers work on the same idea: a magnetic field bends a charged particle's path, and how sharply it curves gives away its momentum and charge. Light particles swing wide, heavy ones barely turn. Mine sorts the spray into labelled bins.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 3 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Gauge Boson Cluster, Lepton Triplet, Strange & Charm Quarks, Strange Matter, Up & Down Quarks.
Made in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Quark-Gluon Collider
pages.text: A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Quarks are never seen alone - the strong force pulls harder the further apart they get. But smash heavy nuclei together hard enough and, for an instant, protons and neutrons melt into a soup of free quarks and gluons: the universe as it was a microsecond after the Big Bang.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

pages.title: Quark-Gluon Collider
pages.text: Cycling blocks: any of them fits (Interface Ports, higher coil/emitter tiers). Rotate, zoom and view layers in $(thing)JEI$().

$(thing)Machine data$(): a multiblock (16 item and 16 fluid inputs, 4 and 4 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Baryon Asymmetry Crystal, Dark Matter, Magnetic Monopole, Quark-Gluon Plasma, Strange Matter, Strange Matter Pellet, Superpartner Shard.
Made in a crafting grid.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$(): Hyperion Synchrotron

Day 96. The $(item)Particle Spectrometer$() splits quark-gluon plasma into $(item)quark flavours$(), $(item)leptons$() and $(item)gauge bosons$(). The heaviest quarks and the $(item)Higgs$() need the Synchrotron.

The $(thing)Standard Model$() is our best account of matter: six quarks, six leptons, the gauge bosons that carry the forces, and the Higgs, whose field gives particles their mass. It is astonishingly accurate, and plainly incomplete - it has no gravity and no dark matter.

All of them together make the $(item)Standard Model Matrix$(). The Collider turns it and dark matter into $(item)Superpartner Shards$(), and the Tesseract Assembler unifies everything into a $(item)Grand Unified Core$().$(br2)Correction to my earlier notes: the Higgs Catalyst now needs a real Higgs boson.
Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.$(br2)Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.$(br2)Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().
At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().

pages.title: Hyperion Synchrotron
pages.text: A ring accelerator built from real beamline parts: bending dipoles, focusing quadrupoles, RF cavities, cryogenics, vacuum pumps and a detector hall. It makes the exotic hadrons nothing else can.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Like the collider, but a real beamline, and every part matters:$(li)dipoles bend$(li)quadrupoles focus$(li)RF cavities accelerate$(li)cryo jackets keep the magnets superconducting$(li)pumps keep the pipe empty$(li)the detector hall sees what was made

Why a ring: a magnetic field curves a charged beam, so the same cavities can kick it again on every lap. A synchrotron raises its field in step with the beam's energy - hence the name.$(br2)Better $(item)coils$() unlock heavier particles: $(item)Glueball Cores$() need tier 2, $(item)Hyperon Crystals$() tier 3.

pages.title: Tachyon Resonator
pages.text: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

A $(thing)tachyon$() is a hypothetical particle that always moves faster than light; in the equations its mass comes out imaginary. No experiment has ever found one. This crystal, apparently, has not read the literature. I have checked the readings four times.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Made in a crafting grid.

Lesson learned the expensive way. Processes cooled by $(fluid)Superfluid Helium$() hand it back as $(fluid)Warm Helium$(). Recondense it in a $(item)Bose-Einstein Condenser$() or the $(item)Fractionation Spire$() - or you will run out. Below about 2 K helium flows with no friction at all; a little warmer and it is just a cold liquid.

High-tier processes leave $(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(). The $(item)Fractionation Spire$() splits it into Dark Matter, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field and Chronon Gas. Nothing is waste if you can separate it.

$(item)Spacetime Slag$() can be sorted by a $(item)Maxwell's Demon$() for Void Lattice and, rarely, Planck Shards. Maxwell dreamed up his demon in 1867: a tiny doorkeeper sorting fast molecules from slow, seeming to cheat the second law. Mine sorts rubble.
Made in a crafting grid.

Some recipes need a $(thing)catalyst$() in an input slot. It is never consumed - JEI marks it in gold. Each catalyst is made from the one before it:

A chemist's catalyst speeds a reaction and comes out unchanged at the end. These behave the same way: present, necessary, never used up. Since each is forged from the one before, I treat the first one as the most precious thing in the lab.
A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.$(br2)Made in $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$().

Some things are not made in a machine: they are $(thing)converged$(). Place a $(item)Convergence Altar$() and up to twelve $(item)Resonance Pedestals$() around it (within 4 blocks, at most one block higher or lower). Put the core item on the altar and one item on each pedestal - JEI shows which.

Power the altar (it takes energy from any side), then right-click it with an empty hand or give it a $(thing)redstone pulse$(). Beams run from the pedestals; when it finishes, the pedestals are empty and the core has become the result. Take it off with an empty hand (sneak-click takes the core back instead).
Bigger rituals need better pedestals: $(item)Harmonic$() (grade 2) and $(item)Absolute$() (grade 3) pedestals carry what a Resonance Pedestal cannot. Every pedestal in use must be good enough.

Automating it is the trick: pipes may put the core onto the altar and take the result off, and every pedestal takes exactly one item from a pipe (it refuses more, and locks while in use). A comparator reads 15 from the altar when a result waits, 7 while it works. The $(item)Engineering Components$() are all made here.
Much later the $(item)Convergence Engine$() runs every convergence recipe as an ordinary machine, at four times the energy.

pages.text: Builds components smaller than a proton - and assembles them into processors.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 2$() machine.

Scale check: a femtometre is 10^-15 m, about the width of a proton. Ordinary chips are measured in nanometres, a million times larger. Anything built here has more in common with a nucleus than with a circuit.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Same principle as a refinery column: heat a mixture, and each component condenses at its own height according to its boiling point. Here the mixture is $(fluid)Dimensional Residue$(), and the fractions are Dark Matter, Exotic Matter, Inflaton Field and Chronon Gas.

pages.title: Lattice Growth Vat
pages.text: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.

Real chips start the same way. A seed crystal is dipped into a melt and drawn slowly upward (the $(thing)Czochralski process$()), and atoms line up behind it into one unbroken lattice - a $(thing)boule$(). In industry a single defect can ruin a wafer, so I do not rush the vat.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
