Feed it Bose-Einstein Condensate and keep it below 5 K. Set the density, the flow, and the laser step: the flow must be subsonic before the step and supersonic after it. The Hawking temperature, ħκ/2πk_B, must stand out of the condensate's own warmth over enough shots - only Bose-Einstein Condensate as the coolant is cold enough.

Day 112. The $(item)Horizon Diver$() takes me through an event horizon. Rule one: $(thing)carry a Geodesic Anchor$(). Without one, tidal forces kill within two seconds - in the black hole and the white hole alike.

Why the tides kill: near a black hole, gravity changes so steeply over the length of a body that the feet are pulled far harder than the head. The stretching is called $(thing)spaghettification$(), and it is not a figure of speech.

Even anchored, it is hostile down here. Time is dilated: I move, swing and dig slower. Gravity is 2.5 times as strong. Below y=16 the singularity tears everything apart. $(thing)Tidal Horrors$() hunt in the dark, and their touch $(thing)spaghettifies$().

Log, second descent. An $(item)Einstein-Rosen Bridge$() stands at 0, 121, 0. I stepped through and came out inside the $(thing)white hole$() - a black hole run backwards, which nothing can enter, only leave. Low gravity, blinding light, everything pushed outward. The $(thing)Photon Moths$() here are harmless.

Neither side is enough alone. From the black hole: $(item)Tidal Alloy$() and $(item)Frozen Photons$(). From the white hole: $(item)Retrocausal Crystals$() and $(item)Primordial Ejecta$(). Together they make the $(item)Einstein-Rosen Core$() - and with it, new bridges I can build myself.
Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Causality Loop Engine
pages.text: Entry undated, on purpose. Sends objects back along a closed timelike curve so they exist twice. The universe is not amused.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

A $(thing)closed timelike curve$() is a path through spacetime that returns to its own past. General relativity allows them in a few exotic solutions; nobody has ever found one in nature.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

How it works: feed an item together with a $(item)Closed Timelike Curve$() and both come back - plus a second copy of the item. It works on Tesseract Cores, singularities, white hole fragments, superintelligences, stellar cores, wormhole throats and even pocket universes. I try not to think about the last one.

Is a dead universe dead forever? Statistical mechanics says no. In a finite system every state recurs (Poincaré recurrence) - for a de Sitter universe after about e^{10¹²²} years. Long before that, fluctuations happen by chance: P ∝ exp(−(Δ_E − TΔ_S)/k_BT). A single brain is far more likely than a whole world - the $(thing)Boltzmann brain$() problem.
The $(item)Entropy Horizon$() waits for one: a horizon shard and negentropy in the haze give a $(item)Boltzmann Fluctuation$() - which a Psionic Resonator turns into two $(item)Boltzmann Brains$().
And the other way out is $(thing)Conformal Cyclic Cosmology$() (in Strings & the Multiverse): the end of one aeon is the beginning of the next.

The second branch of time is $(thing)Finality$(). $(thing)Cosmic Eschatology$() starts from the acceleration equation, ä/a = −4πG(ρ + 3p/c²)/3 + Λc²/3: matter and radiation decelerate the expansion, dark energy accelerates it - and ours is accelerating (q₀ ≈ −0.53).

What happens next depends on dark energy's equation of state w = p/ρc²:$(li)w = −1 (a cosmological constant): expansion forever, to the $(thing)Heat Death$().$(li)w < −1 (phantom energy): the $(thing)Big Rip$().$(li)decaying dark energy or enough matter: the $(thing)Big Crunch$() - and perhaps a $(thing)Bounce$().$(li)at any moment, if the vacuum is metastable: $(thing)Vacuum Decay$().

spacetime/finality_eras.title: The Long Dark: Protons and Black Holes

pages.text: If the universe expands forever, its history after the stars falls into eras. The last red dwarfs die after 10¹⁴ years; then the $(thing)Degenerate Era$() of white dwarfs, neutron stars and planets - until, if grand unification is right, $(thing)Proton Decay$() dissolves them: p → e⁺ + π⁰, with a lifetime above 10³⁴ years.
Watch a tank of water long enough, like Super-Kamiokande: in the $(item)Neutrino Condenser$(), Cherenkov quartz and neutronium under 4,000 mB of water catch $(item)Proton Decay Residue$().

Then the $(thing)Black Hole Era$(): only black holes remain, radiating at T = ħc³/(8πGMk_B). A solar-mass hole takes 10⁶⁷ years to evaporate, getting hotter as it shrinks, and ends in a flash. A $(item)Kugelblitz Chamber$() evaporates a micro singularity down to its $(item)Last Flash$().

The likeliest end: maximum entropy. After the black holes, an empty de Sitter space is left, with a horizon c/H away that glows at ħH/(2πk_B) ≈ 3×10⁻³⁰ K and holds S = πc⁵k_B/(GħH²) ≈ 2×10¹²² - the most entropy there can ever be. Nothing more can happen, because nothing can get colder than its surroundings.

Build the $(item)Entropy Horizon$(). It runs matter forward to the end: proton decay residue and a black hole's last flash become $(item)Heat Death Embers$() and $(fluid)Dark Era Haze$() - photons, neutrinos and positronium atoms wider than today's observable universe. Embers under dark energy give $(item)De Sitter Horizon Shards$(), and embers with a shard give $(item)Heat Death Remnants$().

In its Operation console the simulated age must pass 10³⁴ years (or the protons have not decayed); a faster expansion makes a smaller, hotter horizon - too hot, and it boils the containment. Horizon shards and phantom cells also make a $(item)Cosmological Constant$() in the Siphon.

$(thing)The Big Rip$(): phantom dark energy (w < −1) grows denser as space grows. With w = −1.5 the Rip comes 22 billion years from now: clusters go a billion years before, the Solar System three months before, atoms in the last instant. The $(item)Dark Energy Siphon$() bottles it in a $(item)Phantom Energy Cell$().

$(thing)The Big Crunch$(): expansion reverses and everything falls together. In loop quantum cosmology the Friedmann equation gains a factor (1 − ρ/ρ_c): at the Planck density gravity repels and the collapse $(thing)bounces$(). The $(item)Neutron Star Forge$() crushes spin foam and degenerate matter into a $(item)Bounce Core$().

$(thing)Vacuum Decay$(): a bubble of the true vacuum needs a radius 2σ/ε to grow; bigger, it expands at nearly the speed of light, and inside it chemistry is impossible. The $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$() holds a $(item)True Vacuum Seed$() just below the critical radius. Please keep it there.

pages.title: Laser Interferometer
pages.text: Two long arms at right angles, a laser split between them, and mirrors that hang free. A passing gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other by a thousandth of a proton's width.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Balance the laser power and the arms' finesse between shot noise and radiation-pressure noise; add isolation stages against the ground's shaking (other machines nearby make it worse; underground is quieter); cool the test masses to beat thermal noise. A black hole merger needs a signal-to-noise of 8 at h = 10⁻²¹; a neutron star merger, five times fainter, needs cold mirrors.

The magnification is A = (u² + 2)/(u√(u² + 4)) - huge as u → 0, but the Einstein radius of a small, distant lens is so tiny that the aim's own jitter sets how close you can get.

pages.title: Arrow of Time Shard

pages.title: Bootstrap Artifact
pages.text: An object with no origin. It was handed back from the future, kept, and later sent back to become the thing that was handed over, so nobody ever made it. Its information came from nowhere and it shows no wear at all, even though it is, in a sense, infinitely old.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed Paradox Residue through a Closed Timelike Curve with Chronon Gas in the Causality Loop Engine and waited. Something arrived that I had not yet made. I have since made it, and sent it back, and I am not sure who started this.

pages.title: Christoffel Symbol

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Differentiating geodesic threads with a Koch crystal's self-similarity, I tracked how coordinates bent near the horizon. The Chrono Loom produced the connection coefficients.
Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Stress-Energy Tensor, Unified Notes II.

pages.title: Chronal Accelerator

pages.title: Chronal Anchor
pages.text: A heavy pendulum sealed in chronosteel that keeps my own clock ticking at its proper rate while the world outside speeds up or slows down. Proper time is personal in relativity; this makes sure mine stays mine. Its ticking is the calmest sound I have ever heard.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a dilated time field my heartbeat and my thoughts drifted out of step. I tied a temporal knot to an arrow of time shard and fed it from a chronon capacitor, so my clock is referenced against itself rather than against the field.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Temporal Mechanics.

pages.title: Chronal Field Projector
pages.text: A projector that stretches time in its field. A temporal knot sits in the emitter stack, so clocks inside run faster or slower depending on its setting. The air feels thick and patient within its range.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Gravity slows clocks, which is time dilation. Tying a Temporal Knot into a graviton emitter stack gave me control over the rate, without the mass.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Temporal Mechanics.

pages.title: Closed Timelike Curve
pages.text: A path through spacetime that ends where, and when, it began. Godel showed such loops are allowed in general relativity under certain conditions. In the hand it is a looping thread of light that I keep trying to follow, and keep losing.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Paradox Echo.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Causality Loop Engine, a Superintelligence Core worked out how to make a loop without paradox. I sent a curve back along itself with Chronon Gas, and found it already waiting. Paradox Echoes drop them too.

pages.title: Cosmological Constant

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Aiming a Dark Matter Lens at empty space in the Dark Energy Siphon, I focused the expansion itself rather than any matter. The siphon drew off a measurable amount of vacuum energy, constant no matter how much I took.

pages.title: Dark Energy

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In 1998, distant supernovae showed the expansion of the universe is accelerating. The Dark Energy Siphon drew a sliver of that energy from the vacuum and held it.

pages.title: Einstein-Rosen Bridge
pages.text: A wormhole made solid: one mouth here, the other somewhere far away, joined by a throat through curved spacetime. Peering into it, I see the far side foreshortened and tinted. It does not hum or spin; it simply connects.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in the White Hole Interior, the Black Hole Interior.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Einstein and Rosen found their bridge in the Schwarzschild solution, but it pinches shut too fast to cross. I propped the throat open with an Einstein-Rosen Core, framed it in horizon glass and tidal alloy, and it stayed open.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.

pages.title: Einstein-Rosen Core
pages.text: Both mouths of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held together in one object. Einstein and Rosen found that black hole solutions connect two regions of spacetime. The core pulls in at one end and pushes out at the other.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole, I found tidal scrap; inside a white hole, primordial ejecta. Joining them in the Tesseract Assembler with retrocausal crystal and a frozen photon, I built the bridge.

pages.title: Ejecta Rock

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the ejecta fields I noticed rock whose layers were laid down in reverse order. Only a time-reversed black hole could spit matter out that way. A white hole's leftovers, pushed out the wrong end of time.

It is barely visible and very cold, the faintest red glow, and it never quite fades away. Warming it does nothing.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): mined from Frozen Light Ore in the Black Hole Interior; dropped by the Tidal Horror (the Black Hole Interior).

pages.title: Geodesic Thread
pages.text: The straightest line possible in curved spacetime: the path a falling object takes. Around a black hole, geodesics curve, spiral and close in. The thread bends according to the gravity around it and never kinks.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole, a geodesic is the only safe path. Following one with neutronium and the real continuum in the Chrono Loom, I wove relativity breakdown into a thread that always falls straight.
Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Christoffel Symbol, Unified Notes I.

pages.title: Gravitational Wave Crystal
pages.text: A ripple in spacetime itself, stretching and squeezing distances as it passes, frozen mid-oscillation. LIGO detected the first in 2015 from two merging black holes. The crystal pulses gently, alternately longer and shorter, as if breathing.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Two spinning micro singularities in the Kugelblitz Chamber spiralled together and merged. Hawking radiation lit the scene, and the field equations captured the outgoing ripple before it escaped.

pages.title: Horizon Glass
pages.text: A pane cut from the boundary of no return. Light enters easily but seems reluctant to leave, so everything beyond looks slightly dimmed and stretched. It is cold and smooth, and holding it at an angle makes my reflection redshift.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)An event horizon is just a surface in spacetime; locally nothing special happens there. Near the black hole I found glassy deposits that bent light like that surface does, and learned to cut them into panes.
Made in $(item)Kugelblitz Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dark Matter Lens, Einstein-Rosen Bridge.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Near the horizon, the ground itself is falling. I chipped samples of this spaghettified stone and noticed every crystal pointing the same way: toward the singularity it has been falling into.
Made in $(item)Kugelblitz Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inside a Black Hole.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Degenerate Matter Chunk, Frozen Photon, Horizon Cache.

pages.title: Kerr Metric Shard
pages.text: The exact solution for spacetime around a rotating black hole, found by Roy Kerr in 1963. Near it, spacetime itself is dragged around, and inside the ergosphere nothing can stand still. The shard spins slightly in the hand, even when perfectly balanced.

pages.title: Asymptotic Safety

pages.title: The Hot Big Bang

pages.title: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce
pages.text: $(thing)The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce$()$(br2)Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion.

pages.title: The Big Rip
pages.text: $(thing)The Big Rip$()$(br2)If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.
$(thing)Insight$(): 190$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Mass Manipulation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Negative Mass Ingot.

pages.title: Binary Mergers
pages.text: $(thing)Binary Mergers$()$(br2)Two compact stars in orbit radiate gravitational waves, spiral in, and merge in a final whoop of rising pitch. Their chirp mass sets how fast. Unlocks gravitational-wave echoes - and an answer from the Frontier.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the The Binary.
$(thing)Insight$(): 230$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Gravitational Waves, Kilonovae.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Chirp Signal Record, 1 Merger Remnant, 2 Black Hole Merger Record.

pages.title: The Black Hole Era
pages.text: $(thing)The Black Hole Era$()$(br2)After the protons, only black holes are left, slowly radiating. A black hole of a solar mass needs 10^67 years to evaporate, a supermassive one 10^100 - and then it ends in a flash. Unlocks the Last Flash of a Black Hole.
$(thing)Insight$(): 190$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Singularity Physics, The Holographic Principle.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Hawking Emitter.

pages.title: Black Hole Thermodynamics
pages.text: $(thing)Black Hole Thermodynamics$()$(br2)A black hole has a temperature, so it has an entropy - and that entropy is its horizon's area in Planck units, divided by four. The most information any region can hold is set by its surface, not its volume.
$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Hawking Radiation.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Hawking Quanta, 1 Bekenstein Crystal.

pages.title: Cosmic Eschatology
pages.text: $(thing)Cosmic Eschatology$()$(br2)How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.
$(thing)Insight$(): 160$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Hot Big Bang, Dark Energy.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Dark Matter Lens.

pages.title: The Equivalence Principle
pages.text: $(thing)The Equivalence Principle$()$(br2)Drop a hammer and a feather on the Moon and they land together. Gravity pulls everything with the same acceleration, so in free fall gravity vanishes - Einstein's happiest thought. Unlocks the Proof Mass.
$(thing)Insight$(): 40$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Special Relativity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Gold Ingot.

pages.title: Frame Dragging
pages.text: $(thing)Frame Dragging$()$(br2)A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope in orbit round the Earth turns, by forty milliarcseconds a year, for no other reason. Unlocks the Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.
$(thing)Insight$(): 170$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Geodesics, The Penrose Process.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Precision Gyroscope, 2 Pulsar Timing Record.

pages.title: General Relativity
pages.text: $(thing)General Relativity$()$(br2)Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Special Relativity, Singularity Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Metric Tensor.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the Schwarzschild radius (m) of the Sun, mass 1.989e30 kg.

pages.title: Geodesics
pages.text: $(thing)Geodesics$()$(br2)In curved spacetime a falling body takes the straightest path there is - a geodesic. Gravity is not a force; it is the shape of the road. Unlocks the Geodesic Compass.
$(thing)Insight$(): 140$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): General Relativity, Geometric Topology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Proof Mass, 1 Metric Tensor.

pages.title: Page Curve and Islands
pages.text: $(thing)Page Curve and Islands$()$(br2)The radiation's entropy rises as a black hole evaporates, then - after the Page time - falls back to zero: the information comes out. Islands inside the horizon, counted as part of the radiation, make it turn over.
$(thing)Insight$(): 340$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Information Paradox, ER = EPR.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Firewall Shard, 2 Soft Hair Filament, 1 ER Bridge Thread.

pages.title: Boltzmann Brains & Poincaré Recurrence
pages.text: $(thing)Boltzmann Brains & Poincaré Recurrence$()$(br2)A dead universe is not quite dead. In a finite system at equilibrium every state comes back, given time, and fluctuations out of equilibrium happen by pure chance - a star, a planet, a brain. Unlocks the Boltzmann Fluctuation.
$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Heat Death, Thermodynamics of Information.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Heat Death Ember.

pages.title: Primordial Nucleosynthesis
pages.text: $(thing)Primordial Nucleosynthesis$()$(br2)For three minutes the whole universe was a fusion reactor. Neutrons froze out at one in six, decayed a little, and were swept into helium-4: a quarter of all matter, as measured. Unlocks Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash.
$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): The Hot Big Bang.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 White Dwarf Core.

pages.title: Proton Decay
pages.text: $(thing)Proton Decay$()$(br2)Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.
$(thing)Insight$(): 180$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Grand Unification.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Superpartner Shard.

pages.title: Semiclassical Gravity
pages.text: $(thing)Semiclassical Gravity$()$(br2)Quantum fields on curved spacetime: what can be said with gravity still classical and everything else quantum. Its two tested predictions - gravity on a quantum wave, and a horizon's glow - point past themselves, to spacetime that is quantum too.

$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Neutron Interferometry, Analog Gravity, General Relativity, Monte Carlo Methods.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Gravity-Phase Record, 4 Hawking Correlation Record.

pages.title: Tidal Physics
pages.text: $(thing)Tidal Physics$()$(br2)Gravity pulls harder on your near side than your far side. Near a small black hole the difference tears anything apart lengthwise - spaghettification.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Tidal Stretcher (the Accretion Frontier (Accretion Rim)).
$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Inside a Black Hole, Frame Dragging.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Tidal Shear Crystal, 1 Micro Singularity.

pages.title: Vacuum Decay
pages.text: $(thing)Vacuum Decay$()$(br2)If our vacuum is only metastable, a bubble of the true vacuum may nucleate somewhere, someday. Its wall sweeps outwards at nearly the speed of light, and inside it the laws of physics are different. There would be no warning. Unlocks the True Vacuum Seed.
$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Eschatology, Vacuum Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 Metastable Vacuum Lattice.

Holding it, I sometimes remember mining it before I have done so.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): mined from Retrocausal Ore in the White Hole Interior; dropped by the Photon Moth (the White Hole Interior).

pages.text: Carry an arrow around a small loop on a curved surface and it comes back rotated. The Riemann tensor measures exactly how much, at every point and in every direction. It is the precise mathematical meaning of curvature, and handling it feels like handling the shape of a surface directly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Differentiating the metric twice and letting it orbit a micro singularity, I tracked how parallel-transported vectors rotated. The Tensor Calculus Engine summarised the effect in a single, many-indexed tensor.

pages.text: Gamma rays climbing a tower lose energy to gravity. A source moving at the right speed - less than a micrometre a second - puts them back in tune with the absorber above.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 3$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Built 1 to 8 storeys tall (7.5 m each). Set the Doppler drive to v = gH/c to cancel the gravitational shift, and count long enough that the shift stands five times above the counting error. Keep source and absorber at the same temperature: each kelvin between them shifts the line by 0.66 µm/s.

A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it. Near the Earth the effect is tiny; near a spinning black hole, inside its ergosphere, nothing can stand still.
Stand near a running $(item)Penrose Ergosphere$() or $(item)Kugelblitz Chamber$() and you are carried sideways: $(thing)Frame Drag$().

Light climbing out of gravity loses energy. Over a height H the fraction lost is $(thing)gH/c²$() - about 2.5×10⁻¹⁵ up a 22.5-metre tower. In 1959 Pound and Rebka measured it with the gamma ray of iron-57, whose line is so sharp that even this shows.

The $(item)Pound-Rebka Tower$() is built 1 to 8 storeys tall, 7.5 m each. A $(item)Cobalt-57 Source$() sits on a Doppler drive at the foot, the absorber at the top. Move the source up at exactly $(thing)v = gH/c$() - under a micrometre a second - and the climb is cancelled.

Counting decides how sure you are: the line is 190 µm/s wide, and N gamma rays find its centre to 190/√N. Count until the shift stands five times above that error, and set v within two of it. Keep the tower at the air's temperature: each kelvin between source and absorber shifts the line by 0.66 µm/s - as much as the whole effect.

Two black holes spiralling together shake spacetime: a wave passes, stretching space one way and squeezing it the other, by a strain h of 10⁻²¹ when it reaches us. The $(item)Laser Interferometer$() is an L of two long arms with a $(item)Test Mass$() at each end: a laser split between the arms comes back to interfere, and a wave changes the pattern.

Four noises hide the wave. $(thing)Shot noise$(), the graininess of light, falls as the laser power P and the arms' finesse F rise - but $(thing)radiation pressure$(), the photons' kicks on the mirrors, grows with them. Both depend only on F√P; where they are equal is the standard quantum limit.

$(thing)Seismic noise$() falls tenfold with each isolation stage - more stages, slower to lock. Machines running nearby shake the ground; below sea level it is quieter, as at KAGRA. $(thing)Thermal noise$() in the mirrors falls as √T: cool them with your coolant.

A black hole merger, h = 10⁻²¹, needs a signal-to-noise of 8. A neutron star merger is five times fainter: only cold mirrors will do. Its record points a telescope at the $(thing)kilonova$() - where gold and platinum were made - and every detection gives a great deal of Insight. The chirp's parameters are read off by Bayesian inference: the Analyzer takes black hole records as evidence.

In 1975 Colella, Overhauser and Werner split single neutrons with a perfect silicon crystal and joined them again - and tilted the whole thing. One path ran a few centimetres higher than the other; gravity slowed the neutron on it; the two waves came back out of step. Gravity, acting on a quantum wave: $(thing)Δφ = 2πm²gλA·sin α/h²$().

Grow a $(item)Silicon Boule$() (fused silica and coal in the Crystal Growth Furnace), study it for its Laue Pattern, and cut two into a $(item)Perfect Crystal Interferometer$() - three blades still joined at the base, their lattices aligned to a fraction of an atom.

The $(item)Neutron Interferometer$() runs on a radium-beryllium source. Choose the wavelength and tilt it until gravity has turned the phase at least 30 radians and lands it on a bright fringe; count until the phase is known to 0.1 rad. Each record is a great deal of Insight.

Sound in a fluid flowing faster than sound cannot make headway upstream. Where the flow crosses its own speed of sound there is a horizon for sound - and the mathematics of sound near it is the mathematics of light near a black hole. Hawking radiation included.

The $(item)Analog Black Hole$() makes the flow out of $(fluid)Bose-Einstein Condensate$(): it streams toward a laser step, subsonic, and falls over it, thinned and fast - supersonic. Set the density (sound speed grows as its square root), the flow and the step depth so that both hold.

At the horizon phonon pairs appear, one carried off downstream, its partner escaping up: a glow at $(thing)T_H = ħκ/2πk_B$(), a few nanokelvin. The condensate itself must be colder than that to see it, and the correlations summed over many shots. Nothing but Bose-Einstein Condensate is cold enough as the coolant.

Two experiments have put quantum theory and gravity into one equation: gravity bending a neutron's phase, and a horizon glowing with quantum pairs. Both are $(thing)semiclassical$(): the quantum world on a smooth, classical spacetime.

Beyond them, spacetime itself must be quantum. One way to compute it is to sum over every way of building spacetime out of simple pieces - at random. With Semiclassical Gravity, the Monte Carlo Engine runs these $(thing)causal dynamical triangulations$(): four records of each experiment and two Metric Tensors make a $(item)Spin Foam Lattice$().
From here the road leads on to quantum gravity itself, and to the strings and singularities of the Codex's far end.
Clocks deep in a gravity well run slow: by $(thing)1/√(1 − r_s/r)$() at a distance r from a mass with Schwarzschild radius r_s.

The $(item)Time Dilation Chamber$() holds samples round a dense core. Set its mass and how close they sit: at three times dilation it grows Time-Dilated Samples in bulk; radium ages into polonium; at five, liquid spacetime is strained into $(fluid)Strained Spacetime$(). Too close and they fall through the horizon. Each storey (1 to 7) holds more.

A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope near the Earth turns by $(thing)Ω = 2GJ/(c²r³)$(). A $(item)Precision Gyroscope$() carried in the off hand holds you steady: no Frame Drag, no Tidal Strain.

Tides are the difference between the pull on your two ends: $(thing)2GML/r³$(). Near a small black hole they pull you into spaghetti. Tidal shear crystals, a gyroscope and a micro-singularity knot spacetime into a $(item)Lense-Thirring Vortex Core$().

A falling body follows a $(thing)geodesic$(): the straightest path through curved spacetime. The $(item)Geodesic Compass$() points along one. A mass squeezed inside $(thing)r_s = 2GM/c²$() lets no light out.
Light follows geodesics too, and is bent by $(thing)α = 4GM/(c²b)$() - 1.75″ at the Sun's edge. A mass exactly in front of a star turns it into an Einstein ring.

The $(item)Lensing Concentrator$() aims at a star through a lens mass and turns the focused light into power - at night, under open sky. The magnification $(thing)A = (u² + 2)/(u√(u² + 4))$() grows without limit as the alignment u → 0, but the aim jitters by 0.3 milliarcseconds: choose a massive, near lens so the Einstein radius is big. Above A = 20 it grows an $(item)Einstein Ring Lens$().

Two compact stars spiral in as gravitational waves carry off their orbit; how fast the pitch rises depends only on the $(thing)chirp mass$() (m₁m₂)^(3/5)/(m₁ + m₂)^(1/5). The Binary of the Accretion Frontier drops Chirp Signal Records and Merger Remnants.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the The Binary.

The Laser Interferometer, listening to a chirp with a strain sensor, can hear a $(item)Gravitational Wave Echo$() - repeats after the ringdown, if a horizon is not quite a horizon. Played in the Frontier, an echo summons The Binary just as a Binary Black Hole Merger record does.

Alcubierre found a solution of general relativity that moves a bubble of flat space at any speed: space contracts ahead of it and expands behind. Its wall must be made of $(thing)negative energy$() - from $(item)Negative Energy Lattices$() of Casimir plates.

The $(item)Warp Field Forge$() shapes the bubble. Set its speed, radius and wall sharpness: the negative energy needed grows as v²R²σ, the shear across the wall as vσ (above 5 it tears a passenger apart), and a wall too thick for its bubble (Rσ < 10) leaks. A $(item)Warp Bubble Core$() must be superluminal, with under one solar mass of negative energy.
Use a Warp Bubble Core to anchor where you stand: it becomes an $(item)Anchored Warp Bubble$(). Use that, anywhere, to return there - once. Recipes only take the plain core.

Maldacena and Susskind: two entangled particles are joined by a wormhole too small to cross. The $(item)ER=EPR Weaver$() makes pairs and sends their halves to two mouths. Fidelity falls with the distance and with the weaver's own heat - and every pair heats it. Cold, and close, it weaves an $(item)ER Bridge Thread$().

AdS/CFT: gravity inside a space is a quantum field theory on its boundary. The Holographic Encoder turns a holographic matrix, an island and quantum spacetime condensate into a $(item)Holographic Screen$(), and a screen and Hall bars into a $(item)Boundary CFT Chip$(). For gravity in three dimensions, the boundary theory's central charge is exactly 3L/2G.

A black hole of mass M glows at $(thing)T = ħc³/(8πGMk)$(), radiates power ∝ 1/M², and evaporates in a time ∝ M³. A stellar hole is colder than the sky; one of a billion kilograms, hotter than any star.

The $(item)Micro Black Hole Evaporator$() holds one (a Kugelblitz Seed in a slot) and feeds it dust exactly as fast as it radiates. Feed it less and it shrinks, heats, runs away and explodes; more, and it swells. Below 6×10⁸ kg its gamma rays are too much for the lead. It gives great power and $(fluid)Hawking Radiation$(); above 10¹³ K, $(item)Hawking Quanta$() too.

A black hole has entropy $(thing)S = Ac³/(4Għ)$() - its area in Planck units over four - the most any region can hold: the $(item)Bekenstein Crystal$(). It evaporates; if what comes out is purely thermal, what fell in is gone, and quantum mechanics forbids that.

The $(item)Page Curve Analyzer$() follows Hawking quanta through an evaporation. Firewalls and soft hair are two answers. The third: the radiation's entropy rises, then after the $(thing)Page time$() - when half the hole's entropy is gone, at M/√2 - falls back to zero. A $(item)Page Curve Record$() carried in the off hand keeps your hotbar in order (no Information Loss). With an ER bridge, it finds the $(item)Island$() that makes the curve turn.

Loop quantum gravity quantises space: areas come in steps of $(thing)8πγℓₚ²√(j(j+1))$(). The $(item)Spin Network Loom$() weaves Planck Shards into $(item)Planck Area Tiles$(), tiles into $(item)Spin Network Nodes$(), and nodes with liquid spacetime into $(fluid)Quantum Spacetime Condensate$().

Causal set theory scatters events at random and keeps only their order: the Monte Carlo Engine sprinkles a $(item)Causal Set Seed$(). Asymptotic safety follows gravity's coupling to a fixed point instead of infinity: a node and a seed together make a $(item)Fixed-Point Lattice$().
Empty space looks empty only if you are not accelerating. Accelerate at a, and the vacuum glows at $(thing)T = ħa/(2πck)$() - one kelvin needs 2.5×10²⁰ m/s².

The $(item)Unruh Accelerator$() is a storage ring: electrons of Lorentz factor γ bent by a field B feel a = γ²c²/r, with r = γmc/eB. Gently, it calibrates an $(item)Unruh Thermometer$() (1-10 K). Hard - above 5000 K - its bath turns superfluid helium into Hawking radiation. But the beam radiates as γ³B, and the cavities replace only 500 kW.

Day 58. The $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$() works up from $(item)Lorentz Transforms$() and the $(item)Minkowski Lattice$() to the $(item)Metric$() and $(item)Riemann Curvature Tensors$() and finally the $(item)Einstein Field Core$().

The order follows the physics. First flat $(thing)Minkowski$() spacetime, where the $(thing)Lorentz transform$() says how lengths and times change between moving observers. Then gravity: the $(thing)metric$() measures distance in curved spacetime, the $(thing)Riemann tensor$() measures the curvature, and Einstein's equations tie that curvature to matter.

Why it matters: wormhole throats need an $(item)Einstein Field Core$(), and Alcubierre coils need $(item)metric tensors$(). Kugelblitz chambers can merge black holes into $(item)Gravitational Wave Crystals$() - the ripple of two horizons becoming one, frozen solid.
Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$().
g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$().
Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$().
Made in a crafting grid.
Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$().
How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop - curvature itself.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tensor Calculus Engine$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Lorentz Transform Crystal$(): Alcubierre Coil, Chronon Gas, Minkowski Lattice, Novikov Crystal, Spacetime Singularity$(li)$(item)Metric Tensor$(): Alcubierre Coil, Brane Tether, Causal Set Seed, Riemann Curvature Tensor, Spacetime Singularity and more$(li)$(item)Einstein Field Core$(): Dimensional Residue, Gravitational Wave Crystal, Kerr Metric Shard, Spacetime Singularity, Theo...

Novikov's principle, plainly: if time travel is possible, the only histories allowed are ones that are already consistent. You cannot stop your own birth; something always intervenes.$(br2)Here it is enforced. Closed timelike curves now need a Novikov Crystal: a time loop is only allowed if it can never produce a paradox.

Quantum field theory says empty space is never quite empty: $(thing)virtual particles$() borrow energy for an instant and vanish again. In the Foam they flicker densely enough to catch.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Field notes. It only works in the $(thing)Quantum Foam$(). Each virtual particle has a $(thing)resonance$() (0-100) that changes from place to place. The harvester catches whichever particle its dial is tuned closest to, and the closer the better.

So I take a $(item)Resonance Probe$() to where the harvester stands and read the four values. Then I either move the harvester or retune it, to choose what it makes. Two wasted afternoons before I accepted that the readings are local.

pages.text: Surrounds a captive star with a swarm, and eventually a sphere, of collectors.$(br2)Generates power.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.

Freeman Dyson, 1960: a civilisation hungry enough for energy would wrap its star in collectors, and we could spot it by its waste heat. I appear to be that civilisation now.$(br2)This controller is too complex for a crafting grid. Build it on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts.

Loading it: a $(item)Stellar Core$() in the first slot. $(item)Dyson Swarm Satellites$() (up to 500) in the second - or leave a $(item)Von Neumann Probe$() there and it builds the swarm by itself. $(item)Dyson Shell Segments$() in the third: 64 close the sphere, but you need 100 satellites before shells can be mounted.

The yield, as I have worked it out:$(br2)Output = base x satellites/50 x (1 + shells/16)$(br2)and doubled again once the sphere is complete. A finished sphere is the brightest thing I have built, and from outside you cannot see it at all.

pages.text: When a star exhausts the hydrogen in its core it swells, and its outer layers expand and cool to a dull red. The Sun will do this in about five billion years. The envelope is enormous and tenuous, a thin, glowing fog that barely seems to weigh anything.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Running a stellar core in the Nucleosynthesis Chamber past hydrogen exhaustion, I watched its outer layers puff outward. Separating the swollen envelope from the core left me with this bloated fog.
Made in $(item)Nucleosynthesis Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Magnetar Shard, Stellar Singularity, Supernova Remnant.

pages.text: $(thing)Dyson Sphere$()$(br2)Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

pages.title: Nucleosynthesis
pages.text: $(thing)Nucleosynthesis$()$(br2)Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

$(thing)Insight$(): 90$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Stellar Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 White Dwarf Core.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the energy (MeV) released when four hydrogen atoms fuse into one helium-4 atom (atomic masses in u, 1 u = 931.5 MeV).

pages.title: Residual Starlight
pages.text: The light left over when matter goes beyond stellar temperatures. It is a hot, glowing gas that carries the memory of every star that went into it. It moves like a slow, luminous fog. Its glow is the colour of a sky just after a star has set.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing a Stellar Core beyond its limits in the Transcendent Plasma Forge, with magnetar and pentaquark shards, the matter gave off a glowing gas. Residual starlight, the afterglow of transcendence.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Cosmic String Segment, Dark Energy, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Matter, Exotic Matter Crystal, Horizon Shard, Hypernova Alloy Ingot and more.

pages.title: Stellar Iron Ingot
pages.text: Iron forged in the core of a star, where fusion stops being profitable. Iron has the most tightly bound nucleus, so fusing it or splitting it costs energy. The ingot is dense and dull grey and carries a faint heat that seems to come from somewhere deep inside it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Combining a white dwarf core with ordinary iron in stellar plasma, I drove fusion until it stopped. Iron was where nucleosynthesis ended, and the Chamber left me an ingot of star-forged metal.
Made in $(item)Nucleosynthesis Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Nucleosynthesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dyson Shell Segment, Magnetar Shard, Stellar Singularity, Supernova Remnant.

pages.title: Supernova Remnant
pages.text: The expanding shell of gas and the collapsed core left when a massive star's core can no longer support itself. The shockwave seeds space with heavy elements. This remnant is a dense nugget wrapped in a faint, glowing haze of debris.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Neutron Star Forge I collapsed a stellar iron core under neutronium pressure and flooded it with neutrinos. The red giant envelope blew outward and left a small, heavy remnant.

Made in $(item)Neutron Star Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Nucleosynthesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Gold Ingot, Hypernova Alloy Ingot, Magnetar Shard, Quark Star Core, R-Process Cluster, Stellar Singularity, Theoretical Notes III and more.

pages.title: Transcendent Metal Ingot
pages.text: In the forge, above stellar-core temperatures, properties like hardness and conductivity stop being fixed and start being chosen. This ingot is what a metal looks like when someone else chose them. It weighs exactly what the forge decided, and feels faintly as though it might change its mind.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the forge a hypernova alloy and things that are barely matter at all: an aleph-null shard, Russell's paradox, a cosmic processor. The processor set the rules, the paradox loosened the old ones, and the metal accepted whatever properties it was given.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Apeiron Ingot, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Omniscience Catalyst, Omnium Ingot, Pleroma Confluence.

pages.title: Transcendent Plasma
pages.text: Plasma above the temperature where matter has fixed properties. It is no longer any element; it is all of them and none. It glows every colour at once and has no fixed density. Instruments dipped into it return a different reading every time, all of them correct.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Pushing hypernova alloy with an Aleph-Null Shard and a Russell Paradox Set into the Transcendent Plasma Forge, the plasma stopped having fixed properties. Stellar transcendence.

Made in $(item)Transcendent Plasma Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Transcendence.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmological Constant, False Vacuum, Graviton Crystal, Heat Death Remnant, Horizon Shard, Inflaton Field, Omnium Ingot, Pocket Universe and more.

pages.title: Transfinite Coil Block
pages.text: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself. The windings seem to continue past the point where the coil should end.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Above stellar-core temperatures even cosmic neutronium coils fail. I wound hypernova alloy around an aleph-null shard with a room-temperature superconductor and a cosmic processor, and the coil held.

pages.title: Von Neumann Probe
pages.text: A self-replicating machine that builds copies of itself from whatever material it finds. Send one to a star system and it builds more, which build more, until every star has one. Von Neumann proved such machines were possible. This one is small, neat and patient.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)In the Nanite Assembler I gave a Dyson Swarm Satellite claytronic catoms and a Quantum Processor, so it could fabricate its own parts. It began printing a copy of itself before I had finished writing the entry.
Made in $(item)Nanite Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Dyson Swarm.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Theoretical Notes I.

pages.title: White Dwarf Core
pages.text: What remains when a modest star sheds its outer layers: a core of carbon and oxygen about the size of the Earth, held up against gravity only by electron degeneracy pressure. It is fiercely hot and absurdly heavy for its size, and will cool for longer than the universe has existed.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)After the red giant phase, the Nucleosynthesis Chamber left a small, glowing ember behind. Electron degeneracy held it up, exactly as Chandrasekhar described, and it slowly radiated away its leftover heat.
Made in $(item)Tectonic Press$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Evolution.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Stellar Iron Ingot, Stellar Singularity.

Almost every atom heavier than helium in my body was cooked inside a star. This chamber runs that process on a workbench: a gas cloud falls in on itself, fusion lights, the star swells, and it dies. My notes on stellar evolution follow each stage.

When a real star runs low on hydrogen its outer layers balloon outward; mine swells into a $(item)Red Giant$(), and I keep its $(item)White Dwarf$() - the bare, glowing core left behind.

White dwarfs forge $(item)Stellar Iron$() - the end of fusion. Iron's nucleus is among the most tightly bound there is; fusing it costs energy instead of releasing it. Dyson shells are made of stellar iron.

A red giant crushed onto stellar iron goes supernova. Its remnant feeds the $(item)r-process$() - rapid neutron capture, nature's way of making gold and everything heavier - and it is needed for every quark star.

pages.title: Geodesic Anchor
pages.text: A device that keeps its bearer's worldline intact inside a black or white hole. Without it, tidal forces and causal chaos are lethal within seconds. It is heavy and cool and hums faintly, like a gyroscope.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Inside a black hole I nearly lost my worldline. Combining a Kerr metric shard, graviton crystal and chronon capacitor in a hyperlattice frame on the Extreme Assembly Table, I built an anchor to keep it.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.

pages.title: Grand Unified Core
pages.text: At sufficiently high energy, the electromagnetic, weak and strong couplings run together and meet. Grand unified theories predict magnetic monopoles and proton decay as a consequence. The core is bright and calm, three forces resting in a single symmetry.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Running the Standard Model's couplings upward with superpartners included, I saw them converge. In the Tesseract Assembler, a monopole and a quantum string held the high-energy state long enough to crystallise it.

Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Grand Unification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Eschaton Core, Standard Model Singularity, Theory of Everything, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma.

pages.title: Graviton Crystal
pages.text: Gravitons are the hypothetical quanta of gravity, and this crystal holds them frozen in a lattice. It feels heavier than it is: the stored gravitons pull on my hand as well as on the floor. Near it, falling dust curves slightly toward the crystal before reaching the ground.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): dropped by the Graviton Wisp (the Bulk (Graviton Reef)).

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I cooled Virtual Gravitons from the quantum foam in Superfluid Helium inside the Graviton Condenser until they could not escape. Graviton Wisps carry them naturally, and I found more in vaults, monoliths and derelict stations.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Graviton Wisp.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Anomaly Vault, Bulk Monolith chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Brane Tether, Bulk Crystal, Bulk Stone, Compactification Lathe, Cosmic Processor, Cosmic String Lens, False Vacuum, Geodesic Anchor and more.

pages.title: Graviton Harness
pages.text: A web of straps and plates that takes the pull of a crushing field and spreads it through every bone at once, so no single joint bears it. Tidal forces kill by difference, not by strength; the harness erases the difference. Wearing it feels like being hugged by a planet.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A walk through a high-gravity field nearly broke both my ankles. I laid graviton crystals across neutronium plating and added an inertia damper to smooth the gradients, so that the field pulls on all of me equally and none of me in particular.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.

pages.title: Graviton Wisp
pages.text: $(thing)Graviton Wisp$(). Lives in: Graviton Reef, The Bulk.$(br)Drops: Graviton Wisp Core, Graviton Crystal, Void Lattice Shard.

pages.title: Heat Death Remnant
pages.text: All that is left of a universe that has reached maximum entropy: no stars, no gradients, nothing to drive any process at all. It is cold, perfectly even and perfectly still, a uniform grey with no texture to catch the light. Holding it feels like holding silence.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I let a Pocket Universe in the Universe Forge run to its end. Trillions of years compressed into a few minutes, and the bubble came out like this: inert, even, and oddly peaceful. Its stillness is what makes new universes possible.
Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Cosmogenesis.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Boltzmann Brain, Inflaton Field, Universe Seed.

pages.title: Inflaton Condensate
pages.text: A scalar field held at the top of its potential, rolling so slowly that space doubles many times before it moves.
Made in $(item)Inflation Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Cosmic Inflation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): No-Boundary Seed, Pocket Universe, Reheating Plasma, Universe Seed.

pages.title: M-Brane
pages.text: A two-dimensional membrane from M-theory, the eleven-dimensional framework in which strings are the edges of membranes. A brane like this could host an entire universe on its surface, with gravity alone leaking into the Bulk. It is a sheet of light that ripples when I breathe on it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I wove a D-Brane Sheet with a G2 Manifold and a String Coupling Crystal on the String Resonance Loom, turning the coupling up until the strings fused into a membrane. Eleven dimensions, counted twice to make sure.

Made in $(item)String Resonance Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): M-Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Dimensional Singularity, Exotic Matter Crystal, Inflaton Field, M-Theory Core, Multiverse Shard, Penteract Display, Theoretical Notes II and more.

pages.title: M-Theory Core
pages.text: Five superstring theories turned out to be limits of one eleven-dimensional theory, whose fundamental objects include membranes as well as strings. Witten called it M-theory, and nobody knows what the M stands for. The core vibrates in more directions than seem possible.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Wrapping an M-brane on a G2 manifold and a compactified circle in the Compactification Lathe, I found all five string theories as limits of one. Exotic matter kept the eleventh dimension open.
Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): M-Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Singularity, Theory of Everything.

pages.title: Metastable Vacuum Lattice
pages.text: The Higgs potential mapped out to the Planck scale: the valley we live in is not the deepest one. Held in a lattice of Higgs field capacitors.
Made in $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Vacuum Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): No-Boundary Seed, Topological Defect Core, True Vacuum Seed.

pages.title: No-Boundary Seed
pages.text: A closed universe tunnelled from nothing: round, without an edge, and without a first moment of time.
Made in $(item)Inflation Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Creation from Nothing.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Universe Seed.

pages.title: Quantum String
pages.text: A one-dimensional vibrating string, the fundamental object of string theory. Its mode of vibration decides what it is: one note an electron, another a photon, another a graviton. In the hand it is a thread of light that hums, changing its tune slightly with my pulse.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The String Resonance Loom stretched a Cosmic String Segment down to the Planck scale, tuned it with a Tachyon Crystal and held it in a Superposition Crystal. When it began to vibrate in discrete modes, I knew it was a string.

Made in $(item)String Resonance Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Calabi Yau Knot chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): String Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Brane Tension Fiber, Compactified Circle, D-Brane Sheet, Dimensional Residue, Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix, Grand Unified Core, Graviton Crystal, String Coupling Crystal.

pages.title: Reheating Plasma
pages.text: The hot soup left when the inflaton decayed and inflation ended. It filled a cold, empty universe with particles and heat: the Big Bang proper.

Made in $(item)Inflation Chamber$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Reheating.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Singularity, Baryogenesis Seed, Baryon Asymmetry Crystal, No-Boundary Seed, Pocket Universe, Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash, Universe Seed.

pages.title: Causal Set Theory
pages.text: $(thing)Causal Set Theory$()$(br2)Spacetime as a set of events and nothing else but which can affect which. Scatter them at random, and a manifold appears: order plus number gives geometry.
$(thing)Insight$(): 260$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Quantum Gravity, Set Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Normal Distribution Crystal, 2 Metric Tensor.

pages.title: Conformal Cyclic Cosmology
pages.text: $(thing)Conformal Cyclic Cosmology$()$(br2)At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon.
$(thing)Insight$(): 280$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Creation from Nothing, Heat Death, Cosmogenesis.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 2 De Sitter Horizon Shard.

pages.title: Leptogenesis
pages.text: $(thing)Leptogenesis$()$(br2)Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.
$(thing)Insight$(): 190$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reheating, Neutrino Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 8 Sterile Neutrino.

pages.title: M-Theory
pages.text: $(thing)M-Theory$()$(br2)Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

$(thing)Insight$(): 120$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): String Theory, Brane Cosmology, Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Quantum String.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Find the 11-dimensional Planck length of M-theory from the string coupling gs and string length ls.

pages.title: Creation from Nothing
pages.text: $(thing)Creation from Nothing$()$(br2)Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe.
$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Reheating, Vacuum Stability, Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Spin Foam Lattice.

pages.title: Reheating
pages.text: $(thing)Reheating$()$(br2)Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.
$(thing)Insight$(): 170$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Inflation, High-Energy Particle Physics.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Strange Matter Pellet.

pages.title: Vacuum Stability
pages.text: $(thing)Vacuum Stability$()$(br2)What could stop a universe from starting at all? A vacuum energy a little larger and it would fly apart before stars formed; a Higgs coupling a little smaller and the vacuum would be unstable. Ours sits, by measurement, at the edge: metastable. Unlocks the Metastable Vacuum Lattice.
$(thing)Insight$(): 180$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Cosmic Inflation, The Standard Model.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Higgs Field Capacitor.

pages.title: Rift Anchor
pages.text: A clamp for tears between universes. Graviton crystals pin the edges of the rift, void lattice keeps the Bulk from closing in, and exotic matter props the gap open just long enough to reach through. It vibrates faintly, as if something on the other side were tugging back.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Every rift I opened closed before I could use it. In the Graviton Condenser I bound a Graviton Crystal to a Void Lattice Shard with Exotic Matter, and the next rift stayed open long enough for me to put my hand through.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Exotic Matter Crystal, Inflaton Field, Multiverse Rift Stabilizer, Multiverse Shard, Void Lattice Shard.

pages.title: Rift Frame Casing
pages.text: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe. It is built to sit at the edge of a rift between universes, and it feels faintly cold on one side.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stabilising a multiverse rift tore through every casing I tried. I layered a void lattice shard, which is rigid even with nothing in it, over a hyperframe with graviton crystal to hold the geometry. It held.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmogenic Casing, Multiverse Rift Stabilizer.

pages.title: Spacetime Anchor Pylon
pages.text: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up. Compasses near it point steady.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Large machines warped the ground they stood on. I built a pylon around an anchor core with a chronosteel coil and hyperframe casing, and the warping stopped at its edge.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.

pages.title: Spin Foam Lattice
pages.text: A lattice of spin networks evolving in time, the loop quantum gravity picture of spacetime as discrete quanta of area and volume. It looks like a soap foam frozen in place, but each bubble is a quantum of space itself. Pressing it does not compress it; space does not come in smaller units.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed Graviton Crystals through the Graviton Condenser together with a qubit to track the states and a condensate to hold them coherent. Spacetime started showing up in discrete chunks, which loop gravity had promised.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Gravity.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bounce Core, Coherence Stabiliser, Cosmogenic Casing, Dimensional Residue, No-Boundary Seed, Pocket Universe, Spin Network Loom, Superintelligence Core.

pages.title: Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix
pages.text: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load. Without it, extra dimensions tend to unroll, and the laws of physics shift. It looks like a tight knot of light, faintly warm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)On the String Resonance Loom I wove Quantum Strings through a Calabi-Yau Manifold with a Topological Insulator and Exotic Matter. The compact dimensions held their shape even under pressure.

Made in $(item)String Resonance Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): String Theory.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Adaptive Feedback Core, Anomaly Containment Ward, Contained Anomaly Specimen, Dimensional Stabiliser, Quarantine Field Matrix, Theoretical Notes I.

pages.title: String Coupling Crystal
pages.text: Turn this crystal and the strength with which strings interact changes. Turn it far enough and a strongly coupled string theory becomes a weakly coupled one of a different type: this is string duality. It is cool and smooth and feels slightly alive.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fixed a compactified circle's radius with a bulk crystal and varied the coupling in the Compactification Lathe. At strong coupling, Type IIA became M-theory, and the crystal captured the transition.
Made in $(item)Compactification Lathe$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): M-Brane, Theoretical Notes III.

pages.title: Vacuum Energy Cell
pages.text: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it. It feels heavier when full, though nothing has been added.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Casimir cell ran out of gap. I needed more vacuum to work with, so I folded in exotic matter for negative energy, graviton crystal for structure and a dark matter lens to concentrate the field.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Singularity Energy Cell.

Two branches of physics are about time itself: $(thing)Origin$(), how a universe begins, and $(thing)Finality$(), how it ends. Origin starts with $(thing)The Hot Big Bang$(): run the expansion backwards and everything was once hotter and denser than the core of a star.

The $(thing)Friedmann equation$() says how fast space expands: H² = 8πGρ/3 − kc²/a² + Λc²/3. Matter and radiation slow it, curvature bends it, and the vacuum energy Λ - dark energy - takes over in the end. Exactly flat space has the critical density, about five protons per cubic metre.

$(li)$(thing)Primordial Nucleosynthesis$(): for three minutes the universe fused hydrogen into helium. $(item)Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash$() comes from quark-gluon plasma (or reheating plasma) in the $(item)Nucleosynthesis Chamber$().$(li)$(thing)Cosmic Inflation$() and $(thing)Reheating$(): see the next chapter.$(li)$(thing)Leptogenesis$(), $(thing)Vacuum Stability$(), $(thing)Creation from Nothing$() and $(thing)Conformal Cyclic Cosmology$() come after.

Where Finality ends, Origin begins. Roger Penrose noticed that at the end of a heat death only massless particles remain - and light has no clock: it cannot tell an infinitely large, cold universe from a tiny, hot one. Rescale the dead universe's infinite future and it is the Big Bang of the next $(thing)aeon$().

In the $(item)Inflation Chamber$(): $(item)Heat Death Embers$(), a $(item)De Sitter Horizon Shard$() and $(fluid)Dark Era Haze$() make an $(item)Aeon Boundary Shard$(); the Shard with a $(item)No-Boundary Seed$() and inflaton condensate makes two $(item)Universe Seeds$(). A $(item)Bounce Core$() from a Big Crunch makes one too.

Origin also feeds what came before it: the $(item)Universe Forge$() can make a $(item)Pocket Universe$() from first principles - a seed, a true-vacuum bubble, the asymmetry, the ash and the plasma - and the Eye of the Horizon's and the Omnilex's universes now want Primordial Ash and a No-Boundary Seed.

The Big Bang alone cannot explain why opposite sides of the sky have the same temperature to one part in 100,000: they were never in contact. $(thing)Inflation$() does: before the hot Big Bang, a scalar field - the inflaton - sat high on its potential and made space grow exponentially, sixty e-folds in 10⁻³² s.

Build the $(item)Inflation Chamber$(). It condenses the $(fluid)Inflaton Field$() and $(fluid)False Vacuum$() into $(item)Inflaton Condensate$(). In its Operation console keep the slow-roll ε = 2/φ² below 1 and N = (φ₀² − 2)/4 above 50 - but start the field too high and inflation turns $(thing)eternal$(): quantum jumps outrun the roll, and the bubble never ends (in our universe, other bubbles still may).

$(thing)Reheating$(): at the bottom of its potential the inflaton oscillates and decays. The chamber turns Condensate and a little quark-gluon plasma into $(fluid)Reheating Plasma$() - every particle there is, at 10⁹ GeV and more. That plasma is the raw stuff of every other Origin material.

Reheating makes matter and antimatter in equal amounts, and they should have annihilated into light. For every billion photons there is one baryon left over. Andrei Sakharov's conditions say what it takes: baryon number violation, C and CP violation, and a moment out of equilibrium.

$(thing)Leptogenesis$() meets all three: heavy right-handed neutrinos decay a little more often into leptons than antileptons, and sphaleron transitions of the electroweak vacuum convert that excess into baryons. In a $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$(), antimatter and sterile neutrinos in $(fluid)Reheating Plasma$() leave a $(item)Baryon Asymmetry Crystal$(). With the antimatter of the Antiverse, crystals become a $(item)Baryogenesis Seed$() in the $(item)Mirror Foundry$().

$(thing)Vacuum Stability$(): a universe can fail before it starts. A vacuum energy larger by a factor of a hundred and no galaxy forms; the measured one is 10¹²⁰ times smaller than quantum theory's natural guess - the $(thing)cosmological constant problem$(). And the Higgs coupling runs downwards with energy until, near 10¹⁰ GeV, a deeper vacuum opens: ours is $(thing)metastable$(). The $(item)Higgs Field Modulator$() maps it into a $(item)Metastable Vacuum Lattice$().

$(thing)Creation from Nothing$(): quantise a whole closed universe and its wave function obeys the Wheeler-DeWitt equation. Vilenkin's universe tunnels through a barrier from no space at all; Hartle and Hawking's has no boundary - near the start time turns into space, and asking what came before is like asking what is south of the South Pole.
The $(item)Inflation Chamber$() folds spin foam, inflaton condensate and a metastable vacuum into a $(item)No-Boundary Seed$().

pages.title: String Resonance Loom
pages.text: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 4$() machine.

Two very different 'strings'. A $(thing)cosmic string$() is a hypothetical crack in spacetime left by the early universe, light-years long and thinner than a proton. A $(thing)fundamental string$() is string theory's basic object: each vibration mode is a particle. The $(item)String Resonance Loom$() turns one into the other.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (5 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Brane Tension Fiber, Cosmic String Lens, Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix, M-Brane, Quantum String.
Made in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Universe Forge
pages.text: Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow - and later harvest - a pocket universe. I have never been more nervous.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 5$() machine.
Note to self: this controller is too complex for a crafting grid. It has to be built on the $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$() - check JEI for the exact parts before ordering anything.

A $(thing)false vacuum$() is a metastable state; if it decays, a bubble of true vacuum expands at nearly light speed. $(thing)Inflation$(), driven by the inflaton field, stretched our universe by a factor of at least 10^26 in a fraction of a second. Combine them and you get a universe in a box.

Procedure: first forge a $(item)Pocket Universe$() from a $(item)Universe Seed$(), $(fluid)False Vacuum$() and $(fluid)Inflaton Field$(). Then feed it back in to harvest it until only a $(item)Heat Death Remnant$() remains.$(br2)Four remnants can be re-inflated into a new seed. Nothing is wasted, not even the end of time.

Every journey to another dimension - by Brane Shifter, rift, wormhole, falling through the void or the hyperobject - now takes a moment: the travel animation builds up on screen for under two seconds, and only then do you jump. The loading screen of each world is its own.

Wherever you arrive, you arrive standing: never inside blocks, never in mid-air, never on top of a world's ceiling (the Quantum Foam's Relativity Breakdown, the build limit), never in a fluid or on something that burns. The ground nearby is searched for two free blocks over solid ground - open sky first, otherwise the spot nearest the height you left from.
Only when there is nowhere at all is a small platform built for you, with the room above it cleared. Laws of the place still apply: carry its attunement item.

The $(thing)Planetary Interior$() is the exception to open sky: it has a bedrock roof, so you arrive under it, on dry rock as near y 100 as the cave allows, with a Mantle Breach beside you for the way back.

Every strange dimension has the item that lets you survive it. Each one was made from what you brought back from the places before it - so it carries their protection too.$(br2)Carry an attunement item and every dimension whose own item comes $(l)earlier$() in this list cannot touch you at all: no debuffs, no strange gravity, no rules.
$(li)$(item)Form of the Self$(): the Platonic Realm$(li)$(item)Penning Harness$(): the Antiverse$(li)$(item)Coherence Stabiliser$(): the Quantum Foam$(li)$(item)Brane Tether$(): the Bulk

$(li)$(item)Geodesic Anchor$(): black and white holes$(li)$(item)Well-Ordering Charm$(): the Transfinite Hierarchy$(li)$(item)Primordial Charter$(): Hyperdimensional Reality$(li)$(item)Identity Kernel$(): the Transcendental$(br2)So the $(item)Primordial Charter$() shields you completely in every place before Hyperdimensional Reality, does its usual job inside Hyperdimensional Reality itself, and only the Transcendental still needs the $(item)Identity Kernel$(). In its own dimension, each item works as it always has.

Brane cosmology says our universe is a membrane adrift in a higher-dimensional $(thing)Bulk$(). The $(item)Brane Shifter$() slips me sideways into it, and back. It requires the Brane Cosmology research.

First crossing. The Bulk is an endless void of floating islands under the shadow of a vast hypercube - a four-dimensional cube, of which I only ever see a 3D shadow. Monoliths hide vaults of exotic materials, and $(item)Void Lattice Ore$() is common here.
Physics aside: in brane-world models only gravity leaks out into the Bulk, which might be why it is so much weaker than the other forces. Standing out here, I believe it.
Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.

Log, the Bulk, fifth crossing. It is not uniform. There are regions: the open $(thing)Bulk$(), the crystal $(thing)Graviton Reefs$() and the $(thing)Moduli Wastes$().

$(thing)Derelict Stations$() hold salvage and supplies - someone came here before me. $(thing)Collapsed Calabi-Yau Knots$() hang over the Wastes with caches at their hearts. In string theory, Calabi-Yau shapes are the tiny curled-up extra dimensions; these have come uncurled.

The locals:$(li)$(thing)Graviton Wisps$() pull you toward them and crush you up close.$(li)$(thing)Brane Striders$() slip between branes when hurt and leave you seeing double.$(li)$(thing)Moduli Crawlers$() hunt in packs and climb anything.$(br2)I keep my back to a wall. It does not help with the Crawlers.

Ruins and impossible structures keep their treasure in $(item)Containment Caches$(), not chests. Each dimension seals its own kind: the Bulk Cache borrows room from a fifth dimension, the Euclid Reliquary of the Platonic Realm closes on an exact right angle, the Hilbert Locker is always full and always has room for one more.
A cache works like a chest of 27 slots; hoppers and pipes can reach it. Breaking it spills its contents and drops the cache itself. You can make an ordinary $(item)Containment Cache$() of your own.
Sunday. Even a lab deserves some style. Put a block of any high-tech material in a $(item)Stonecutter$() for plating, tiles, bricks and pillars - and back again, so nothing is wasted.

Surround a material block with glowstone dust for four $(item)Lamps$(). Most bricks and tiles also come as stairs, slabs and walls.$(br2)Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium, Dilithium and Void Lattice each have a storage block too - which is how I keep the hoard tidy.
Made in a crafting grid.
Nether expedition, day 2. $(item)Dilithium$() grows down here. Its lattice is porous to antimatter, which makes it the only practical regulator for an annihilation reactor.

Field notes: annihilation turns all the rest mass of matter and antimatter into energy - E = mc², the full amount, against under 1% for fusion. The hard part has always been holding antimatter without it touching anything. A crystal it can pass through gently is exactly what such a reactor needs.
Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): mined from Dilithium Ore in the Nether.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Dilithium Crystal$(): Annihilation Core, Block of Dilithium, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dilithium Crystal, Magnetar Shard and more
Every other place has its own law, and the law is not kind to visitors. Carry the right $(thing)attunement$() anywhere in your inventory and you will live - with a reminder of where you are.

$(li)$(item)Brane Tether$(), the Bulk: without it, $(thing)Dimensional Bleed$(); with it, half gravity and twice the knockback.$(li)$(item)Primordial Charter$(), Hyperdimensional Reality: without it a hostile new law every few seconds; with it, a new law (good or bad) every minute and a half.

$(li)$(item)Form of the Self$(), the Platonic Realm: without it, $(thing)Imperfection$(); with it, only a $(thing)sword$() can dig - pickaxes barely scratch the ideal.$(li)$(item)Coherence Stabiliser$(), the Quantum Foam: without it, constant $(thing)Decoherence$(); with it, you still blink a few blocks now and then.

$(li)$(item)Well-Ordering Charm$(), the Transfinite Hierarchy: without it, $(thing)Infinite Regress$() deepens every ten seconds; with it, Regress I and hunger.$(li)$(item)Geodesic Anchor$(), both holes: without it, death in two seconds. In the white hole gravity points $(thing)up$() - sneak to fall.$(li)$(item)Identity Kernel$(), the Transcendental: without it, $(thing)Dissolution$().
Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk - or in any field of extra dimensions.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam - or in an altered vacuum.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.

None of these places has a bottom you can die on. Fall off the floor of one and you fall into another:$(li)off the $(thing)Bulk$(): back onto our own brane$(li)through the $(thing)Platonic Realm$(): into the Transfinite Hierarchy$(li)below the $(thing)Transfinite$(): into the Quantum Foam

$(li)through a $(thing)black hole$()'s singularity: out of its white hole$(li)past the top of a $(thing)white hole$(): home$(li)between the branches of $(thing)Hyperdimensional Reality$(): into the Bulk$(li)out of the $(thing)Transcendental$(): into Hyperdimensional Reality$(br2)Carry the right attunement for wherever you land.

One world is different. The $(thing)Planetary Interior$() has a true floor - the $(item)Inner Core Boundary$(), solid iron that nothing yet cuts - and a roof of bedrock. There is nothing to fall through: you leave the way you came, by a $(item)Mantle Breach$().

The floor of the Planetary Interior: the edge of the solid inner core, 5,150 km down. Iron here is crystallised under 330 GPa and about 5,400 C - as hot as the Sun's surface, yet solid because the pressure will not let it melt.$(br2)$(thing)Found$(): in the Planetary Interior.

A hole bored through bedrock by the Core Drill. Step into it and you fall to the Planetary Interior; on arrival a second breach opens in the floor beside you, and stepping into that one brings you back up.
Stand inside a structure built in more dimensions than three and your eyes stop agreeing with your feet. The deeper you go, the more space folds to match the object you are in:

$(li)$(thing)Tesseracts$() and Bulk monoliths: nested cubes turning inside one another$(li)$(thing)Fractals$(): the view contains itself, again and again$(li)$(thing)Platonic solids$(): mirrored through their symmetry$(li)$(thing)Hilbert's Hotel$() and the Ordinal Spire: an endless corridor$(li)$(thing)Calabi-Yau knots$() and Hopf rings: space wound round itself

$(li)$(thing)Graviton reefs$(): light bent into an Einstein ring$(li)$(thing)Anomaly vaults$(): the picture tears$(li)the heart of the $(thing)Transcendental$(): all of it at once.$(br2)It is harmless, and fades as you walk out. It can be switched off in the client config (structureDistortion).

The $(thing)Planetary Interior$() needs no attunement item - its laws are only the planet's own, and they press harder the deeper you go. You reach it with the $(item)Core Drill$() (research $(thing)Plate Tectonics$()), cutting the Overworld's bedrock floor; you leave by any $(item)Mantle Breach$() - one opens beside you wherever you arrive.

$(li)$(thing)Lithostatic Pressure$(): below y 100, one level for every 25 blocks deeper; you move and mine slower.$(li)$(thing)Tremors$() in the Crustal Caverns: a few seconds of Seismic Vertigo.$(li)$(thing)Mantle plumes$() in the Mantle Convection Zone throw you upwards.$(li)$(thing)Geomagnetic storms$() in the Geodynamo Core leave you Magnetized: compasses spin.

$(li)The $(thing)Natural Reactor$() is radioactive - its background is far above the Overworld's, and Fission Fragment seams are hot.
