block:false_vacuum#lore.text: False Vacuum, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:feed_horn#lore.text: A flared metal waveguide at the focus of a dish. It funnels the faint reflected radio waves into the receiver and turns a deaf ear to whatever comes from the sides.

block:femto_fabricator#lore.text: Builds components smaller than a proton - and assembles them into processors.

block:femtoscale_assembly_line#lore.text: A long line of robotic arms and fabrication heads for the most complex assemblies: high-tier processors and late-game machine controllers.

block:ferrofluid#lore.text: Ferrofluid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:field_emitter#lore.text: A compact emitter of neutronium plate, Cherenkov quartz and a quantum dot that projects a field shaped by the dot's quantum state. Change the state, change the field.

block:fission_fragment_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Fission Fragment Mix when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:foam_bubble#lore.text: A pocket of space sitting in a higher-energy vacuum than its surroundings, metastable and patient. Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256.

block:foam_cache#lore.text: Held together by a bubble of stable vacuum. Spacetime at the Planck scale may seethe with fluctuations; inside, it has been made to keep still.

block:foam_substrate#lore.text: Spongy, effervescent matter scooped from below the Planck length. Bubbles of spacetime swell and vanish inside it so fast the block seems to fizz without making a sound.

block:focus_receiver#lore.text: The target at a lens's focal point, where light gathered over a broad aperture converges onto one small spot. It has to survive what it receives.

block:forged_omnipotence_core#lore.text: An Omnipotence Core forged anew. Unbreakable; only the Hand of the Demiurge can attune, wake or move it.

block:fractal_lattice_block#lore.text: A block of the Platonic Realm's fractal lattice, for building with - and an ingredient of its machines.

block:fractal_ore#lore.text: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Fractal Dust when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:fractionation_casing#lore.text: A casing of containment field glass and chronosteel over event horizon casing, made to separate fluids by mass and charge in a tall spire. Watching through the glass, the layers settle into neat bands.

block:fractionation_spire#lore.text: A tall distillation spire that separates Dimensional Residue and Warm Helium into useful fractions.

block:fractured_reality#lore.text: What a failing multiblock leaks: a higher-dimensional shadow that spreads from block to block like an infection.

block:frontier_regolith#lore.text: Rock ground to dust by billions of years of micrometeorites. Assayed in bulk it gives back its interstellar dust and a little rare earth.

block:frozen_light_ore#lore.text: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Frozen Photon when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:galton_board#lore.text: Twelve rows of pegs. Every piece bounces left or right at each, and where it lands sorts it: most near the middle, a few far out in the tails.

block:garnet_crystal#lore.text: A mass of garnet, the dodecahedral silicate that grows where rock is buried and heated. Its zoned layers record the pressures it passed through.

block:gas_centrifuge_cascade#lore.text: Rotors spinning faster than sound fling the heavier isotope outward. One stage enriches a little; a tower of them, a lot. Build it taller for more stages: each new layer on top is one more.

block:gene_sequencer#lore.text: Reads a genome letter by letter - and, run backwards, writes one.

block:geode_shell#lore.text: A hollow stone lined with crystals that grew inward, one layer at a time, from mineral-rich water seeping through the cavity over ages.

block:golden_ratio_glass#lore.text: Glass made with a transcendental crystal so that its proportions follow the golden ratio at every scale. Each pane is divided into smaller panes in the same ratio, forever.

block:goniometer#lore.text: A precision turntable that sets sample and detector at exact angles. The detector swings twice as far as the crystal, keeping θ and 2θ in step.

block:graphite_moderator_block#lore.text: Pure graphite slows fission neutrons by collision with carbon nuclei, which seldom absorb them. Chicago Pile-1 was a stack of such blocks, in 1942.

block:graviton_condenser#lore.text: Quantises gravity itself - gravitons, spin foam and the anchors of reality.

block:graviton_field_emitter#lore.text: A field emitter upgraded with a graviton crystal and a gravitic lens element, so it projects gravity as well as fields. It weighs more on one side than the other, and that side changes.

block:graviton_field_projector#lore.text: Projects a field around a structure; what the field is decides what the machine inside can do.

block:graviton_lens_array#lore.text: An array of gravitic lens elements that bend spacetime to focus gravitational waves, the way a glass lens bends light. Inside, the space seems to pinch toward the centre.

block:growth_furnace_casing#lore.text: The insulated shell of a crystal-growth furnace. Its job is calm: the steadier the heat around the melt, the fewer flaws freeze into the crystal.

block:harmonic_pedestal#lore.text: A pedestal tuned to resonance. What is set on it rings at whole-number multiples of one frequency, as the harmonics of a single string do.

block:hawking_radiation_collector#lore.text: A collector of Hawking absorber plates and entangled photons that catches the faint radiation evaporating black holes give off. It is warm, and the warmth comes from somewhere it should not.

block:heavy_water#lore.text: Heavy Water, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:heliostat#lore.text: A mirror that tracks the Sun on two axes. At Odeillo, sixty-three of them feed one parabolic concentrator whose focus passes 3,000 °C.

block:helium3_detector#lore.text: A tube of helium-3 gas. A slow neutron splits a nucleus into a proton and a triton with 764 keV between them, and the gas lights up with charge.

block:hex_glass#lore.text: Glass held together by a hexagonal force field, like a honeycomb of light. Each cell glows faintly at its edges. It is strong and very slightly warm to the touch.

block:higgs_field_modulator#lore.text: Tunes the Higgs field locally to strip mass from matter - or make it negative.

block:hilbert_brick#lore.text: Brick moulded to the standards of Hilbert's programme: every face a rigorous statement, every joint a valid inference.

block:hilbert_locker#lore.text: Always full, and always room for one more. Move each item up one shelf, and the first shelf is free again, however many there are.

block:holographic_encoder#lore.text: Writes a volume of matter onto its own boundary surface, per the holographic principle.

block:horizon_cache#lore.text: A locker whose lid is an event horizon held open. While it stays shut, what is inside lies beyond the causal reach of everything else.

block:horizon_cage#lore.text: A cage of fields for something with no surface to grip. A black hole cannot be touched, so it must be held by its charge alone.

block:horizon_containment#lore.text: Walls built to hold a region where escape velocity reaches light speed. Nothing leaves through a horizon; the walls are for what has not fallen in yet.

block:horizon_glass#lore.text: A pane cut from the boundary of no return. Light enters easily but seems reluctant to leave, so everything beyond looks slightly dimmed and stretched.

block:hydrogen_cloud#lore.text: Ionised hydrogen glowing red at 656 nm, the H-alpha line. You can walk straight through it.

block:hyperframe_casing#lore.text: A casing laced with topological insulator and superposition crystal, so that its interior exists in several overlapping configurations at once.

block:hypernova_plasma#lore.text: Hypernova Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:hyperreal_cache#lore.text: Its walls obey whatever law is currently in force. The contents, like infinitesimals beside the real numbers, sit at a scale no ordinary rule can reach.

block:hyperspherical_ore#lore.text: Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Hypersphere Fragment when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:hypervelocity_impact_forge#lore.text: A railgun: an armature shot down two rails at kilometres a second into a target, where the shock makes what only impacts can.

block:impact_breccia#lore.text: Rock shattered and welded back together in the instant of an impact. It lines a meteorite crater's bowl and rim.

block:impact_chamber#lore.text: An armoured chamber for hypervelocity tests. Above about 3 km/s, a projectile carries more energy per kilogram than the same mass of TNT.

block:induction_generator#lore.text: A coil spun inside a permanent magnet's field by a small turbine. Stronger magnets give more power; flowing water beside it spins it faster.

block:infall_rock#lore.text: Rock stretched and compressed on its way toward a black hole. Its grains are elongated along one axis by tidal forces, and the light from it arrives reddened and slow.

block:inflation_chamber#lore.text: A sphere of containment glass around a pocket of false vacuum, wound with coils and lensed by gravitons. The inflaton inside rolls down its potential slowly enough to inflate - and then it reheats, and a universe's worth of matter is made.

block:inner_core_boundary#lore.text: The floor of the Planetary Interior: the edge of the solid inner core, 5,150 km down.

block:interface_port#lore.text: Takes the place of a structure's block to let items, fluids and energy in and out (or to link an ME network). Sneak-use with an empty hand to make it pull ingredients from, or push products into, the blocks beside it.

block:interferometer#lore.text: Splits a beam of light, sends the halves down two paths and brings them back together. A change in path of a fraction of a wavelength moves the fringes.

block:interstellar_scoop#lore.text: Sweeps up the thin gas and dust between the stars. Only high above the world, or out in space.

block:ionic_liquid#lore.text: Ionic Liquid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:iridium_crucible#lore.text: A crucible of iridium, which melts at 2,446 °C and shrugs off most molten oxides. Laser crystals such as YAG are pulled from melts held in one.

block:iron_meteorite#lore.text: The iron-nickel mass of a meteorite, half buried where it struck. Found in craters out in open country. Gives Meteoric Iron when mined. Needs a stone pickaxe or better.

block:irradiation_chamber#lore.text: Holds a target in the neutron flux of a source until nuclei catch neutrons and become something else.

block:isomer_trigger#lore.text: A gamma pulse knocks a hafnium-178m2 nucleus out of its long-lived state, and all its stored energy comes out at once.

block:jet_collimator#lore.text: A magnetic nozzle that pinches a plasma flow into a narrow beam, much as twisted field lines are thought to shape the jets of quasars and young stars.

block:kaluza_klein_ore#lore.text: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Kaluza-Klein Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:koch_crystal#lore.text: A pane whose rim is a Koch snowflake: a finite area enclosed by an infinitely long border. The glass is clear, but its edge glitters endlessly as each tiny triangle catches light.

block:kugelblitz_chamber#lore.text: Focuses so much light into one point that it collapses into a black hole.

block:laser_cutter#lore.text: A focused beam that cuts copper, silicon and diamond to a micron.

block:laser_interferometer#lore.text: Two long arms at right angles, a laser split between them, and mirrors that hang free. A passing gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other by a thousandth of a proton's width.

block:lattice_growth_vat#lore.text: Grows flawless single-crystal boules atom by atom in a superfluid bath.

block:lead_bricks#lore.text: Bricks of lead shielding. Lead is dense and has many electrons, so it stops gamma rays well - about half of them every 1.3 cm - but it does little against neutrons.

block:lead_hazard_panel#lore.text: A lead panel striped for danger: decoration for shielded rooms, and it stops gamma rays like any lead.

block:lead_shielding_block#lore.text: Dense lead for stopping gamma rays. Each half-value layer halves the dose; for the gammas of cobalt-60 that is about 1.2 cm of lead.

block:leaded_glass#lore.text: Glass with lead oxide melted in, often over half by weight. Lead's dense electron clouds stop X-rays and gamma rays while visible light passes through.

block:lens_array_block#lore.text: A grid of lenses working side by side, each forming its own small image of the scene. Together they see from many points at once.

block:lens_grinder#lore.text: A turning lap that wears glass into a curve with ever finer grit, then polishes it. Spinoza earned part of his living at one.

block:lens_pylon#lore.text: A mast that holds mass where its curvature bends passing light. A gravitational lens has no single focal point: it brings light together along a line.

block:lensing_concentrator#lore.text: Lines a star up behind a mass and collects the light the mass bends together: an Einstein ring, made into power.

block:liquid_antihelium#lore.text: Liquid Antihelium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:liquid_sodium#lore.text: Liquid Sodium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:liquid_spacetime#lore.text: Liquid Spacetime, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:lithography_glass#lore.text: Containment field glass doped with quantum dots so that light passing through it is shaped at nanometre resolution. It projects patterns far finer than its own grain.

block:lithostatic_casing#lore.text: A casing built to bear the load of rock. In Earth's crust, lithostatic pressure rises by about 27 MPa for every kilometre of depth.

block:logos_coil_block#lore.text: A coil wound of Logos Thread, the word that puts things in order. Current through it does not so much make a field as insist on one.

block:magnetar_crust_ore#lore.text: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Magnetar Crust Fragment when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:magnetic_confinement_casing#lore.text: A casing that holds plasma away from its own walls with superconducting magnetic fields, tuned by dilithium. It works on the same principle as a tokamak.

block:magnetite_block#lore.text: Compacted Fe₃O₄, the most strongly magnetic mineral in nature. Lodestones, magnetite probably magnetised by lightning, made the first compasses.

block:magnetite_bricks#lore.text: Bricks of magnetite (Fe3O4), the most magnetic mineral in nature. Iron oxide is dense, so it also shields: it stops gamma rays about two thirds as well as lead, and neutrons three times better.

block:magnetizer#lore.text: A coil around an iron core that pulses a field through a magnet blank. Only a field stronger than the blank's coercivity sets it.

block:mantle_breach#lore.text: A hole bored through bedrock by the Core Drill.

block:markov_chain_refinery#lore.text: Three vats in a ring, the feed hopping between them by tuned chances. Where it spends its time - the chain's steady state - decides what it becomes.

block:markov_vat#lore.text: A vat whose contents change from one state to the next by chance alone. Where they go next depends only on where they are now, never on how they got there.

block:matrioshka_brain#lore.text: Nested shells of computronium around a star. It thinks; you gain Insight.

block:maxwell_demon_sorter#lore.text: A molecular gatekeeper that sorts fast particles from slow ones, defying the second law of thermodynamics.

block:metallic_hydrogen#lore.text: Liquid Metallic Hydrogen, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:metamaterial_weaver#lore.text: Lays down sub-wavelength lattices that bend light (and gravity) the wrong way.

block:mhd_channel_casing#lore.text: The duct of a magnetohydrodynamic generator. Hot conducting gas rushes through a magnetic field, and current is drawn straight off electrodes in its walls, with no turbine at all.

block:mhd_electrode#lore.text: An electrode lining a magnetohydrodynamic channel. Conducting fluid swept through a magnetic field drives current straight into it, with no turbine at all.

block:mhd_field_magnet#lore.text: The magnet across an MHD channel. Conducting fluid driven through its field makes current at right angles to both, and the output rises with the square of the field.

block:mhd_generator#lore.text: A conducting fluid driven through a magnetic field makes current with no moving parts: the flow itself is the armature.

block:micro_black_hole_evaporator#lore.text: A black hole lighter than a mountain, held in a cage and fed as fast as it evaporates: it glows with Hawking radiation hotter than any star.

block:microscope_column#lore.text: The tube that holds a microscope's objective and eyepiece at a fixed distance apart. No light microscope resolves much finer than about 200 nm.

block:mirror_foundry#lore.text: A stack of Penning traps: anti-ores are melted, refined and cast without ever touching a wall - and matter and antimatter are bound into one alloy.

block:moduli_ore#lore.text: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 160. Gives Moduli Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:moissanite_crystal#lore.text: Silicon carbide, found by Henri Moissan in a meteorite crater in 1893. Nearly as hard as diamond, it splits light into colours even more strongly.

block:molten_salt_fuel#lore.text: Molten Salt Fuel, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:molten_salt_reactor#lore.text: Uranium dissolved in molten fluoride salt flows through a core of graphite and goes critical there. Tune it to exactly one neutron per neutron.

block:monte_carlo_engine#lore.text: Halls of random-number cores that answer by throwing dice: sample enough and the error falls as one over the square root of the count.

block:mossbauer_absorber#lore.text: Iron-57 bound so firmly in its crystal that it soaks up 14.4 keV gamma rays without recoil, a resonance sharp enough to feel one part in a thousand trillion.

block:multiverse_rift#lore.text: Holds open a tear into neighbouring universes and harvests what leaks through.

block:nanite_assembler#lore.text: A molecular foundry that builds machines atom by atom - including machines that build themselves.

block:nanite_slurry#lore.text: Nanite Slurry, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:nebular_ice#lore.text: Water, carbon monoxide and ammonia frozen together on dust grains at about fifteen kelvin. Starlight slowly builds larger molecules within it.

block:neural_synthesizer#lore.text: Grows photonic neural networks and the artificial minds that run on them.

block:neutrino_condenser#lore.text: Traps the ghost particles that pass through planets without noticing.

block:neutron_guide#lore.text: A tube whose walls reflect slow neutrons at grazing angles, much as a glass fibre carries light. Guides lead beams tens of metres from a reactor to the instruments.

block:neutron_interferometer#lore.text: A neutron's wave split by a perfect silicon crystal and joined again. Tilt it, and gravity pulls one path more than the other: quantum mechanics and gravity in one measurement.

block:neutron_star_forge#lore.text: Recreates the crushing interior of a collapsed star: neutronium, metallic hydrogen and quark matter.

block:neutronium_block#lore.text: A cube of compacted neutronium, matter in which electrons and protons have been crushed together into neutrons.

block:neutronium_bricks#lore.text: Neutronium Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.

block:neutronium_bricks_slab#lore.text: A slab of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.

block:neutronium_bricks_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.

block:neutronium_bricks_wall#lore.text: A wall of Neutronium Bricks, for building with.

block:neutronium_pillar#lore.text: A pillar of Neutronium, for building with.

block:neutronium_plating#lore.text: Neutronium rolled into flat plates and riveted onto a block face. It is grey, dense and almost reflective, with seams that look as though they were drawn with a ruler.

block:neutronium_plating_slab#lore.text: A slab of Neutronium Plating, for building with.

block:neutronium_plating_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Neutronium Plating, for building with.

block:neutronium_plating_wall#lore.text: A wall of Neutronium Plating, for building with.

block:neutronium_tiles#lore.text: Neutronium Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.

block:neutronium_tiles_slab#lore.text: A slab of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.

block:neutronium_tiles_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Neutronium Tiles, for building with.

block:nucleosynthesis_chamber#lore.text: Takes a star through its whole life - collapse, ignition, giant phase, death - and keeps the elements it forges.

block:nuclide_forge#lore.text: A heavy-ion accelerator firing into a spinning target: fuses nuclei into elements beyond the periodic table, aiming for the island of stability.

block:nutrient_broth#lore.text: Nutrient Broth, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:observatory_cache#lore.text: A locker held in stasis by superconducting coils. Whoever sealed it meant the contents to be found exactly as they were left.

block:observatory_dome#lore.text: A rotating hemispherical roof with a shuttered slit, turned to keep pace with the telescope so it always looks out through the opening.

block:observatory_wall#lore.text: A wall of Observatory, for building with.

block:observer_plate#lore.text: A structural plate. Hold Shift to see which structures take it.

block:oklo_rock#lore.text: Host rock of the Natural Reactor, modelled on Oklo in Gabon, where two billion years ago groundwater slowed neutrons enough for uranium ore to run as a fission reactor for hundreds of thousands of years.

block:oklo_uraninite_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 36 and 126. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:omega_simulator#lore.text: Runs the whole confrontation with Alpha Omega again - inside a model of it. Shown one Proof of Everything as a template, it walks the argument once more and writes out another copy.

block:omnilex_casing#lore.text: The casing of the final machine: crystallised law and arbor heartwood bound over a transfinite casing. It looks like wood and glass and law at the same time.

block:omnilex_engine#lore.text: Simulates the World Tree and the Ocean of Primordial Law - and so controls them. Only works in Hyperdimensional Reality Space.

block:omnipotence_casing#lore.text: Material that refuses to be broken by anything made in the ordinary world: no vanilla tool touches it - only the mod's own (the tag theoreticalsciences:omnipotent_tools).

block:omnipotence_core#lore.text: The Core of the Transcendental itself.

block:omnium_block#lore.text: A solid cube of the metal that is every metal at once. It weighs exactly what I expect it to weigh, whatever that is, and it rings with every resonant frequency simultaneously.

block:omnium_energy_cell#lore.text: The last word in storage. Omnium lines the walls, the Omega Point sits at its heart, and the energy inside no longer obeys the usual bookkeeping.

block:optical_bench#lore.text: A rigid, flat rail on which lenses, slits and mirrors are clamped in line. Optics is mostly alignment, and this is where alignment is kept.

block:optical_workshop#lore.text: Grinding spindles, polishing laps and an interferometer: blanks become lenses, plates and gratings, true to a fraction of a wavelength.

block:ordinal_ore#lore.text: Found in the Transfinite Hierarchy, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Ordinal Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:ordinal_recursor#lore.text: Counts past infinity: takes a limit, adds one, and keeps going - omega, omega plus one, omega times two, omega squared, epsilon-naught...

block:ordinal_stone#lore.text: Stone laid down in well-ordered strata. Every layer has a next one, and every collection of layers has a first; even the infinite stacks have a successor waiting above them.

block:oxygen_cloud#lore.text: Doubly ionised oxygen glowing green-blue at 501 nm. You can walk straight through it.

block:page_curve_analyzer#lore.text: Follows the entropy of a black hole's radiation as it evaporates - and finds the information coming back out.

block:pair_source#lore.text: A laser through a nonlinear crystal. Now and then one photon splits into two whose polarisations are entangled: measure one and the other is already decided.

block:particle_spectrometer#lore.text: Separates a spray of particles by mass and charge: quark flavours, leptons and gauge bosons, one by one.

block:peano_engine#lore.text: Builds number systems the way mathematicians did: zero, then "the next one", then negatives, fractions, reals and beyond.

block:penrose_ergosphere#lore.text: Extracts the rotational energy of a spinning black hole via the Penrose process.

block:peridot_crystal#lore.text: Peridot Crystal Mass: the ground of one of the strange places beyond the Overworld.

block:peridotite#lore.text: The dense green rock of the upper mantle, mostly olivine. Brought up into water and air, it slowly drinks them in and turns to serpentinite.

block:photoresist#lore.text: Quantum-Dot Photoresist, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:pitchblende_ore#lore.text: Found in the Overworld, between Y 0 and 48. Gives Raw Pitchblende when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:planck_casing#lore.text: Armour for working at the smallest length that means anything.

block:planck_cutter#lore.text: Slices boules into wafers, and wafers into dies, along cuts one Planck length wide.

block:planetesimal_core_ore#lore.text: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Exoplanet Core Sample when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:plasma_crucible_casing#lore.text: A casing of chronosteel around magnetic confinement and superconducting coils, built to hold plasma at stellar temperatures for as long as needed.

block:plasma_injection_nozzle#lore.text: A nozzle that fires plasma into a confinement chamber at a precisely controlled rate. Magnetic confinement steers it, a cryocooler keeps the coils cold, and the tip glows white when in use.

block:pleroma#lore.text: Pleroma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:pleroma_confluence#lore.text: Fills with a million mB of water, lava and every fluid of the mod, plus 64,000 mB of every mod's Essence, and condenses them into Pleroma.

block:pleroma_glass#lore.text: Named for the Gnostics' Pleroma, the fullness of all that is. Light passes through it; nothing else is allowed to.

block:pleroma_reconstitutor#lore.text: A cathedral of Absolute Frame and Pleroma Glass around a Logos-wound throat. Fed the Echo of the Transcendental and everything the Sundering left, it plays the echo back - until the dimension it remembers exists again.

block:polished_cherenkov_quartz#lore.text: Quartz polished to carry Cherenkov light, the blue glow given off when a charged particle outruns light in the glass, at about two-thirds of c.

block:polished_dilithium#lore.text: Dilithium cut and polished to a flawless face. Real dilithium, Li₂, is a fleeting molecule of lithium vapour; this crystal answers to fiction instead.

block:pound_rebka_tower#lore.text: Gamma rays climbing a tower lose energy to gravity. A source moving at the right speed - less than a micrometre a second - puts them back in tune with the absorber above.

block:precision_assembly_casing#lore.text: A casing of neutronium plate around a photonic processor and a femtoscale inductor, built so that nothing inside it vibrates by more than a fraction of a proton. It is dead silent and dead still.

block:press_ram#lore.text: The working piston of a hydraulic press. A small pump pushes on a broad face, and Pascal's principle multiplies the force by the ratio of their areas.

block:primary_mirror_cell#lore.text: The cradle that holds a telescope's main mirror, propping its back at many points so the glass does not sag out of shape as the tube tilts.

block:prime_number_ore#lore.text: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Prime Shard when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:primordial_law#lore.text: Primordial Law, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:primordial_soup#lore.text: Primordial Soup, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:proof_assistant#lore.text: Checks proofs one axiom at a time. Logic, set theory and category theory are all built here.

block:proof_floor#lore.text: Flat, even and featureless, like the axioms beneath a theorem. Everything above it stands only because it does not give way.

block:proof_membrane#lore.text: A sheet stretched across the gap between premise and conclusion. Every step of the argument is a fibre in it, and one false step tears it through.

block:proof_wall#lore.text: A wall of Living Proof, for building with.

block:protostar_fragment#lore.text: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Protostellar Ember when mined with stone pickaxe or better.

block:pull_shaft#lore.text: A slow, steady drive that draws its load upward at a controlled rate. In a crystal puller it lifts the seed exactly as fast as the crystal grows.

block:pulsar_crust#lore.text: Iron from a neutron star's crust: a lattice of nuclei in a sea of electrons, held under a field of some hundred million tesla.

block:pulsar_timing_ore#lore.text: Found in the Accretion Frontier, between Y 0 and 255. Gives Pulsar Timing Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:pulsed_lab_casing#lore.text: Steel walls lined with mesh, built to keep the sharp spikes of pulsed experiments in and stray radio noise out. A Faraday cage, in effect.

block:pulsed_magnet_lab#lore.text: A coil of Bitter plates and a room of capacitors dumped into it: a field of up to a hundred tesla, for a few milliseconds.

block:quadrupole_focusing_magnet#lore.text: A quadrupole magnet with four pole tips that squeeze a particle beam in one direction while stretching it in the other. Pairs of them focus a beam the way lenses focus light.

block:quantum_entangler#lore.text: Spontaneous parametric down-conversion splits photons into entangled pairs, then binds them into qubits.

block:quantum_error_correction_core#lore.text: A core that protects a quantum computer's fragile states by spreading each logical qubit across many physical ones and fixing errors as they happen. It hums with a steady, careful rhythm.

block:quantum_lithographer#lore.text: Engraves logic onto wafers through a lens. The lens is a catalyst and is never consumed.

block:quantum_spacetime_condensate#lore.text: Quantum Spacetime Condensate, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:quark_gluon_collider#lore.text: A ring accelerator that smashes heavy nuclei into quark-gluon plasma.

block:quark_gluon_plasma#lore.text: Quark-Gluon Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:radio_dish_panel#lore.text: One curved panel of a radio dish. Its surface need only be true to a small fraction of the wavelength, so for long waves even wire mesh will do.

block:radio_telescope#lore.text: A dish that listens to the sky: to cold hydrogen, to pulsars. It works by day and in rain, but every machine running nearby is noise in its receiver.

block:radiometer_mast#lore.text: A mast of radiometers weighing incoming sunlight against outgoing heat. A planet's climate hangs on that balance, a few watts per square metre either way.

block:radium_lamp#lore.text: Radium mixed with phosphor glows for years without power. The dial painters of the 1920s, who pointed their brushes with their lips, paid for that glow.

block:rail_conductor#lore.text: One of a pair of heavy rails. Current runs up one, across the armature and back down the other, and the magnetic force flings the armature along them.

block:raw_star_matter#lore.text: Raw Star Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:reactor_vessel_casing#lore.text: Thick steel for a reactor's pressure vessel. It must hold the core for decades while neutrons slowly make the metal more brittle.

block:reality_compiler#lore.text: If the universe is a simulation, this decompiles it.

block:reality_lattice_casing#lore.text: A casing that contains computronium and a Bekenstein crystal to keep track of every bit of information inside it.

block:redshift_tower_casing#lore.text: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.

block:refinery_casing#lore.text: Casing for a refinery that runs on chance. Each stage passes its product to the next by probability alone, and the averages come out exact.

block:reflecting_telescope#lore.text: A mirror under a dome, its slit open to the night. The bigger the mirror and the longer the exposure, the fainter the stars it records - on a clear, dark night, under open sky.

block:refractory_firebox#lore.text: A fire chamber lined with firebrick, which keeps its strength far above the heat that slumps common brick. The fire stays in, and most of the heat does too.

block:reheating_plasma#lore.text: Reheating Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:relativity_breakdown#lore.text: Relativity Breakdown, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:renormalised_essence#lore.text: Renormalised Essence, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:research_nexus#lore.text: A ring of error-corrected cores around a well of light that reads Research Dossiers and studies them in your place, shortening whatever you are researching.

block:research_terminal#lore.text: Where research is done: spend Insight here to study what comes next.

block:resonance_pedestal#lore.text: A pedestal tuned to ring in sympathy with its neighbours, as a wine glass sings to a matching note. The first and plainest of its kind.

block:retrocausal_ore#lore.text: Found in the White Hole Interior, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Retrocausal Crystal when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:return_rift#lore.text: A tear in space that leads back the way it came. Of all the doors in these places, it is the one that always opens onto home.

block:rf_accelerating_cavity#lore.text: A resonant cavity driven by a tachyon klystron that gives each passing particle a precisely timed kick. Inside, radio waves bounce in a standing pattern. It hums at a frequency I can feel in my teeth.

block:rf_oscillator#lore.text: The heart of a cyclotron. It drives the gap at the cyclotron frequency, qB/2πm, which does not change with speed, so a circling particle is kicked every half turn.

block:rich_copper_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Copper Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.

block:rich_gold_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 12 and 96. Gives Rich Gold Chunk when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:rich_iron_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 50 and 126. Gives Rich Iron Chunk when mined with stone pickaxe or better.

block:rift_frame_casing#lore.text: A casing reinforced against tearing open: void lattice, graviton crystal and chronosteel over a hyperframe.

block:rim_slag#lore.text: Cinder flung from the inner edge of an accretion disk, where gas spirals in at a fair fraction of light speed and is heated to millions of degrees.

block:ringwoodite_ore#lore.text: Found in the Planetary Interior, between Y 4 and 84. Gives Ringwoodite when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:salt_heat_exchanger#lore.text: Passes heat between molten salt and water. Nitrate salt stays liquid from about 220 to 565 °C, so it can carry heat that would boil water off at once.

block:satellite_wreck#lore.text: The scorched frame and panels of a satellite that came down. Most burn up on re-entry; this one did not, quite.

block:schrodinger_limit#lore.text: Schrödinger's Limit, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:scintillator_panel#lore.text: A sheet that gives a brief flash of light whenever a charged particle passes through. Walls of them catch cosmic-ray showers as they rain down.

block:seismic_isolator#lore.text: Springs and dampers that cut a mirror off from the ground. Ground tremor dwarfs the 10⁻¹⁸ m a passing gravitational wave stretches an interferometer arm.

block:seismograph#lore.text: A heavy pendulum that the ground moves under. It times two kinds of wave from below - fast pressure waves and slow shear waves - and the gap between them says how deep their source lies.

block:singularity_compactor#lore.text: Feed it a great many of one item and it compacts them into a singularity - no timer, as fast as you feed it.

block:singularity_energy_cell#lore.text: At the centre of this cell sits a tiny singularity, wrapped in cosmic neutronium. Energy falls into it and is held behind the horizon until it is needed.

block:solar_furnace#lore.text: Heliostats turn with the Sun and feed a parabolic mirror wall, which brings their light to a point. Concentrated ten thousand times, sunlight melts what no fuel flame can.

block:solar_receiver#lore.text: The target at the focus of a mirror field, built to drink in concentrated sunlight. At Odeillo such a focus reaches some 3,500 °C.

block:spacetime_alloy_block#lore.text: Forty spacetime alloy ingots pressed into one block. The alloy bends spacetime around itself slightly, so the block's edges never look quite square.

block:spacetime_alloy_coil_block#lore.text: A grade of structure coil. Better coils make the machines built with them faster - hold Shift to see which.

block:spacetime_anchor_pylon#lore.text: A pylon that pins a patch of spacetime in place, built around a spacetime anchor core and a chronosteel coil. The ground around it feels unusually solid, as if gravity had made its mind up.

block:spacetime_bricks#lore.text: Spacetime Bricks: a building block of the strange places, for building with.

block:spacetime_bricks_slab#lore.text: A slab of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.

block:spacetime_bricks_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.

block:spacetime_bricks_wall#lore.text: A wall of Spacetime Bricks, for building with.

block:spacetime_casing#lore.text: A machine casing: the shell a structure is built from. Hold Shift to see which structures use it.

block:spacetime_panel#lore.text: A panel of spacetime alloy whose surface seems to bend inward slightly, as if the wall behind it were further away than it is. It is cool, smooth and very faintly disorienting to look at for long.

block:spacetime_tiles#lore.text: Spacetime Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.

block:spacetime_tiles_slab#lore.text: A slab of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.

block:spacetime_tiles_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Spacetime Tiles, for building with.

block:spectrograph#lore.text: A slit, a grating and a plate. Light comes in as one colour and leaves as a rainbow crossed with dark lines, and every line is an element's fingerprint.

block:spent_fuel_salt#lore.text: Spent Fuel Salt, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:spin_network_loom#lore.text: Weaves quanta of area and volume into a spin network: space, a grain at a time.

block:station_hull#lore.text: Aluminium skin and stringers from a spacecraft, thin enough to dent by hand. In vacuum, a few millimetres of it is all that separates air from nothing.

block:stellar_containment_plate#lore.text: A plate of degenerate armour and spacetime alloy over magnetic confinement casing, built to hold back the pressure and heat of a star. It is impossibly heavy and faintly warm.

block:stellar_frame_casing#lore.text: A casing of neutronium plate over event horizon casing with a Higgs field capacitor to steady its mass. It is built to hold the weight and heat of a star, and it glows faintly gold at the seams.

block:stellar_lamp#lore.text: A stellar frame casing with glowstone at its heart, so it shines with a warm, golden light like a small star seen through a window. It is warm to stand next to.

block:stellar_plasma#lore.text: Stellar Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:stellar_plasma_crucible#lore.text: Melts and alloys matter in plasma as hot as a stellar core. Makes Chronosteel, Spacetime Alloy, Cosmic Neutronium and Exotic Solder.

block:step_laser#lore.text: A laser whose pulse makes a moving step in the refractive index of glass. Light trying to overtake the step is slowed to a halt at it: an event horizon for light.

block:stochastic_core#lore.text: A bank of random sources for Monte Carlo sums. The error falls as one over the square root of the samples: a hundred times the dice for ten times the accuracy.

block:strained_spacetime#lore.text: Strained Spacetime, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:strange_matter#lore.text: Strange Matter, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:string_resonance_loom#lore.text: Plucks cosmic strings into fundamental quantum strings and weaves them into membranes.

block:superconducting_coil_block#lore.text: A drum of superconducting coil wound around spacetime casing. Current, once started, circulates in it forever with no loss at all. The field it makes tugs gently at anything metal nearby.

block:superconducting_solder#lore.text: Superconducting Solder, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:supercritical_solvent#lore.text: Supercritical Solvent, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:supercritical_water#lore.text: Supercritical Water, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:superfluid_helium#lore.text: Superfluid Helium, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:synaptic_fluid#lore.text: Synaptic Fluid, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:synchrotron#lore.text: A ring accelerator built from real beamline parts: bending dipoles, focusing quadrupoles, RF cavities, cryogenics, vacuum pumps and a detector hall. It makes the exotic hadrons nothing else can.

block:tachyon_resonator#lore.text: Resonates a crystal lattice until it emits particles that travel faster than light.

block:tectonic_press#lore.text: A multi-anvil press over a firebox: it squeezes rock to the pressures of the deep mantle and bakes it to match. What crystallises depends on where on the phase diagram you hold it.

block:telescope_pier#lore.text: A heavy masonry column for a telescope to stand on, built apart from the dome floor so that footsteps never shake the image.

block:telescope_tube#lore.text: Holds a telescope's mirrors in exact alignment and is blackened inside, so the only light that reaches the focus is light from the sky.

block:tensor_engine#lore.text: Computes in curved spacetime: Lorentz transformations, metrics, curvature and finally Einstein's field equations.

block:tesla_coil#lore.text: A resonant transformer: a spark-gap primary ringing in tune with a tall secondary steps a few kilovolts up to millions, and the toroid throws arcs metres long.

block:tesla_primary#lore.text: A few turns of heavy copper fed by a capacitor and a spark gap. Tuned to the secondary, it rings its energy across into the tall coil beside it.

block:tesla_secondary#lore.text: The tall, finely wound coil of a Tesla transformer. Tuned to resonate with the primary, it builds hundreds of kilovolts at its crown.

block:tesla_toroid#lore.text: The smooth metal doughnut atop a Tesla coil. Its broad curve spreads the charge and holds off corona, so the voltage climbs higher before sparks break out.

block:tesseract_assembler#lore.text: Folds matter through a fourth spatial dimension.

block:test_mass_chamber#lore.text: A vacuum chamber that hangs a polished fused-silica mirror on fine fibres, isolated from every tremor so it moves only when spacetime does.

block:thermoelectric_generator#lore.text: A furnace wrapped in thermocouples: the heat of ordinary fuel, turned straight into current by the Seebeck effect. Humble - and the first power any laboratory has.

block:tidal_ore#lore.text: Found in the Black Hole Interior, between Y 20 and 256. Gives Tidal Alloy Scrap when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:tidal_plasma#lore.text: Tidal Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:tilt_table#lore.text: A table that tilts a neutron interferometer about its beam. In 1975 one let Colella, Overhauser and Werner see gravity shift a single neutron's quantum phase.

block:time_dilation_chamber#lore.text: Holds its samples deep in the gravity well of a dense core, where their clocks run slow against the world outside.

block:tokamak#lore.text: A ring of hydrogen plasma held off its walls by a twisted magnetic field, hot enough for deuterium and tritium to fuse.

block:tokamak_casing#lore.text: Lead-lined shell for a fusion hall. Deuterium-tritium fusion sends out 14.1 MeV neutrons that pass through anything thin, so these walls are not.

block:topological_transmuter#lore.text: Changes a material's topology without changing its chemistry.

block:toroidal_field_coil#lore.text: One of the D-shaped coils that ring a tokamak. Together they make the strong field running the long way round the torus, holding the plasma off the walls.

block:transcendent_cache#lore.text: A locker past every infinity the lesser caches count to. What it holds is not so much stored as asserted to exist.

block:transcendent_glass#lore.text: Glass that is transparent to more than light. Looking through it, I see the room beyond and, faintly, the rules that make the room possible.

block:transcendent_plasma#lore.text: Transcendent Plasma, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:transcendent_plasma_forge#lore.text: Four plasma injectors fire into a coil-wrapped chamber hotter than a hypernova. Burns catalyst plasmas to forge metals whose properties are chosen rather than discovered.

block:transcendent_stone#lore.text: Rock that no longer remembers which universe formed it. It has the solid presence of stone but none of the expected minerals, and its surface shifts colour faintly with my mood.

block:transcendental_ore#lore.text: Found in the Platonic Realm, between Y 0 and 200. Gives Transcendental Crystal when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:transfinite_casing#lore.text: A casing built to hold infinities: aleph-null shards over reality lattice casing, with a Russell set and a Banach-Tarski sphere worked into the seams.

block:transfinite_coil_block#lore.text: A coil of hypernova alloy wound around an aleph-null shard over a cosmic neutronium coil, superconducting at room temperature. It carries a current that never quite finishes counting itself.

block:transition_valve#lore.text: A valve that sends each state on to the next by fixed odds. It looks only at where things are, never at how they got there: the Markov property.

block:turbomolecular_vacuum_pump#lore.text: A pump whose rotor spins so fast that its blades knock gas molecules out of the chamber one by one. It whines at a pitch just below hearing. Ultra-high vacuum starts here.

block:universe_forge#lore.text: Triggers false-vacuum decay and cosmic inflation to grow - and later harvest - a pocket universe.

block:unruh_accelerator#lore.text: A storage ring whose electrons are accelerated so hard round their curve that, to them, the empty vacuum is warm.

block:unruh_detector#lore.text: An accelerating detector should feel empty space as warm. It is a faint warmth: one kelvin takes an acceleration of some 10^20 metres per second squared.

block:unruh_ring_casing#lore.text: Casing for a ring of extreme acceleration. An accelerated observer finds warm thermal radiation where an inertial one sees empty vacuum: the Unruh effect.

block:vacuum_beam_pipe#lore.text: A pipe of containment field glass and metamaterial lined with Casimir plates, so the space inside is emptier than empty. A particle beam runs through it without touching anything at all.

block:vacuum_beam_tube#lore.text: Steel tube pumped to ultra-high vacuum, so a laser crosses kilometres with no stray gas to jitter its phase. LIGO's arms hold nearly 10,000 m³ of it.

block:vacuum_energy_cell#lore.text: Energy borrowed from the vacuum itself, stored with exotic matter to keep the books balanced. Inside, graviton crystal holds the field taut while a dark matter lens focuses it.

block:vacuum_harvester#lore.text: Holds a bubble of false vacuum open in the Quantum Foam and catches the virtual particles that flicker through it. What it catches depends on where it stands and how it is tuned.

block:vacuum_state_projector#lore.text: A projector that changes what empty space is. Exotic matter in its core shifts the vacuum energy of the region it covers, so the field inside is a slightly different universe.

block:vacuum_vessel#lore.text: The sealed doughnut-shaped chamber of a tokamak, pumped below a billionth of an atmosphere before fuel is let in, so the plasma meets nothing but itself.

block:virtual_graviton_ore#lore.text: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Graviton when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:virtual_monopole_ore#lore.text: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Monopole when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:virtual_photon_ore#lore.text: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Photon when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:virtual_quark_ore#lore.text: Found in the Quantum Foam, between Y 0 and 256. Gives Virtual Quark when mined with iron pickaxe or better.

block:void_bricks#lore.text: Void lattice cut into bricks - rigid blocks of nothing stacked with careful joints. The wall looks like a pattern of very clean holes in the world.

block:void_bricks_slab#lore.text: A slab of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.

block:void_bricks_stairs#lore.text: Stairs of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.

block:void_bricks_wall#lore.text: A wall of Void Lattice Bricks, for building with.

block:void_glass#lore.text: Glass as dark as the space it came from. Gravity bends light as a lens does, and a well-aligned mass draws a background source into a full Einstein ring.

block:void_lattice_block#lore.text: Void lattice shards compacted into a block - a crystal of empty sites that is rigid even though there is nothing in it. Looking at it feels like looking at a hole in the world with very clean edges.

block:void_lattice_ore#lore.text: Found in the Bulk, between Y 0 and 128. Gives Void Lattice Shard when mined with diamond pickaxe or better.

block:void_pillar#lore.text: A pillar of Void Lattice, for building with.

block:void_tiles#lore.text: Void Lattice Tiles: a building block of the strange places, for building with.

block:warp_casing#lore.text: Hull plating for a warp field forge. An Alcubierre bubble would need negative energy density in its walls, which is what makes this casing exotic.

block:warp_coil_ring#lore.text: One ring of a warp coil. The Alcubierre metric demands negative energy density, which no ordinary matter can supply in bulk.

block:warp_field_forge#lore.text: Shapes a bubble of flat space inside a wall of negative energy: contracted ahead, expanded behind.

block:weaver_casing#lore.text: Casing for a machine that stitches with entanglement. Two particles that share one state stay linked, however far apart the weave carries them.

block:white_hole_emitter#lore.text: Runs a black hole backwards in time. Nothing can enter; everything comes out.

block:wormhole_frame_casing#lore.text: A casing threaded with negative mass and exotic matter, the ingredients a traversable wormhole needs to keep its throat open.

block:wormhole_projector#lore.text: Opens a traversable wormhole to distant stars and drags their matter through.

block:x_ray_diffractometer#lore.text: X-rays scattered by a crystal's planes of atoms reinforce only at angles that fit the spacing between them. Find the angle, and you know the lattice - and how to cut it.

block:xenoplasm#lore.text: Xenoplasm, loose in the world. An empty Containment Cell scoops it up.

block:xray_cabinet#lore.text: A lead-lined, interlocked box that keeps X-rays in. Opening the door cuts the tube, so the only thing exposed is the sample.

block:xray_tube#lore.text: Electrons slammed into a copper anode knock out inner electrons, and copper's sharp Kα X-ray line shines out as others fall in. Nearly all the rest ends as heat.

block:zero_point_extractor#lore.text: Burns Casimir plates, exotic matter, metamaterial sheets, spin foam and mirror processors to pull energy out of the vacuum.

item:absolute_dossier#lore.text: The research of a civilisation that has nearly finished. Feeds a Research Nexus.

item:absolute_infinity#lore.text: Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.

item:absolute_notes_1#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:absolute_notes_2#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:absolute_notes_3#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:absolute_singularity#lore.text: Not a point where the laws break down: a point where there are no laws to break.

item:accretion_disk_fragment#lore.text: Slag from the inner edge of an accretion disk, frozen where it was flung out. It still remembers ten million kelvin.

item:accretion_disk_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Accretion Disk Plasma - a liquid, at 10,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:adaptive_feedback_core#lore.text: Learns how its machine wanders and leans against it before it does.

item:aeon_boundary_shard#lore.text: Rescale an infinitely old, empty, massless universe and it looks like a Big Bang. A sliver of the seam between two aeons.

item:akashic_record#lore.text: Everything that has ever been known, written once. Creative mode only.

item:alcubierre_coil#lore.text: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.

item:aleph_null_shard#lore.text: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.

item:aleph_one#lore.text: The next size of infinity after the countable one.

item:alpha_omega_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Alpha Omega into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:amethyst_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 amethyst shard, crushed into one point.

item:anchor_core#lore.text: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.

item:anchored_warp_bubble#lore.text: A warp bubble tied to the place it was anchored. Used, it carries you back there and is spent.

item:annihilation_core#lore.text: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.

item:annihilator_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Annihilator into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:anomalous_strain_culture#lore.text: Stem cells exposed to a contained anomaly. Their checkpoints are failing one by one: no p53, no brakes, no reason to stop dividing.

item:anomaly_catalogue#lore.text: Every kind of anomaly you have contained, what it can do, how far it can spread and how big the largest one will be. Most are small; a few are not.

item:anomaly_specimen#lore.text: A sample of something that should not be, held in a quarantine field small enough to carry. It is still trying to get out.

item:anticarbon_crystal#lore.text: Antidiamond. Four antibonds per anti-atom, as hard as diamond.

item:antigold_ingot#lore.text: As soft, as dense and as noble as gold. Do not wear it.

item:antihelium_nucleus#lore.text: Two antiprotons and two antineutrons. Our own detectors have glimpsed a handful; the Antiverse is full of them.

item:antihydrogen_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Antihydrogen - a gas, at 20 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:antihydrogen_crystal#lore.text: Frozen antihydrogen: one antiproton, one positron, a few kelvin.

item:antihydrogen_wisp_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Antihydrogen Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:antiiron_ingot#lore.text: Anti-iron, refined in levitation. Its surface never touches the mould.

item:antimatter_pellet#lore.text: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything.

item:antimatter_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 antimatter pellet, crushed into one point.

item:antiproton_bundle#lore.text: A few billion antiprotons, slowed from near light speed and held in a magnetic bottle.

item:antiquark_shard#lore.text: Confined anti-colour charge, chipped from a creature of the Antiverse.

item:antisilicon_shard#lore.text: Semiconductor of the Antiverse - its holes are positrons.

item:antiwater_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Antiwater - a liquid, at 290 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:apeiron_ingot#lore.text: Anaximander's apeiron: the boundless stuff everything else is cut from. The ingot has edges only where you look.

item:apochromatic_objective#lore.text: Fluorite between two lenses of fused silica: three colours brought to exactly one focus, and the rest within a hair of it.

item:apoptosis_trigger#lore.text: A CRISPR-written instruction that only an anomalous cell will read: a reminder of the death it was always supposed to accept.

item:aquifer_sample#lore.text: Water from a confined aquifer, tens of thousands of years old: rain from the last ice age, still on its way.

item:arbor_heartwood_sample#lore.text: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.

item:arrow_of_time_shard#lore.text: Entropy only goes up - that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.

item:assembly_matrix#lore.text: The frame femtoscale parts are mounted on: the Femtoscale Assembly Line and the White Hole Emitter build with it.

item:atto_capacitor#lore.text: Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.

item:atto_inductor#lore.text: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.

item:atto_transistor#lore.text: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.

item:autocatalytic_broth_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Autocatalytic Broth - a liquid, at 320 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:autonomous_calibrator#lore.text: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.

item:avogadro_record#lore.text: A thousand tracks of a clay grain in water, each one a staggering random walk, and from how far they wander: how many molecules make a mole. Perrin won the Nobel Prize for this.

item:axiom_fragment#lore.text: A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.

item:axiom_key#lore.text: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.

item:axiom_of_choice#lore.text: From every set of sets you may pick one of each. Accept it and spheres can be doubled.

item:axiom_schema#lore.text: The rules you agree to before you prove anything.

item:axiom_sentinel_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Axiom Sentinel into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:banach_tarski_sphere#lore.text: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.

item:baryogenesis_seed#lore.text: Out of equilibrium, violating baryon number, C and CP: the three conditions for a universe to end up made of something.

item:baryon_asymmetry_crystal#lore.text: One extra quark in every billion pairs. Everything that was not annihilated grew out of that one part in a billion.

item:basaltic_magma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Basaltic Magma - a liquid, at 1,450 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:beam_splitter#lore.text: A disc of fused silica coated so it lets exactly half the light through and reflects the other half.

item:bekenstein_crystal#lore.text: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.

item:binary_serpent_spawn_egg#lore.text: Two bodies coiled round each other in a tightening spiral, shedding gravitational waves. Each turn is faster than the last, until the chirp ends in a merger.

item:biosphere_compendium#lore.text: One of every creature that can be eaten, pressed into one. Do not eat.

item:bitter_plate#lore.text: A copper disc cut with a slit and pierced with cooling holes. Stacked into a helix, Bitter plates make the strongest steady magnets there are.

item:black_swan_feather#lore.text: Proof that the improbable happens. For centuries every swan was white - until one was not.

item:black_swan_spawn_egg#lore.text: The rare, unforeseeable event, explained only afterwards. Europeans held every swan white until Dutch sailors met black ones in Australia in 1697; this one is seldom seen.

item:blue_ice_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 blue ice, crushed into one point.

item:boltzmann_brain#lore.text: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.

item:boltzmann_brain_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Boltzmann Brain into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:boltzmann_fluctuation#lore.text: Wait long enough in a universe at equilibrium and anything happens by chance. This is the anything.

item:bootstrap_artifact#lore.text: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.

item:boron_control_rod#lore.text: Boron carbide in a steel sleeve. Boron-10 drinks neutrons: push the rod in and the chain reaction slows.

item:bose_einstein_condensate_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Bose-Einstein Condensate - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:bottom_top_quarks#lore.text: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.

item:bounce_core#lore.text: A universe crushed to the Planck density, where the quantum geometry of space turned the collapse around.

item:boundary_cft_chip#lore.text: A quantum field theory without gravity, on a boundary - which is the same theory as gravity in the space inside it.

item:brane_shifter#lore.text: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.

item:brane_strider_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Brane Strider into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:brane_tension_fiber#lore.text: A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.

item:brane_tether#lore.text: Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk - or in any field of extra dimensions.

item:bridgmanite#lore.text: The most abundant mineral on Earth - and almost never seen, because it only exists under the pressure of the lower mantle.

item:brown_dwarf_core#lore.text: The dense heart of a failed star: too light to fuse hydrogen, heavy enough once to burn its deuterium. It still glows with the heat of its own contraction.

item:brownian_suspension_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Brownian Suspension - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:bubble_universe_sample#lore.text: An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.

item:buckyball_cage#lore.text: Sixty carbon atoms arranged like a football - with room inside for one more atom.

item:burst_afterglow_crystal#lore.text: The fading afterglow of a gamma-ray burst - the brightest explosions there are, seen across the Universe.

item:calabi_yau_manifold#lore.text: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.

item:californium_252_neutron_source#lore.text: A microgram of californium splits by itself often enough to give off two million neutrons a second.

item:cantor_key#lore.text: Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place. Use again to return.

item:car_t_culture#lore.text: Killer T cells taught a new receptor: they hunt one marker, the anomaly's own, and they multiply as they find it.

item:carbon_nanotube_bundle#lore.text: Graphene rolled into tubes, the tubes twisted into rope.

item:carborane_superacid_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Carborane Superacid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:cardinal_shard#lore.text: A piece of how many there are - even when there are infinitely many.

item:casimir_plate#lore.text: Two plates nanometres apart. The vacuum between them pushes.

item:category_lattice#lore.text: Objects and arrows, and nothing else. All of mathematics fits inside.

item:causal_set_seed#lore.text: Events scattered at random into spacetime, with nothing but which came before which. From that order alone, geometry grows.

item:causal_shield_lattice#lore.text: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that hit it are deflected into somebody else's timeline.

item:causal_solder_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Causal Solder - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:cepheid_standard_candle#lore.text: The light curve of a Cepheid variable. How long it takes to pulse tells how bright it truly is (Leavitt's law) - and so how far away.

item:cherenkov_boule#lore.text: A single crystal of Cherenkov quartz, grown in superfluid helium. Ready to be sliced.

item:cherenkov_lattice#lore.text: Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.

item:cherenkov_quartz#lore.text: Glows with the blue light of particles outrunning light in a medium.

item:cherenkov_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 cherenkov quartz, crushed into one point.

item:cherenkov_wafer#lore.text: A wafer sliced from a Cherenkov boule.

item:chiral_crystal#lore.text: Left-handed or right-handed, never both. Life only uses one hand.

item:chirp_signal_record#lore.text: The rising whoop of two compact stars spiralling together: their gravitational waves climb in pitch and strength until they merge.

item:chondrite_fragment#lore.text: Stone that never melted since the planets formed: grains of olivine and metal, and among them dust older than the Sun.

item:christoffel_symbol#lore.text: How the coordinates twist from one point to the next.

item:chronal_anchor#lore.text: Holds your own clock steady. Carry it into fields where time runs fast or slow.

item:chronon_capacitor#lore.text: Holds quanta of time. Handle before use.

item:chronon_gas_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Chronon Gas - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:chronoplastic_gasket#lore.text: Seals a joint against time itself: what is inside ages at the machine's pace, not the world's.

item:chronosteel_ingot#lore.text: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.

item:chronosteel_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 chronosteel ingot, crushed into one point.

item:circuit_substrate#lore.text: The blank on which every circuit board is built.

item:claytronic_catom#lore.text: One cell of a substance that can become anything.

item:closed_timelike_curve#lore.text: A path through spacetime that ends where - and when - it started.

item:cobalt_57_source#lore.text: Iron-54 struck by the alpha particles of radium becomes cobalt-57, which decays into iron-57 and gives off a gamma ray so sharp in energy it can be shifted by gravity across a few metres.

item:cognitive_singularity#lore.text: Every thought that could be thought, compressed into one point.

item:coherence_stabiliser#lore.text: Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam - or in an altered vacuum.

item:coherent_wiring_harness#lore.text: Superconducting wire braided so its electrons keep their phase from end to end. Every quantum machine is threaded with it.

item:compactified_circle#lore.text: A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length.

item:complex_plane#lore.text: Real and imaginary at right angles. Every polynomial finally has its roots.

item:computronium_ingot#lore.text: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.

item:computronium_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 computronium ingot, crushed into one point.

item:confidence_interval_gauge#lore.text: A gauge that shows not a value but a range, and how sure it is. Carried in the off hand, it steadies the luck of what you drink (no Variance).

item:contagion_network_map#lore.text: Every contact, every transmission, every node an infection passed through. Somewhere in it is the threshold where R crosses 1.

item:containment_cell#lore.text: A magnetically sealed flask for fluids too hot, too cold or too strange for a bucket. Scoop a source block or fill it from a tank.

item:continuum_shard#lore.text: The cardinality of the real line. Is it the next infinity after aleph-null? The axioms cannot say.

item:copper_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 copper ingot, crushed into one point.

item:core_drill#lore.text: A diamond-set coring bit on a hydraulic hammer. Hold it against bedrock and it cuts through - the first tool that can.

item:corundum#lore.text: Aluminium oxide, as hard as anything but diamond. Coloured by a trace of iron and titanium it is sapphire; by chromium, ruby. Clear and hard, it makes the best lenses and bearings.

item:cosmic_board#lore.text: A board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold.

item:cosmic_die#lore.text: A die holding a galaxy-scale computation.

item:cosmic_flux_coupler#lore.text: Couples a machine to the flux of a whole cosmos without being consumed by it.

item:cosmic_lens#lore.text: A loop of cosmic string bends light into perfect focus. A lithography catalyst.

item:cosmic_logic_wafer#lore.text: Etched with a lens made of a cosmic string. Each trace is a light-year long, folded.

item:cosmic_neutronium_ingot#lore.text: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.

item:cosmic_neutronium_singularity#lore.text: 4,096 cosmic neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.

item:cosmic_processor#lore.text: Tier V processor. A computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip.

item:cosmic_ray_shard#lore.text: Crystal scarred by the tracks of cosmic rays - nuclei flung across the Galaxy by supernova shocks at nearly the speed of light.

item:cosmic_record_fragment#lore.text: A sliver of a disc that recorded the Big Bang.

item:cosmic_string_segment#lore.text: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.

item:cosmic_web_filament#lore.text: The largest structure there is: filaments of dark matter and gas a hundred million light-years long, with galaxies strung along them like dew on a web.

item:cosmological_constant#lore.text: Lambda: the energy of empty space that pushes the universe apart.

item:cow_record#lore.text: Neutron counts swinging between the two exits as the interferometer tilts: the fringes gravity draws on a quantum wave.

item:cpt_mirror#lore.text: Reverses charge, parity and time at once. Through it lies a universe exactly like ours, made of antimatter.

item:crown_of_transcendence#lore.text: You see everything, because nothing can hide from what is outside it.

item:cryocooler_unit#lore.text: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. Superconductors stop superconducting without one.

item:cryogenic_receiver#lore.text: An amplifier cooled near absolute zero behind a sapphire window, in a copper feed. The colder it is, the less it hisses over the faint signal from the sky.

item:cryptochrome_magnetoreceptor#lore.text: The protein in a robin's eye that feels Earth's field through entangled radical pairs.

item:crystalline_matrix_ingot#lore.text: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.

item:d_brane_sheet#lore.text: The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one.

item:dark_energy_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Dark Energy - a gas, at 3 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:dark_era_haze_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Dark Era Haze - a gas, at 1 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:dark_matter_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Dark Matter - a gas, at 3 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:de_sitter_horizon_shard#lore.text: A piece of the cosmic horizon of an empty, accelerating universe. It glows at 10^-30 K and holds 10^122 bits.

item:deep_brine_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Deep Brine - a liquid, at 330 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:deep_sky_plate#lore.text: A long exposure on a dark, moonless night: faint smudges that are whole galaxies, millions of light-years away.

item:degenerate_armour_plate#lore.text: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.

item:degenerate_matter_chunk#lore.text: Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.

item:demiurge_hand#lore.text: The craftsman of the world had to hold it somehow. The only thing that can tune, wake or move an Omnipotence Core.

item:derivative_operator#lore.text: Instantaneous rate of change: the slope of a curve at a single point.

item:destabilised_husk_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Destabilised Husk into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:deuterium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Deuterium - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:dice_set#lore.text: Two fair dice: thirty-six outcomes, eleven totals, and seven the most likely of them.

item:differential_manifold#lore.text: A space that is flat up close and curved far away - the stage on which relativity is written.

item:dilaton_crystal#lore.text: A frozen value of the string coupling - how strongly strings interact. Grows on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk.

item:dilithium_crystal#lore.text: Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.

item:dilithium_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 dilithium crystal, crushed into one point.

item:dimensional_residue_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Dimensional Residue - a liquid, at 500 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:dimensional_singularity#lore.text: All eleven dimensions, compressed into none.

item:dipole_winding#lore.text: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle coil. Its field bends a particle beam into a ring.

item:dodecaract_excavator#lore.text: A cube with twelve dimensions has 4096 corners. One of them is always already inside the rock.

item:dynamic_singularity#lore.text: A singularity of something from another mod (or added by your pack).

item:dyson_shell_segment#lore.text: A curved plate of a star-enclosing shell. 64 of them close the sphere.

item:dyson_swarm_satellite#lore.text: One of millions. Feed them to a Dyson Array.

item:e8_lattice#lore.text: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.

item:echelle_grating#lore.text: A few dozen grooves to the millimetre ruled steep in an aluminised silica blank, used at high orders: it spreads a star's light into a spectrum a hundred times finer than a prism's.

item:echo_lattice#lore.text: Echoes of the Transcendental, crossed and woven into a frame that remembers the shape of a world.

item:eigenstate_lattice#lore.text: The states a measurement is allowed to find, and no others.

item:einstein_field_core#lore.text: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.

item:einstein_ring_lens#lore.text: A crystal from the Lensing Void that bends light round itself like a mass: a point behind it shows as a ring.

item:einstein_rosen_core#lore.text: Both ends of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held in one hand.

item:electrical_steel_lamination#lore.text: Thin sheets of silicon steel, insulated from each other, so a changing field cannot drive eddy currents through the core.

item:electride_crystal#lore.text: A salt whose negative ions are bare electrons sitting in holes in the lattice.

item:empirical_dossier#lore.text: Every early discovery, written up. A Research Nexus can study it in your place.

item:empirical_notes_1#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:empirical_notes_2#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:empirical_notes_3#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:empty_set#lore.text: The set with nothing in it - made from the nothing a Void Wraith leaves behind.

item:engineered_enzyme#lore.text: A protein designed to speed up exactly one reaction a millionfold.

item:entangled_bus_bar#lore.text: Two bars that are one: a current at one end is already at the other.

item:entangled_photon_pair#lore.text: Measure one and the other already knows.

item:entanglement_tuner#lore.text: Links Entangled Transceivers to one channel. Sneak-use a transceiver to switch it between sending and receiving.

item:entropy_censer#lore.text: Swing it and the world remembers how to decay. Any affliction, on one creature or on a place.

item:entropy_die#lore.text: A die worn perfectly fair. Every face is equally likely - which is to say it carries the most entropy a die can: log₂ 6 bits a throw.

item:epsilon_naught#lore.text: Omega to the omega to the omega... forever. And still countable.

item:equilibrium_lattice#lore.text: Forged with Omnipotence: a law that says this machine does not change. It does not.

item:er_bridge_thread#lore.text: Two entangled particles, and a wormhole too small to pass through joining them: Einstein-Rosen equals Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen.

item:ergodic_mixer_core#lore.text: A mixer that visits every state there is, given time - so its average over time is its average over all of them.

item:error_correction_lattice#lore.text: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.

item:eschaton_cell#lore.text: The end of all things, metered out in doses. What the last artefacts burn to stay what they are.

item:eschaton_core#lore.text: The heart of every last thing. Forged by hand in the reborn Core - and once you have, the Eschaton Foundry can make more.

item:eternity_catalyst#lore.text: A crystal that outlasts the universe. Some of the final processes only need it present; others use it up.

item:euclidean_anchor#lore.text: Euclid's fifth postulate, made to hold. Wherever its bearer stands, parallel lines stay parallel.

item:evaporation_flash#name.text: Last Flash of a Black Hole

item:evaporation_flash#lore.text: The final second of an evaporating black hole: hotter and brighter the smaller it gets, until nothing is left but the light.

item:exoplanet_core_sample#lore.text: Iron and nickel from the core of a planet that formed round another star, and was shattered in a collision long ago.

item:exotic_crystal_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 exotic matter crystal, crushed into one point.

item:exotic_matter_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Exotic Matter - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.
