item:exotic_matter_crystal#lore.text: Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.

item:exotic_matter_singularity#lore.text: Negative mass, antimatter, strange matter and dark matter, compressed into one point.

item:exotic_solder_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Exotic Solder - a liquid, at 1,200 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:false_vacuum_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of False Vacuum - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:false_vacuum_membrane#lore.text: The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.

item:faraday_cage_mesh#lore.text: A fine copper mesh. Charges in it rearrange until the field inside is zero. Carried in the off hand, it shields you from Decoherence.

item:faraday_isolator#lore.text: A garnet crystal in a strong magnetic field turns the plane of polarised light - the same way whichever way the light goes. Light passes out; its reflection, turned twice, cannot pass back.

item:femto_capacitor#lore.text: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.

item:femto_inductor#lore.text: A superconducting coil wound around nothing.

item:ferrite_magnet#lore.text: Iron oxide pressed with clay, fired, then magnetised: cheap, brittle and permanently magnetic.

item:ferrofluid_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Ferrofluid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:feynman_diagram#lore.text: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.

item:field_calibrator#lore.text: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.

item:firewall_shard#lore.text: If information escapes a black hole, the entanglement across its horizon must break - and a broken horizon would burn whatever falls in. A shard of that hypothetical wall of fire.

item:fission_fragment_mix#lore.text: Caesium, strontium, iodine and xenon: what a uranium nucleus becomes when it splits. Two billion years ago, Oklo made this on its own.

item:fission_husk_spawn_egg#lore.text: A heavy, unstable shell of uranium-dark stone. It is always close to splitting, and when it goes it breaks into two lighter pieces and a burst of heat.

item:fixed_point_lattice#lore.text: Gravity's strength, run to ever shorter distances, settles on a fixed value instead of blowing up: a theory safe all the way down.

item:flerovium_ingot#lore.text: Element 114, held together by magic numbers of protons and neutrons.

item:fluorite_boule#lore.text: Calcium fluoride grown as one crystal. It bends colours apart less than any glass, so lenses of it bring every colour to one focus.

item:fluorite_lens#lore.text: A lens cut from a fluorite boule along its lattice. Paired with glass it cancels the colour error glass alone cannot.

item:fluorspar#lore.text: Calcium fluoride, which grows in veins beside calcite. The fluorine that turns uranium into a gas comes from here.

item:folded_protein_crystal#lore.text: A chain of amino acids that found its one shape out of more than the universe has atoms.

item:form_of_the_self#lore.text: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.

item:formal_proof_tree#lore.text: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.

item:fourier_series#lore.text: Any signal is a sum of waves. This one is a sum of all of them.

item:fractal_core#lore.text: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.

item:fractal_dust#lore.text: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.

item:fractal_set#lore.text: z → z² + c, iterated forever. Infinitely detailed at every scale.

item:fractal_wyrm_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Fractal Wyrm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:fractured_essence#lore.text: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.

item:frontier_suit_boots#lore.text: Boots that pull you down where gravity is weak and hold you up where it is strong: you walk normally in the Asteroid Belt and the Pulsar Field.

item:frontier_suit_chestplate#lore.text: Layers of reflective foil round a coolant loop: the Accretion Rim's heat cannot set you alight.

item:frontier_suit_helmet#lore.text: A visor that measures how the light reaching it is bent and unbends it: you see through nebular dust and the Lensing Void's warped sight lines, and a Nebuloid cannot blind you.

item:frontier_suit_leggings#lore.text: A frame that takes the stretch for you: the Accretion Rim's tidal pull no longer strains you.

item:frozen_photon#lore.text: Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.

item:function_graph#lore.text: A rule that sends every input to exactly one output - drawn as a curve of light.

item:functor_bridge#lore.text: A map between categories that keeps every arrow pointing the right way.

item:fused_silica#lore.text: Quartz melted in the Solar Furnace and cooled to a glass. It barely expands with heat, so a mirror made of it keeps its figure.

item:fused_silica_lens#lore.text: A lens of fused silica, ground and polished to a quarter of a wavelength. Glass has no lattice: it needs no orientation to cut.

item:fusion_blanket_tile#lore.text: Lithium-6 behind lead and graphite. It catches the fusion neutrons, turns their energy into heat, and breeds tritium as it does.

item:g2_manifold#lore.text: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.

item:galactic_filament#lore.text: A map of the hydrogen in a filament of gas feeding a galaxy - a thread of the cosmic web, at the scale of one galaxy.

item:garnet#lore.text: Pyrope garnet, born where crust is dragged down and squeezed. Hard, dense and cheap: the grit of every cutting wheel.

item:garnet_boule#lore.text: A synthetic garnet crystal, grown flawless. Garnets doped with rare earths are the heart of the most common solid-state lasers.

item:gauge_boson_cluster#lore.text: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.

item:gauss_meter#lore.text: A Hall-effect probe: reads the magnetic field where you stand, from the planet's own to a magnet in your hand.

item:geiger_counter#lore.text: Held in either hand, it clicks for every decay it hears - from what you carry and from the ground around you.

item:geiger_tube#lore.text: A thin wire in a tube of low-pressure gas at high voltage. One ionising particle and the whole tube avalanches into a click.

item:gene_sampler#lore.text: Use on any creature to take a genome sample. Creatures from other dimensions give xenogenome samples.

item:general_ai_core#lore.text: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.

item:genome_sample#lore.text: Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.

item:geodesic_anchor#lore.text: Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.

item:geodesic_compass#lore.text: A compass that points along the straightest path through curved spacetime - which is the path a falling body takes.

item:geodesic_thread#lore.text: The straightest possible line - through curved spacetime.

item:geodetic_surveyor#lore.text: Triangulates the ground around you and lists the ores within 24 blocks, with the nearest of each.

item:geodynamo_wraith_spawn_egg#lore.text: A drifting presence of churning iron and current, the geodynamo given shape. Like Earth's own field, it wanders, and now and then flips its poles.

item:geoid_model#lore.text: The true shape of the planet: not a sphere, not quite an ellipsoid, but the surface the sea would take if it could flow everywhere.

item:glowstone_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 glowstone dust, crushed into one point.

item:glueball_core#lore.text: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.

item:godel_sentence#lore.text: "This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.

item:gold_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 gold ingot, crushed into one point.

item:grand_unified_core#lore.text: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.

item:graphene_sheet#lore.text: Carbon one atom thick. Stronger than steel, conducts better than copper.

item:graphite_moderator#lore.text: Nuclear-grade graphite. Carbon slows fission neutrons down without swallowing them, so they can split the next nucleus.

item:gravitational_wave_crystal#lore.text: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.

item:gravitational_wave_echo#lore.text: Faint repeats after a merger's ringdown - if a horizon is not quite a horizon, the waves bounce. Play it in the Accretion Frontier and something answers.

item:gravitic_lens_element#lore.text: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.

item:graviton_crystal#lore.text: Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.

item:graviton_harness#lore.text: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields.

item:graviton_wisp_core#lore.text: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.

item:graviton_wisp_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Graviton Wisp into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:greaves_of_the_absolute#lore.text: Distance is a law. You may keep it or not.

item:gw_record_bbh#lore.text: A chirp a fifth of a second long: two black holes of thirty suns each spiralling together a billion light-years away.

item:gw_record_bns#lore.text: A minute-long chirp of two neutron stars colliding. Where they merged, gold and platinum were made - and a telescope can still see it glow.

item:hafnium_178m2_isomer#lore.text: A nucleus that holds 2.4 MeV in a high-spin state for thirty-one years: a gram of it stores as much as a tonne of TNT.

item:hafnium_dust#lore.text: What is left when an isomer gives up its energy: ordinary hafnium.

item:hall_bar_chip#lore.text: A strip of two-dimensional electrons at a kelvin and ten tesla. Its Hall resistance sits on plateaus at exactly h/(νe²): a resistance standard set by nature.

item:hamiltonian_operator#lore.text: Ask it how a system changes and it answers with the energy.

item:hawking_absorber_plate#lore.text: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.

item:hawking_emitter#lore.text: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.

item:hawking_imp_spawn_egg#lore.text: A small creature forever evaporating. Like a black hole, the smaller it gets the hotter it glows and the faster it radiates itself away.

item:hawking_quanta#lore.text: The last light of a tiny black hole, caught as it evaporated. Hotter the smaller the hole was.

item:hawking_radiation_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Hawking Radiation - a gas, at 60 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:hawking_record#lore.text: Phonon pairs straddling a sonic horizon, one on each side, correlated as Hawking said they must be: the glow of a horizon, seen.

item:heat_death_ember#lore.text: The last warmth of a universe going cold: a little above the temperature of its own horizon, and falling.

item:heat_death_remnant#lore.text: All that is left of a universe at maximum entropy. Cold, even and perfectly still.

item:heavy_radiation_plating#lore.text: Lead, graphite and boron carbide, which swallows the slowed neutrons. A plated piece stops 25% of the dose - four of them, all but 5%.

item:heavy_water_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Heavy Water - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:heliostat_mirror#lore.text: A flat silvered mirror on a two-axis mount that turns with the Sun, so its reflection stays on one spot all day.

item:higgs_boson_crystal#lore.text: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.

item:higgs_catalyst#lore.text: A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Spent in making spin foam, pulsar crystals and wormhole throats.

item:higgs_field_capacitor#lore.text: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.

item:hilbert_bellhop_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Hilbert Bellhop into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:holographic_matrix#lore.text: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.

item:holographic_screen#lore.text: A surface that holds everything in the volume behind it, one bit per four Planck areas.

item:hopf_fibration#lore.text: A 3-sphere unwound into circles, every two of them linked.

item:horizon_diver#lore.text: Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.

item:horizon_shard#lore.text: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.

item:hotel_key#lore.text: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.

item:hydrogen_line_map#lore.text: A chart of the 21-centimetre glow of cold hydrogen across the Galaxy. The line's Doppler shift gives how fast each cloud moves.

item:hypercube_drifter_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Hypercube Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:hyperdimensional_boule#lore.text: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension.

item:hyperdimensional_die#lore.text: A die that is larger on the inside.

item:hyperdimensional_logic_wafer#lore.text: Circuits laid out in four dimensions, folded flat.

item:hyperdimensional_pearl#lore.text: A pearl that teleports to everywhere at once.

item:hyperdimensional_processor#lore.text: Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist.

item:hyperdimensional_wafer#lore.text: A wafer with more surface than its area allows.

item:hyperlattice_frame#lore.text: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension, so a nine-by-nine assembly has room for its insides.

item:hypernova_alloy_ingot#lore.text: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.

item:hypernova_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Hypernova Plasma - a liquid, at 10,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:hyperon_crystal#lore.text: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be.

item:hypersphere_fragment#lore.text: A curved piece of a sphere with a 3-dimensional surface.

item:ice_core#lore.text: A cylinder of ice drilled from a glacier. Every layer is a year of snow, and its trapped bubbles are samples of the air of that year.

item:identity_kernel#lore.text: The smallest thing that is still you. Carry it in the Transcendental.

item:imaginary_unit#lore.text: The square root of minus one, distilled from the imaginary mass of a tachyon.

item:immortal_cell_line#lore.text: Telomerase switched back on: the chromosome ends rebuild themselves, and the cells forget how to grow old. They have outlived their donor.

item:inaccessible_cardinal#lore.text: An infinity so large nothing smaller can build it.

item:inertia_damper#lore.text: Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.

item:infinitesimal#lore.text: Smaller than every positive number, yet not zero.

item:inflaton_condensate#lore.text: A scalar field held at the top of its potential, rolling so slowly that space doubles many times before it moves.

item:inflaton_field_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Inflaton Field - a gas, at 100,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:integer_ring#lore.text: The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative.

item:integral_operator#lore.text: The area under a curve, summed from infinitely many infinitesimal slices.

item:interstellar_dust#lore.text: Grains of silicate and soot a tenth of a micron across, coated in ice. A hundredth of the interstellar medium by mass - and what every rocky planet was made of.

item:interstellar_medium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Interstellar Medium - a gas, at 8,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:ionic_liquid_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Ionic Liquid - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:iron_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 iron ingot, crushed into one point.

item:island_fragment#lore.text: A region inside the horizon that belongs, after the Page time, to the radiation outside: the island that makes the curve turn over.

item:kaluza_klein_shard#lore.text: Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.

item:kaluza_klein_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 kaluza klein shard, crushed into one point.

item:kerr_metric_shard#lore.text: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole - ergosphere and all.

item:kilonova_ash#lore.text: Gold, platinum and lanthanides made in a second by the rapid neutron capture of a neutron-star merger, and thrown out at a fifth of the speed of light.

item:klein_bottle#lore.text: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.

item:kugelblitz_seed#lore.text: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.

item:lapis_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 lapis lazuli, crushed into one point.

item:laplaces_demon#lore.text: An intellect that knows every force and every position. Shown a machine, it knows exactly how the machine must be run.

item:large_deviation_shard#lore.text: A record of something that was not supposed to happen - and the exponentially small odds it beat.

item:laser_head#lore.text: A laser rod between two mirrors, pumped by a flash of light, behind a Faraday isolator so no reflection can come back into it. A single frequency, steady for hours.

item:laser_rod#lore.text: Garnet doped with neodymium, cut along its lattice and polished flat at both ends. Pumped with light, it gives back more light than it took in, all of one colour: infrared at 1064 nanometres.

item:lattice_seed#lore.text: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.

item:laue_pattern#lore.text: A photographic plate exposed to X-rays scattered by a crystal: a pattern of spots that shows how its lattice planes lie. Cut along them.

item:law_crystal#lore.text: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.

item:law_violation_shard#lore.text: A sliver of space where a conservation law quietly fails: charge appears from nothing, and the rest of physics has to make room.

item:law_wraith_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Law Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:lawgivers_codex#lore.text: Blank, until you write. Then the place you stand in obeys what you wrote.

item:lead_shielding_plate#lore.text: Dense, soft and cheap. Each centimetre of lead halves a gamma ray's chance of getting through.

item:lens_phantom_spawn_egg#lore.text: Nearly invisible: it is seen only by how it bends the light behind it into arcs and rings, the way unseen dark matter betrays itself to telescopes.

item:lense_thirring_vortex_core#lore.text: A knot of spacetime twisted round by a spinning mass: anything near it is dragged round with it.

item:lepton_triplet#lore.text: Electron, muon and tau - with a neutrino shadowing each.

item:light_radiation_plating#lore.text: Lead plate shaped to fit armour. Put it with any armour piece in a crafting grid: that piece then stops 10% of the radiation dose.

item:light_sail#lore.text: A sail of aluminised film a few microns thick, pushed by nothing but the pressure of starlight. Unfurl it high above the world, where there is no air left to drag on it, and it carries you out to the Accretion Frontier.

item:liquid_antihelium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Liquid Antihelium - a liquid, at 2 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:liquid_sodium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Liquid Sodium - a liquid, at 600 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:liquid_spacetime_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Liquid Spacetime - a liquid, at 3 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:lithium_6_ingot#lore.text: Lithium enriched in its lighter isotope. One neutron splits it into helium and tritium - which is how a fusion blanket breeds its fuel.

item:lithium_ingot#lore.text: The lightest metal, won from brine. Soft enough to cut with a knife; it floats on oil and burns crimson.

item:lithospheric_plate_fragment#lore.text: Rock from the base of a tectonic plate, where the cold, rigid lithosphere rides on the soft mantle below.

item:litz_wire#lore.text: Hundreds of thin copper strands, each insulated and woven so every one takes its turn at the outside: at high frequency current crowds to a wire's skin, and this gives it more skin.

item:logos_thread#lore.text: A strand of the Word that orders the world. Wound into a coil it makes space obey a shape.

item:lonsdaleite#lore.text: Hexagonal diamond, made only in the shock of an impact - harder, in places, than diamond itself.

item:lorentz_transform_crystal#lore.text: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.

item:m_brane#lore.text: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.

item:m_theory_core#lore.text: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.

item:magma_crawler_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Magma Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:magnetar_crust_fragment#lore.text: Iron crust from a magnetar, under a field of 10¹¹ tesla. It cracks in starquakes - and it still bends compass needles from across a room.

item:magnetar_shard#lore.text: Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.

item:magnetic_monopole#lore.text: A north pole with no south. Dirac would be pleased.

item:magnetite#lore.text: Fe₃O₄, the most magnetic mineral there is. Struck by lightning it becomes lodestone; ground up it becomes ferrite.

item:magnetized_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Magnetized Plasma - a gas, at 1,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:mantle_of_omnipotence#lore.text: Harm needs a law to happen by. You are wearing all of them.

item:markov_chain_link#lore.text: A link that remembers only the one before it. Chain enough of them and the past stops mattering at all.

item:massless_alloy#lore.text: The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.

item:mathematics_singularity#lore.text: Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.

item:maxwell_boltzmann_gas_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Maxwell-Boltzmann Gas - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:maxwell_demon_chip#lore.text: A tiny intelligence that opens a door for fast molecules only. Thermodynamics objects.

item:medium_radiation_plating#lore.text: Lead backed with graphite, which slows the neutrons lead lets through. A plated piece stops 18% of the dose.

item:merger_remnant#lore.text: What is left when two compact stars become one: a single spinning hole, ringing down to stillness.

item:metal_organic_framework#lore.text: Metal nodes, organic struts: a sponge with more inner surface than a football pitch per gram.

item:metallic_hydrogen_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Liquid Metallic Hydrogen - a liquid, at 20 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:metallic_hydrogen_ingot#lore.text: Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.

item:metamaterial_sheet#lore.text: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.

item:metamorphic_schist#lore.text: Basalt pressed and baked until its minerals regrew as flat, glittering mica - with the odd red garnet among them.

item:metastable_vacuum_lattice#lore.text: The Higgs potential mapped out to the Planck scale: the valley we live in is not the deepest one. Held in a lattice of Higgs field capacitors.

item:metastatic_spore#lore.text: A cluster of cells that has learned to leave: to slip its tissue, ride the blood and grow again somewhere it was never meant to be.

item:meteoric_iron#lore.text: Iron and nickel from the core of a planetesimal that shattered billions of years ago. Etched, it shows crossed plates that grew only a degree in a million years.

item:metric_tensor#lore.text: g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime.

item:micro_singularity#lore.text: A black hole the mass of a mountain, smaller than an atom.

item:microenvironment_organoid#lore.text: An anomaly is never alone: here it has grown its own blood vessels, recruited its own stroma and taught the local immune cells to look away.

item:minkowski_lattice#lore.text: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.

item:mirror_alloy_ingot#lore.text: Matter and antimatter in alternating grains, a Penning field between every pair. It hums.

item:mirror_processor#lore.text: Antisilicon logic on an anticarbon die: it computes with positrons.

item:mobius_strip#lore.text: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.

item:mod_essence_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Mod Essence - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:modular_form#lore.text: A function so symmetric it is called "the fifth fundamental operation of arithmetic".

item:moduli_crawler_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Moduli Crawler into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:moduli_crystal#lore.text: The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.

item:moissanite#lore.text: Silicon carbide, found in nature only in a few meteorites and in mantle rock. Harder than any gem but diamond, and far tougher: a drill bit of it cuts iron.

item:moissanite_drill#lore.text: A moissanite-tipped drill on a netherite shank: it mines Iron-Nickel and Core Magnetite Ore, which nothing softer can.

item:moissanite_lens#lore.text: Silicon carbide bends light more than diamond does: a moissanite lens is strong for its thickness, and it fires rainbows.

item:molecular_cloud_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Molecular Cloud - a gas, at 15 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:molecular_orbital_lattice#lore.text: Electron wavefunctions shared between atoms, frozen into a grid. This is what a chemical bond is.

item:molten_salt_fuel_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Molten Salt Fuel - a liquid, at 900 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:monazite_sand#lore.text: Heavy golden grains sorted out of beach sand: a phosphate of the rare earths, with a little thorium that keeps it faintly radioactive.

item:monte_carlo_sample_pack#lore.text: A billion random points, drawn and sorted: the answer to an integral too hard to do any other way, to a part in thirty thousand.

item:morphogenic_serum#lore.text: Every signal an embryo listens to, in one vial. A Breached Anomaly Engine spends one on every creature it grows.

item:mu_metal_shield#lore.text: Four parts nickel to one of iron, annealed in hydrogen: so permeable that a magnetic field would rather run through it than past what it shields. Carried in the off hand, it keeps you from being Magnetized.

item:multiverse_shard#lore.text: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle.

item:muonic_catalyst#lore.text: Swap an electron for a muon and atoms shrink 200 times - close enough to fuse cold.

item:nanite_slurry_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Nanite Slurry - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:nanite_swarm#lore.text: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.

item:nanite_swarm_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Nanite Swarm into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:narrow_ai_core#lore.text: Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.

item:natural_number_lattice#lore.text: One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".

item:nebular_gas_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Nebular Gas - a gas, at 40 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:nebuloid_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Nebuloid into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:negative_energy_lattice#lore.text: Casimir cavities stacked by the million: in each, the vacuum between the plates holds less energy than the vacuum outside.

item:negative_mass_ingot#lore.text: Push it and it comes toward you.

item:negentropy_cell#lore.text: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.

item:neodymium_blank#lore.text: Nd₂Fe₁₄B, cast and pressed, not yet magnetised. Its crystals all point the same way, waiting for a field strong enough to set them.

item:neodymium_magnet#lore.text: The strongest permanent magnet known: a thumb-sized piece can hold a kilogram of steel. Loses its strength above about 80 °C.

item:netherite_singularity#lore.text: 2,048 netherite ingot, crushed into one point.

item:neural_lattice#lore.text: Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.

item:neural_organoid#lore.text: A pea-sized brain grown in a dish. It has started to dream.

item:neutrino_flux_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Neutrino Flux - a gas, at 10 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:neutronium_plate#lore.text: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.

item:neutronium_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.

item:no_boundary_seed#lore.text: A closed universe tunnelled from nothing: round, without an edge, and without a first moment of time.

item:noble_gas_clathrate#lore.text: Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said.

item:normal_distribution_crystal#lore.text: Faceted where the bell curve says it should be: most of it near the middle, less and less towards the edges, none past the tails.

item:novikov_crystal#lore.text: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.

item:nuclear_waste_glass#lore.text: Fission products melted into borosilicate glass: it will hold them for the hundred thousand years they need.

item:nutrient_broth_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Nutrient Broth - a liquid, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:ocean_simulacrum#lore.text: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.

item:octonion_crystal#lore.text: Eight dimensions, and multiplication no longer associates. The largest number system that still divides.

item:omega_one#lore.text: The first ordinal that cannot be counted.

item:omega_ordinal#lore.text: The first number after all of the counting numbers.

item:omega_point#lore.text: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.

item:omnicellular_genome#lore.text: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension.

item:omnilex#lore.text: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.

item:omnilex_seal#lore.text: A wax seal pressed with a law. Machines that bear one are permitted to work.

item:omnipotence_dust#lore.text: Ground Omnipotence. Each grain can still be anything - for a moment.

item:omnipotence_seed#lore.text: Everything a Core needs to grow, folded small: a heart, a remembered world, and the proof that it can be done.

item:omnipotence_shard#lore.text: A splinter of the Core that made anything. It still remembers how - it has only forgotten what.

item:omnipotent_edge#lore.text: A blade with no thickness and no limit. What it cuts has never existed.

item:omnipotent_ingot#lore.text: Metal that is whatever metal it needs to be. Forged at the reborn Core, out of the boundless and the dust of the old Core.

item:omniscience_catalyst#lore.text: Every singularity there is, fused around a Theory of Everything. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.

item:omnium_ingot#lore.text: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.

item:omnium_singularity#lore.text: Two hundred and fifty-six Omnium Ingots in one point. There is nothing left to compress it into.

item:ontological_junction#lore.text: Where a machine's idea of itself meets its matter. Without one, big machines forget what they are for.

item:ontological_processor#lore.text: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers - it decides what is true.

item:oracle_lemma#lore.text: Creative mode only. Use inside one of Alpha Omega's trial chambers to have it count as solved.

item:ordinal_hound_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Ordinal Hound into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:ordinal_shard#lore.text: A piece of the order in which infinities come.

item:page_curve_record#lore.text: The entropy of a black hole's radiation: rising as it evaporates, until halfway - then falling back to zero. Information comes out. Carried in the off hand, it puts your hotbar back in order (no Information Loss).

item:panspermia_seed#lore.text: Life packed to survive the trip between universes.

item:paradox_echo_spawn_egg#lore.text: A figure forever meeting its own past. It acts out the grandfather paradox, flickering whenever its history stops adding up.

item:paradox_residue#lore.text: What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.

item:partition_function_matrix#lore.text: Z = Σ e^(−E/kT), summed over every state a system can be in. Everything else - energy, entropy, pressure - is a derivative of it.

item:path_integral#lore.text: Every way of getting from here to there, added up.

item:penning_harness#lore.text: A wearable Penning trap: magnetic and electric fields that keep every atom of you from touching the Antiverse.

item:penrose_spindle#lore.text: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.

item:pentaquark_shard#lore.text: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant - unless you crystallise them.

item:penteract_lattice#lore.text: A five-dimensional cube: 32 corners, 80 edges, 40 cells.

item:perfect_crystal_interferometer#lore.text: Three slabs cut from one silicon crystal, still joined at the base, so their lattice planes line up to a fraction of an atom: they split a neutron's wave, steer it, and bring it back together.

item:peridot#lore.text: Gem olivine, the mineral the upper mantle is mostly made of. It forms only deep down and only reaches the surface carried up in lava.

item:permafrost_sample#lore.text: Soil frozen for thousands of years, holding the carbon of the plants that grew before it froze.

item:phantom_energy_cell#lore.text: Dark energy with w below -1. Its density grows as space expands, until it tears apart galaxies, stars, atoms - and then the cell.

item:phase_locked_stabiliser#lore.text: Locks a multiblock's fields to a reference oscillator. Drift comes slower and smaller.

item:photographic_plate#lore.text: A glass plate coated with a light-sensitive emulsion set in gelatin. Left open under the sky for an hour, it records stars far too faint for any eye.

item:photon_moth_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Photon Moth into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:photonic_lens#lore.text: Focuses light onto wafers: never used up in lithography, though many finer optics are built from it.

item:photonic_logic_wafer#lore.text: Engraved with waveguides instead of wires.

item:photonic_neuron#lore.text: A neuron that thinks at the speed of light.

item:photonic_processor#lore.text: Tier I processor. Computes with light.

item:photoresist_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Quantum-Dot Photoresist - a liquid, at 290 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:pixel_tracker_module#lore.text: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.

item:planck_area_tile#lore.text: The smallest area there is, in loop quantum gravity: 8πγℓₚ²√(j(j+1)), where a spin network's link pierces a surface.

item:planck_diver#lore.text: Shrinks you past the Planck length into the Quantum Foam. Use again to come back.

item:planck_mite_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Planck Mite into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:planck_shard#lore.text: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.

item:planetary_core_sample#lore.text: Iron and nickel from two planets' cores, pressed together to the pressure at a core's centre: the stuff every rocky planet sinks to its middle.

item:planetary_nebula_shell#lore.text: The glowing shell a dying Sun-like star throws off: oxygen green, hydrogen red, round a white dwarf at its centre.

item:planetary_plate#lore.text: The sharpest of a thousand short exposures of a planet, taken in the instants the air held still: belts, moons, a shadow.

item:plasma_nozzle_tip#lore.text: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.

item:plasma_thruster_nozzle#lore.text: A magnetic nozzle of lonsdaleite and iron: plasma pushed out along its field lines leaves faster than any chemical exhaust.

item:platonic_compass#lore.text: Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).

item:pleroma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Pleroma - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:pleroma_crystal#lore.text: Pleroma - the fullness. Every law the Transcendental held, frozen into one lattice.

item:plume_elemental_spawn_egg#lore.text: A column of hot rock rising from the base of the mantle, solid yet flowing over the ages. Where such a plume reaches the crust, chains of volcanoes follow.

item:plutonium_239_pellet#lore.text: Bred from uranium-238 in the reactor and taken out of its spent salt. Warm to the touch from its own alpha decay.

item:pocket_universe#lore.text: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it.

item:poisson_clock#lore.text: A clock that ticks at random: each tick a decay in its radium, the waits between them falling off exponentially. It keeps perfect average time and never says when.

item:polonium_210_source#lore.text: A speck of polonium giving off so many alpha particles that it is warm to the touch. Harmless at arm's length; deadly inside you.

item:positronium_hydride#lore.text: A molecule made of a hydrogen atom and an atom of matter bound to antimatter. It lasts a nanosecond - unless you trap it.

item:positronium_skitterer_spawn_egg#lor.text: Calls a Positronium Skitterer into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:posterior_tablet#lore.text: Belief, updated by evidence. Carry one while solving a research derivation and it pays for a hint instead of Insight.

item:power_set#lore.text: The set of all subsets. Always strictly bigger than what you started with.

item:precision_gyroscope#lore.text: A fused-quartz sphere, the roundest object ever made, spinning in a vacuum. Space itself turns its axis. Carried in the off hand, it holds you steady against Frame Drag and Tidal Strain.

item:predictive_lattice_governor#lore.text: Simulates the machine a minute ahead and corrects what has not happened yet.

item:presolar_grains#lore.text: Silicon carbide stardust condensed in the winds of stars that died before the Sun was born. Moissan named the mineral moissanite when he found it in a meteorite.

item:pressure_suit_boots#lore.text: Sealed boots of a pressure suit. Above about 19 km, the Armstrong limit, water boils at body temperature, and so would the wearer without them.

item:pressure_suit_chestplate#lore.text: A rigid shell built to bear the weight of rock overhead. At the base of Earth's mantle the pressure reaches about 136 GPa, over a million atmospheres.

item:pressure_suit_helmet#lore.text: A sealed helmet that keeps the head in breathable pressure. Above about 19 km, water in the body would boil at body temperature without it.

item:pressure_suit_leggings#lore.text: Layered leggings that hold air pressure against the body. Bending a knee in an inflated suit is hard work, so the joints are built to keep their volume constant.

item:prime_shard#lore.text: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.

item:prime_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 prime shard, crushed into one point.

item:primordial_ash#lore.text: What the first three minutes made: three parts hydrogen to one of helium-4, a pinch of deuterium and helium-3, a trace of lithium-7.

item:primordial_charter#lore.text: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.

item:primordial_ejecta#lore.text: Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw.

item:primordial_harvest#lore.text: Every crop that has ever grown, in one seed.

item:primordial_law_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Primordial Law - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:primordial_soup_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Primordial Soup - a liquid, at 340 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:prion_lattice#lore.text: Misfolded protein stacked into amyloid. Touch a healthy protein to it and the healthy one misfolds too: shape is the infection.

item:prior_tablet#lore.text: What you believe before you look, written down so that the evidence can change it.

item:programmable_matter#lore.text: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command.

item:proof_fragment#lore.text: Part of a proof an Axiom Sentinel was writing about you. QED.

item:proof_mass#lore.text: A polished cube of gold and platinum that touches nothing. Whatever path it follows is the path of free fall itself.

item:proof_of_everything#lore.text: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.

item:proton_decay_residue#lore.text: Positrons and neutral pions from protons that lived 10^34 years and then simply came apart.

item:protostar_core#lore.text: A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse.

item:protostellar_ember#lore.text: A shard of a star not yet lit, still glowing with the heat of its own collapse. A furnace of a fuel: it burns for a long time.

item:prussian_blue_tablet#lore.text: Iron hexacyanoferrate. Swallowed, it traps radioactive caesium and thallium in the gut so the body passes them instead of keeping them.

item:psionic_ether_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Psionic Ether - a gas, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:pulsar_timing_crystal#lore.text: Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.

item:pulsar_timing_record#lore.text: Arrival times of a pulsar's pulses, steady to a millionth of a second over months: a clock spun up in a dead star.

item:pulsar_wisp_spawn_egg#lore.text: A spinning wisp that flashes on a perfect beat, like the lighthouse beam of a pulsar. Millisecond pulsars keep time nearly as well as atomic clocks.

item:quadrupole_pole_tip#lore.text: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.

item:quantum_chlorophyll#lore.text: Photosynthesis moves energy by trying every path at once - coherently.

item:quantum_dot#lore.text: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.

item:quantum_field_lattice#lore.text: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.

item:quantum_processor#lore.text: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits.

item:quantum_singularity#lore.text: Every possible state at once, compressed into one point.

item:quantum_spacetime_condensate_cell#l.text: 1,000 mB of Quantum Spacetime Condensate - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:quantum_string#lore.text: A one-dimensional vibrating string. Its mode of vibration decides which particle it is.

item:quarantine_field_matrix#lore.text: A field that clears an anomaly faster than it can copy itself. It does not destroy anything - it only keeps R below one.

item:quark_gluon_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Quark-Gluon Plasma - a liquid, at 4,000,000,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:quark_star_core#lore.text: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.

item:quasar_jet_filament#lore.text: A thread of the jet that a spinning black hole drives out along its axis at nearly the speed of light, wound up in magnetic field.

item:quaternion_crystal#lore.text: Hamilton carved i² = j² = k² = ijk = -1 into a bridge. Here it is carved into a crystal: pure rotation.

item:qubit#lore.text: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.

item:qubit_array_wafer#lore.text: Thousands of qubits, engraved through a metamaterial lens.

item:qubit_die#lore.text: A single die of entangled qubits.

item:quine_replicator#lore.text: A machine whose instructions contain a description of itself and an order to copy it. A von Neumann replicator, a virus, a meme.

item:r_process_cluster#lore.text: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.

item:radiogenic_lead#lore.text: Lead that was once uranium, radium and radon: the stable end of a decay chain, made one nucleus at a time.

item:radium_salt#lore.text: Ten milligrams of radium chloride, glowing faintly in the dark by its own decay. Handle it as little as you can.

item:radon_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Radon-222 - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:rail_armature#lore.text: A copper slug that bridges a railgun's two rails: the current through it and the field of the rails push it out at kilometres a second.

item:random_number_chip#lore.text: Single photons meet a half-silvered mirror: transmitted is 1, reflected is 0. Nothing in the universe knows the next bit in advance.

item:random_walker_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Random Walker into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:rare_earth_oxide#lore.text: Neodymium, samarium and their cousins, so alike chemically that it took a century and a spectroscope to tell them apart.

item:rational_field#lore.text: Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere - and still full of holes.

item:raw_antigold#lore.text: Gold of the mirror universe, cold blue where ours is warm yellow - only the light it reflects is the same.

item:raw_antiiron#lore.text: Ore from the Antiverse. Iron, exactly - except that every particle in it is the opposite one.

item:raw_pitchblende#lore.text: Uraninite: heavy, black and pitch-glossy. Marie and Pierre Curie found two new elements in it by following its radioactivity.

item:raw_star_matter_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Raw Star Matter - a liquid, at 15,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:real_continuum#lore.text: The rationals with every gap filled - including the transcendental numbers mined from the Platonic Realm.

item:reality_anchor#lore.text: Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.

item:recombinant_dna#lore.text: A double helix spliced from more than one creature.

item:red_giant_envelope#lore.text: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.

item:redshift_lens#lore.text: A calibrated lens of spectra: distances from standard candles set against the redshifts of their galaxies. Every one is moving away, and the farther, the faster.

item:redshift_record#lore.text: Counts of gamma rays climbing a tower, and the source speed that brought them back into tune: gravity measured with a stopwatch of atomic nuclei.

item:refractory_suit_boots#lore.text: Boots lined with refractory ceramic, the kind that keeps its strength at temperatures that melt steel and lets very little of the heat through.

item:refractory_suit_chestplate#lore.text: Armour of refractory ceramics, which keep their strength where metals soften. Basaltic magma erupts at about 1,100 to 1,200 °C, and the suit hardly notices.

item:refractory_suit_helmet#lore.text: A helmet lined with ceramic that shrugs off heat which would melt steel. It insulates, so the inside stays cool while the outside glows.

item:refractory_suit_leggings#lore.text: Leggings of ceramic fibre under aluminised cloth, like a furnace worker's. The bright outer layer reflects radiant heat before it can soak in.

item:reheating_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Reheating Plasma - a liquid, at 1,000,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:rekindled_heart#lore.text: Four sparks of the second creation, beating together around an Eschaton Core.

item:rekindled_spark#lore.text: What the Pleroma Reconstitutor leaves behind once the Transcendental is whole again: the first light of the second creation.

item:relativity_breakdown_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Relativity Breakdown - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:renormalised_essence_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Renormalised Essence - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:residual_starlight_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Residual Starlight - a gas, at 50,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:resistant_clone#lore.text: The cells that survived the last treatment - and so the ones that make the next tumour. Selection, not malice.

item:resolved_anomaly#lore.text: An anomaly explained: its strangeness measured, renormalised, and written back into the laws. It is just physics now. It always was.

item:resonance_probe#lore.text: Reads the four virtual-particle resonances where you stand in the Quantum Foam.

item:retrocausal_crystal#lore.text: It formed after you mined it.

item:rf_resonator_cell#lore.text: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.

item:rich_copper_chunk#lore.text: Porphyry copper, veined with gold that came up with it.

item:rich_gold_chunk#lore.text: Reef gold in quartz pebbles - the kind of ore that, on Earth, carries uraninite too.

item:rich_iron_chunk#lore.text: Banded iron from deep down: richer than any Overworld ore, with magnetite in its layers.

item:riemann_curvature_tensor#lore.text: How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop - curvature itself.

item:riemann_zeta_crystal#lore.text: Every non-trivial zero lies on the critical line. Probably. This crystal grew along it.

item:rift_anchor#lore.text: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.

item:ringwoodite#lore.text: A high-pressure form of olivine from 520 km down. Its crystals hold water: there may be more of it in the mantle than in every ocean.

item:room_temperature_superconductor#lor.text: Zero resistance without cryogenics. Physicists have chased this for a century.

item:russell_paradox_set#lore.text: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?

item:samarium_cobalt_blank#lore.text: Sm₂(Co,Fe,Cu)₁₇: harder to magnetise than neodymium, and it keeps its magnetism far hotter.

item:samarium_cobalt_magnet#lore.text: A little weaker than neodymium, but it keeps its field up to 300 °C - the magnet for hot machines.

item:sapphire_boule#lore.text: A single crystal of aluminium oxide pulled from the melt, every atom of it in one lattice. Cut, it gives windows clear from ultraviolet to infrared.

item:sapphire_window#lore.text: A disc of synthetic sapphire, aluminium oxide grown from the melt: hard, clear from ultraviolet to infrared, and it stays clear when frozen.

item:satellite_image_plate#lore.text: The ground seen from orbit, in visible and infrared: rivers, faults, and the heat of what lies under the surface.

item:schmidt_corrector#lore.text: A thin, almost flat plate of fused silica, figured to a gentle aspheric curve. In front of a spherical mirror it gives a sharp image across a field many degrees wide.

item:schrodinger_limit_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Schrödinger's Limit - a liquid, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:scintillator_crystal#lore.text: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.

item:sediment_core#lore.text: A tube of layered ground. Each band is a year, a flood or an ash fall, stacked in the order it happened.

item:seismic_recorder_drum#lore.text: A paper drum turned by clockwork under a hanging pen. The ground shakes, the pen does not, and the difference is written down.

item:self_healing_polymer#lore.text: Cut it and the chains find each other again.

item:silicon_boule#lore.text: Silicon reduced from silica with carbon, then pulled from its melt as one flawless crystal: the most perfect solid people make.

item:silicon_life_spore#lore.text: Life built on silicon instead of carbon. It grew in the Bulk.

item:simulated_universe#lore.text: A whole other world, run from its first instant to its last inside the Forge. Each mod has its own.

item:singularity_cluster#lore.text: Nine singularities condensed into one, when there are too many to hold.

item:singularity_scepter#lore.text: It does not fire singularities. It decides where one has always been.

item:soft_hair_filament#lore.text: Zero-energy excitations on a horizon that remember what fell in: a black hole may not be quite as bald as it seems.

item:solar_statite#lore.text: A light sail balanced between gravity and radiation pressure.

item:source_code_fragment#lore.text: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments.

item:spacetime_alloy_ingot#lore.text: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.

item:spacetime_alloy_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 spacetime alloy ingot, crushed into one point.

item:spacetime_bearing#lore.text: Turns on a frictionless geodesic. It will outlast the machine around it.

item:spacetime_catalyst#lore.text: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) to grow pocket universes and the highest processors.

item:spacetime_singularity#lore.text: All of relativity, compressed into the one place relativity breaks down.

item:spacetime_slag#lore.text: Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.

item:spark_of_life#lore.text: The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.

item:specimen_bundle#lore.text: One of everything a mod's world grows or leaves behind, sealed in glass.

item:spectral_analyzer#lore.text: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.

item:spectral_plate#lore.text: Starlight spread into a rainbow and caught on glass. The dark lines in it say which elements the light passed through.

item:spent_fuel_rod#lore.text: A fuel rod after three years in a reactor: still mostly uranium, but laced with fission products a million times more radioactive.

item:spent_fuel_salt_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Spent Fuel Salt - a liquid, at 900 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:spin_foam_lattice#lore.text: Loop quantum gravity: spacetime itself, woven from discrete quanta of area.

item:spin_network_node#lore.text: A node of a spin network: a grain of volume, its faces the links that join it to its neighbours. Space is built from these.

item:spinor_lattice#lore.text: Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.

item:stabiliser_matrix#lore.text: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.

item:standard_model_matrix#lore.text: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.

item:standard_model_singularity#lore.text: Every particle that exists, compressed into one point.

item:star_field_plate#lore.text: A developed plate of a patch of sky: thousands of stars, their positions measured to a fraction of an arcsecond.

item:stellar_core#lore.text: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole.

item:stellar_iron_ingot#lore.text: Iron from the core of a star - the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.

item:stellar_iron_singularity#lore.text: 16,384 stellar iron ingot, crushed into one point.

item:stellar_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Stellar Plasma - a liquid, at 15,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:stellar_singularity#lore.text: The whole life of a star, compressed into one point.

item:stellar_spectrum_plate#lore.text: Starlight spread into a spectrum on the plate. The dark lines across it give each star's temperature and what it is made of.

item:stem_cell_culture#lore.text: Cells that have not yet decided what to become.

item:sterile_neutrino#lore.text: Interacts with nothing except gravity. Very hard to keep hold of.

item:strain_sensor#lore.text: A fused-silica fibre that changes its light when it stretches by a part in a billion.

item:strained_spacetime_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Strained Spacetime - a liquid, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:strange_charm_quarks#lore.text: The second generation: heavier, and they only exist for an instant outside strange matter.

item:strange_matter_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Strange Matter - a liquid, at 1,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:strange_matter_pellet#lore.text: Up, down and strange quarks. Possibly contagious.

item:strange_matter_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 strange matter pellet, crushed into one point.

item:stress_energy_tensor#lore.text: Matter tells spacetime how to curve. This is what it says.

item:string_coupling_crystal#lore.text: Tunes how strongly strings split and join. Turn it up and string theory becomes a different string theory.

item:structure_assembler#lore.text: Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory. Sneak-use to preview what is missing. Sneak-use on any block of an ME network to bind it: what you lack is then taken from the network.

item:superconducting_coil#lore.text: Zero resistance. The current never stops.

item:superconducting_solder_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Superconducting Solder - a liquid, at 4 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:supercritical_solvent_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Supercritical Solvent - a liquid, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:supercritical_water_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Supercritical Water - a liquid, at 650 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:superfluid_helium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Superfluid Helium - a liquid, at 2 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:superintelligence_core#lore.text: It has already read this tooltip. And the next one.

item:supernova_remnant#lore.text: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy.

item:superpartner_shard#lore.text: A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.

item:superposition_crystal#lore.text: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.

item:surreal_number#lore.text: Conway's numbers: every real, every ordinal, every infinitesimal - all in one ordered field.

item:survey_map#lore.text: Heights, rivers and benchmarks, measured rather than guessed. Every line on it was walked.

item:survey_satellite#lore.text: A telescope pointed down instead of up, with solar wings and a radio. Flown high enough, it photographs the ground.

item:symbiont_culture#lore.text: The same anomaly, turned: it still copies itself, but now it pays its host back. Parasite and partner differ by one sign.

item:synaptic_fluid_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Synaptic Fluid - a liquid, at 310 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:synthetic_cell#lore.text: The smallest genome that can still be alive, written from scratch.

item:tachyon_flux_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Tachyon Flux - a gas, at 0 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:tachyon_klystron#lore.text: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future.

item:tachyon_singularity#lore.text: 8,192 tachyon crystal, crushed into one point.

item:tardigrade_culture#lore.text: Survives vacuum, radiation and freezing by simply pausing being alive.

item:technetium_99m_vial#lore.text: An excited nucleus that gives off one clean gamma ray and calms down within hours: the most used medical isotope in the world.

item:telescope_mirror_blank#lore.text: A disc of glass ground to a paraboloid within a fraction of a wavelength, then silvered. Light from a whole star lands on one point.

item:telomerase_complex#lore.text: Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age.

item:temporal_knot#lore.text: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.

item:temporal_singularity#lore.text: Every moment there has ever been, compressed into one instant.

item:tesseract_core#lore.text: A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.

item:tesseract_lens#lore.text: Focuses light through the fourth dimension. A lithography catalyst.

item:test_mass#lore.text: Forty kilograms of fused silica, polished to a few nanometres and hung on silica fibres: a mirror that does nothing but follow spacetime.

item:theodolite_lens#lore.text: A sighting lens on a graduated circle: two angles and one measured baseline, and every distance follows.

item:theoretical_dossier#lore.text: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.

item:theoretical_notes_1#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:theoretical_notes_2#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:theoretical_notes_3#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:theory_of_everything#lore.text: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.

item:thorium_232_pellet#lore.text: Three times as common as uranium, and not fissile itself - but a neutron makes it uranium-233, which is.

item:thought_matrix#lore.text: A thought, frozen in a lattice so it can be copied.

item:tidal_alloy_scrap#lore.text: Metal pulled thin by tides stronger than its bonds.

item:tidal_horror_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Tidal Horror into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:tidal_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Tidal Plasma - a liquid, at 50,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:tidal_shear_crystal#lore.text: A crystal pulled long and thin by a tidal force: one end fell faster than the other.

item:tidal_stretcher_spawn_egg#lore.text: A creature of the tide near a compact mass, where feet are pulled harder than head. It draws everything near it out long and thin, like spaghetti.

item:time_dilated_sample#lore.text: A crystal grown deep in a gravity well. By its own clock it took longer to form than the outside world saw.

item:topological_board#lore.text: A board whose traces are protected by topology.

item:topological_boule#lore.text: A boule doped with topological insulator. Its surface conducts; its interior never will.

item:topological_defect_core#lore.text: A knot in a broken symmetry: the field could not agree which vacuum to fall into, so it kept both - and the seam between them cannot untie.

item:topological_die#lore.text: A die of topologically protected logic.

item:topological_insulator#lore.text: Insulating bulk, conducting surface - protected by topology.

item:topological_logic_wafer#lore.text: Braided anyons on a wafer - errors cannot touch them.

item:topological_processor#lore.text: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry.

item:topological_wafer#lore.text: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance.

item:topos#lore.text: A universe of mathematics with its own internal logic. Change the topos and you change what is true.

item:transcendence_crystal#lore.text: A crystal that has stepped outside every system that could describe it.

item:transcendent_metal_ingot#lore.text: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.

item:transcendent_plasma_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Transcendent Plasma - a liquid, at 100,000,000 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:transcendental_crystal#lore.text: π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Mined in the Platonic Realm, or extracted from axiom stone in an Analytic Continuator.

item:transcendental_echo#lore.text: The last ringing of a destroyed dimension, caught before it faded. It is the shape of the place, without the place.

item:transfinite_lattice_bolt#lore.text: Threaded with ℵ₀ turns. It never quite finishes screwing in, and it never comes loose.

item:transfinite_processor#lore.text: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.

item:transfinite_weave#lore.text: A weave with more threads than any finite count. Aleph-one and Absolute Infinity are stitched on it.

item:transit_light_curve#lore.text: A star's brightness, dipping for a few hours as a planet crosses in front of it. The depth gives the planet's size.

item:treads_of_infinity#lore.text: Every step lands. None of them fall.

item:tree_simulacrum#lore.text: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.

item:tritium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Tritium - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:true_vacuum_seed#lore.text: A bubble of the deeper vacuum, held below its critical radius. Let it grow and it expands at the speed of light, forever.

item:turbomolecular_rotor#lore.text: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.

item:turing_morphogen#lore.text: Two chemicals, one fast and one slow, that paint stripes and spots by themselves.

item:unbihexium_ingot#lore.text: Element 126, the heart of the island of stability. Nothing should be this heavy and last this long.

item:undecidable_kernel#lore.text: A program no other program can predict: whether it halts is true or false, and provably unprovable. It runs on anyway.

item:unified_dossier#lore.text: Everything up to the edge of mathematics, unified. Feeds a Research Nexus.

item:unified_notes_1#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:unified_notes_2#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:unified_notes_3#lore.text: One third of a Research Dossier.

item:universe_seed#lore.text: A grain of false vacuum primed to inflate into a cosmos.

item:unruh_thermometer#lore.text: A detector that clicks when it is accelerated through empty space: to it, the vacuum is a warm bath, T = ħa/2πck.

item:up_down_quarks#lore.text: The two lightest quark flavours - everything you have ever touched is made of them.

item:uranium_235_pellet#lore.text: Uranium enriched to a few percent of the fissile isotope: reactor fuel. The cascade will not go past 20%.

item:uranium_238_pellet#lore.text: Depleted uranium: what is left when the U-235 has been taken out. Dense, barely radioactive - and fertile: in a reactor it becomes plutonium.

item:uranium_hexafluoride_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Uranium Hexafluoride - a gas, at 340 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:vacuum_drifter_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Vacuum Drifter into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:virtual_graviton#lore.text: A quantum of gravity that has not yet decided to exist.

item:virtual_monopole#lore.text: A magnet with one pole. The vacuum only lends these briefly.

item:virtual_pair_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Virtual Pair into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:virtual_photon#lore.text: Light that never left anything and will never arrive.

item:virtual_quark#lore.text: A quark borrowed from the vacuum. It wants to go back.

item:void_essence#lore.text: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.

item:void_lattice_shard#lore.text: A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.

item:void_lattice_singularity#lore.text: 32,768 void lattice shard, crushed into one point.

item:void_wraith_spawn_egg#lore.text: Calls a Void Wraith into the world. Creative mode only: nothing hatches from it in survival.

item:von_neumann_probe#lore.text: Builds copies of itself from whatever it finds. Put one in a Dyson Array.

item:warm_helium_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Warm Helium - a gas, at 300 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:warp_bubble_core#lore.text: A bubble of flat space ready to be pushed through curved space. Used, it anchors where you stand; the anchored bubble brings you back there once.

item:wave_packet#lore.text: A particle, written as a sum of waves - localised, but never exactly.

item:wavefunction#lore.text: Everything a particle could be, written down at once.

item:waveguide#lore.text: A rectangular copper pipe that carries microwaves the way a pipe carries water - no wave longer than twice its width gets through.

item:well_ordering_charm#lore.text: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.

item:whipple_shield_boots#lore.text: Armoured like a spacecraft: a thin outer bumper shatters an incoming particle into a spray the inner wall can stop. Fred Whipple proposed it in 1946.

item:whipple_shield_chestplate#lore.text: A thin bumper held off from the wall behind it. A micrometeoroid striking it shatters into a spreading cloud the inner layer can stop. Fred Whipple proposed it in the 1940s.

item:whipple_shield_helmet#lore.text: A thin outer bumper set apart from the shell, as Fred Whipple proposed in 1946. A fast grain strikes it, shatters into a spray, and spends itself in the gap.

item:whipple_shield_leggings#lore.text: Leggings layered like a Whipple shield: a thin outer skin shatters a hypervelocity grain into a spray of vapour that the next layer catches.

item:white_dwarf_core#lore.text: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.

item:white_hole_fragment#lore.text: A time-reversed horizon. Nothing can enter.

item:wormhole_throat#lore.text: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, held open with exotic matter.

item:xenobot_swarm#lore.text: Living machines made of cells, designed by an evolutionary algorithm.

item:xenogenome_sample#lore.text: A genome from a creature of another dimension. Its code is not written in DNA.

item:xenoplasm_cell#lore.text: 1,000 mB of Xenoplasm - a liquid, at 290 K - sealed in a containment cell. Pours out and fills up like a bucket.

item:yellowcake#lore.text: Uranium oxide concentrate, roasted out of pitchblende: a coarse yellow-brown powder, still 99.3% uranium-238.

item:zeolite_catalyst#lore.text: A crystal full of molecule-sized pores; reactions that fit inside go faster.

research:abiogenesis.desc.text: Where chemistry becomes life. Unlocks the Abiogenesis Crucible and the Spark of Life.

research:abstract_algebra.desc.text: Quaternions, octonions and spinors: number systems that give up commutativity, then associativity.

research:accelerator_physics.desc.text: Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

research:accretion_physics.desc.text: Matter falling onto a compact object turns its gravity into light - up to a third of its rest energy for a spinning black hole, fifty times better than fusion. The brightest things in the universe are lit this way. Unlocks the Accretion Disk Reactor.

research:ads_cft.desc.text: A theory of gravity in a curved space and a quantum field theory on its boundary, without gravity, are the same theory in two languages. The universe as a hologram, made exact.

research:alcubierre_metric.desc.text: General relativity allows a bubble of flat space to be carried faster than light - if its wall is made of negative energy. Unlocks the Warp Field Forge.

research:analog_gravity.desc.text: A fluid flowing faster than its own sound has a horizon for sound, and the mathematics of sound on it is the mathematics of light near a black hole - Hawking radiation included. Unlocks the Analog Black Hole.

research:annihilation_power.desc.text: Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.

research:anomalous_leakage.desc.text: An anomaly in physics is a law that holds classically but fails in the quantum world: a conserved charge that quietly is not. Where a defect touches ordinary space, such failures leak out - local violations the rest of physics must absorb. Unlocks the Local Law Violation.

research:anomalous_phenomena.desc.text: Every science has its anomalies: effects that the laws we know cannot explain, systems that copy themselves and refuse to die. Containment failures leave them lying around. Study them properly - how they arise, spread, interact with the normal world, and how they can finally be explained. Unlocks the Anomaly Containment Ward and Contained Anomaly Specimens.

research:anomaly_resolution.desc.text: The last step is not destruction but understanding. An anomaly measured completely - how it scales, where it breaks the law and by exactly how much - can be renormalised: absorbed into a deeper law that explains it. It was never abnormal, only unexplained. Unlocks the Resolved Anomaly.

research:anomaly_scaling.desc.text: What can an anomaly do, and how big can it get? Catalogue them, and their sizes - tumours, outbreaks, avalanches, ruptures - follow power laws: most are tiny, a few are vast, and the mean is set by the exponent. Unlocks the Anomaly Catalogue.

research:antiatom_chemistry.desc.text: An antiproton and a positron make antihydrogen - with exactly the same spectrum as hydrogen. Unlocks the Antiproton Decelerator.

research:artificial_intelligence.desc.text: Photonic neural networks and narrow AI. Unlocks the Neural Synthesizer.

research:assembly_lines.desc.text: Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

research:asymptotic_safety.desc.text: Gravity's coupling, followed to ever shorter distances, may settle onto a fixed point instead of blowing up - and then general relativity is a complete quantum theory as it stands.

research:autocatalysis.desc.text: A reaction whose product speeds up its own making grows exponentially and can oscillate, flare and spread as a wave. A prion does it with shape alone: a misfolded protein that refolds the healthy ones it touches. Unlocks Autocatalytic Broth and the Prion Lattice.

research:axiom_theory.desc.text: Beneath the source code of reality lie its axioms - and axioms can be distilled, edited and broken. Unlocks the Axiom Distiller.

research:baryon_asymmetry.desc.text: For every billion antibaryons in the early universe there were a billion and one baryons. We are the one. Unlocks the Baryogenesis Seed.

research:bayesian_inference.desc.text: Belief is a probability, and evidence should change it by a fixed rule: how likely the evidence was if you are right, against how likely it was anyway. Unlocks the Bayesian Analyzer and the Prior and Posterior Tablets.

research:beyond_the_omega.desc.text: With the Proof of Everything, the Omnilex Engine can be pushed past the possible - into the Transcendental.

research:big_bang_cosmology.desc.text: Everything we see was once hotter and denser than the inside of any star, and has been expanding and cooling ever since. The Friedmann equations of general relativity say how fast: by what fills the universe and how it is curved. The first study of the Origin.

research:big_crunch.text: The Big Crunch & the Big Bounce

research:big_crunch.desc.text: Enough matter, or dark energy that decays, and the expansion stops and reverses: everything falls back into a crunch. Quantum geometry may refuse the singularity - at the Planck density gravity repels, and the crunch bounces into a new expansion. Unlocks the Bounce Core.

research:big_rip.desc.text: If dark energy is phantom - w below -1 - its density grows as space expands. Clusters, then galaxies, then stars and planets, then atoms are torn apart, all in a finite time. Unlocks the Phantom Energy Cell.

research:binary_mergers.desc.text: Two compact stars in orbit radiate gravitational waves, spiral in, and merge in a final whoop of rising pitch. Their chirp mass sets how fast. Unlocks gravitational-wave echoes - and an answer from the Frontier.

research:black_hole_era.desc.text: After the protons, only black holes are left, slowly radiating. A black hole of a solar mass needs 10^67 years to evaporate, a supermassive one 10^100 - and then it ends in a flash. Unlocks the Last Flash of a Black Hole.

research:black_hole_interior.desc.text: What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

research:black_hole_thermodynamics.desc.text: A black hole has a temperature, so it has an entropy - and that entropy is its horizon's area in Planck units, divided by four. The most information any region can hold is set by its surface, not its volume.

research:brane_cosmology.desc.text: Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.

research:brownian_motion.desc.text: Pollen grains in water never keep still. In 1905 Einstein showed why - molecules too small to see, striking them at random - and how far they wander says how big the molecules are. Perrin watched, and atoms were real. Unlocks the Brownian Microscope.

research:calculus.desc.text: Infinitesimals, derivatives and integrals - and manifolds, the spaces calculus lives on.

research:cartography.desc.text: A map is a projection: a round planet drawn on a flat sheet, and every projection trades one truth for another. The first study of the Earth sciences. Unlocks the Survey Map.

research:casimir_effect.desc.text: Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

research:category_theory.desc.text: Objects and arrows. Functors between categories, and toposes - universes with their own logic.

research:causal_set_theory.desc.text: Spacetime as a set of events and nothing else but which can affect which. Scatter them at random, and a manifold appears: order plus number gives geometry.

research:causality_violation.desc.text: Closed timelike curves: send something back to before it was made, and now there are two.

research:chemical_bonding.desc.text: Atoms share electrons because a shared wavefunction has lower energy. Unlocks the Chemical Reactor.

research:chronodynamics.desc.text: If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.
