research:climatology.desc.text: What the air holds decides how much of the Sun's heat the world keeps: carbon dioxide traps it, aerosols send it back. Unlocks the Climate Engine.

research:clonal_evolution.desc.text: A tumour is a population, and populations evolve. Every treatment selects the few cells that happen to resist it; they inherit the tumour. Drug resistance is not learned but chosen - by the treatment itself. Unlocks the Resistant Clone Colony.

research:combinatorics.desc.text: Counting without listing: how many orders, how many choices, how fast the numbers grow - so fast that their logarithm is the only way to hold them. Unlocks the Quantum Random Number Chip.

research:compact_stars.desc.text: Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

research:compactification.desc.text: Where are the extra dimensions? Rolled up too small to see. Unlocks the Compactification Lathe.

research:complex_analysis.desc.text: Add the square root of minus one and every polynomial has its roots. Fourier series and fractals follow.

research:component_tiers.desc.text: Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

research:conceptual_singularities.desc.text: Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

research:conformal_cyclic_cosmology.desc.text: At the end of time only massless things remain, and massless things cannot tell an infinite distance from a finite one. Rescale the dead universe and its infinite future becomes the Big Bang of the next aeon. Where Finality ends, Origin begins: make a Universe Seed from the end of a universe.

research:conquered_alpha_omega.desc.text: You understood. It let you go.

research:containment_protocols.desc.text: To study an anomaly you must keep it alive; to keep the world safe you must keep it from spreading. Quarantine is the art of clearing it just faster than it copies itself - R below 1, and not much below. Unlocks the Quarantine Field Matrix.

research:cosmic_eschatology.desc.text: How does a universe end? Its fate is written in what fills it: matter decelerates the expansion, dark energy accelerates it, and the equation of state w decides whether it freezes, rips or collapses. The first study of Finality.

research:cosmic_inflation.desc.text: Why is the universe so flat, so smooth, and the same in every direction - even regions that could never have touched? Because a scalar field, the inflaton, made space grow by e sixty times over in 10^-32 seconds. Unlocks the Inflation Chamber and Inflaton Condensate.

research:cosmic_web.desc.text: On the largest scales the galaxies are not scattered evenly: they lie along filaments and sheets round enormous voids, the shape gravity has pulled the dark matter into since the Big Bang. Unlocks the cosmic web simulation.

research:cosmogenesis.desc.text: False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

research:cpt_symmetry.desc.text: Reverse charge, parity and time together and the laws of physics do not change. Somewhere, then, there is a universe of antimatter. Unlocks the CPT Mirror and the Penning Harness.

research:cryogenics.desc.text: Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

research:crystal_growth_physics.desc.text: Every transistor, laser and lens crystal starts as a seed dipped in its own melt. How fast it is drawn out decides what defects and impurities it keeps. Unlocks the Crystal Growth Furnace and its boules.

research:crystallography.desc.text: A crystal is one pattern of atoms repeated in every direction. X-rays are short enough to be scattered by its planes, and the angles at which they reinforce give the spacing between them. Unlocks the X-ray Diffractometer and the Laue Pattern.

research:cyclotron_physics.desc.text: A charge in a magnetic field circles at a frequency that does not depend on its speed. Kick it at that frequency and it spirals out, faster every turn - until relativity puts it out of step. Unlocks the Cyclotron.

research:dark_energy.desc.text: The energy of empty space itself, pushing galaxies apart.

research:dark_sector.desc.text: Most of the universe's mass does not interact with light. Unlocks the Dark Matter Halo Collector.

research:decay_chains.desc.text: Uranium becomes thorium, then radium, then radon, then polonium and at last lead - fourteen steps, each with its own half-life. Wait long enough and every step runs as fast as the slowest feeds it. Unlocks Radiogenic Lead and Lead Shielding.

research:deep_drilling.desc.text: The deepest hole ever drilled went down 12 km and met rock at 180 °C, softer than expected and full of water. Drilling deep is a fight with heat and pressure. Unlocks the Deep Drilling Rig.

research:directed_evolution.desc.text: A million generations in a minute, if time runs fast enough. Unlocks the Evolution Engine and telomerase.

research:distributions.desc.text: Add up enough small independent chances and their total always spreads into the same bell-shaped curve, whatever the chances were. Unlocks the Normal Distribution Crystal.

research:dyson_sphere.desc.text: Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

research:electrochemistry.desc.text: Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.

research:electrodynamics.desc.text: Maxwell's four equations: charges make electric fields, there are no magnetic charges, changing fields make each other - and so a wave of field can carry itself across empty space, at exactly the speed of light. Unlocks waveguides, Faraday cage mesh, mu-metal and the Hypervelocity Impact Forge.

research:electromagnetic_induction.desc.text: A changing magnetic field drives a current. Spin a coil in a field and you have a generator; laminate the iron core and you stop it heating itself. Unlocks Magnetite and Electrical Steel Laminations.

research:entangled_logistics.desc.text: Two particles, one state - and so one channel. Unlocks Entangled Relays, Transceivers and the Entanglement Tuner.

research:epidemic_dynamics.desc.text: Between hosts, an infection is a reproduction number. Above R = 1 it spreads through a population; below it, it dies out - a phase transition, the same as water freezing or a fluid percolating through porous rock. Unlocks the Contagion Network Map.

research:equivalence_principle.desc.text: Drop a hammer and a feather on the Moon and they land together. Gravity pulls everything with the same acceleration, so in free fall gravity vanishes - Einstein's happiest thought. Unlocks the Proof Mass.

research:er_epr.desc.text: Maldacena and Susskind's conjecture: two entangled particles are joined by a wormhole, too small to pass through. Entanglement is geometry. Unlocks the ER=EPR Weaver.

research:ergodic_theory.desc.text: A system that, given time, passes through every state open to it: averaging over time is then the same as averaging over all states. Unlocks the Markov Chain Refinery and the Ergodic Mixer Core.

research:exoplanetology.desc.text: Most stars have planets. Watch a star's light dip as one crosses in front of it, and the dip gives its size; its spectrum through the planet's air gives what it is made of. Unlocks transit photometry and the assay of exoplanet cores.

research:exotic_chemistry.desc.text: Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

research:extreme_value_theory.desc.text: The largest of many random draws follows its own law - and the rarest events are less rare than a bell curve says. Black swans happen.

research:extremophiles.desc.text: Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

research:femtoengineering.desc.text: Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

research:ferromagnetism.desc.text: In iron, the spins of neighbouring atoms line up of their own accord - until heat shakes them apart above a critical temperature. Unlocks the Ferrite Magnet.

research:field_engineering.desc.text: Gravity, dimension, time and the vacuum are all fields - and fields can be projected. Unlocks the Field Projectors, the Graviton Harness and the Chronal Anchor.

research:formal_logic.desc.text: Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

research:fractional_distillation.desc.text: High-tier processes leave Dimensional Residue. Distil it back into useful matter in the Fractionation Spire.

research:frame_dragging.desc.text: A spinning mass drags spacetime round with it: a gyroscope in orbit round the Earth turns, by forty milliarcseconds a year, for no other reason. Unlocks the Lense-Thirring Vortex Core.

research:fusion_ignition.desc.text: Deuterium and tritium fuse into helium and a neutron, giving 17.6 MeV - if they are hot enough, dense enough, and held long enough. Unlocks the Tokamak, heavy water, deuterium and tritium breeding.

research:galactic_dynamics.desc.text: Map how fast the Galaxy's hydrogen turns at each distance from its centre and the stars alone cannot hold it together: something unseen outweighs them several times over. Unlocks the long galactic survey.

research:gamma_ray_bursts.desc.text: For a few seconds, the brightest light in the Universe: a jet from a newborn black hole at nearly the speed of light, beamed straight at us. Unlocks the Burst Observatory.

research:general_intelligence.desc.text: A mind that can learn anything.

research:general_relativity.desc.text: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

research:genomics.desc.text: Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

research:geodesics.desc.text: In curved spacetime a falling body takes the straightest path there is - a geodesic. Gravity is not a force; it is the shape of the road. Unlocks the Geodesic Compass.

research:geodesy.desc.text: Measure one baseline and two angles and every other distance follows - that is how countries were mapped, triangle by triangle. Geodesy measures the planet itself. Unlocks the Theodolite Lens, the Geoid Model and the Geodetic Surveyor.

research:geometric_optics.desc.text: A lens bends light by the difference in its two curvatures, times how much more slowly light runs in it. Grind the curvatures, polish the error away, and you have an instrument. Unlocks the Optical Workshop and its lenses, plates and gratings.

research:geometric_topology.desc.text: Surfaces with one side and bottles with no inside.

research:geomorphology.desc.text: Landforms are a record: rivers carry grains, the grains settle, and the speed at which they settle sorts sand from silt from clay. Unlocks the Sediment Core.

research:grand_unification.desc.text: At high enough energy, three forces become one.

research:gravitational_lensing.desc.text: Light follows geodesics too: a mass bends the light passing it, twice as much as Newton would say, and a mass exactly between you and a star turns it into a ring. Unlocks the Lensing Concentrator.

research:gravitational_redshift.desc.text: Light climbing out of a gravity well loses energy, so its frequency falls: clocks below run slow seen from above. In 1959 Pound and Rebka measured it up a 22.5-metre tower. Unlocks the Pound-Rebka Tower and the Cobalt-57 Source.

research:gravitational_time_dilation.des.text: A clock lower in a gravity well ticks slower than one above it. Satellite navigation has to correct for it every day, or it would drift kilometres. Unlocks the Atomic Clock.

research:gravitational_waves.desc.text: Masses that accelerate send ripples through spacetime itself, stretching and squeezing everything they cross. The strongest reach us from merging black holes - as a strain of one part in 10²¹. Unlocks the Laser Interferometer and its Test Masses.

research:hawking_radiation.desc.text: Near a horizon the same happens without anyone accelerating: a black hole glows, at a temperature inversely proportional to its mass, and slowly evaporates. Unlocks the Micro Black Hole Evaporator.

research:heat_death.desc.text: The likeliest end of all: endless expansion to maximum entropy. Stars burn out, protons decay, black holes evaporate, and an empty de Sitter space is left, glowing at the temperature of its own horizon. Unlocks the Entropy Horizon.

research:holographic_principle.desc.text: Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

research:horizon_simulation.desc.text: A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.

research:hydrology.desc.text: Water moves through rock as through a sponge, slowly: Darcy's law, flow = permeability × pressure gradient. Under the plains lie aquifers of rain that fell before the last ice age. Unlocks the Aquifer Pump.

research:hyperdimensional_geometry.desc.text: Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

research:hyperdimensional_reality.desc.text: The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

research:immune_evasion.desc.text: To survive, an anomaly must escape everything built to remove it: hide its markers from the immune system, switch telomerase back on and forget how to age, grow its own blood vessels, and finally leave - slip into the blood and seed itself somewhere new. Unlocks the Immortal Cell Line and the Metastatic Spore.

research:incompleteness.desc.text: Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

research:information_paradox.desc.text: If a black hole evaporates into thermal radiation, whatever fell in is lost - and quantum mechanics forbids that. Something must give. Unlocks the Page Curve Analyzer.

research:interstellar_medium.desc.text: Between the stars is not nothing: a few atoms in every cubic centimetre, cold molecular clouds where stars are born, hot ionised bubbles blown by the ones that died, and dust through all of it. Unlocks the Interstellar Scoop.

research:invasion_fronts.desc.text: No anomaly grows alone. It recruits blood vessels and stroma, signals to the cells around it, and invades as a travelling front whose speed is set by how fast it grows and how far it diffuses - the same mathematics as a cellular automaton spreading on a grid. Unlocks the Tumour Microenvironment Organoid.

research:island_of_stability.desc.text: Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

research:isotope_separation.desc.text: Isotopes of one element are chemically the same; only their mass differs, by about one per cent for uranium. Spin them fast enough and that is enough to sort them, a little at a time. Unlocks the Gas Centrifuge Cascade, Yellowcake and Fluorspar.

research:kilonovae.desc.text: When two neutron stars merge, a few hundredths of a solar mass of neutron-rich matter is flung out, and in a second it captures neutrons up to gold and platinum. Its radioactive glow fades over days.

research:laser_physics.desc.text: An excited atom struck by a photon of the right colour gives off a second, identical one. Pump a crystal full of excited atoms between two mirrors and the light builds on itself: one colour, one direction, in step. Unlocks the Laser Rod, Laser Head and Faraday Isolator.

research:leptogenesis.desc.text: Matter and antimatter should have annihilated perfectly. They did not: heavy neutrinos decayed out of equilibrium, unequally to leptons and antileptons, and sphalerons turned the excess into baryons - one in a billion. Unlocks the Baryon Asymmetry Crystal.

research:loop_quantum_gravity.desc.text: Quantise geometry itself: areas and volumes come in discrete steps, carried by a spin network. Space is woven, not continuous. Unlocks the Spin Network Loom.

research:m_theory.desc.text: Strings are the edges of membranes in eleven dimensions.

research:magnetars.desc.text: A star's core collapses to a neutron star and its field is squeezed with it, flux conserved: a thousand times stronger than any magnet made on Earth, a billion times. Starquakes crack its crust.

research:magnetic_confinement.desc.text: A charged particle spirals round a field line and cannot leave it. Twist the lines into a torus and a plasma can be held off every wall. Unlocks the Pulsed Magnet Lab and the Tokamak's coils.

research:magnetic_monopoles.desc.text: Grand unified theories say magnetic charges must exist, made in the first instant - and Dirac showed that one would explain why every electric charge is a whole number of e. The Pulsed Magnet Lab can search for them in magnetar crust.

research:magnetohydrodynamics.desc.text: A conducting fluid in a magnetic field carries the field with it and pushes current through it: the physics of the Sun's surface, of the geodynamo, and of a generator with no moving parts. Unlocks the MHD Generator.

research:magnetostatics.desc.text: A steady current makes a magnetic field that circles the wire and weakens with distance from it. The first study of electromagnetism. Unlocks the Gauss Meter.

research:mantle_geodynamics.desc.text: The mantle is solid rock, and yet it flows: a centimetre a year, heated from below, cooled from above, turning over like a pot on a stove. Its minerals - ringwoodite, bridgmanite - only exist under its pressure.

research:mass_manipulation.desc.text: Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

research:matrioshka_brain.desc.text: Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

research:measure_problem.desc.text: In a universe that lasts forever, everything that can fluctuate into being does, infinitely often - even a lone brain that only thinks it remembers a world. How then to say what is likely? Unlocks the deliberate assembly of a Boltzmann Brain.

research:metamaterials.desc.text: Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.

research:metamorphism.desc.text: Bury a rock and it changes without melting: its minerals regrow as the ones stable at the new pressure and temperature. Every boundary on that map has a slope set by how much the change gains in entropy and loses in volume. Unlocks the Tectonic Press.

research:meteoritics.desc.text: Stones fall from the sky: iron ones from the broken cores of small planets, stony ones that never melted at all since the planets formed. Look for their craters. Unlocks the assay of meteorites.

research:mirror_metallurgy.desc.text: Metals that must never touch anything. Unlocks the Mirror Matter Foundry, anti-metals and the Mirror Alloy.

research:molecular_biology.desc.text: Life is chemistry that copies itself. Unlocks the Bioreactor, Nutrient Broth and the Gene Sampler.

research:monte_carlo_methods.desc.text: When a sum is too hard to do, guess it at random - many times. The scatter of the guesses falls as one over the square root of how many; steer them well and it falls faster. Unlocks the Monte Carlo Engine.

research:morphogenesis.desc.text: How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

research:multiverse.desc.text: Other branes, other constants, other universes - and a way to reach them.

research:nanochemistry.desc.text: Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

research:nanotechnology.desc.text: Assemblers that build anything atom by atom - including copies of themselves.

research:neurobiology.desc.text: Grow a brain in a dish and ask it what it thinks. Unlocks neural organoids.

research:neutrino_physics.desc.text: Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.

research:neutron_interferometry.desc.text: A neutron is a wave too. Split it with a perfect crystal, let gravity pull on one path a little more than the other, and the waves no longer meet in step: gravity, measured on a single quantum particle. Unlocks the Neutron Interferometer and the Silicon Boule.

research:nuclear_astrophysics.desc.text: Stars fuse by tunnelling: their protons are far too cold to touch, but quantum mechanics lets a few through the Coulomb barrier. The Gamow energy sets which ones.

research:nuclear_binding_energy.desc.text: A nucleus weighs less than the protons and neutrons in it. The missing mass is the energy that binds them - millions of times more per atom than any chemical bond. The way into fission and fusion.

research:nuclear_fission.desc.text: A slow neutron splits a uranium-235 nucleus into two lighter ones, freeing 200 MeV and two or three new neutrons. If on average exactly one of them splits another nucleus, the reaction keeps itself going. Unlocks the Molten Salt Reactor.

research:nuclear_isomers.desc.text: Some nuclei can sit in an excited state for years, held there by their spin. Hafnium-178m2 holds 2.4 MeV per nucleus for thirty-one years. Unlocks the Isomer Trigger.

research:nucleosynthesis.desc.text: Every element heavier than helium was made in a star. Iron is where fusion stops; supernovae make the rest.

research:number_systems.desc.text: Zero, and "the next one". From two rules, all of arithmetic. Unlocks the Peano Arithmetic Engine.

research:number_theory.desc.text: Primes, modular forms and the Riemann zeta function - the hardest problems in mathematics are about whole numbers.

research:observational_astronomy.desc.text: Everything known about the sky came through a lens. A bigger mirror gathers more light and splits finer detail - up to the limit that the wave nature of light itself sets. Unlocks the Telescope Mirror Blank.

research:omnilex.desc.text: Understand the Tree and the Ocean well enough to simulate them, and you control both. Unlocks the Omnilex Engine - the final machine.

research:oncogenesis.desc.text: A cancer is not one mistake but several: an oncogene stuck on, a tumour suppressor like p53 lost, a checkpoint skipped - each a mutation that gives one cell an advantage over its neighbours. The hallmarks of cancer are what that cell has learned. Unlocks the Anomalous Strain Culture.

research:page_curve.desc.text: The radiation's entropy rises as a black hole evaporates, then - after the Page time - falls back to zero: the information comes out. Islands inside the horizon, counted as part of the radiation, make it turn over.

research:panspermia.desc.text: Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

research:paradox_engineering.desc.text: Russell sets and Banach-Tarski spheres: building with contradictions.

research:particle_physics.desc.text: Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

research:pathological_objects.desc.text: Mathematics has its monsters too: curves continuous everywhere and smooth nowhere, sets with no size, systems so sensitive that they are deterministic and unpredictable at once, and questions no algorithm can decide. They were never errors - only the parts of the theory that had not been explained yet. Unlocks the Undecidable Kernel.

research:penrose_process.desc.text: Energy can be stolen from a rotating black hole's ergosphere.

research:planetary_geology.desc.text: Every rocky planet sorts itself the same way: iron sinks to a core, rock floats above as mantle and crust. Comparing their cores tells how planets form.

research:plasma_metallurgy.desc.text: Alloys forged in stellar plasma: Chronosteel and Exotic Solder. Unlocks the Stellar Plasma Crucible.

research:plate_tectonics.desc.text: The crust is broken into plates that ride on the hot mantle beneath. Where they part, rock wells up; where they meet, one dives under the other. Unlocks the Core Drill - the first tool that cuts bedrock - and the way into the Planetary Interior.

research:platonic_realm.desc.text: If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.

research:pleroma.desc.text: The fullness of everything: every fluid there is, poured together. Unlocks the Pleroma Confluence.

research:poincare_recurrence.desc.text: A dead universe is not quite dead. In a finite system at equilibrium every state comes back, given time, and fluctuations out of equilibrium happen by pure chance - a star, a planet, a brain. Unlocks the Boltzmann Fluctuation.

research:precision_lithography.desc.text: Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

research:primordial_nucleosynthesis.desc.text: For three minutes the whole universe was a fusion reactor. Neutrons froze out at one in six, decayed a little, and were swept into helium-4: a quarter of all matter, as measured. Unlocks Primordial Nucleosynthesis Ash.

research:probability_theory.desc.text: Chance has rules. Count the ways an outcome can happen, divide by all the ways anything can, and the result is exact even when every single trial is not. Unlocks the Dice Set.

research:protein_folding.desc.text: A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.

research:proton_decay.desc.text: Grand unified theories join quarks and leptons, so even a proton can change into a positron and a pion. Its lifetime is at least 10^34 years - and after the last star, the degenerate era ends when every proton is gone. Unlocks Proton Decay Residue.

research:psionics.desc.text: Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

research:quantum_biology.desc.text: Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.

research:quantum_chemistry.desc.text: Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

research:quantum_cosmology.desc.text: Before inflation, before time: a closed universe can tunnel into existence from no space at all, or begin without a boundary, its time becoming space near the start like the South Pole of a sphere. Quantum cosmology writes the wave function of the whole universe. Unlocks the No-Boundary Seed.

research:quantum_entanglement.desc.text: Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.

research:quantum_field_theory.desc.text: Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

research:quantum_foam.desc.text: Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

research:quantum_foundations.desc.text: Everything is a wave until it is measured. Catalogue phenomena with the Spectral Analyzer to begin.

research:quantum_gravity.desc.text: Gravitons and spin foam: spacetime made of quanta. Unlocks the Graviton Condenser.

research:quantum_hall_effect.desc.text: Electrons in a sheet at low temperature and strong field fill Landau levels; the Hall resistance locks onto plateaus at h/(νe²), exact to a part in a billion - because it counts a topological invariant. Unlocks Hall Bar Chips.

research:radio_astronomy.desc.text: Cold hydrogen, invisible to any telescope, glows at 21 centimetres; dead stars spinning hundreds of times a second pulse in radio. A dish and a cold receiver hear them through cloud and daylight. Unlocks the Radio Telescope and the Cryogenic Receiver.

research:radioactivity.desc.text: Some nuclei are unstable and fall apart on their own, at random, but at a rate fixed for each kind. Half of any sample is gone after its half-life, whatever you do to it. Unlocks Radium Salt, the Geiger Tube and Counter, and the Prussian Blue Tablet.

research:radiochemistry.desc.text: Chemistry done by following radioactivity: a few atoms of a new element are found because they glow. Radium gives off a gas, radon, that decays in days. Unlocks the Decay Chamber.

research:real_analysis.desc.text: Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

research:reality_breach.desc.text: Break every law of physics and mathematics at once, and step through the hole. Unlocks the Axiomatic Breach Engine and the Axiom Key.

research:reheating.desc.text: Inflation leaves space empty and cold. When the inflaton reaches the bottom of its potential it oscillates and decays, and its energy becomes a hot plasma of every particle there is: the hot Big Bang begins here. Unlocks Reheating Plasma.

research:remote_sensing.desc.text: A telescope turned round: from orbit, in visible light and infrared and radar, the whole ground at once. Unlocks the Survey Satellite.

research:research_synthesis.desc.text: Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

research:resonant_circuits.desc.text: A capacitor and a coil pass energy back and forth, electric then magnetic, at one frequency of their own. Two such circuits in tune trade it between them - and one can step the voltage up enormously. Unlocks the Tesla Coil.

research:seismology.desc.text: Earthquakes send two kinds of wave through rock: fast pressure waves and slower shear waves. Time the gap between them and you know how far away the source is; time it at three stations and you know where. Unlocks the Seismograph.

research:self_replication.desc.text: A program that prints itself, a machine that builds itself from a description of itself, a virus, a rumour: every replicator holds a copy of its own instructions. Whether its lineage survives is a branching process - it dies out unless each copy makes more than one more. Unlocks the Quine Replicator.

research:semiclassical_gravity.desc.text: Quantum fields on curved spacetime: what can be said with gravity still classical and everything else quantum. Its two tested predictions - gravity on a quantum wave, and a horizon's glow - point past themselves, to spacetime that is quantum too. Unlocks causal dynamical triangulations in the Monte Carlo Engine.

research:set_theory.desc.text: Everything is a set. Power sets, the continuum, and the axiom of choice.

research:simulation_hypothesis.desc.text: If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

research:singularity_physics.desc.text: Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

research:special_relativity.desc.text: The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

research:spectroscopy.desc.text: Split light by colour and its spectrum tells you what made it: how hot, and which elements, by the dark and bright lines each one leaves. Unlocks the Spectrograph and Spectral Plates.

research:standard_model.desc.text: Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

research:statistical_mechanics.desc.text: Temperature, pressure and entropy are averages over states too many to count: each weighted by e^(−E/kT). Sum the weights and the partition function holds every property of the system.

research:stellar_astrophysics.desc.text: A star's colour gives its surface temperature, and its brightness and temperature together give its size: a star radiates σT⁴ from every square metre. The Sun is the star close enough to use. Unlocks the Solar Furnace and deep-sky exposures.

research:stellar_engineering.desc.text: Ignite a captive star from white-hole ejecta.

research:stellar_evolution.desc.text: Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

research:stellar_transcendence.desc.text: Above stellar-core temperatures, matter stops having fixed properties. Unlocks the Transcendent Plasma Forge.

research:stochastic_processes.desc.text: Chance that unfolds in time: a walk with random steps, a clock with random ticks, a chain whose next state depends only on this one. Unlocks Markov Chain Links, Poisson Clocks and Brownian Suspension.

research:string_theory.desc.text: Every particle is a vibrating string. Unlocks the String Resonance Loom.

research:superacid_chemistry.desc.text: Acids a million million times stronger than sulfuric - strong enough to protonate almost anything.

research:superconductivity.desc.text: Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

research:superintelligence.desc.text: A mind that improves itself. Computronium becomes possible.

research:supersymmetry.desc.text: Every boson has a fermion twin. The lightest of them is dark matter.

research:supramolecular_chemistry.desc.text: Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

research:symbiosis_parasitism.desc.text: Two populations that share a world either compete, prey, or help. A parasite and a symbiont can be the same organism with one interaction coefficient flipped - mitochondria were invaders once. The boundary between anomaly and normality is a sign. Unlocks the Symbiont Culture.

research:synthetic_biology.desc.text: Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

research:tachyonics.desc.text: Hypothetical faster-than-light particles. Their imaginary mass makes them slow down as they gain energy.

research:targeted_therapy.desc.text: Kill the anomaly, spare the normal: CRISPR-written triggers that make only anomalous cells accept apoptosis, CAR-T cells taught to hunt one marker, and dose split into fractions the normal tissue can repair between. Unlocks the Anomaly Resolution Engine, the Apoptosis Trigger and CAR-T Cell Culture.

research:telescope_optics.desc.text: A telescope is a light bucket: its mirror gathers as much more light than your eye as its area is larger, so it records stars hundreds of times fainter. What it cannot beat is the air above it. Unlocks the Reflecting Telescope and the Photographic Plate.

research:temporal_mechanics.desc.text: The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.

research:the_rekindling.desc.text: The Transcendental exists again, and the Core with it - now able to forge what even it could not simply make.

research:the_sundering.desc.text: You told Omnipotence to stop, and it did. From its shards: Omnipotence Dust, the Apeiron Ingot, the Pleroma Crystal, Logos Thread - and the Pleroma Reconstitutor.

research:theory_of_everything.desc.text: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model as one theory.

research:thermodynamics_of_information.d.text: Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

research:tidal_physics.desc.text: Gravity pulls harder on your near side than your far side. Near a small black hole the difference tears anything apart lengthwise - spaghettification.

research:topological_defects.desc.text: When a field cools and must choose between equal vacua, distant regions choose differently - and where they meet, the old symmetry is trapped in a wall, a string or a knot that cannot be smoothed away. Pockets of false vacuum survive the same way. Unlocks the Topological Defect Core.

research:topology.desc.text: Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

research:transfinite_hierarchy.desc.text: Ordinals count past infinity; cardinals measure it. Both have a place of their own - with the objects of higher dimensions. Unlocks the Cantor Key and the Ordinal Recursor.

research:transfinite_mathematics.desc.text: Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

research:transuranic_synthesis.desc.text: Beyond uranium every element is made: a nucleus is fed neutrons until it beta-decays up the table - plutonium, americium, curium, californium. Unlocks Californium-252.

research:traversable_wormholes.desc.text: Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

research:unruh_effect.desc.text: Empty space is empty only for an observer who is not accelerating. Accelerate, and the vacuum fills with a warm glow - at a temperature proportional to the acceleration. Unlocks the Unruh Accelerator.

research:vacuum_decay.desc.text: If our vacuum is only metastable, a bubble of the true vacuum may nucleate somewhere, someday. Its wall sweeps outwards at nearly the speed of light, and inside it the laws of physics are different. There would be no warning. Unlocks the True Vacuum Seed.

research:vacuum_energy_storage.desc.text: Store energy in the difference between two vacua. Unlocks the Energy Cells.

research:vacuum_stability.desc.text: What could stop a universe from starting at all? A vacuum energy a little larger and it would fly apart before stars formed; a Higgs coupling a little smaller and the vacuum would be unstable. Ours sits, by measurement, at the edge: metastable. Unlocks the Metastable Vacuum Lattice.

research:white_holes.desc.text: The time-reverse of a black hole: a horizon nothing can enter.

research:xenobiology.desc.text: Life in other dimensions does not use DNA. Unlocks xenogenome work, Xenoplasm and silicon life.

jei:env_hint.text: Project them with Field Projectors, or build where the dimension already has them.

jei:forge_laws.text: Compile at the rebuilt Core: tune its laws. 3 min re-seed after any forging.

jei:forge_laws_drift.text: Compile at the rebuilt Core. Laws drift after each forging; 3 min re-seed. A Reconstitutor or Eschaton Foundry makes it too.

jei:forge_wait.text: After any forging the Forge waits 3 minutes before it compiles again.

jei:info.entangled_relay.text: Item, fluid and energy transport. Place it against a machine, tank or chest, tune several to one channel with an Entanglement Tuner, and sneak-use with the tuner to switch it between sending and receiving. Moves 256 items, 64,000 mB and 64 M FE per tick, at any distance, even between dimensions. Research: Entangled Logistics.

jei:info.entangled_transceiver.text: The upgraded Entangled Relay: 8,192 items, 4,096,000 mB and 2.1 billion FE per tick, on the same channels. Place it against a machine, tank or chest, tune it with an Entanglement Tuner and sneak-use to switch between sending and receiving.

jei:info.entanglement_tuner.text: Tunes Entangled Relays and Transceivers to one channel (use it on them), and sneak-use switches one between sending and receiving. Everything on a channel moves items, fluids and energy between the blocks they face.

jei:info.pleroma.text: Made in the Pleroma Confluence from 1,000,000 mB of every other fluid (water and lava included).

jei:info.relativity_breakdown.text: Relativity Breakdown is the ceiling of the Quantum Foam. Fill a cell from it - it regenerates at once and never flows. Processed into the concepts of general relativity.

jei:info.schrodinger_limit.text: Schrödinger's Limit is the floor of the Quantum Foam. Fill a cell from it - it regenerates at once and never flows. Processed into the concepts of quantum mechanics.

jei:physics_hint.text: Set the machine's parameters (Controls tab) so these hold.

jei:port_allowed.text: An Interface Port may replace this block

jei:secret_1.text: IRREVERSIBLE - the Omnilex Engine is destroyed

jei:secret_2.text: Needs an overclock that should not exist

jei:secret_3.text: Asks for confirmation before it starts

jei:tier_family.emitter.text: Field Emitter (any tier, lowest one counts):

jei:tier_hint.text: Coils: speed + recipe tier. Emitters: x parallels.

jei:vacuum_note_1.text: Makes ONE of these per run: the particle whose resonance its tuning dial is set closest to. Each particle has a resonance from 0 to 100 that changes from place to place - read them with a Resonance Probe where the harvester stands, then set the dial to the one you want. The closer, the more it yields.

jei:vacuum_slot.text: Set the harvester's dial to this particle's resonance where it stands (read it with a Resonance Probe)

jei:variable_height.text: Variable height: the shown stage layer can be stacked up to %s high.

tooltip:analyzer_usage.text: Use on blocks, machines or creatures. Sneak-use to observe this dimension.

tooltip:anchored_warp_bubble.text: Anchored at %s, %s, %s in %s. Use to return there (spent).

tooltip:assembler_mode_build.text: Mode: build (sneak-use in the air to switch)

tooltip:assembler_mode_disassemble.text: Mode: disassemble (sneak-use in the air to switch)

tooltip:beyond_omnipotence.text: Beyond Omnipotence: the Core cannot materialize it

tooltip:censer_use.text: Use on a creature: afflict it. Use: a cloud where you look. Sneak-use: choose.

tooltip:chronal_accelerator.text: Time runs up to 256x faster for everything in its field. Every extra tick costs energy and Chronon Gas.

tooltip:cluster.text: Condensed singularities. The Omniscience Catalyst asks for these when there are too many singularities to hold.

tooltip:codex_key.text: Press %s for its page in the Quantum Codex

tooltip:codex_lookup.text: In any inventory: hover an item and press %s to look it up

tooltip:codex_sneak.text: Sneak + use: open the Research Tree

tooltip:codex_use.text: Use: open the Codex (start at "Start Here")

tooltip:decor_lag_lens.text: Heavy: bends the light behind it (screen-space lensing). Many in view can lower your frame rate.

tooltip:decor_lag_many.text: Light, but dozens in view at once can lower your frame rate.

tooltip:empty_cell.text: Right-click a Theoretical Sciences fluid, or use on a tank

tooltip:eschaton.dormant.text: DORMANT - recharge with an Eschaton Cell

tooltip:eschaton_cell.use.text: Use: pour it into every endgame item you carry or wear, emptiest first

tooltip:euclidean_anchor.off.text: Switched off: space bends as it likes

tooltip:euclidean_anchor.on.text: Holding space flat: no distortion near impossible structures

tooltip:euclidean_anchor.use.text: Use to switch on or off. Works anywhere in the inventory; spends charge only while it holds space flat.

tooltip:ex_nihilo_engine.text: Infinite FE to every neighbour; charges the items of players within 16 blocks

tooltip:frontier_suit.text: Each piece answers one region of the Accretion Frontier.

tooltip:gas_cell.text: Contained gas. Venting it releases it harmlessly.

tooltip:laplaces_demon.text: Use on a multiblock controller: tunes it to the recipe its inputs match (or hold a recipe's product in your off hand to choose it) - every control, the coolant, containment and drift.

tooltip:lawgivers_codex.target.text: Look at a creature when opening it to rewrite that creature too

tooltip:lawgivers_codex.use.text: Use: rewrite the laws of the dimension you stand in

tooltip:light_sail.text: Use under open sky at y 200+ to sail to the Accretion Frontier; use there to return.

tooltip:magma_proof.text: A full set protects against Basaltic Magma

tooltip:multiblock.text: Multiblock controller - sneak-right-click to diagnose the structure

tooltip:omnilex_dimension.text: Only operates in Hyperdimensional Reality Space

tooltip:omnipotent_edge.harvest.text: What it kills - drops and experience - comes straight to you

tooltip:omnipotent_edge.hit.text: Every cut also unmakes: damage that ignores armour and invulnerability

tooltip:omnipotent_edge.sneak.text: Sneak-use: Chronal Stasis - time stops for every mob within 24 blocks for 10 s

tooltip:omnipotent_edge.use.text: Use: Erasure - hostile creatures in a cone before you cease to exist

tooltip:only_in_dimension.text: Only works in %s - anywhere else it stands idle

tooltip:oracle_lemma.text: Creative only: solves the Alpha Omega trial chamber you stand in

tooltip:pressure_suit.text: A shell of high-pressure minerals. Each piece takes a level off Lithostatic Pressure; a full suit cancels it at any depth.

tooltip:radiation_plating.1.text: Light radiation plating: stops %s%% of the dose

tooltip:radiation_plating.2.text: Medium radiation plating: stops %s%% of the dose

tooltip:radiation_plating.3.text: Heavy radiation plating: stops %s%% of the dose

tooltip:raiment.piece.boots.text: Worn: no fall damage, higher jumps

tooltip:raiment.piece.chestplate.text: Worn: immune to fire; all other harm is halved

tooltip:raiment.piece.helmet.text: Worn: night vision and water breathing

tooltip:raiment.piece.leggings.text: Worn: swifter stride, step up full blocks

tooltip:raiment.set.text: Full Raiment: invulnerable, flight, no hunger, and no dimension's laws can touch you

tooltip:refractory_suit.text: Corundum and moissanite over basalt fibre. A full suit is proof against Basaltic Magma, Deep Brine and every fire.

tooltip:simulated_universe.text: The universe of %s, simulated to completion. Its creative items are forged from it.

tooltip:singularity_scepter.use.text: Use: aim up to 64 blocks. Sneak-use: change mode. Never harms players.

tooltip:specimen_bundle.text: Gathered on the Extreme Assembly Table. JEI shows what goes in.

tooltip:stabiliser.text: %s%% less drift, %sx longer between drift steps, %s%% less wear and damage

tooltip:stabiliser_perfect.text: Perfect: no drift, no wear, no quench, no fault. Completely hands off.

tooltip:stabiliser_use.text: Use on a multiblock controller to install. A better one replaces it (and hands it back).

tooltip:transcendent_cache.text: Holds 243 kinds of item, up to 2,147,483,647 of each. Keeps its contents when broken.

tooltip:warp_bubble_core.text: Use to anchor where you stand - you get an Anchored Warp Bubble that returns you here once.

tooltip:whipple_shield.text: A thin bumper sheet, a gap, and layers of ceramic cloth: a micrometeorite shatters on the bumper and its spray is caught behind. Each piece stops a quarter of the Asteroid Belt's micrometeorites; a full set, all of them.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.c.cool.text: The crucible cannot be held colder than its coolant

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.c.eigen.text: Error catastrophe: the genome cannot persist

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.d.Y.desc.text: Fraction of chains that keep growing.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.d.kh.desc.text: Bonds broken by water per second.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.disturb.text: Temperature swings: the error rate varies by ±10%·d.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.p.Fuv.desc.text: Energy driving the chemistry. Also mutates.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.p.Tr.desc.text: Temperature of the primordial broth. Cannot be colder than the coolant.

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.p.c.desc.text: Concentration of building blocks (wet-dry cycling concentrates them).

physics:abiogenesis_crucible.rate.desc.text: Synthesis rate follows the yield and the energy supply.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.c.blowout.text: Past the Eddington luminosity: the disk's own light has blown it apart

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.d.eta.des.text: The share of the infalling rest energy radiated before matter crosses the innermost stable orbit.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.d.lam.des.text: How close the disk runs to blowing itself apart.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.disturb.text: The feed is clumpy: the accretion rate varies by ±5%·d.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.p.M.desc.text: The mass of the captive black hole.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.p.a.desc.text: How fast the hole turns, from 0 to the 0.998 a disk spins it up to.

physics:accretion_disk_reactor.p.md.desc.text: How fast matter is fed into the disk.

physics:analog_black_hole.c.warm.text: The trap is too warm for a condensate to form

physics:analog_black_hole.d.SNR.desc.text: How clearly the pairs stand out.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.TH.desc.text: The horizon's glow (κ from the flow's rise over a healing length of 1 µm).

physics:analog_black_hole.d.Tb.desc.text: The condensate's own warmth, set by the trap walls.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.cd.desc.text: The thinned condensate carries sound slower.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.cu.desc.text: Speed of sound in the upstream condensate.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.md.desc.text: Above 1: sound is swept away - past the horizon.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.mu.desc.text: Below 1: sound can still travel upstream.

physics:analog_black_hole.d.vd.desc.text: The flow, sped up by the step.

physics:analog_black_hole.disturb.text: Shot-to-shot atom number: the density varies by ±3%·d.

physics:analog_black_hole.p.U.desc.text: How deep the laser step it falls over is.

physics:analog_black_hole.p.n.desc.text: Atoms per volume in the condensate. Denser carries sound faster.

physics:analog_black_hole.p.sh.desc.text: How many condensates are made and imaged, their correlations summed.

physics:analog_black_hole.p.v.desc.text: How fast the condensate flows toward the step.

physics:annihilation_reactor.c.cryo.text: Interlock: magnetic nozzle not superconducting (too warm)

physics:annihilation_reactor.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the magnetic nozzle quench

physics:annihilation_reactor.c.radiation.text: Gamma flux through the shield is melting the structure

physics:annihilation_reactor.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:annihilation_reactor.d.Pel.desc.text: Power converted from the captured pions.

physics:annihilation_reactor.d.Pesc.desc.text: Gamma power getting through the shield.

physics:annihilation_reactor.d.fcap.desc.text: Fraction of charged pions caught by the nozzle.

physics:annihilation_reactor.p.mdot.desc.text: Antimatter annihilated per second (with as much matter).

physics:annihilation_reactor.p.sh.desc.text: Tungsten shielding. Each 20 cm stops 63% of the gamma rays.

physics:annihilation_reactor.rate.desc.text: Generator output follows the captured power.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.c.breac.text: R above 1: the anomaly is spreading through the containment

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.c.dorma.text: The quarantine is so strong the specimen has gone dormant: nothing to study

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.c.overh.text: The quarantine field is overheating the ward

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.d.Re.de.text: How many new anomalous units each one makes before it is cleared. Contained below 1.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.d.act.d.text: How much the specimen does while you watch it: what the study is made of.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.d.be.de.text: The growth rate the drift leaves you with.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.disturb.text: The specimen's growth rate wanders by ±10%·d.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.p.beta..text: How fast the specimen is fed and allowed to copy itself.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.p.q.des.text: How fast the quarantine field clears anomalous units.

physics:anomaly_containment_ward.rate.de.text: A faster-growing specimen held just below R = 1 gives the most to study.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.c.surv.text: The anomaly survives: too many of its clonogens are left

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.c.toxi.text: The dose is destroying the normal tissue around the anomaly

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.d.al.d.text: How sensitive this anomaly is to the dose.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.d.bed..text: The biologically effective dose the normal tissue around the anomaly receives.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.d.lk.d.text: The natural logarithm of the fraction of clonogens killed.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.d.tcp..text: The chance that not one anomalous cell survives.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.distur.text: The anomaly's sensitivity α wanders by ±5%·d.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.p.D.de.text: How hard each fraction hits. Bigger fractions kill more per fraction, and harm normal tissue faster.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.p.n.de.text: How many fractions the dose is split into.

physics:anomaly_resolution_engine.rate.d.text: The surer the resolution, the faster the work goes.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.c.barrie.text: Barrier not shaped: the wall cannot form

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.c.cryo.text: Interlock: barrier-shaping coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the barrier-shaping coils quench

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.c.runawa.text: Bubbles everywhere: the breach spreads beyond the chamber

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.d.Bc.des.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.d.Rc.des.text: Smallest bubble that grows rather than collapses.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.d.lgN.de.text: Expected bubbles nucleated per second in the 1 m³ chamber.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.p.Bb.des.text: Shapes the barrier between the vacua (needs 2 T per TeV³ of tension).

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.p.de.des.text: How much lower the breached vacuum lies.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.p.sig.de.text: Surface tension of the bubble wall.

physics:axiomatic_breach_engine.rate.des.text: The breach runs at a fixed pace.

physics:brownian_microscope.c.boiling.text: The water in the cell is boiling

physics:brownian_microscope.c.frozen.text: The water in the cell has frozen

physics:brownian_microscope.d.Dc.desc.text: How fast a grain spreads out.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.bias.desc.text: How much the uncertainty in each position inflates the result.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.err.desc.text: How well the count of molecules is known.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.eta.desc.text: How thick the water is at this temperature.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.msd.desc.text: How far a grain wanders, squared, between frames.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.res.desc.text: The finest detail the objective resolves.

physics:brownian_microscope.d.stat.desc.text: The scatter of an average over n tracks.

physics:brownian_microscope.disturb.text: Convection in the cell: the drift biases the tracks by ±1%·d.

physics:brownian_microscope.p.NA.desc.text: How wide a cone of light the objective takes in. Higher resolves finer.

physics:brownian_microscope.p.dt.desc.text: Time between the frames the displacement is measured over.

physics:brownian_microscope.p.n.desc.text: How many grains are followed. More tracks, a better average - and a slower count.

physics:brownian_microscope.rate.desc.text: Fewer tracks and shorter intervals are faster.

physics:burst_observatory.d.Pdet.desc.text: The chance of catching at least one.

physics:burst_observatory.d.R.desc.text: Bursts a day above the threshold.

physics:burst_observatory.disturb.text: Background: the noise rate varies by ±20%·d.

physics:burst_observatory.p.Eth.desc.text: The least energy a flash must deposit to count.

physics:burst_observatory.p.t.desc.text: How long it watches before it reports.

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.chronolo.text: Chronology protection: vacuum polarisation diverges at the Cauchy horizon

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.cryo.text: Interlock: mouth-steering coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.ctc.text: No closed timelike curve yet: the lag is shorter than the light time

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.near_hor.text: Close to the chronology horizon: the structure strains

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the mouth-steering coils quench

physics:causality_loop_engine.c.steer.text: Steering field too weak for that turnaround

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.acc.desc.text: Acceleration needed to turn the mouth around.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.gam.desc.text: Time dilation of the travelling mouth.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.lag.desc.text: How much less the travelling mouth has aged.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.loop.des.text: How far back a signal can go: the length of the closed timelike curve.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.ratio.de.text: A time machine exists above 1. Near 1, chronology protection bites.

physics:causality_loop_engine.d.tl.desc.text: Light travel time between the mouths.

physics:causality_loop_engine.disturb.text: Mouth trajectory error: the trip speed is v·(1 ± 0.01%·d).

physics:causality_loop_engine.p.Bm.desc.text: Field that steers the charged mouth.

physics:causality_loop_engine.p.L.desc.text: Distance between the mouths once back.

physics:causality_loop_engine.p.Tt.desc.text: Duration of the round trip in the stay-at-home frame.

physics:causality_loop_engine.rate.desc.text: Loops run at a fixed pace.

physics:climate_engine.c.runaway.text: Runaway warming: the engine's own feedbacks are tearing it apart

physics:climate_engine.d.dF.desc.text: The change in the heat the world keeps.

physics:climate_engine.d.dT.desc.text: How much warmer (or colder) it gets.

physics:climate_engine.p.Cc.desc.text: How much carbon dioxide the engine holds in the air.

physics:climate_engine.p.aer.desc.text: How much sunlight its aerosols reflect.

physics:concept_compressor.c.cryo.text: Interlock: holographic-store coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:concept_compressor.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the holographic-store coils quench

physics:concept_compressor.c.shannon.text: Rate below the entropy: information is destroyed

physics:concept_compressor.c.store.text: Store field too weak for that rate

physics:concept_compressor.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:concept_compressor.d.H.desc.text: Information content of the concept per symbol.

physics:concept_compressor.d.Vd.desc.text: Variance of the information per symbol.

physics:concept_compressor.d.gap.desc.text: How far above the entropy the code runs.

physics:concept_compressor.d.lgPe.desc.text: Chance a block is decoded wrongly.

physics:concept_compressor.d.ratio.desc.text: How much smaller the concept becomes.

physics:concept_compressor.disturb.text: Source drift: the concept's entropy fluctuates by ±1%·d.

physics:concept_compressor.p.Bh.desc.text: Field of the holographic store (needs 5 T per bit of rate).

physics:concept_compressor.p.R.desc.text: Bits written per source symbol. Compression ratio is 1/R.

physics:concept_compressor.p.n.desc.text: Symbols coded together. Longer blocks, fewer errors, slower.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.c.boil.text: The melt is so hot it attacks the crucible and boils off

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.c.crucibl.text: The iridium crucible softens above 2,800 K

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.c.frozen.text: The melt has frozen: the heaters are below its melting point

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.G.desc.text: How steeply the temperature falls across the growth front.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.bl.desc.text: The melt layer at the front that rejected impurities pile up in.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.dT.desc.text: How far above its melting point the melt is held.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.ke.desc.text: How readily the crystal takes in the impurity, compared with the melt.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.pur.des.text: The boule's purity, from a feed 98% pure.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.d.xi.desc.text: Near 3 the crystal grows free of point defects.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.disturb.text: Convection in the melt: the superheat varies by ±2%·d.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.p.Th.desc.text: Temperature of the heaters round the crucible.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.p.v.desc.text: How fast the seed and the growing crystal are drawn up.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.p.w.desc.text: How fast the crystal turns. Stirring thins the layer of melt the impurities pile up in.

physics:crystal_growth_furnace.rate.desc.text: The faster it is pulled, the sooner the boule is done.

physics:cyclotron.c.phase.text: The beam has slipped out of phase with the RF

physics:cyclotron.c.target.text: The target is melting under the beam

physics:cyclotron.d.Be.desc.text: The field the protons actually see.

physics:cyclotron.d.E.desc.text: Energy at the extraction radius, R = 0.75 m.

physics:cyclotron.d.N.desc.text: Turns taken to reach it, at 50 kV across the gap.

physics:cyclotron.d.Pb.desc.text: Power the beam drops into the target.

physics:cyclotron.d.fc.desc.text: How often a proton circles, at low energy.

physics:cyclotron.d.slip.desc.text: How far out of step the beam has fallen.

physics:cyclotron.p.B.desc.text: Field between the pole pieces. Iron saturates above about 2.2 T.

physics:cyclotron.p.I.desc.text: Protons per second. More current, more yield - and more heat in the target.

physics:cyclotron.p.frf.desc.text: Frequency of the voltage on the dees. It must match the protons' cyclotron frequency.

physics:cyclotron.rate.desc.text: More current makes the isotope faster.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.c.pullin.text: Casimir pull-in: the plates snap together

physics:dark_energy_siphon.c.thermal.text: Thermal photons swamp the vacuum signal: cool the plates

physics:dark_energy_siphon.d.grad.desc.text: How fast the force grows as the gap closes. Must stay below the plate stiffness.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.d.lamT.desc.text: Above this gap thermal photons dominate the force, not the vacuum.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.d.lgu.desc.text: Compared with the dark energy density of the universe, ρ_Λ ≈ 6×10⁻¹⁰ J/m³.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.d.u.desc.text: Magnitude of the (negative) energy density in the gap.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.disturb.text: Plate parallelism error: the effective gap is a·(1 + 0.5%·d).

physics:dark_energy_siphon.p.f.desc.text: Plates are cycled open and shut to harvest energy each stroke.

physics:dark_energy_siphon.p.ks.desc.text: Spring constant of the plate suspension. The Casimir force must not pull the plates in.

physics:dark_matter_collector.c.cryo.text: Interlock: veto-shield magnet not superconducting (too warm)

physics:dark_matter_collector.c.kinemati.text: Threshold above the maximum recoil: nothing can be seen

physics:dark_matter_collector.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the veto-shield magnet quench

physics:dark_matter_collector.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:dark_matter_collector.d.E0.desc.text: Scale of the exponential recoil spectrum.

physics:dark_matter_collector.d.Emax.des.text: Largest recoil a WIMP can give.

physics:dark_matter_collector.d.mu.desc.text: Sets how much energy can be transferred.

physics:dark_matter_collector.p.A.desc.text: Nucleus used as target (O = 16, Ar = 40, Ge = 73, Xe = 131).

physics:deep_drilling_rig.c.bit.text: The diamond cutters are burning (above 700 K)

physics:deep_drilling_rig.c.buckle.text: The drill string is buckling under the weight

physics:deep_drilling_rig.c.kick.text: Kick: formation fluid is flowing into the well

physics:deep_drilling_rig.c.losses.text: Lost circulation: the mud is fracturing the rock

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.Pf.desc.text: Pressure at which the rock splits open.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.Pm.desc.text: Pressure the mud column puts on the bottom of the well.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.Pp.desc.text: Pressure of the water in the rock's pores.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.ROP.desc.text: How fast the bit cuts. Overbalanced mud holds the chips down and slows it.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.Tb.desc.text: The cutters' temperature: the rock's heat plus friction.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.d.Tz.desc.text: Temperature of the rock at the bit.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.disturb.text: Overpressured pockets: the pore pressure varies by ±3%·d.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.p.W.desc.text: How much of the drill string's weight rests on the bit.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.p.rm.desc.text: Density of the drilling mud that fills the well.

physics:deep_drilling_rig.rate.desc.text: The faster it cuts, the faster cores come up.

physics:dyson_array.c.carnot.text: Heat sink as hot as the collectors: no engine can run

physics:dyson_array.d.Pu.desc.text: Electric power per square metre of swarm.

physics:dyson_array.d.Teq.desc.text: Equilibrium temperature of a collector at this distance.

physics:dyson_array.d.eta.desc.text: Efficiency of the heat engines between the collectors and your coolant.

physics:dyson_array.disturb.text: Stellar flare activity: collector temperature varies by ±1%·d.

physics:dyson_array.p.cov.desc.text: Fraction of collectors facing the star.

physics:dyson_array.p.r.desc.text: Distance of the collector swarm from the star.

physics:dyson_array.rate.desc.text: Generator output follows the useful flux.

physics:entropy_horizon.c.hot.text: The horizon is too small and too hot: the containment is boiling

physics:entropy_horizon.c.young.text: Too young: the stars are still burning and the protons have not decayed

physics:entropy_horizon.d.He.desc.text: The expansion rate the drift leaves you with.

physics:entropy_horizon.d.Rh.desc.text: How far away the horizon is.

physics:entropy_horizon.d.Sleft.desc.text: How close the simulated universe is to maximum entropy.

physics:entropy_horizon.d.Tgh.desc.text: The faint thermal glow of the cosmic horizon.

physics:entropy_horizon.p.Hs.desc.text: How fast the simulated space expands. A faster expansion means a smaller, hotter horizon.

physics:entropy_horizon.p.age.desc.text: How far the simulation is run. Protons decay near 10³⁴ years, black holes evaporate by 10¹⁰⁰.

physics:entropy_horizon.rate.desc.text: The further towards maximum entropy, the faster the ember and the haze come off.

physics:er_epr_weaver.d.Fd.desc.text: How well the pairs stay entangled.

physics:er_epr_weaver.disturb.text: Path noise: the coherence length varies by ±5%·d.

physics:er_epr_weaver.p.L.desc.text: How far apart the two ends are taken.

physics:er_epr_weaver.p.Np.desc.text: How many entangled pairs a second it makes.

physics:eschaton_foundry.c.collapse.text: The forging volume is collapsing behind its own horizon

physics:eschaton_foundry.d.E.desc.text: The energy actually in the volume.

physics:eschaton_foundry.d.R.desc.text: The radius of the forging volume.

physics:eschaton_foundry.d.Rs.desc.text: Squeezed inside this, the energy is a black hole.

physics:eschaton_foundry.d.lgS.desc.text: The most information the volume can hold, as a power of ten bits.

physics:eschaton_foundry.d.x.desc.text: How far outside its own horizon the forging is. It must stay above 1.

physics:eschaton_foundry.disturb.text: The vacuum fluctuates: the energy actually held varies by ±2%·d.

physics:eschaton_foundry.p.lgE.desc.text: The energy poured into the forging volume, as a power of ten joules.

physics:eschaton_foundry.p.lgR.desc.text: The radius it is held in, as a power of ten metres.

physics:eschaton_foundry.rate.desc.text: The more room the bound leaves above what the forging needs, the faster it goes.

physics:essence_distillery.c.weak.text: The fluids do not separate (S below 0.2): bring the column to their boiling point

physics:essence_distillery.d.Qd.desc.text: Heat into the column; all of it leaves through the coolant.

physics:essence_distillery.d.S.desc.text: How cleanly the fluids part (1 is perfect).

physics:essence_distillery.d.Tb.desc.text: Where the blend of fluids boils right now.

physics:essence_distillery.disturb.text: The mixture's boiling point wanders by ±15%·d.

physics:essence_distillery.p.Rr.desc.text: Liquid sent back down the column per unit drawn off.

physics:essence_distillery.p.Tc.desc.text: Temperature the reboiler holds the column at. Bring it to the mixture's boiling point.

physics:essence_distillery.rate.desc.text: The cleaner the separation, the faster the Essence comes off.

physics:evolution_engine.c.drift.text: Drift dominates: selection is blind at this population size

physics:evolution_engine.d.Pfix.desc.text: Chance a new beneficial mutation takes over (Kimura).

physics:evolution_engine.p.lgN.desc.text: Number of organisms, as a power of ten.

physics:evolution_engine.p.s.desc.text: Fitness advantage of the selected trait.

physics:evolution_engine.rate.desc.text: Evolution proceeds as fast as adaptations fix.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.c.censor.text: a² + Q² > M²: naked singularity - cosmic censorship violated

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.c.charge_hold.text: Charge not held: field too weak

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.c.cryo.text: Interlock: charge-confinement coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the charge-confinement coils quench

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.d.disc.desc.text: Must stay positive: otherwise there is no horizon and the singularity is naked.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.d.eisco.desc.text: Fraction of rest mass radiated by matter spiralling down to the ISCO: 5.7% (a = 0) to 42% (a = 1).

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.d.ks.desc.text: Surface gravity; zero for an extremal hole.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.disturb.text: Frame-dragging noise: the effective spin is a + 0.002·d.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.p.Bf.desc.text: Holds the charge in place (needs 100 T per unit Q/M).

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.p.aS.desc.text: Angular momentum per unit mass (G = c = 1).

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.p.lgM.desc.text: Mass of the simulated hole in solar masses, as a power of ten.

physics:eye_of_the_horizon.rate.desc.text: Simulations run at a fixed pace.

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.c.cryo.text: Interlock: magnetic-tweezer coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.c.photo.text: Photodamage: the light is breaking the parts

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.c.quenc.text: Field above the critical field: the magnetic-tweezer coils quench

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.d.Bc.de.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.d.dmg.d.text: Above 1, ultraviolet light breaks bonds in the parts.

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.d.sig.d.text: Thermal position noise of a trapped part.

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.disturb.text: Laser pointing noise: stiffness varies by ±3%·d.

physics:femtoscale_assembly_line.p.lam.d.text: Shorter wavelength traps harder (κ ∝ λ⁻³) but damages more.

physics:fractionation_spire.c.condense.text: Condenser too warm: the light fraction will not condense

physics:fractionation_spire.c.pinch.text: Reflux below the Underwood minimum: the column pinches

physics:fractionation_spire.c.stages.text: Not enough trays for that purity at this reflux

physics:fractionation_spire.d.Nreq.desc.text: Trays needed at this reflux (Eduljee's fit).

physics:fractionation_spire.d.Rmin.desc.text: Reflux needed with infinitely many trays.

physics:fractionation_spire.p.Qr.desc.text: Heat driving the column. All of it leaves through the condenser into the coolant.

physics:fractionation_spire.p.Rr.desc.text: Liquid returned to the column per unit of product.

physics:fractionation_spire.p.xD.desc.text: Target mole fraction of the light component in the product.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.c.burst.text: Rotor stress above what carbon fibre safely holds

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.c.freeze.text: Uranium hexafluoride freezing onto the rotor walls

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.c.resonan.text: The rotors are sitting on a flexural resonance

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.Rf.desc.text: U-235 to U-238 in the feed.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.Tg.desc.text: The gas runs a little warmer than the coolant.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.al.desc.text: How much richer in the light isotope the axis is than the wall.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.be.desc.text: What one stage multiplies the isotope ratio by.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.n.desc.text: Stage layers built in the tower.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.sig.des.text: Stress in the carbon-fibre rotor wall.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.ve.desc.text: The speed the rotors actually run at.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.d.xP.desc.text: Fraction of U-235 in the product.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.disturb.text: Rotor imbalance: the speed wanders by ±1%·d.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.p.th.desc.text: The fraction of each stage's feed passed up as product. A small cut enriches more, a large one is faster.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.p.v.desc.text: How fast the rotor wall moves. The separation grows with v², and so does the stress in the rotor.

physics:gas_centrifuge_cascade.rate.desc.text: A bigger cut, and a taller tower, pass more product.

physics:hypervelocity_impact_forge.c.ero.text: The rails are eroding under the arc

physics:hypervelocity_impact_forge.d.P.d.text: The shock pressure in the target (ρ = 8 g/cm³).

physics:hypervelocity_impact_forge.d.v.d.text: How fast it leaves the rails.

physics:hypervelocity_impact_forge.distu.text: Rail contact: the force varies by ±3%·d.

physics:inflation_chamber.c.cold.text: Reheating too weak: the universe stays cold and empty

physics:inflation_chamber.c.eternal.text: Eternal inflation: quantum jumps outrun the roll and the bubble never reheats

physics:inflation_chamber.c.noinfl.text: No inflation: the field is too low on its potential (ε above 1)

physics:inflation_chamber.c.short.text: Too few e-folds: the bubble comes out curved and lumpy

physics:inflation_chamber.d.Nf.desc.text: How many times space grows by e. About 60 solve the horizon and flatness problems.

physics:inflation_chamber.d.Trh.desc.text: How hot the universe is when inflation ends.

physics:inflation_chamber.d.phe.desc.text: The starting field the fluctuations leave you with.

physics:inflation_chamber.disturb.text: Quantum fluctuations kick the starting field by ±3%·d.

physics:inflation_chamber.p.Gam.desc.text: How quickly the inflaton decays into particles once it reaches the bottom.

physics:inflation_chamber.p.phi.desc.text: Where on its potential the inflaton starts. Higher means more e-folds.

physics:inflation_chamber.rate.desc.text: More e-folds and a hotter reheating make the work go faster.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.c.hoop.text: Hoop conjecture not met: the pulse is not focused inside its own Schwarzschild radius

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.M0d.desc.text: Mass-energy of the pulse: the mass of the hole it forms.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.PH.desc.text: Power radiated. Grows as 1/M²: smaller holes burn brighter.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.TH.desc.text: Temperature of the hole's thermal radiation.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.lgM.desc.text: Mass of the captive black hole, as a power of ten.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.life.desc.text: How long the hole would last with nothing fed in.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.mdeq.desc.text: Feed rate that exactly balances evaporation at the present mass. The balance is unstable: below it the hole shrinks ever faster.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.d.rs0.desc.text: The pulse must be focused inside this radius to collapse.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.disturb.text: Feed-coupling efficiency drifts: only ṁ·(1 + 5%·d) actually falls in.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.p.Eg.desc.text: Energy per photon. Shorter wavelength = smaller focal spot (λ = 1.24×10⁻¹⁵ m·GeV / E).

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.p.NA.desc.text: How steeply the beams converge. The diffraction-limited spot is λ/(2·NA).

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.p.lgE.desc.text: Total energy of the converging laser pulse, as a power of ten. E/c² is the mass of the black hole it forms.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.p.mdot.desc.text: Mass fed into the hole. At equilibrium it equals the Hawking mass loss.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.rate.desc.text: The chamber works at a fixed pace once the hole is in range.

physics:kugelblitz_chamber.s.M.desc.text: Mass of the captive hole: dM/dt = ṁ − P_H/c². Below 10⁶ kg it dies in a final burst; above 10¹³ kg it outgrows the chamber.

physics:laser_interferometer.c.lock.text: The ground shakes too hard: the arms cannot hold lock

physics:laser_interferometer.d.SNR.desc.text: How far the wave stands above the noise.

physics:laser_interferometer.d.hg.desc.text: The ground's shaking, after the isolation stages. Machines nearby make it worse; below sea level it is quieter.

physics:laser_interferometer.d.hr.desc.text: Random kicks of photons on the test masses.

physics:laser_interferometer.d.ht.desc.text: Brownian jiggling of the mirrors and their fibres.

physics:laser_interferometer.d.x.desc.text: What both quantum noises depend on.

physics:laser_interferometer.p.F.desc.text: How many times the light bounces along each arm before it returns: the arm is that much longer in effect.

physics:laser_interferometer.p.P.desc.text: Light circulating from the laser. More beats shot noise - and kicks the mirrors harder.

physics:laser_interferometer.p.ns.desc.text: Pendulums and springs between the ground and each test mass. Each cuts the shaking tenfold - and makes the mirrors slower to lock.

physics:laser_interferometer.rate.desc.text: A clearer detection is faster; every isolation stage makes locking slower.

physics:lensing_concentrator.c.day.text: No starlight to focus: it is daytime

physics:lensing_concentrator.c.roof.text: Its lenses cannot see the sky

physics:lensing_concentrator.d.A.desc.text: How much brighter the star appears.

physics:lensing_concentrator.d.ue.desc.text: The alignment, blurred by the aim.

physics:lensing_concentrator.p.Dl.desc.text: How far away the lens is (the star is at 8 kpc).

physics:lensing_concentrator.p.Ml.desc.text: The mass that does the focusing.

physics:lensing_concentrator.p.u.desc.text: How far the star is from exactly behind the lens, in Einstein radii.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.d.pA.desc.text: Share of the time the feed spends in vat A.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.d.pB.desc.text: Share of the time in vat B.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.d.pC.desc.text: Share of the time in vat C.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.d.pe.desc.text: The chance the worn valve actually gives.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.disturb.text: Valve wear: the A → B chance varies by ±5%·d.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.p.p.desc.text: Chance per step that feed in vat A moves on to B.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.p.q.desc.text: Chance per step that feed in vat B moves on to C.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.p.r.desc.text: Chance per step that feed in vat C moves back to A.

physics:markov_chain_refinery.rate.desc.text: The slowest hop sets how fast it mixes.

physics:matrioshka_brain.d.T1.desc.text: Equilibrium temperature of the innermost shell.

physics:matrioshka_brain.d.Tout.desc.text: Temperature of the outermost shell; it cannot be colder than the coolant.

physics:matrioshka_brain.d.eta.desc.text: Fraction of the starlight that can do work.

physics:matrioshka_brain.d.lgops.desc.text: Irreversible bit operations per second at the Landauer limit.

physics:matrioshka_brain.disturb.text: Stellar luminosity variation: the inner shell runs at T·(1 ± 1%·d).

physics:matrioshka_brain.p.Nsh.desc.text: Each shell runs on the heat of the one inside it.

physics:matrioshka_brain.p.fd.desc.text: Fraction of the starlight captured and used.
