physics:matrioshka_brain.rate.desc.text: Computation rate follows the usable power.

physics:mhd_generator.c.arc.text: Electrode arcing: current density above 100 A/cm²

physics:mhd_generator.c.pumps.text: The pumps cannot drive the flow that fast

physics:mhd_generator.d.p.desc.text: Electrical power per cubic metre of channel.

physics:mhd_generator.d.q.desc.text: What the pumps must drive the fluid against.

physics:mhd_generator.disturb.text: Magnet supply ripple: the field varies by ±1%·d.

physics:mhd_generator.p.B.desc.text: Field across the channel. Iron-cored magnets saturate near 2 T.

physics:mhd_generator.p.k.desc.text: The fraction of the open-circuit voltage the load takes.

physics:mhd_generator.p.u.desc.text: How fast the fluid is driven through the channel.

physics:mhd_generator.rate.desc.text: Power output follows the electric power.

physics:micro_black_hole_evaporator.c.ev.text: The hole is shrinking faster than it is fed - it is running away

physics:micro_black_hole_evaporator.c.ga.text: Its radiation is too hot for the shield

physics:micro_black_hole_evaporator.c.sw.text: The hole is growing into its own feed

physics:micro_black_hole_evaporator.p.fd.text: Mass fed in, as a fraction of what it radiates away.

physics:mirror_foundry.c.brillouin.text: Positron plasma above the Brillouin limit

physics:mirror_foundry.c.cryo.text: Interlock: Penning-trap solenoid not superconducting (too warm)

physics:mirror_foundry.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the Penning-trap solenoid quench

physics:mirror_foundry.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:mirror_foundry.d.Tpool.desc.text: Temperature reached by the levitated anti-ore.

physics:mirror_foundry.d.lgBr.desc.text: Highest density the field can hold.

physics:mirror_foundry.d.lgrec.desc.text: Three-body antihydrogen formation rate per antiproton.

physics:mirror_foundry.disturb.text: Positron heating: the plasma runs at T·(1 + 10%·|d|).

physics:mirror_foundry.p.B.desc.text: Axial magnetic field of the trap.

physics:mirror_foundry.p.Prf.desc.text: Induction power melting the levitated anti-ore.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.c.flow.text: No salt flow: the heat has nowhere to go

physics:molten_salt_reactor.c.freeze.text: The fuel salt is freezing (below 732 K): the freeze plug has drained the core

physics:molten_salt_reactor.c.prompt.text: Prompt critical: reactivity above the delayed-neutron fraction

physics:molten_salt_reactor.c.vessel.text: Above 980 K the Hastelloy-N vessel creeps

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.Pth.desc.text: Heat carried out of the core by the salt.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.Ts.desc.text: Where the temperature feedback brings k to exactly 1.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.eta.desc.text: How much of it the turbine turns into work.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.f.desc.text: Fraction of slowed neutrons the fuel absorbs.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.k0.desc.text: With leakage (20%) and the rods (worth up to half).

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.kinf.desc.text: Neutrons per neutron in an endless core: η = 2.07, p = 0.92, ε = 1.02.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.d.rho.desc.text: How far from critical, in per cent mille.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.disturb.text: Xenon and burn-up: reactivity drifts by ±0.2%·d.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.p.Q.desc.text: How fast the salt is pumped through the core and the heat exchanger.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.p.c.desc.text: How much uranium is dissolved in the salt.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.p.r.desc.text: How far the boron rods are pushed into the core.

physics:molten_salt_reactor.rate.desc.text: Power output follows the electric power.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.d.Pl.desc.text: The heat of the bits erased, at the cores' temperature.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.d.err.desc.text: How far the answer may be off, in parts per million.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.d.sv.desc.text: The spread of the steered samples.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.disturb.text: Correlations in the random stream: the error grows by up to 10%·d.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.p.lgN.desc.text: How many samples are drawn: 10 to this power.

physics:monte_carlo_engine.p.s.desc.text: How strongly the samples are steered. Best near the problem's own optimum.

physics:multiverse_rift.c.flat.text: Brane mistuned: it inflates or crunches

physics:multiverse_rift.d.Lam.desc.text: The effective Planck scale on our brane.

physics:multiverse_rift.d.m1.desc.text: Mass of the first Kaluza-Klein graviton.

physics:multiverse_rift.d.w.desc.text: Suppression of every energy on our brane.

physics:multiverse_rift.disturb.text: Tension drift: the residual vacuum energy is δ + 0.002·d. Re-tune δ to cancel it.

physics:multiverse_rift.p.dl.desc.text: Detuning of the brane tension from the Randall-Sundrum value.

physics:multiverse_rift.p.k.desc.text: AdS curvature of the bulk, in Planck units.

physics:multiverse_rift.rate.desc.text: The rift is harvested at a fixed pace.

physics:neutron_interferometer.d.fr.desc.text: 1 on a bright fringe, −1 on a dark one.

physics:neutron_interferometer.d.phi.des.text: The phase gravity puts between the paths (A = 10 cm²).

physics:neutron_interferometer.d.sp.desc.text: How well the counts fix the phase (40 neutrons a minute).

physics:neutron_interferometer.disturb.text: Thermal bending of the crystal: the phase drifts by ±0.05 rad·d.

physics:neutron_interferometer.p.al.desc.text: How far the plane of the two paths is tilted from the horizontal.

physics:neutron_interferometer.p.lam.des.text: Set by the velocity selector: slower neutrons, longer waves.

physics:neutron_interferometer.p.t.desc.text: How long the neutrons are counted at this setting.

physics:neutron_star_forge.c.buchdahl.text: Buchdahl limit exceeded: no static star is possible

physics:neutron_star_forge.c.cryo.text: Interlock: flux-compression coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:neutron_star_forge.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the flux-compression coils quench

physics:neutron_star_forge.c.tov.text: Above the TOV mass: collapse into a black hole

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.Cc.desc.text: Buchdahl: no static star can have C above 8/9.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.fK.desc.text: Spinning faster than this flings the equator off.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.lgB.desc.text: Field after flux compression from a 300 000 km core. Magnetars exceed 10¹⁴ G.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.lgrho.desc.text: Neutron drip at 14.6; nuclear density at 17.4; deconfinement above ~18.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.rho.desc.text: Density from non-relativistic neutron degeneracy pressure.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.rs.desc.text: Radius at which it would become a black hole.

physics:neutron_star_forge.d.z.desc.text: Gravitational redshift of light from the surface.

physics:neutron_star_forge.p.Bcoil.desc.text: Field of the coils before flux compression amplifies it into the star.

physics:neutron_star_forge.p.lgp.desc.text: Central pressure applied, as a power of ten.

physics:neutron_star_forge.rate.desc.text: Compression proceeds at a fixed pace.

physics:nuclide_forge.c.barrier.text: Below the Coulomb barrier: nothing fuses

physics:nuclide_forge.c.cryo.text: Interlock: focusing solenoids not superconducting (too warm)

physics:nuclide_forge.c.focus.text: Solenoids too weak to focus the beam

physics:nuclide_forge.c.nb_quench.text: Cavity quench: the niobium went normal

physics:nuclide_forge.c.phase.text: Phase at the crest: no phase focusing, the bunch spreads out

physics:nuclide_forge.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the focusing solenoids quench

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Elab.desc.text: Kinetic energy of the ions leaving the linac.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Estar.desc.text: How hot the compound nucleus is born. Too cold and it never formed; too hot and it fissions before it cools.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Pb.desc.text: Beam power deposited in the target.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Pcav.desc.text: Heat dissipated in the niobium cavity walls. BCS surface resistance falls exponentially with temperature: 2 K costs a fraction of 4 K.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.VC.desc.text: Electrostatic repulsion the nuclei must overcome to touch.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.Vf.desc.text: Voltage actually delivered, with the drifting detuning.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.brho.desc.text: How hard the ions are to bend or focus.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.fsol.desc.text: Focal length of each 0.5 m solenoid.

physics:nuclide_forge.d.tr.desc.text: Fraction of the beam inside the RF bucket (phase acceptance).

physics:nuclide_forge.d.xs.desc.text: How likely a fusion-evaporation event is, relative to its best.

physics:nuclide_forge.disturb.text: Cavity field drift (microphonics, Lorentz detuning): every cavity gives V·(1 ± 1%·d).

physics:nuclide_forge.p.Bs.desc.text: Field of the focusing solenoids between cavities.

physics:nuclide_forge.p.I.desc.text: Particle current on target. More ions, more fusions - and more target heating.

physics:nuclide_forge.p.V.desc.text: Accelerating voltage of each of the 40 cavities.

physics:nuclide_forge.p.phi.desc.text: RF phase the ions ride on. Closer to 0° gives more energy; negative phases are needed for longitudinal (phase) focusing.

physics:nuclide_forge.p.qi.desc.text: Charge state after the stripper foil. Energy gain is q·V per cavity.

physics:nuclide_forge.rate.desc.text: Fusions per second: beam intensity × transmission × cross-section.

physics:omnilex_engine.c.range.text: r above 4: the map leaves the unit interval

physics:omnilex_engine.c.sync.text: Laws not synchronised: the lattice tears into incoherent regions

physics:omnilex_engine.d.esync.desc.text: Coupling needed to synchronise the lattice.

physics:omnilex_engine.d.lam.desc.text: Rate at which nearby histories diverge. Positive means chaos.

physics:omnilex_engine.p.eps.desc.text: How strongly neighbouring laws are coupled.

physics:omnilex_engine.rate.desc.text: Simulations run at a fixed pace.

physics:optical_workshop.d.Pw.desc.text: In dioptres: one over the focal length in metres.

physics:optical_workshop.d.S.desc.text: Peak brightness of a star's image against a perfect lens.

physics:optical_workshop.d.e.desc.text: How far the surface is from its ideal shape.

physics:optical_workshop.d.f.desc.text: Where it brings parallel light to a point.

physics:optical_workshop.disturb.text: Temperature of the shop: the glass expands, and the power drifts by ±0.2%·d.

physics:optical_workshop.p.C1.desc.text: One over the radius of the first surface.

physics:optical_workshop.p.C2.desc.text: One over the radius of the second surface.

physics:optical_workshop.p.tp.desc.text: How long the surface is polished. Longer is truer - and slower.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.c.cryo.text: Interlock: horizon-threading coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:penrose_ergosphere.c.ergo.text: Outside the ergosphere: no negative-energy orbits exist

physics:penrose_ergosphere.c.horizon.text: Splitting point inside the horizon: nothing comes back

physics:penrose_ergosphere.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the horizon-threading coils quench

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.Pbz.desc.text: Power extracted magnetically from the spin.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.Pp.desc.text: Power extracted by the Penrose process.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.eta.desc.text: Extracted energy per unit rest mass: best deep in the ergosphere.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.etamax.desc.text: Best possible Penrose efficiency for this spin; 20.7% for an extremal hole.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.d.rp.desc.text: Event horizon radius of a Kerr hole of spin a.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.disturb.text: Accretion torque noise: the spin-up torque varies by ±20%·d.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.p.Bh.desc.text: Field threading the horizon: also extracts spin as Blandford-Znajek power.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.p.rinj.desc.text: Where the infalling matter is split, in units of the hole's mass (G = c = 1). Must be inside the ergosphere (r < 2M) and outside the horizon.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.p.tau.desc.text: Prograde matter fed at the inner orbit to spin the hole back up.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.rate.desc.text: Generator output scales with the extracted power.

physics:penrose_ergosphere.s.a.desc.text: Dimensionless spin. Extraction spins it down; the torque spins it up. At 0.998 (Thorne's limit) the horizon is close to tearing.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.c.flood.text: More than 20 GW of drive is not being absorbed: the throat overheats

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.c.hold.text: Throat field too weak to hold the Echo

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.c.tear.text: Field above 70 T: the throat is tearing

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.A.desc.text: How much of the drive the Echo answers (1 on resonance).

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.B.desc.text: Field the Logos coils hold in the throat.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.Pe.desc.text: Power going into rebuilding the Transcendental.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.Pw.desc.text: Drive the Echo does not take: it heats the throat.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.Q.desc.text: How sharply the Echo resonates. Disturbance broadens it.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.U.desc.text: Energy stored in the throat field (5 m³).

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.f0.desc.text: Where the Echo actually rings right now.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.d.x.desc.text: Relative distance of the drive from the Echo.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.disturb.text: The Echo drifts: its quality factor falls to Q₀/(1 + |d|) and its frequency wanders by 0.01%·d.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.p.I.desc.text: Current through the Logos coils. Sets the field in the throat: B = 0.8·I.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.p.f.desc.text: Frequency at which the pump drives the throat. Tune it onto the Echo.

physics:pleroma_reconstitutor.rate.desc.text: The Transcendental rebuilds as fast as the Echo absorbs power.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.H.desc.text: How far the gamma rays climb.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.mis.desc.text: How far the setting is from cancelling the shift.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.sg.desc.text: The line is 190 µm/s wide; 30,000 counts a minute.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.sh.desc.text: How much frequency the gamma rays lose.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.vg.desc.text: The source speed whose Doppler shift makes up the loss.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.vt.desc.text: From a temperature difference between source and absorber (the second-order Doppler shift).

physics:pound_rebka_tower.d.zs.desc.text: How many counting errors the whole effect amounts to.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.disturb.text: Vibration of the tower: the thermal shift wanders by ±10%·d.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.p.t.desc.text: How long the gamma rays are counted at this speed.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.p.v.desc.text: How fast the Doppler drive moves the source. Upward is positive.

physics:pound_rebka_tower.rate.desc.text: Shorter counts are faster; a taller tower measures more at once.

physics:pulsed_magnet_lab.c.burst.text: The magnetic pressure is tearing the coil apart

physics:pulsed_magnet_lab.d.Bf.desc.text: The field at the centre of the coil.

physics:pulsed_magnet_lab.d.dT.desc.text: How much the pulse heats the copper.

physics:pulsed_magnet_lab.disturb.text: Capacitor charge: the current varies by ±2%·d.

physics:pulsed_magnet_lab.p.t.desc.text: How long the field is held.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.aperture.text: Beam halo scraping the vacuum chamber

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.cryo.text: Interlock: dipoles and quadrupoles not superconducting (too warm)

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.focus_hi.text: Quadrupoles too strong: betatron motion unstable

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.focus_lo.text: Quadrupoles too weak: the beam is not focused

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the dipoles and quadrupoles quench

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.rf.text: RF cannot replace the synchrotron loss: beam lost

physics:quark_gluon_collider.c.space_cha.text: Space-charge tune shift too large: the beam blows up

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.Bf.desc.text: The field the beam actually sees: the set field plus the drifting field error.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.Bpole.des.text: Field at the quadrupole pole tip (aperture 3 cm).

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.E.desc.text: Total relativistic energy of one particle.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.U0.desc.text: Energy radiated per turn by a particle bent on radius ρ. Grows as γ⁴: light particles radiate enormously.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.bet.desc.text: Speed as a fraction of light.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.bmax.desc.text: Largest beta function in the lattice: the beam is widest here.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.dQ.desc.text: How much the beam's own charge defocuses it. Worst at low energy; above 0.25 the beam blows up.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.eBj.desc.text: Energy density reached in the overlap region (Bjorken estimate). Above ~1 GeV/fm³ hadrons melt into quark-gluon plasma.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.kq.desc.text: Normalised focusing strength of the quadrupoles.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.mu.desc.text: Betatron phase advance per FODO cell. 90° gives the smallest beam.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.p.desc.text: Momentum held on the design orbit of bending radius ρ.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.sNN.desc.text: Centre-of-mass energy per colliding nucleon pair, head-on. This is what decides what the collision can make.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.sig.desc.text: RMS beam radius at the widest point (normalised emittance 2 µm).

physics:quark_gluon_collider.d.x.desc.text: Half the FODO phase advance. Stable only between 0 and 1; 0.707 (μ = 90°) is ideal.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.disturb.text: Dipole field error (power-supply ripple, magnet hysteresis): the beam sees B·(1 ± 0.4%·d).

physics:quark_gluon_collider.p.B.desc.text: Field of the bending dipoles. Sets the momentum the ring can hold: p = 0.2998·q·B·ρ.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.p.G.desc.text: Focusing strength of the FODO quadrupoles. Too weak or too strong and the betatron motion is unstable.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.p.I.desc.text: Circulating current. More current, more collisions - and more space charge and radiated power.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.p.V.desc.text: Accelerating voltage per turn. Must at least replace what the beam radiates away each turn.

physics:quark_gluon_collider.rate.desc.text: Collision rate: the beam current, times how well the lattice focuses (best at μ = 90°).

physics:radio_telescope.c.sky.text: The dish has no view of the sky

physics:radio_telescope.d.SNR.desc.text: How far the source stands above the noise.

physics:radio_telescope.d.Sf.desc.text: The source's brightness at this frequency.

physics:radio_telescope.d.Tsys.desc.text: Noise the receiver hears from everything but the source.

physics:radio_telescope.d.dil.desc.text: The share of the band the line fills.

physics:radio_telescope.d.inb.desc.text: Positive: the line falls inside the band.

physics:radio_telescope.d.ts.desc.text: How much a pulse is spread across the band.

physics:radio_telescope.p.B.desc.text: How wide a band is taken in. Wider collects more noise-beating samples, but dilutes a line and smears a pulse.

physics:radio_telescope.p.nu.desc.text: Where the receiver is tuned. Cold hydrogen shines at 1420.4 MHz.

physics:radio_telescope.p.tau.desc.text: How long each point is observed.

physics:radio_telescope.rate.desc.text: A clearer detection is faster; very long integrations are slower.

physics:reality_compiler.c.threshold.text: Above the threshold: error correction makes things worse

physics:reality_compiler.d.Pq.desc.text: Heat leaking down the control wiring.

physics:reality_compiler.d.lgpL.desc.text: Logical error per cycle, as a power of ten.

physics:reality_compiler.d.pth.desc.text: Probability a qubit is thermally excited.

physics:reality_compiler.disturb.text: Control-line crosstalk: gate errors grow by 20%·|d|.

physics:reality_compiler.p.NL.desc.text: How many logical qubits the program uses.

physics:reality_compiler.p.clk.desc.text: Speed of the syndrome cycle. Faster gates make more errors.

physics:reality_compiler.p.fq.desc.text: Higher frequency, larger hf/kT - but more heat per qubit.

physics:reflecting_telescope.c.dark.text: The sky is too bright: a telescope works only at night

physics:reflecting_telescope.c.sky.text: Something blocks the sky above the slit

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.fr.desc.text: In exposures shorter than the air's coherence time (about 50 ms) the seeing is partly frozen.

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.mlim.desc.text: The faintest star the plate records. Each magnitude is 2.5 times fainter.

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.msky.desc.text: Darker skies have larger numbers. The Moon brightens it by up to 3 magnitudes.

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.res.desc.text: The size of a star's image on the plate.

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.see.desc.text: How far the turbulent air smears a star. It improves the higher the telescope stands.

physics:reflecting_telescope.d.th.desc.text: The finest detail the mirror itself can split, for green light.

physics:reflecting_telescope.p.D.desc.text: How much of the primary mirror is used. More gathers more light and resolves finer.

physics:reflecting_telescope.p.t.desc.text: How long the plate is open. Longer reaches fainter stars - and lets the air blur them.

physics:reflecting_telescope.rate.desc.text: Deeper than the target needs is faster; very long exposures are slower.

physics:research_nexus.disturb.text: Systematic drift: the signal estimate wanders by ±5%·d.

physics:research_nexus.p.Kh.desc.text: Searches run in parallel. Faster, but every extra look dilutes the significance.

physics:research_nexus.p.Lint.desc.text: How much data is taken. More data, more significance - and more time.

physics:research_nexus.p.cut.desc.text: How hard events are selected. Signal survives as 1 − c³, background as (1 − c)².

physics:research_nexus.rate.desc.text: Less data and more parallel searches finish sooner.

physics:solar_furnace.c.sun.text: The Sun is too low (or down)

physics:solar_furnace.d.G.desc.text: Sunlight arriving now, by the Sun's height.

physics:solar_furnace.d.Tt.desc.text: Where the target radiates away what it absorbs.

physics:solar_furnace.d.q.desc.text: Power falling on each square metre of the target.

physics:solar_furnace.disturb.text: Thin cloud: the sunlight varies by ±3%·d.

physics:solar_furnace.p.C.desc.text: How many suns the heliostats and the mirror bring to the target.

physics:solar_furnace.p.g.desc.text: The louvres in front of the target. Close them to hold the temperature down.

physics:solar_furnace.rate.desc.text: The hotter above its melting point, the faster the charge melts.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.c.beta_l.text: β above the Troyon limit: the plasma disrupts

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.c.cryo.text: Interlock: toroidal field coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.c.greenw.text: Above the Greenwald density: radiative collapse, disruption

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.c.kink.text: Safety factor below 2: external kink, disruption

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the toroidal field coils quench

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Bc.des.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Bpk.de.text: Field on the inner leg of the toroidal coils, where it is highest.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Pbr.de.text: Radiation from electrons braking on ions. Grows with Z_eff.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Pch.de.text: Part of the fusion power that stays in the plasma and heats it.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Pfus.d.text: Total fusion power of the plasma.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Ploss..text: Power crossing the plasma edge (sets the confinement scaling).

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Qf.des.text: Fusion power out per heating power in.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.Zeff.d.text: Average ion charge including impurities; drives radiation losses.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.blim.d.text: Above this the plasma goes unstable and disrupts.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.nG.des.text: Above this density the edge radiates and the plasma disrupts.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.q95.de.text: Field-line winding at the edge. Below 2 the kink mode tears the plasma apart.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.sv.des.text: Fusion reactivity of the fuel at the plasma temperature (Gamow form; E_G is the Gamow energy).

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.tauE.d.text: Energy confinement time, IPB98(y,2) scaling law.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.d.trip.d.text: Lawson's figure of merit. Deuterium-tritium ignites near 30.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.disturb.text: Impurity influx from the wall: Z_eff rises by up to 30% (d = −1 clean ... +1 dirty), and bremsstrahlung with it.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.p.Bt.des.text: Field on the plasma axis. Raises the β limit and the safety factor.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.p.Ip.des.text: Current driven through the plasma. Improves confinement (τ_E ∝ I^0.93) and the density limit, but lowers the safety factor.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.p.Pa.des.text: Neutral beams and RF heating power put into the plasma.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.p.n.desc.text: Ion density. Fusion power grows as n², but so does bremsstrahlung, and there is the Greenwald limit.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.rate.des.text: Smelting rate follows the power heating the plasma: fusion heating plus your own.

physics:stellar_plasma_crucible.s.Tp.des.text: Ion temperature. Rises while heating beats losses: dT/dt = (P_aux + P_α − P_br − W/τ_E)/(3nV).

physics:synchrotron.c.aperture.text: Beam halo scraping the vacuum chamber

physics:synchrotron.c.cryo.text: Interlock: dipoles and quadrupoles not superconducting (too warm)

physics:synchrotron.c.focus_hi.text: Quadrupoles too strong: betatron motion unstable

physics:synchrotron.c.focus_lo.text: Quadrupoles too weak: the beam is not focused

physics:synchrotron.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the dipoles and quadrupoles quench

physics:synchrotron.c.rf.text: RF cannot replace the synchrotron loss: beam lost

physics:synchrotron.c.space_charge.text: Space-charge tune shift too large: the beam blows up

physics:synchrotron.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:synchrotron.d.Bf.desc.text: The field the beam actually sees: the set field plus the drifting field error.

physics:synchrotron.d.Bpole.desc.text: Field at the quadrupole pole tip (aperture 3 cm).

physics:synchrotron.d.E.desc.text: Total relativistic energy of one particle.

physics:synchrotron.d.U0.desc.text: Energy radiated per turn by a particle bent on radius ρ. Grows as γ⁴: light particles radiate enormously.

physics:synchrotron.d.bet.desc.text: Speed as a fraction of light.

physics:synchrotron.d.bmax.desc.text: Largest beta function in the lattice: the beam is widest here.

physics:synchrotron.d.dQ.desc.text: How much the beam's own charge defocuses it. Worst at low energy; above 0.25 the beam blows up.

physics:synchrotron.d.kq.desc.text: Normalised focusing strength of the quadrupoles.

physics:synchrotron.d.mu.desc.text: Betatron phase advance per FODO cell. 90° gives the smallest beam.

physics:synchrotron.d.p.desc.text: Momentum held on the design orbit of bending radius ρ.

physics:synchrotron.d.sig.desc.text: RMS beam radius at the widest point (normalised emittance 2 µm).

physics:synchrotron.d.x.desc.text: Half the FODO phase advance. Stable only between 0 and 1; 0.707 (μ = 90°) is ideal.

physics:synchrotron.disturb.text: Dipole field error (power-supply ripple, magnet hysteresis): the beam sees B·(1 ± 0.4%·d).

physics:synchrotron.p.B.desc.text: Field of the bending dipoles. Sets the momentum the ring can hold: p = 0.2998·q·B·ρ.

physics:synchrotron.p.G.desc.text: Focusing strength of the FODO quadrupoles. Too weak or too strong and the betatron motion is unstable.

physics:synchrotron.p.I.desc.text: Circulating current. More current, more collisions - and more space charge and radiated power.

physics:synchrotron.p.V.desc.text: Accelerating voltage per turn. Must at least replace what the beam radiates away each turn.

physics:synchrotron.rate.desc.text: Collision rate: the beam current, times how well the lattice focuses (best at μ = 90°).

physics:tectonic_press.d.Pdg.desc.text: Above it diamond is stable, below it graphite.

physics:tectonic_press.d.Pe.desc.text: The pressure the sample feels, after gasket creep.

physics:tectonic_press.d.Pps.desc.text: Above it ringwoodite breaks down to bridgmanite and periclase. Its slope is negative.

physics:tectonic_press.d.Prw.desc.text: Above it olivine has become ringwoodite.

physics:tectonic_press.d.kin.desc.text: How fast the sample reacts, relative to the recipe's reference temperature.

physics:tectonic_press.d.z.desc.text: How deep in the Earth this pressure is found.

physics:tectonic_press.disturb.text: Gasket creep: the sample sees P·(1 ± 2%·d).

physics:tectonic_press.p.P.desc.text: Pressure on the sample. 1 GPa is about 30 km down.

physics:tesla_coil.c.flashover.text: Flashover down the secondary: above 5 MV it arcs along its own winding

physics:tesla_coil.d.fs.desc.text: Where the secondary rings (50 mH, 20 pF).

physics:tesla_coil.d.mis.desc.text: How far apart the two are.

physics:tesla_coil.disturb.text: Spark-gap jitter: the primary's frequency wanders by ±0.5%·d.

physics:tesla_coil.p.Np.desc.text: Where on the flat spiral the primary is tapped: its inductance grows as the square.

physics:tesla_coil.p.Vin.desc.text: The voltage the bank is charged to before the gap fires.

physics:tesla_coil.rate.desc.text: Longer arcs work the charge faster.

physics:tesseract_assembler.c.cryo.text: Interlock: radion-stabiliser coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:tesseract_assembler.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the radion-stabiliser coils quench

physics:tesseract_assembler.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:tesseract_assembler.d.Vp.desc.text: Volume of the 3-D shadow of the unit tesseract: 1 face-on, up to √3 tilted.

physics:tesseract_assembler.d.m1.desc.text: Mass of the lightest Kaluza-Klein excitation.

physics:tesseract_assembler.disturb.text: Rotation-stage backlash: the xw angle is α + 0.5°·d.

physics:tesseract_assembler.p.Bs.desc.text: Field holding the radion (the size of R₅) in place.

physics:tesseract_assembler.p.R5.desc.text: Radius of the curled-up fifth dimension.

physics:tesseract_assembler.p.al.desc.text: Rotation of the 4-cube in the x-w plane.

physics:tesseract_assembler.p.be.desc.text: Rotation of the 4-cube in the y-w plane.

physics:tesseract_assembler.rate.desc.text: Assembly runs at a fixed pace.

physics:time_dilation_chamber.c.fallen.text: The samples have fallen through the horizon

physics:time_dilation_chamber.d.f.desc.text: How much slower the samples' clocks run.

physics:time_dilation_chamber.p.Mc.desc.text: The mass at the chamber's heart.

physics:time_dilation_chamber.p.r.desc.text: How close to the core the samples are held.

physics:time_dilation_chamber.rate.desc.text: More dilation, and a bigger chamber, do more.

physics:tokamak.c.cryo.text: The superconducting coils are too warm

physics:tokamak.c.disrupt.text: The plasma has disrupted: its pressure beat the field

physics:tokamak.c.quench.text: The superconducting coils have quenched (too much field)

physics:tokamak.d.L3.desc.text: Lawson's figure of merit. D-T ignites at 3.

physics:tokamak.d.tau.desc.text: How long the plasma keeps its heat.

physics:tokamak.disturb.text: Edge turbulence: the confinement time varies by ±5%·d.

physics:tokamak.p.B.desc.text: The field holding the plasma off the wall.

physics:tokamak.p.Ti.desc.text: How hot the plasma is (1 keV is 11.6 million kelvin).

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.c.beta.text: β above the Troyon limit: the plasma disrupts

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.c.cryo.text: Interlock: toroidal field coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.c.gree.text: Above the Greenwald density: radiative collapse, disruption

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.c.kink.text: Safety factor below 2: external kink, disruption

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.c.quen.text: Field above the critical field: the toroidal field coils quench

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Bc.d.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Bpk..text: Field on the inner leg of the toroidal coils, where it is highest.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Pbr..text: Radiation from electrons braking on ions. Grows with Z_eff.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Pch..text: Part of the fusion power that stays in the plasma and heats it.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Pfus.text: Total fusion power of the plasma.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Plos.text: Power crossing the plasma edge (sets the confinement scaling).

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Qf.d.text: Fusion power out per heating power in.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.Zeff.text: Average ion charge including impurities; drives radiation losses.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.blim.text: Above this the plasma goes unstable and disrupts.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.nG.d.text: Above this density the edge radiates and the plasma disrupts.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.q95..text: Field-line winding at the edge. Below 2 the kink mode tears the plasma apart.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.sv.d.text: Fusion reactivity of the fuel at the plasma temperature (Gamow form; E_G is the Gamow energy).

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.tauE.text: Energy confinement time, IPB98(y,2) scaling law.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.d.trip.text: Lawson's figure of merit. Deuterium-tritium ignites near 30.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.distur.text: Impurity influx from the wall: Z_eff rises by up to 30% (d = −1 clean ... +1 dirty), and bremsstrahlung with it.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.p.Bt.d.text: Field on the plasma axis. Raises the β limit and the safety factor.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.p.Ip.d.text: Current driven through the plasma. Improves confinement (τ_E ∝ I^0.93) and the density limit, but lowers the safety factor.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.p.Pa.d.text: Neutral beams and RF heating power put into the plasma.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.p.n.de.text: Ion density. Fusion power grows as n², but so does bremsstrahlung, and there is the Greenwald limit.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.rate.d.text: Smelting rate follows the power heating the plasma: fusion heating plus your own.

physics:transcendent_plasma_forge.s.Tp.d.text: Ion temperature. Rises while heating beats losses: dT/dt = (P_aux + P_α − P_br − W/τ_E)/(3nV).

physics:universe_forge.c.cryo.text: Interlock: inflaton-trap coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:universe_forge.c.horizon.text: Inflation too short: the horizon problem is not solved

physics:universe_forge.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the inflaton-trap coils quench

physics:universe_forge.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:universe_forge.d.lgAs.desc.text: Amplitude of the density perturbations. Ours: 2.1×10⁻⁹ (log −8.68).

physics:universe_forge.d.ns.desc.text: Tilt of the primordial spectrum. Ours: 0.965 ± 0.004.

physics:universe_forge.d.phis.desc.text: Inflaton value when the CMB scales left the horizon.

physics:universe_forge.disturb.text: Inflaton coupling noise: the power p seen is p + 0.01·d.

physics:universe_forge.p.Ns.desc.text: How many e-folds of inflation remain after today's largest scales left the horizon.

physics:universe_forge.p.p.desc.text: Shape of the potential V ∝ φᵖ.

physics:universe_forge.rate.desc.text: The forge runs at a fixed pace.

physics:unruh_accelerator.c.rf.text: The cavities cannot replace what the beam radiates

physics:unruh_accelerator.d.Tu.desc.text: How warm the vacuum looks to the beam.

physics:unruh_accelerator.disturb.text: Beam energy jitter: γ varies by ±1%·d.

physics:unruh_accelerator.p.Bb.desc.text: The field that bends the beam round the ring.

physics:unruh_accelerator.rate.desc.text: A more energetic beam works faster.

physics:vacuum_harvester.c.avalanche.text: Parametric instability: the photon number runs away

physics:vacuum_harvester.c.cryo.text: Interlock: mirror-drive coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:vacuum_harvester.c.drive.text: Mirror drive too weak for that modulation depth

physics:vacuum_harvester.c.qreach.text: The cavity cannot reach that Q at this temperature

physics:vacuum_harvester.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the mirror-drive coils quench

physics:vacuum_harvester.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:vacuum_harvester.d.Gp.desc.text: Below 1 the cavity amplifies the vacuum stably; at 1 it runs away.

physics:vacuum_harvester.d.Nph.desc.text: Real quanta created per mode per modulation period.

physics:vacuum_harvester.d.Qmax.desc.text: Best Q the superconducting cavity reaches at this temperature.

physics:vacuum_harvester.disturb.text: Mirror drive phase noise: the gain varies by ±2%·d.

physics:vacuum_harvester.p.Bm.desc.text: Field of the magnetic mirror drive (ε ≤ 0.002·B).

physics:vacuum_harvester.p.lgQ.desc.text: Loaded quality factor, as a power of ten. Higher Q stores the created quanta longer.

physics:vacuum_harvester.p.nu.desc.text: Which virtual particle the cavity is tuned to. Match the Foam's local resonance (use a Field Calibrator to see it).

physics:vacuum_harvester.rate.desc.text: Harvest rate follows the quanta created per stroke.

physics:warp_field_forge.c.exotic.text: More negative energy than the forge can hold

physics:warp_field_forge.d.E.desc.text: How much negative energy the wall needs.

physics:warp_field_forge.d.Rs.desc.text: How sharp the wall is for its bubble.

physics:warp_field_forge.d.tid.desc.text: The tidal shear across the wall. A passenger is torn apart above 5.

physics:warp_field_forge.disturb.text: Casimir supply: the negative energy needed varies by ±5%·d.

physics:warp_field_forge.p.R.desc.text: The size of the flat region inside.

physics:warp_field_forge.p.v.desc.text: How fast the bubble is to move, in units of the speed of light.

physics:white_hole_emitter.c.blowout.text: Radiation pressure exceeds the magnetic pressure: blow-out

physics:white_hole_emitter.c.cryo.text: Interlock: confinement coils not superconducting (too warm)

physics:white_hole_emitter.c.quench.text: Field above the critical field: the confinement coils quench

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.Bc.desc.text: The highest field the coil conductor can carry while superconducting, at the present cold-mass temperature. Hotter means lower.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.LEdd.desc.text: Luminosity at which radiation pressure balances gravity.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.edd.desc.text: Above 1 the outflow is super-Eddington and batters the chamber.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.inflow.desc.text: Gas captured from the chamber vacuum.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.lgL.desc.text: Luminosity as a power of ten.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.pmag.desc.text: Pressure the confinement field can hold back.

physics:white_hole_emitter.d.prad.desc.text: Radiation pressure on the 3 m chamber wall.

physics:white_hole_emitter.disturb.text: Chamber outgassing: the residual gas pressure fluctuates by a factor 10^(0.3·d).

physics:white_hole_emitter.p.Bcf.desc.text: Magnetic field holding the radiation pressure off the walls.

physics:white_hole_emitter.p.lgM.desc.text: Mass of the white hole, as a power of ten. Sets its Eddington luminosity.

physics:white_hole_emitter.p.lgP.desc.text: Residual gas pressure. Gas falling in is what makes white holes collapse.

physics:white_hole_emitter.s.xacc.desc.text: Matter piled up at the horizon, as a fraction of the Eardley threshold. At 1 the white hole collapses into a black hole.

physics:wormhole_projector.c.exotic.text: Not enough exotic matter: the throat pinches off

physics:wormhole_projector.c.tidal.text: Tidal forces would shred the cargo

physics:wormhole_projector.d.Mreq.desc.text: Exotic mass needed to hold the throat open.

physics:wormhole_projector.d.tide.desc.text: Stretching across a 25 cm crate. Over 100 g it is torn apart.

physics:wormhole_projector.disturb.text: Exotic-matter leakage: the throat needs M·(1 ± 2%·d).

physics:wormhole_projector.p.Mx.desc.text: Negative-energy matter supplied to the throat, in Jupiter masses.

physics:wormhole_projector.p.v.desc.text: Speed of cargo through the throat.

physics:wormhole_projector.rate.desc.text: A wider throat passes more cargo at once.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.c.kedge.text: Below copper's K-edge: no Kα line

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.d.Pa.desc.text: Heat the anode has to shed.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.d.dm.desc.text: The lattice spacing this angle picks out.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.d.err.desc.text: How far that is from the crystal's own spacing.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.d.th.desc.text: The glancing angle on the lattice planes.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.disturb.text: Thermal drift of the goniometer: the angle wanders by ±0.05°·d.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.p.I.desc.text: Electrons per second onto the anode. More current, more X-rays - and more heat in the anode.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.p.V.desc.text: The voltage across the X-ray tube. Copper's Kα line appears only above 8.98 kV.

physics:x_ray_diffractometer.p.tt.desc.text: The angle between the incoming beam and the detector.

advancements:frontier_arrival.descriptio.text: Ride starlight to the Accretion Frontier.

advancements:interior_arrival.descriptio.text: Drill through the floor of the world into the Planetary Interior.

boss:alpha_omega.genesis_1.text: I am what your engine was made of: every law you broke apart to build it.

boss:alpha_omega.genesis_2.text: You took the universe to pieces. Do you understand any of them?

boss:alpha_omega.genesis_3.text: Why does a clock slow down? What is a measurement? How many infinities are there?

boss:alpha_omega.genesis_4.text: And why did you do it - to make, to know, or to be?

boss:alpha_omega.genesis_5.text: Come inside. Show me what you understand.

boss:alpha_omega.proof_2.text: One last question. Everything depends on it.

boss:alpha_omega.shielded.text: It has closed itself into a proof. Answer at the pedestals.

cinematic:rekindled.subtitle.text: Its Echo has been played back into being. Everything exists again.

commands:radiation.reset.text: Cleared the radiation dose of %s (and in Mekanism and GregTech, where installed)

commands:radiation.set.text: Set the radiation dose of %s to %s

death.attack:basaltic_magma.player.text: %1$s was melted into the mantle whilst fighting %2$s

death.attack:stellar_heat.player.text: %1$s was dissolved into plasma whilst fighting %2$s

env:min_y_or.text: At y %s or higher, or in %s

gui:attune.awake.text: AWAKE - in tune with this place

gui:attune.compact_help.text: Drag the track, or scroll on it (Shift: x10, Ctrl: x100).

gui:attune.hint.abnormality.text: While uncontained, the anomaly spreads: it nudges the other branches and clouds every other reading. Contain it first.

gui:attune.hint.biology.text: Living parameters: what is measured is what they settle into together, not each one on its own.

gui:attune.hint.chemistry.text: The three reagents always add up to a whole: raising one lowers the other two.

gui:attune.hint.finality.text: Entropy creeps up while you work on a dormant Core: leave it a little low, and wake the Core soon after.

gui:attune.hint.mathematics.text: Whole numbers, exact or nothing. Each lamp is one law: a mod 7, a times b mod 11, a + b + n mod 13, and n prime.

gui:attune.hint.origin.text: Phases wrap round. The first is absolute; each of the others counts from the one before it.

gui:attune.hint.physics.text: Three plain fields. But its target leans on Abnormality, the branch before it in the ring.

gui:attune.ring.text: each leans on the one before

gui:attune.wake_help.text: Wake the Core: every branch must be in tune (Mathematics: all four laws). Costs one action of the Hand's Eschaton Charge.

gui:codex.centre_tip.text: Go back to where this map begins (C or Home)

gui:codex.create.tip.text: Bring the creature into being at the block you are looking at

gui:codex.damage.tip.text: Multiply the attack damage of every mob in this dimension (never players)

gui:codex.entity.tip.text: The creature to create, or to transmute the target into

gui:codex.fit_tip.text: Zoom out until every node of this map is on screen (F)

gui:codex.gravity.tip.text: Multiply gravity for every living thing in this dimension

gui:codex.gravity.zero.tip.text: No gravity at all: everything that leaves the ground drifts

gui:codex.heal.tip.text: Restore the target to full health

gui:codex.health.tip.text: Multiply the maximum health of every mob in this dimension (never players)

gui:codex.hostile.tip.text: Whether monsters arise on their own in this dimension. Spawners and eggs still work

gui:codex.intro_1.text: Begin at the glowing "Start Here" node and follow the numbered steps downwards - each opens as you get there.

gui:codex.intro_2.text: Drag to move the map, mouse wheel to zoom, hover a node to light up what it links to, click to read. Search: bottom right.

gui:codex.intro_3.text: Sneak + use the Codex (or the Research button) opens the Research Tree. In an inventory, hover an item and press %s to look it up.

gui:codex.locked_page.text: This entry is still locked.$(br2)Research $(thing)%s$() to read it.

gui:codex.map_tip.text: Drag (or use the arrow keys) to move the map. Mouse wheel to zoom.

gui:codex.missing.text: The Codex data is missing (a resource pack may have removed it).

gui:codex.next_none.text: Nothing waiting: gather Insight with the Spectral Analyzer, or explore the map.

gui:codex.next_open_research.text: Click to open the Research Tree

gui:codex.next_steps_tip.text: What you can do now: research ready to start, and guide steps not read yet (N)

gui:codex.no_recipe.text: Recipe %s is not loaded in this world.

gui:codex.pacify.tip.text: The target will never again turn on a player

gui:codex.passive.tip.text: Whether animals and other peaceful creatures arise on their own in this dimension

gui:codex.research_tip.text: Open the research tree (sneak-using the Codex opens it too)

gui:codex.restore.tip.text: Undo every rewritten law of this dimension: gravity, spawning and mob strength

gui:codex.rewrite.none.text: Rewrite: no target (look at a creature when opening)

gui:codex.speed.tip.text: Multiply the speed of every mob in this dimension (never players)

gui:codex.time.tip.text: Move the sun. Dimensions that share the Overworld's clock move with it

gui:codex.transmute.tip.text: Turn the target into the creature named in the Create box; it keeps its name

gui:codex.weather.tip.text: Set the weather for the next ten minutes

gui:collapse_body.text: Running this recipe cannot be undone. The engine and its whole structure will be destroyed and fold into a five-dimensional object that drags everything near it inside. Proceed?

gui:compactor_instant.text: No timer: fills as fast as you feed it

gui:compactor_needs.text: Needs %s in total - feed it any amount at a time

gui:console.scope_plain.text: How it has moved over the last eight seconds.

gui:console.scope_window.text: The green band is the window the recipe needs this quantity held in; the line turns red outside it.

gui:core_forge_locked.text: The Forge wakes only in a Core that has been destroyed and rebuilt.

gui:core_shutdown_warn.text: Initiating the Shutdown Sequence destroys the Transcendental in 60 seconds. Nobody will be able to enter it again until it is rebuilt. What is left of the Core becomes the material of everything beyond it.

gui:law.1.text: c - the speed of light, the limit of cause

gui:law.2.text: h-bar - the grain of action, the scale of the quantum

gui:law.3.text: alpha - the fine-structure constant, the strength of light on matter

gui:law.4.text: Lambda - the cosmological constant, the push of the vacuum

gui:law.5.text: k_B - Boltzmann's constant, the exchange rate of entropy

gui:law_hint.text: Click the arrows (or the scale), or scroll; shift: x10

gui:nexus_tip.text: A Research Nexus can speed this up (dossier tier %s or better)

gui:omega_needs_omnilex.text: The aleph-null overclock: carry the Omnilex to set it.

gui:omega_tip.text: An overclock that should not exist

gui:omega_tip_on.text: The aleph-null overclock is SET. Press to release it.

gui:phys.coil_tc.text: Coil tier %s: Tc %s K, Bc2(0) %s T

gui:phys.coolant_tank.hint.text: Pipe in any coolant, or click with a filled container

gui:phys.edit_hint.text: Click to type a value (1.5e3 works). Scroll to step; Shift ×10, Ctrl ×100.

gui:phys.kind.damage.text: If broken: containment loses integrity every second.

gui:phys.kind.quench.text: If broken: a quench - stored energy dumps as heat, containment takes a hit, 8 s to recover.

gui:phys.kind.stop.text: If broken: the machine will not run.

gui:phys.kind.wear.text: If broken: containment wears four times as fast.

gui:phys.no_coolant.text: No coolant - shedding heat to air only

gui:phys.spent_tank.hint.text: Drain it (e.g. warm helium back to the condenser) or the loop stops

gui:puzzle_derived_tip.text: Equation derived - solve it to begin.

gui:puzzle_tip.text: Needs a derivation: build and solve its equation.

gui:review_tip.text: Click to read its derivation again.

gui:tank_hint_in.text: Click with a fluid container to pour in (or drain)

gui:tank_hint_out.text: Click with an empty container to drain

gui:zoom_tip.text: Zoom (mouse wheel, + / -). Ctrl + wheel scrolls, Shift + wheel scrolls sideways, drag to pan.

key:codex_lookup.text: Look up in the Quantum Codex

message:akashic_creative.text: The Akashic Record opens only in creative mode.

message:akashic_done.text: The Akashic Record: %s research entries learned, and every symbol.

message:altar_full.text: Take the last result off the altar first.

message:altar_no_core.text: Put the core item on the altar first.

message:altar_no_recipe.text: Nothing converges: no recipe matches the altar and the pedestals around it.

message:altar_research.text: You do not understand this convergence yet (research needed).

message:altar_status.text: Converging: %s%% - %s FE stored, %s FE per tick

message:altar_weak.text: These pedestals cannot carry it: every pedestal in use must be of grade %s or better.

message:analyzer_idle.text: The machine is idle - nothing to observe.

message:antiverse_arrival.text: Everything is the same, and everything is the opposite. Do not touch anything.

message:antiwater_burns.text: The antiwater is annihilating against you!

message:assembler_blocked.text: %s position(s) are obstructed (marked) - clear them yourself; the assembler never breaks blocks.

message:assembler_bound.text: Structure Assembler bound to the ME network at %s

message:assembler_disassemble_confirm.text: Use again within 5 seconds to take apart %s block(s).

message:assembler_disassemble_dropped.text: Your inventory was full: the rest is on the ground at your feet.

message:assembler_disassemble_kept.text: %s block(s) could not be removed here (protected or unbreakable).

message:frontier_return.text: Starlight carries you home - the sail slows your fall.

message:shutdown.10.text: [Omnipotence] Ten. What I was will be scattered as shards. Gather them.

message:shutdown.20.text: [Omnipotence] The halo is falling. Leave, or be carried out.

message:shutdown.30.text: [Omnipotence] Thirty seconds. I have made everything you asked of me. I have never been asked to stop.

message:shutdown.40.text: [Omnipotence] The reliquaries are returning what they held to nothing.

message:shutdown.50.text: [Omnipotence] Releasing the laws I was holding. The rim of the world is coming loose.

message:shutdown.60.text: [Omnipotence] Shutdown Sequence accepted. I will stop in sixty seconds.

message:shutdown.done.text: The Transcendental is gone. In your hands: what is left of Omnipotence.

message:shutdown.world.text: Somewhere beyond every law, the Transcendental has been destroyed.

message:variance_hall.text: The odds in this hall feel thinner than they should.

message:void_accretion_frontier.text: You fall off the edge of the Frontier - and the light sail's tether drags you home.

message:void_antiverse.text: You fall out of the bottom of the Antiverse - and back into your own universe.

message:void_black_hole_interior.text: The singularity crushes you through - and a white hole spits you out.

message:void_hyperdimensional_reality.text: You fall between the branches of the World Tree, into the Bulk.

message:void_platonic_realm.text: Beneath the last Form lies the first infinity. You fall into the Transfinite Hierarchy.

message:void_proof.text: The proof will not let you fall out of it.

message:void_quantum_foam.text: The foam lets go of you, and you settle into the Bulk.

message:void_the_bulk.text: You fall off the edge of the Bulk - and land back on our own brane.

message:void_transcendental.text: You fall out of the Transcendental, back into Hyperdimensional Reality.

message:void_transfinite_hierarchy.text: Below every ordinal there is only foam. You fall into the Quantum Foam.

message:void_white_hole_interior.text: The white hole expels you back into ordinary space.

message:warp_anchored.text: The bubble closes round this place. Use it to come back here, once.

message:warp_lost.text: The place this bubble was anchored to no longer exists.

proof:already.text: Alpha Omega is already examining you.

proof:boss_sub.text: Every concept, rule and dimension - in one.

proof:bulk.lesson.text: Our space is a brane in something larger.

proof:bulk.rule.text: Answer five questions about spacetime and its extra dimensions at the pedestals.

proof:codex.lesson.text: Everything you built was written down.

proof:codex.rule.text: Answer five questions about what you have done to get here.

proof:diagonal.lesson.text: Change every diagonal digit and no list can contain you.

proof:diagonal.rule.text: Six numbers hang on the wall. Make a seventh that no list could contain. Cantor needed only one line to do it.

proof:diagonal.steps.text:
HOW TO ESCAPE
1. On the wall, lit lamps are 1 and dark lamps are 0. Each row is one number.
2. The gold [digits] run down the diagonal: digit 1 of Number 1, digit 2 of Number 2 ... digit 6 of Number 6.
3. Flip your switches below so each of YOUR digits is the OPPOSITE of the gold digit in the same column.
4. Touch the pedestal. Your number now differs from every number on the wall, so it cannot be on the list.

proof:diagonal.wrong.text: The list already knows that number. It rewrites itself - read it again.

proof:enter_sub.text: Understand where you are, and it will let you go.

proof:failed.died.text: The proof closes over you. The Omnilex will find its way back to your hands.

proof:failed.left.text: You left the proof unfinished. The Omnilex will find its way back to your hands.

proof:forms.rule.text: Answer five questions about shape and dimension at the pedestals.

proof:forms.voice.text: Perfection is rarer than you think.

proof:foundations.rule.text: Answer five questions about quanta, information and proof at the pedestals.

proof:hotel.lesson.text: Infinity can be full and still have room.

proof:hotel.rule.text: Answer five questions about infinity at the pedestals.

proof:hotel.voice.text: A full infinite hotel always has room.

proof:measurement.lesson.text: Observation changes the observed. Measure nothing you want to keep.

proof:measurement.observed.text: You looked at it. It is somewhere else now.

proof:measurement.rule.text: Step on the exit plate. Here, whatever is observed collapses somewhere else.

proof:proper_time.lesson.text: Moving clocks run slow - and the still ones are easy targets.

proof:proper_time.rule.text: Live through 20 seconds of your own time. Your clock only runs while you are at rest. The singularity strikes where you stand.

proof:qed_sub.text: The proof is complete. It begins to melt.

proof:question_n.text: Correct answers: %s / %s (a wrong answer costs two)

proof:stranded.text: The proof you stood in is no longer being argued. You wake where you last slept.

proof:won_sub.text: Alpha Omega lets you go - and leaves you its proof.

scepter:mode.big_bang.desc.text: A new universe for an instant: a vast blast that leaves every block untouched

scepter:mode.black_hole.desc.text: A singularity that drags creatures within 8 blocks inward for 3 s, then crushes them

scepter:mode.entanglement.desc.text: Strike up to 8 creatures near the target as one entangled state

scepter:mode.tesseract.desc.text: Fold space: step to the point you are looking at

scepter:mode.white_hole.desc.text: Matter pours out of nothing, hurling everything nearby away and hurting it

status:not_yet_forged.text: Forge it once by hand first

transit:accretion_frontier.flavour.text: Starlight presses on the sail. The stars crowd ahead, and something dark waits among them.

transit:accretion_frontier.flavour_leavi.text: The sail turns for home. The black hole shrinks behind you to a point.

transit:antiverse.flavour.text: Charge, parity and time reversed. Touch nothing you brought with you.

transit:antiverse.flavour_leaving.text: Through the mirror again, back into a universe made of matter.

transit:black_hole_interior.flavour.text: Past the event horizon, every road leads to the centre.

transit:black_hole_interior.flavour_leav.text: Climbing out of a black hole. This should be impossible.

transit:hyperdimensional_reality.flavour.text: More directions than you have names for. The World Tree waits above the Ocean of Law.
The extra dimensions fold away. Three will have to do.

transit:living_proof.flavour.text: Inside Alpha Omega's mind, every step must follow from the last.

transit:living_proof.flavour_leaving.text: Q.E.D. The proof lets you go.

transit:planetary_interior.flavour.text: Crust, mantle, and below: the rock grows hotter with every kilometre.

transit:planetary_interior.flavour_leavi.text: The layers fall away beneath you. Cool rock, then daylight.

transit:platonic_realm.flavour.text: Every shadow on the cave wall gives way to its perfect form.

transit:platonic_realm.flavour_leaving.text: Back among the shadows. The forms stay true without you.

transit:quantum_foam.flavour.text: Shrinking past the Planck length, where space itself boils.

transit:quantum_foam.flavour_leaving.text: The bubbles shrink to nothing as you grow back into the world.

transit:the_bulk.flavour.text: Our brane peels away. Between the membranes, gravity alone can follow you.

transit:the_bulk.flavour_leaving.text: The membranes close in. You settle back onto our own brane.

transit:transfinite_hierarchy.flavour.text: Remove the middle third. Repeat forever. Keep counting past infinity.

transit:transfinite_hierarchy.flavour_le.text: Back to finite numbers, where every count comes to an end.

transit:white_hole_interior.flavour.text: Time runs backwards here: nothing may enter, everything is thrown out.

transit:white_hole_interior.flavour_leav.text: Flung out of the white hole and back into ordinary time.
